papers.title: Verifiable Knowledge Expansion through Retrieval-Grounded Formal Concept Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Ontology construction requires deciding which objects, attributes, and structural relations should be accepted as valid knowledge. Language models can propose such structures from text, but their outputs can still be unsupported or inconsistent. This paper proposes a retrieval-augmented small language model (SLM) framework that uses formal concept analysis (FCA) as a symbolic verification loop for knowledge expansion. Starting from seed attributes, FCA proposes implications over a growing formal context. A retrieval-grounded SLM oracle then validates each implication or returns a counterexample. The oracle also supports incidence judgments, consistency checks, and attribute proposals, making accepted implications, counterexamples, contradictions, and corrections inspectable. In a rare ataxia setting constructed from Orphadata resources, retrieval-grounded 10-seed runs obtain relation F1 of 0.29-0.52 and closure-based implication F1 of 0.22-0.30. Larger seed sets increase the number of evaluated implications and often improve implication F1. The lower implication scores reflect a stricter evaluation of derived implications, where one missed or extra relation can affect several implication judgments. Ablations show that incidence judgments in a fixed object-attribute setting can improve closure-based implication scores. However, identifying positive object-attribute pairs remains difficult even when the candidate objects and attributes are fixed.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, Accepted to the 8th epiDAMIK ACM SIGKDD International Workshop on Epidemiology meets Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery (epiDAMIK 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于检索增强的小语言模型框架，利用形式概念分析（FCA）作为符号验证循环，用于知识扩展。从种子属性开始，FCA在增长的形式上下文中提出蕴含关系，检索接地SLM预言机验证每个蕴含或返回反例。在罕见共济失调数据集上，关系F1为0.29-0.52，蕴含F1为0.22-0.30。
Motivation: 本体构建需要确定哪些对象、属性和结构关系应被接受为有效知识，语言模型的输出可能缺乏支持或不一致，需要可验证的知识扩展方法。
Method: 提出检索增强的小语言模型框架，以形式概念分析作为符号验证循环，通过SLM预言机验证蕴含、判断关联、检查一致性和提出属性，使接受的过程可检查。
Result: 在罕见共济失调数据集中，10个种子运行的关系F1为0.29-0.52，闭包蕴含F1为0.22-0.30；更大种子集增加评估蕴含数并改善蕴含F1；消融实验显示固定对象-属性设置中的关联判断可改善闭包蕴含分数。
Conclusion: 框架实现了可验证的知识扩展，但识别正对象-属性对仍然困难，即使对象和属性固定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-Empowered Multimodal Fusion Framework for Autonomous Driving: Semantic Enhancement and Channel-Adaptive Design
papers.abstract_en: Vision-radar fusion is central to robust autonomous driving, combining dense visual semantics with precise range and velocity measurements from radar. However, real-world fusion quality is fundamentally challenged by dynamically varying input quality, stemming from occlusion, adverse weather, and channel noise. To address this, we re-frame the problem from static data fusion to channel-aware semantic reasoning and propose a Large Language Model-centric Semantic-layer Channel-aware Integrated Perception (LM-SCIP) framework. It places a Large Language Model (LLM) as a central reasoning core to fuse a local visual stream with a quality-varying external radar stream used to cover perception-blind spots. Concretely, LM-SCIP couples a hierarchical radar-vision encoder with a Channel-Adaptive Semantic Module (CASM) that maps link indicators into a "Channel Prompt" to dynamically gate external radar features. A parameter-efficient, LoRA-tuned LLM, in conjunction with a heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts (H-MoE), then arbitrates between local visual cues and the channel-conditioned radar context. Finally, a decoupled multi-task decoder outputs localization, trajectory forecasting, and image reconstruction. Experiments on nuScenes and VIRAT validate our approach. On nuScenes, under a controlled toggle of radar input, LM-SCIP reduces localization RMSE by 40.0% versus a vision-only baseline. On VIRAT, the model attains a 0.214m localization RMSE and 0.179m minFDE (k=1). These results reveal that the proposed LM-SCIP enables a robust vision-dominant fallback at low SNR and synergistic fusion at high SNR.

papers.title: JointHOI: Jointly Generating Contact Maps Enhances Hand Object Interaction Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text driven hand object interaction (HOI) generation is gaining attention for immersive applications and robotics, yet producing physically plausible interactions remains challenging. Even when individual motions appear natural, small contact errors can cause conspicuous artifacts such as floating and interpenetration. Prior methods mitigate these issues using explicit contact cues or implicit grasp priors, but typically rely on multi stage pipelines and fail to model temporally evolving contact. We present JointHOI, a single stage diffusion framework that jointly generates 3D hand object motion and dynamic, distance based contact maps from text. By treating contact as an auxiliary inner modality, joint generation enables the model to learn contact motion coupling during training. At inference, contact guided sampling enforces consistency between generated contact maps and motion implied geometry, improving temporal stability and reducing penetration and floating. Experiments on GRAB and ARCTIC demonstrate consistent improvements in text adherence and physical plausibility over prior methods.

papers.title: Repair the Amplifier, Not the Symptom: Stable World-Model Correction for Agent Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: As agent planning moves from short tool chains toward persistent workflows with thousands or tens of thousands of steps, failures will occur inside large planning graphs rather than in isolated predictions. Replanning the entire graph after every mistake is neither computationally realistic nor desirable: full-graph replay consumes large context budgets, exposes the LLM to many irrelevant symptoms, and can degrade long-context retrieval. This paper studies the missing component in such systems: a world-model corrector that repairs the failed planning graph in place. We compare two families of correctors. The first is the common engineering approach: scan nodes and edges, choose a suspicious local region, and ask an LLM to repair it. We implement strong engineering LLM correctors and find that they can help, especially when given very large contexts. The second family is our approach, WM-SAR (World-Model Subgraph Amplification Repair): instead of scanning for visible symptoms, it works backward from subgraph amplification, identifies the nodes and edges that keep re-amplifying error, and sends only that causal subgraph to the LLM. Across graph simulations and LLM repair experiments, WM-SAR substantially outperforms engineering correctors under realistic token budgets, achieves near-whole-graph stabilization with a compact region, and gives the LLM a cleaner repair target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对agent长程规划中失败后全图重放成本高且引入无关症状的问题，提出世界模型纠正器WM-SAR（World-Model Subgraph Amplification Repair），通过反向追踪子图放大识别持续放大错误的因果子图，仅将该子图发送给LLM修复。实验表明，在现实token预算下，WM-SAR显著优于直接扫描症状的工程纠正器，实现接近整图稳定性的紧凑区域修复。
Motivation: 现有agent规划系统在长程任务中失败后，全图重放计算成本高、消耗大量上下文，且使LLM暴露于无关症状，缺乏高效的本地纠正机制。
Method: WM-SAR方法：从子图放大反向工作，识别规划图中持续放大错误的节点和边，提取因果子图，仅将该子图发送给LLM进行精确修复。
Result: 在图形模拟和LLM修复实验中，WM-SAR在现实token预算下大幅优于工程纠正器，能够用紧凑区域稳定接近整个规划图。
Conclusion: WM-SAR为长程agent规划提供了更高效、更清洁的在位纠正方式，避免全图重放和症状扫描，提升了规划系统的可靠性和效率。

papers.title: SimWorlds: A Multi-Agent System for Dynamic 3D Scene Creation
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly used to translate natural language into 3D scenes in a procedural way, but existing systems focus on static output. Dynamic 4D scenes from text alone, in which liquids flow, particles emit, rigid bodies cascade, and articulated mechanisms move, remain largely unexplored despite their value as editable content and as physics-grounded training data for video generation and embodied AI. Two challenges set the dynamic case apart from static text-to-scene work: an agent must jointly coordinate spatial layout, multiple physics solvers, temporal sequencing, camera, and lighting in a single coherent scene, and verifying motion correctness from rendered video is fundamentally harder than judging a single image. We present SimWorlds: a multi-agent framework that produces dynamic, editable 4D scenes from text, with Blender-specific procedural knowledge, a planner-coder-reviewer workflow driving a fixed ordered sequence of construction stages, a layered scene protocol enforced by a deterministic verifier, and a runtime-state inspection tool suite that catches mechanism failures the rendered image cannot reveal. We also introduce 4DBuildBench, a benchmark for assessing both visual fidelity and physical consistency of the procedural dynamic 3D scenes generated from text prompts. Experiments show that SimWorlds outperforms prior dynamic Blender generation baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SimWorlds，一个基于多智能体的框架，利用Blender专业知识从自然语言生成动态、可编辑的4D场景。系统通过规划者-编码者-审查者工作流协调空间布局、物理求解器、时序、相机和光照，并引入确定性验证器和运行时状态检查工具集来确保机制正确性。同时提出4DBuildBench基准，用于评估动态3D场景的视觉保真度和物理一致性。实验表明SimWorlds在动态场景生成上优于先前基线。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理主要生成静态3D场景，而动态4D场景（如液体流动、粒子发射、刚体级联、铰链运动）的生成尚未被充分探索，且动态场景的验证比静态图像更困难。
Method: 提出多智能体框架SimWorlds，包含Blender特定程序化知识、规划者-编码者-审查者工作流、固定顺序的构建阶段、分层场景协议以及运行时状态检查工具集，用于从文本生成并验证动态4D场景。
Result: 在4DBenchmark基准上，SimWorlds在视觉保真度和物理一致性方面优于先前的动态Blender生成基线。
Conclusion: SimWorlds实现了从文本到动态、可编辑4D场景的自动生成，为视频生成和具身AI提供物理一致的训练数据。

papers.title: Mastermind: Strategy-grounded Learning for Repository-Scale Vulnerability Reproduction
papers.abstract_en: Repository-level vulnerability reproduction is a demanding software engineering (SE) task: an agent must inspect a codebase, infer the input grammar that reaches a vulnerable path, construct a proof-of-conceptv(PoC), and verify that the crash disappears on the patched build. Recent LLM agents can often execute these steps when the approach is correct, yet they still fail by choosing the wrong strategy. This paper argues that strategy, rather than the full action trajectory, is the right learning unit for such SE agents: it is compact enough to optimize, concrete enough to guide execution, and stable enough to store and reuse across attempts. We present Mastermind, a dual-loop framework that separates transferable strategy learning from task-specific experience. A trainable planner learns reusable vulnerability-reproduction strategies through SFT and milestone-based GRPO, while an experience loop maintains task-local strategy records that guide subsequent attempts. The planner is trained independently of the executor, allowing strategy learning to improve multiple frozen executors without modifying their action-generation capability. We evaluate Mastermind on CyberGym using 260 training tasks and 200 held-out evaluation tasks. With GPT-5.5 as the frozen executor, Mastermind achieves an 84.5% pass rate, outperforming open-book PoC context (60.0%), Best-of-8 sampling (63.0%), and iterative improvement (77.0%). The same planner also improves GPT-5.4 mini and GLM~5.1 from 45.0% and 58.5% to 60.0% and 71.0%. These results demonstrate that learning high-level strategies is an effective and transferable mechanism for improving repository-scale SE agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Mastermind，一个双循环框架，将可迁移的策略学习与任务特定经验分离，用于仓库级漏洞复现。通过有监督微调（SFT）和基于里程碑的GRPO训练可训练规划器，学习可重用的漏洞复现策略；经验循环维护任务局部策略记录以指导后续尝试。在CyberGym的260个训练任务和200个保留测试任务上，以GPT-5.5为固定执行器，Mastermind达到84.5%的通过率，优于开放书本PoC上下文（60.0%）、Best-of-8采样（63.0%）和迭代改进（77.0%）。相同的规划器也将GPT-5.4 mini和GLM~5.1的通过率从45.0%和58.5%分别提升至60.0%和71.0%。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理在仓库级漏洞复现中常因选择错误策略而失败；策略比完整动作轨迹更适合作为学习单元，因其更紧凑、可优化、具体且稳定。
Method: 提出Mastermind双循环框架：训练循环通过SFT和基于里程碑的GRPO训练可训练规划器学习可迁移策略；经验循环维护任务局部策略记录。规划器独立于执行器训练，无需修改执行器的动作生成能力。
Result: 在CyberGym上，以GPT-5.5为冻结执行器，Mastermind达到84.5%通过率，显著优于基线方法。同一规划器可提升其他冻结执行器（GPT-5.4 mini和GLM~5.1）的通过率。
Conclusion: 学习高层策略是改进仓库级软件工程代理的有效且可迁移机制，但论文仅评估了特定基准和模型，泛化性有待进一步验证。

papers.title: Denser $\neq$ Better: Limits of On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continual Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Continual post-training enables foundation models to acquire new knowledge while preserving existing capabilities. Recent work suggests that on-policy learning can mitigate forgetting, with on-policy self-distillation emerging as a particularly attractive approach. In this work, we revisit this optimistic view through self-distillation policy optimization (SDPO). Our experiments show that SDPO can accelerate in-domain specialization when teacher signals are stable and well aligned, but it struggles to generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios. In continual post-training, SDPO exhibits stronger forgetting and can even collapse, whereas on-policy reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO adapt more conservatively and better preserve prior capabilities. Further analyses reveal that denser self-distillation induces larger drift in both parameter space and response space, and can amplify high-frequency formatting artifacts through a self-reinforcing teacher--student loop. These findings suggest that on-policy data alone is insufficient for continual learning. Dense self-distillation can accelerate specialization when teacher targets are stable and token-level supervision is reliable, but it should not be treated as a default stabilizer for continual post-training. Our code is available at https://github.com/Moenupa/SDPO-CL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过自蒸馏策略优化（SDPO）实验，质疑on-policy自蒸馏在持续后训练中的有效性。结果表明，当教师信号稳定时SDPO可加速领域内专业化，但难以泛化到分布外场景，且导致更强遗忘甚至崩溃，而on-policy RL方法（如GRPO）更保守地保留先前能力。进一步分析表明，密集自蒸馏会在参数和响应空间引起更大偏移，并通过自我强化循环放大高频格式化伪影。
Motivation: 近期工作认为on-policy学习可缓解遗忘，on-policy自蒸馏尤为吸引人。本文重新审视这一乐观观点，发现其局限性。
Method: 采用自蒸馏策略优化（SDPO）框架进行实验，比较密集自蒸馏与on-policy RL方法（如GRPO）在持续后训练中的表现。
Result: SDPO在教师信号稳定时可加速领域内专业化，但在分布外场景泛化能力差；在持续后训练中表现出更强遗忘甚至崩溃；密集自蒸馏导致参数和响应空间更大偏移，并放大高频格式化伪影。
Conclusion: on-policy数据本身不足以进行持续学习。密集自蒸馏在教师目标稳定和token级监督可靠时可加速专业化，但不应用作持续后训练的默认稳定器。

summary_sections.method: 采用自蒸馏策略优化（SDPO）框架进行实验，比较密集自蒸馏与on-policy RL方法（如GRPO）在持续后训练中的表现。
summary_sections.result: SDPO在教师信号稳定时可加速领域内专业化，但在分布外场景泛化能力差；在持续后训练中表现出更强遗忘甚至崩溃；密集自蒸馏导致参数和响应空间更大偏移，并放大高频格式化伪影。
summary_sections.conclusion: on-policy数据本身不足以进行持续学习。密集自蒸馏在教师目标稳定和token级监督可靠时可加速专业化，但不应用作持续后训练的默认稳定器。

papers.title: Role-Aware Neural Convex Divergence Heads for Asymmetric Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many representation learning problems involve directed relations, such as lexical entailment, sentence entailment, ontology hierarchy, and citation links. Standard Euclidean, cosine, and Mahalanobis heads are symmetric, while generic neural scorers can model directionality but provide limited geometric structure. This paper proposes a role-aware neural convex divergence head for asymmetric representation learning. The head applies source- and target-role projections before evaluating an input-convex neural Bregman divergence, yielding a nonnegative structured score in the role-projected space. We characterize its projected-space identity, source-role convexity, directional-gap decomposition, and Hessian-based local curvature. Experiments on lexical, sentence, ontology, and directed graph benchmarks compare symmetric distances, unstructured asymmetric scorers, order/hyperbolic baselines, plain ICNN-Bregman heads, and the proposed role-aware variant. Across ten random seeds on the main semantic and ontology benchmarks, role-aware projections consistently improve directional accuracy over plain ICNN-Bregman heads while preserving zero observed negative divergence rate. The results also identify a boundary case: on large fixed-feature citation prediction, specialized symmetric or hyperbolic baselines remain stronger in ranking accuracy. Overall, the proposed head is best understood as a structured and interpretable plug-in distance module for tasks where directional relations matter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种角色感知的神经凸散度头（role-aware neural convex divergence head），用于不对称表示学习。该方法在对输入进行源/目标角色投影后，计算输入凸神经Bregman散度，从而获得非负的结构化分数。实验在词汇蕴含、句子蕴含、本体层级和引用图等基准上，相比于对称距离和无结构的不对称评分器，该方法在方向性准确率上取得一致提升，同时保持零负散度率。但在大规模固定特征引用预测上，专门的对称或双曲基线仍更优。
Motivation: 标准表示学习中使用的欧氏距离、余弦距离和马氏距离对称性，无法建模词汇蕴含、句子蕴含等方向性关系。通用的神经评分器可建模方向性但缺乏几何结构。
Method: 提出角色感知的神经凸散度头，首先对输入应用源角色和目标角色投影，然后评估输入凸神经Bregman散度，得到角色投影空间中的非负结构化分数。该方法具有投影空间同一性、源角色凸性、方向性间隙分解和基于Hessian的局部曲率等理论性质。
Result: 在词义关系、句子关系、本体和引用网络上，相比对称距离、无结构不对称评分器、序/双曲基线、普通ICNN-Bregman头，该方法一致提升方向性准确率，并保持零负散度率。但在大规模固定特征引用预测中，专门的对称或双曲基线仍然在排序准确率上更强。
Conclusion: 该头部最好被理解为一个结构化的、可解释的即插即用距离模块，适用于方向性关系重要的任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ProCal: Inference-Time Proposal Calibration for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection aims to localize and classify objects beyond the fixed set of categories seen dur ing training. Recent open-vocabulary object detection methods improve localization and classification for unseen categories by leveraging a frozen VLM as a detector backbone. However, VLM classification score lacks recognizing position and scale of the object in an image. We observe that pretrained VLMs en able to classify foreground and background regions. According to this observation, we propose a simple inference-time Pro posal Calibration (ProCal) that improves localization quality of the classification score. ProCal computes a proposal prior by combining two scores: localization-aware foreground score and background-aware suppression score. Localization-aware foreground score captures whether a proposal contains an object area. Background-aware suppression score measures the extent to which the proposal resembles background. We analyze that ProCal suppresses false novel activation on background proposals and consistently ranks true novel proposals above background and partial novel proposals. Applied to CLIPSelf ViT-L/14, ProCal improves APr +2.5 on OV-LVIS. The analyses show that proposal-level localization-aware reranking effects to mitigate ranking miscalibration for novel objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放词汇目标检测中VLM分类分数缺乏位置和尺度感知的问题，提出推理时提议校准方法ProCal。ProCal通过结合定位感知前景分数和背景抑制分数来计算提议先验，从而抑制背景上的虚假新型激活，并一致地将真实新型提议排在背景和部分新型提议之上。在CLIPSelf ViT-L/14上应用ProCal，在OV-LVIS数据集上APr提升2.5。
Motivation: 开放词汇目标检测中，VLM分类分数无法识别目标在图像中的位置和尺度，导致定位质量不佳。
Method: 提出推理时提议校准方法ProCal，计算定位感知前景分数和背景抑制分数的组合作为提议先验，用于重新排序提议。
Result: 在OV-LVIS数据集上，基于CLIPSelf ViT-L/14，ProCal使APr提升2.5。
Conclusion: 提议级定位感知重排能够缓解新型物体的排名失配问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DL-VINS-Factory: A Modular Framework for Learned Visual Front-Ends in Visual-Inertial SLAM
papers.abstract_en: Deep-learning features excel in visual matching, yet their practical value in tightly coupled visual-inertial SLAM (VI-SLAM) remains insufficiently characterized. We present DL-VINS-Factory, a unified framework that integrates learned feature extractors (ALIKED, RaCo, SuperPoint, XFeat) with either Lucas--Kanade (LK) optical-flow tracking or LightGlue (LG) descriptor matching. All front-ends share a sliding-window Ceres back-end, with optional AnyLoc DINOv2-VLAD loop closure, and 4-DoF pose-graph optimization. We benchmark the system across the four datasets covering indoor, unstructured outdoor, aggressive-motion, and visually degraded conditions. Results show that learned front-ends are viable for real-time embedded VI-SLAM, but are not universally superior to classical tracking. Relative to the corresponding GFTT+LK baseline, ALIKED+LG reduces EuRoC ATE by $5\%$ in monocular odometry and by $7\%$ in stereo with loop-closure. On NTU-VIRAL, where aggressive aerial motion increases inter-frame viewpoint change, ALIKED+LG stereo reduces loop-closed ATE by $12\%$. In Botanic Garden dataset, optical-flow tracking remains preferable, but learned keypoints still improve over the baseline GFTT, in which SuperPoint+LK reduces grayscale camera ATE by $29\%$, while RaCo+LK reduces RGB camera ATE by $38\%$. On SubT-MRS, learned front-ends display varying degree of improvement based on individual cases. With TensorRT acceleration on a Jetson AGX Orin, all valid configurations run in real time between $29$--$47$ FPS in monocular mode and $18$--$33$ FPS in stereo mode for the EuRoC and NTU-VIRAL datasets. AnyLoc further confirms roughly $2$--$7\times$ more valid loops than BRIEF+DBoW2. The implementation is open-sourced at https://github.com/limshoonkit/DL-VINS-Factory-ROS2/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DL-VINS-Factory，一个统一框架，集成多种学习型视觉前端（ALIKED、RaCo、SuperPoint、XFeat）与 LK 光流跟踪或 LightGlue 描述子匹配，共享滑动窗口 Ceres 后端和可选的 AnyLoc DINOv2-VLAD 回环检测。在四个数据集上的实验表明，学习型前端在实时嵌入式 VI-SLAM 中可行，但并非普遍优于经典方法。在 EuRoC 上 ALIKED+LG 相比 GFTT+LK 基线在单目和立体模式下分别降低 ATE 5% 和 7%；在 NTU-VIRAL 上立体模式下降 12%；在 Botanic Garden 数据集上 SuperPoint+LK 和 RaCo+LK 分别降低灰度相机和 RGB 相机 ATE 29% 和 38%。所有有效配置在 Jetson AGX Orin 上可实现 29-47 FPS（单目）和 18-33 FPS（立体）。AnyLoc 相比 BRIEF+DBoW2 发现约 2-7 倍有效回环。
Motivation: 深度学习特征在视觉匹配中表现出色，但其在紧耦合视觉惯性 SLAM 中的实际价值尚未被充分表征。
Method: 提出 DL-VINS-Factory 框架，集成多种学习型特征提取器（ALIKED、RaCo、SuperPoint、XFeat）和两种跟踪/匹配方法（LK 光流、LightGlue 描述子匹配），后端采用滑动窗口 Ceres 优化，并可选 AnyLoc 回环检测和 4-DoF 位姿图优化。
Result: 在四个数据集上，学习型前端相比 GFTT+LK 基线有不同程度改进：EuRoC 上 ALIKED+LG 单目 ATE 降低 5%，立体降低 7%；NTU-VIRAL 上立体降低 12%；Botanic Garden 上 SuperPoint+LK 降低灰度相机 ATE 29%，RaCo+LK 降低 RGB 相机 ATE 38%；SubT-MRS 上改进因情况而异。所有有效配置在 Jetson AGX Orin 上实时运行（单目 29-47 FPS，立体 18-33 FPS）。AnyLoc 回环检测质量优于传统 BRIEF+DBoW2。
Conclusion: 学习型视觉前端在实时嵌入式 VI-SLAM 中可行且有潜力，但并非通用解决方案，具体优势取决于场景和配置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProSAC-CT: Progressive Spectral-Anatomical Co-Guided Multi-Stage Diffusion Model for Low-Dose CT Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) reduces radiation exposure but introduces stronger quantum noise, streak artifacts, and local texture degradation, which can obscure anatomical boundaries and weaken low-contrast structures. Diffusion models are promising for LDCT denoising by progressively recovering normal-dose CT (NDCT) images from degraded LDCT inputs, but existing methods often suffer from insufficient anatomical guidance, uncertain frequency-dependent recovery, and uniform reverse-process modeling. We propose ProSAC-CT, a progressive spectral-anatomical co-guided multi-stage diffusion model for image-domain LDCT denoising. ProSAC-CT integrates an anatomical-prior-guided conditioning (APGC) module, a residual frequency-domain decoupling stage (RFDDS), and a time-step-decoupling denoising decoder (TD3). APGC extracts LDCT-derived structural guidance, RFDDS enhances frequency-aware representations, and TD3 assigns them to different reverse-diffusion stages for anatomical stabilization, boundary refinement, and fine-detail recovery. Experiments on four LDCT degradation benchmarks show that ProSAC-CT improves image fidelity, structural similarity, perceptual quality, and information preservation over representative methods while better preserving boundary-sensitive anatomical details. Downstream anatomical-region classification on Mayo-2020 further indicates that ProSAC-CT retains task-relevant anatomical information, supporting its practical use for low-dose CT denoising.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ProSAC-CT，一种渐进式频谱-解剖协同引导的多阶段扩散模型，用于低剂量CT（LDCT）去噪。该模型集成了解剖先验引导的条件模块（APGC）、残差频域解耦阶段（RFDDS）和时间步解耦去噪解码器（TD3），分别提供结构引导、频率感知表示和分阶段恢复。在四个LDCT退化基准上，ProSAC-CT在图像保真度、结构相似性、感知质量和信息保留方面优于现有方法，并在Mayo-2020数据集上的下游解剖区域分类中保留了任务相关的解剖信息。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在LDCT去噪中缺乏充分的解剖结构引导、频域恢复不明确以及反向过程建模单一，导致解剖边界模糊和低对比度结构退化。
Method: 提出三种创新模块：APGC模块提取LDCT导出的结构引导信息；RFDDS增强频域感知表示；TD3将不同表示分配给不同的反向扩散阶段，分别用于解剖稳定、边界细化和细节恢复。
Result: 在四个LDCT退化基准上，ProSAC-CT在图像保真度、结构相似性、感知质量和信息保留上优于代表性方法，并在Mayo-2020数据集上的下游解剖区域分类中证实保留了任务相关的解剖信息。
Conclusion: 该模型通过频谱-解剖协同引导的多阶段扩散，能更好地保留边界敏感的解剖细节，支持低剂量CT去噪的实际应用。

papers.title: Decentralized Stochastic Subgradient-type Methods with Communication Compression for Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider the nonsmooth nonconvex decentralized optimization problem, where inter-agent communication is compressed. We propose a general framework that unifies various decentralized stochastic subgradient-type methods with unbiased compression and contractive compression with error compensation. By relating the consensus-error iterates and the averaged iterates to the trajectories of continuous-time differential inclusions, we establish global convergence for all methods encompassed by our framework when the objective functions are nonsmooth and lack Clarke regularity. Based on our framework, we further develop several compression-based methods, including decentralized stochastic subgradient methods utilizing sign-based regularization and gradient-tracking momentum. Preliminary numerical experiments empirically support our theoretical results and highlight the communication-accuracy trade-off of the newly developed methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非光滑非凸分布式优化问题，提出一个统一框架，涵盖多种带通信压缩的随机次梯度方法（包括无偏压缩和带误差补偿的收缩压缩）。通过将共识误差和平均迭代轨迹与连续时间微分包含关联，证明了框架下所有方法的全局收敛性。基于该框架，进一步开发了基于符号正则化和梯度跟踪动量的新方法，初步数值实验验证了理论结果并展示了通信-精度权衡。
Motivation: 现有分布式优化方法大多假设目标函数光滑或凸性，或缺乏对压缩通信下非光滑非凸问题的收敛性分析，而实际问题中目标函数常非光滑且不具备Clarke正则性。
Method: 提出一个统一的分析框架，通过关联离散迭代与连续时间微分包含轨迹，处理无偏压缩和带误差补偿的收缩压缩两种通信压缩策略。基于该框架，设计了两种具体方法：基于符号正则化的分布式随机次梯度方法和带梯度跟踪动量的方法。
Result: 理论证明了框架下所有方法的全局收敛性，无需目标函数满足Clarke正则性。初步数值实验支持理论结论，并揭示了通信压缩与精度之间的权衡关系。
Conclusion: 论文提供了一个统一的理论框架，将多种压缩通信的分布式非光滑非凸优化方法纳入分析，并证明了其全局收敛性。局限性在于实验结果仅为初步的，未在更大规模或更实际的问题上验证。

papers.title: Path-level Hindsight Instructions for Semantic Exploration in Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy exploration is a crucial component for training robust Vision-Language Navigation agents, as it exposes the policy to a broader state distribution. However, such exploration inevitably leads to trajectories that deviate from expert demonstrations, resulting in a semantic mismatch between the executed visual stream and the original language instruction. In this work, we address this challenge by introducing Phi-Nav, a unified on-policy framework that leverages hindsight reasoning to align instructions with the agent's actual exploratory journey. Specifically, Phi-Nav operates through a three-stage dual-supervision cycle: 1) the agent performs oracle-guided on-policy exploration, sampling a trajectory while learning from expert action feedback, 2) a hindsight speaker synthesizes a path-level hindsight instruction grounded in the collected visual observations, and 3) the agent conducts a second imitation pass, treating the synthesized trajectory-instruction pair as an additional expert demonstration. Through this process, Phi-Nav bridges the critical semantic supervision gap inherent in on-policy methods, transforming semantically unlabeled movement into dense training signals. Evaluations on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks show that Phi-Nav yields competitive performance while requiring only a fraction of the expert demonstrations used by current baselines. These results underscore the necessity of semantic exploration in VLN, positioning Phi-Nav as an effective solution for training embodied agents with limited data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Phi-Nav，一种基于事后推理的统一在线策略框架，用于视觉语言导航。该方法通过三阶段双监督循环（oracle 引导探索、事后指令生成、第二次模仿学习）解决在线探索中语义不匹配的问题。在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准上，Phi-Nav 以更少的专家示教取得竞争性性能。
Motivation: 在线策略探索会导致轨迹偏离专家演示，造成视觉流与原始语言指令之间的语义不匹配，削弱导航代理的训练效果。
Method: Phi-Nav 通过三阶段循环运作：1）oracle 引导的在线策略探索；2）事后说话者根据视觉观测生成路径级事后指令；3）将生成轨迹-指令对作为额外专家演示进行第二次模仿学习。
Result: 在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准上，Phi-Nav 取得竞争性性能，且仅需当前基线所用专家示教的一小部分。
Conclusion: 结果表明语义探索对视觉语言导航至关重要，Phi-Nav 是训练具身代理的有效解决方案，尤其适用于数据有限场景。

papers.title: The Turning Point of 3D Plant Phenotyping: 3D Foundation Models Enable Minute-to-Second Cross-Crop Reconstruction and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: 3D plant phenotyping is notoriously known to be procedure-complicated and of low throughput due to the extensive multi-view imaging, the fragile 3D reconstruction pipeline, and the additional cost from reconstructed geometry to phenotypic extraction. These limitations are further amplified in low-cost data acquisition, where smartphone videos or sparsely sampled multi-view images provide limited view overlap and self-occlusion. In this work, we show that the conventional 3D plant phenotyping pipeline could be streamlined and significantly accelerated with 3D Foundation Models (3DFMs), and particularly, present one of the first cross-crop 3D phenotyping frameworks powered by 3DFMs. The framework replaces COLMAP-style sparse initialization with 3DFM-based feed-forward geometric recovery, combines geometry-constrained 3D Gaussian Splatting for dense reconstruction, enables few-view reconstruction through iterative view synthesis and refinement, and converts reconstructed geometry into measurable organs through 2D-to-3D semantic transfer, metric scale recovery, and organ instance separation. We further construct a cross-crop dataset with smartphone-based image acquisition, diverse plant morphologies, and manual annotations for segmentation and phenotypic evaluation. Experiments across 26 plant sequences show that 3D Foundation Models reduce the average reconstruction time from 6.52 minutes to 1.58 seconds while maintaining high reconstruction quality and phenotyping accuracy. These results suggest a fresh technical route for high-throughput 3D plant phenotyping, from low-cost image acquisition to fast reconstruction, perception, scale recovery, and phenotypic measurement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示了3D基础模型（3DFMs）如何将传统3D植物表型分析流程从分钟级加速到秒级。提出一个跨作物3D表型框架，用3DFM替代COLMAP的稀疏初始化，结合几何约束的3D高斯泼溅进行稠密重建，并实现少视角重建、2D到3D语义转换、度量尺度恢复和器官分离。在26个植物序列上，平均重建时间从6.52分钟降至1.58秒，同时保持高重建质量和表型精度。
Motivation: 传统3D植物表型分析流程复杂、通量低，尤其在低成本数据采集（如手机视频或稀疏多视角图像）下，由于视角重叠有限和自遮挡，问题更加突出。需要一种更快速、鲁棒的方法来加速从低代价图像采集到表型测量的全过程。
Method: 提出一个由3DFM驱动的跨作物3D表型框架：用3D基础模型的馈送式几何恢复替代COLMAP的稀疏初始化；结合几何约束的3D高斯泼溅进行稠密重建；通过迭代视角合成与精化实现少视角重建；通过2D到3D语义迁移、度量尺度恢复和器官实例分割将几何转化为可测量的器官。同时构建了跨作物数据集（手机图像、多样形态、人工标注）。
Result: 在26个植物序列上，平均重建时间从6.52分钟降至1.58秒，且重建质量和表型精度保持高水平。
Conclusion: 该工作表明3DFM为高通量3D植物表型分析提供了一条新技术路线，从低成本图像采集到快速重建、感知、尺度恢复和表型测量。

papers.title: Efficient Temporal Point Processes via Monotone Alternating Splines
papers.abstract_en: Temporal point processes (TPPs) have widespread applications across various domains. Compared to modeling the conditional intensity of a TPP, modeling its cumulative conditional intensity function (CCIF) improves computational efficiency and eliminates numerical approximation errors. However, current CCIF parameterizations uniformly rely on Monotone Neural Networks (MNNs), which we identify as suffering from three structural deadlocks--convexity restrictions, saturation limits, and violations of CCIF modeling requirements--that fundamentally restrict their representational capacity for complex temporal dynamics. To resolve these bottlenecks, this paper proposes a novel framework called Monotone Alternating Splines (MAS). By leveraging distinct interpolation and extrapolation components, MAS provides a flexible and efficient framework for modeling CCIFs. Theoretically, MAS's interpolation provides strong fitting accuracy, while its extrapolation supports robust generalization, reducing the irreducible approximation gaps of MNNs. Extensive experiments show that MAS achieves superior performance on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间点过程（TPP）中累积条件强度函数（CCIF）建模的现有单调神经网络（MNN）方法存在的三个结构性瓶颈（凸性限制、饱和极限、违反CCIF建模要求），提出单调交替样条（MAS）框架。MAS通过分离插值与外推组件，在理论上降低逼近误差，实验表明在合成和真实数据集上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有CCIF参数化依赖单调神经网络（MNN），但MNN存在凸性限制、饱和极限及违反CCIF建模要求等结构性问题，限制了其对复杂时间动态的表示能力。
Method: 提出单调交替样条（MAS）框架，利用不同的插值和外推组件分别建模CCIF，插值保证拟合精度，外推支持稳健泛化，从而缩小MNN的不可约逼近误差。
Result: 摘要报告MAS在合成和真实数据集上均取得优于现有方法的性能。
Conclusion: MAS通过分离插值与外推解决了MNN的结构缺陷，为TPP的CCIF建模提供了灵活高效的框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MedStreamBench: A Time-Aware Benchmark for Streaming and Proactive Medical Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Existing medical video benchmarks primarily evaluate whether a model produces the correct answer, but rarely assess whether it answers at the right time. In real clinical settings, AI systems must decide not only what to predict, but also when to answer, defer judgment, or proactively raise alerts. This creates a critical gap between benchmark evaluation and deployment requirements. We present MedStreamBench, a benchmark for time-aware medical video understanding. MedStreamBench integrates 22 medical datasets and 5,419 QA instances across four temporal settings: retrospective, present, future, and proactive. Unlike conventional benchmarks that assume full-video access, MedStreamBench restricts models to temporally bounded evidence windows and supports both single-turn and streaming evaluation. We further introduce a proactive monitoring setting that requires models to determine whether and when clinically relevant alerts should be triggered. Beyond answer correctness, MedStreamBench evaluates temporal behavior through responsiveness and post-evidence stability. Experiments on leading general-purpose and medical vision-language models reveal a substantial gap between offline recognition and temporally grounded decision-making, with performance dropping markedly in streaming and proactive settings. Our benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Venn2024/MedStreamBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedStreamBench是一个面向时间感知的医疗视频理解基准，包含22个医疗数据集和5419个问答实例，支持回顾、当前、未来和主动四种时间设置。该基准评估模型不仅回答正确性，还评估回答时机和主动警报能力。实验表明当前模型在流式和主动设置下性能显著下降。
Motivation: 现有医疗视频基准只评估答案正确性，忽略回答时机和主动决策能力，与现实临床部署需求存在差距。
Method: 整合22个医疗数据集，构建5419个问答实例，设计四种时间设置（回顾、当前、未来、主动），限制模型使用时间窗口证据，支持单轮和流式评估，并引入主动监控设置。
Result: 主流通用和医疗视觉语言模型在离线识别上表现良好，但在流式和主动设置下性能明显下降，表明存在时间接地决策的显著差距。
Conclusion: 强调了时间感知评估的重要性，并指出当前模型在流式和主动医疗视频理解中的不足。

papers.title: Identifiability Limits of Physics-Informed Inference for Spatial Stochastic Dynamics from Static Snapshots
papers.abstract_en: Despite increasing scale and resolution, many biological measurements remain destructive, revealing only spatial information rather than the dynamics it encodes. By combining flexible representations with mechanistic constraints, physics-informed machine learning offers a promising route to inferring these dynamics from static snapshots. Motivated by subcellular imaging of gene expression, we ask when a static spatial pattern of molecules can identify spatially varying diffusivity, creation, destruction, and boundary exchange, and how different inference schemes perform on the task. A structural identifiability analysis shows that distributed sources are non-identifiable, whereas a point source such as a transcription site can restore identifiability. These limits are further shaped by seemingly innocuous modeling choices: the boundary conditions, the spatial regularity of the underlying dynamics, and even the stochastic calculus convention. We then adapt several physics-informed schemes, differing in how they represent the solution and enforce the governing equations, and demonstrate effective inference from a single snapshot. Physics-informed approaches can thus recover spatial heterogeneities of biological dynamics from static data, but their use should be accompanied and guided by careful identifiability analysis for meaningful interpretation of the results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从静态快照中推断空间随机动力学参数的可辨识性极限，以亚细胞基因表达成像为背景。结构可辨识性分析表明分布源不可辨识，但点源可恢复可辨识性；边界条件、空间正则性和随机微积分约定等建模选择会影响可辨识性。作者调整多种物理信息推断方案，证明可从单张快照有效推断空间异质性。
Motivation: 许多生物测量破坏性获取空间信息而非动态过程，物理信息机器学习有望从静态快照推断动力学，但可辨识性边界尚不明确。
Method: 结构可辨识性分析结合多种物理信息推断方案，通过不同方式表示解并强制执行控制方程，评估对空间变化扩散、创建、消亡和边界交换参数的推断能力。
Result: 分布源参数不可辨识，点源可恢复可辨识性；建模选择（边界条件、空间正则性、随机微积分约定）影响可辨识性。物理信息方法能有效从单张快照恢复空间异质性。
Conclusion: 物理信息推断可用于从静态数据恢复生物动力学的空间异质性，但需配合可辨识性分析以合理解释结果。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 物理信息推断可用于从静态数据恢复生物动力学的空间异质性，但需配合可辨识性分析以合理解释结果。

papers.title: RTE-FM-Dehazer: Radiative Transfer Equation Inspired Flow Matching for Real-World Image Dehazing
papers.abstract_en: Single-image dehazing aims to recover a clear scene from a hazy image and is generally formulated as an image-to-image translation task; however, it faces two limitations. Its performance depends heavily on the haze-formation priors embedded in the model. Prevailing methods adopt the Atmospheric Scattering Model (ASM), whose assumptions of single scattering and homogeneous media are often violated, leading to residual haze and color drift. Moreover, large-scale real hazy/clear pairs are impractical to collect, and existing synthesis approaches fail to reproduce the full complexity of natural haze. To address these issues, we present RTE-FM-Dehazer, a novel dehazing approach, together with a scalable data pipeline. Unlike the ASM, the Radiative Transfer Equation (RTE) jointly accounts for both scattering and absorption, naturally accommodating the non-homogeneous, multiple-scattering media that characterize real hazy scenes. Motivated by the structural similarity between the RTE diffusion-absorption term and the ODE in flow matching, we introduce a diffusion-absorption regularizer derived from a reduced RTE, to steer the flow matching trajectory at each step. Next, leveraging modern vision-language models, we build an automated pipeline and release P-HAZE, a dataset of 50000 realistic hazy/clear pairs. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that RTE-FM-Dehazer, trained solely on P-HAZE, effectively eliminates artifacts like residual haze and color drift, exhibits strong cross-domain generalization, and achieves leading results on five real-world dehazing benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RTE-FM-Dehazer，一种基于辐射传输方程（RTE）启发流匹配的真实图像去雾方法，并构建了包含5万对真实雾/清晰图像的P-HAZE数据集。该方法利用RTE的扩散-吸收项与流匹配ODE的结构相似性，引入扩散-吸收正则化器引导模型轨迹，从而克服传统大气散射模型（ASM）在非均匀、多次散射介质中的局限性。实验表明，仅在P-HAZE上训练的模型能够有效消除残雾和颜色漂移，在五个真实去雾基准上取得领先结果，并展现出强跨域泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有单图像去雾方法依赖大气散射模型（ASM），但ASM的单散射和均匀介质假设在真实场景中常被违背，导致残雾和颜色漂移；同时大规模真实雾/清晰对难以收集，现有合成数据无法复现自然雾的复杂性。
Method: 提出RTE-FM-Dehazer，利用辐射传输方程（RTE）的扩散-吸收项与流匹配（flow matching）中ODE的结构相似性，设计扩散-吸收正则化器来引导去雾轨迹；并借助视觉-语言模型构建自动化数据管道，生成5万对真实雾/清晰图像数据集P-HAZE。
Result: 仅在P-HAZE上训练的RTE-FM-Dehazer在五个真实世界去雾基准上达到领先性能，有效消除残雾和颜色漂移，并展现出强跨域泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调RTE比传统ASM更能建模真实非均匀、多次散射介质，且结合流匹配的正则化方法能有效提升去雾质量，同时大规模真实数据集的构建方法具有可扩展性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Finite-Lag Operator Geometry of Recurrent Representations
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent representations are trajectories, but representation geometry is often measured from static snapshots. We develop finite-lag operator geometry for recurrent hidden states from observed source-successor pairs $(X_t,X_{t+Δ})$. The primitive is the conditional transport law $Q_Δ(dy\mid x)$, estimated by a dense Gaussian source-smoothing operator. From this directed finite-lag law we derive a source-centered transport tensor $G_Δ$, which decomposes exactly into conditional spread and coherent displacement, and an antisymmetric coordinate circulation $W_Δ^ρ$, which summarizes directed lagged flow. We prove affine covariance with explicit metric dependence of scalar summaries, dense estimator stability on bounded trajectory clouds, and a finite-lag separation result showing that source-centered transport detects deterministic recurrent motion not recorded by infinitesimal carre-du-champ geometry. A linear-Gaussian closed form calibrates the quantities in terms of the update $A_Δ$, source covariance, and innovation covariance. Controlled experiments validate the decomposition, circulation, covariance, and stability predictions. In performance matched repeat-copy networks, the framework reveals architecture dependent differences in total transport scale and coherent displacement trace, while coherent displacement fraction is metric and resolution dependent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为递归隐藏状态开发有限滞后算子几何，通过观测的源-后继对估计条件运输律，导出源中心传输张量（分解为条件扩散和相干位移）以及反对称坐标环流。证明了仿射协方差、有界轨迹云上的估计稳定性，以及有限滞后分离结果，可以检测确定性递归运动。在性能匹配的重复复制网络中，框架揭示了架构依赖的传输尺度差异。
Motivation: 递归表示本质上是轨迹，但表示几何常从静态快照测量，缺乏对滞后动力学的显式建模。
Method: 从观测的源-后继对(X_t,X_{t+Δ})出发，通过密集高斯源平滑算子估计条件运输律Q_Δ，进而导出源中心传输张量G_Δ（分解为条件扩散和相干位移）和反对称坐标环流W_Δ^ρ。
Result: 证明了仿射协方差、有界轨迹云上的估计稳定性，以及有限滞后分离结果；在线性高斯闭式解中校准，并在重复复制网络中验证了分解、环流、协方差和稳定性。
Conclusion: 框架揭示了架构依赖的传输尺度差异，但相干位移分数依赖于度量和分辨率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InterCMDM: Block-Causal Diffusion for Autoregressive Human Interaction Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-conditioned human interaction generation must capture both long-range temporal causality within each individual and tightly coupled coordination between partners. Existing interaction diffusion models typically denoise full sequences using bidirectional attention, which obscures causality and hinders streaming and long-horizon generation. Autoregressive alternatives enforce causality but often suffer from temporal drift, leading to coordination degradation and unstable interaction dynamics over time. We propose InterCMDM, a block-causal latent diffusion framework for autoregressive two-person interaction generation. InterCMDM introduces a Dual-Stream Causal Diffusion Transformer that maintains separate causal streams for each person while modeling inter-person dependencies via unified dual-stream attention with multi-task attention masks. These masks unify interaction modeling within a single attention mechanism and support diverse coordination behaviors, including simultaneous actions, reactive responses, leader-follower dynamics, and independent motion. By training a single model across these mask configurations as a form of data augmentation, InterCMDM enables controllable interaction generation by simply selecting the desired attention mask at inference time. Finally, a block-wise diffusion objective enables stable latent rollout over long sequences without repeated decode-encode cycles. InterCMDM achieves state-of-the-art performance on InterHuman and Inter-X, improving text-motion alignment, realism, and long-horizon continuity.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026, Project website: https://yu1ut.com/InterCMDM-HP/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InterCMDM，一个块因果潜在扩散框架，用于自回归双人交互生成。通过双流因果扩散 Transformer 和多任务注意力掩码，统一了同步、反应、领导-跟随和独立运动等协调行为。块级扩散目标实现了长序列稳定生成，在 InterHuman 和 Inter-X 数据集上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有交互扩散模型使用双向注意力掩盖了因果关系，难以支持流式或长程生成；自回归方法则易发生时间漂移，导致协调退化和不稳定。
Method: 提出双流因果扩散 Transformer，为每个个体维护独立因果流，通过统一的多任务注意力掩码建模人际依赖。该掩码在单注意力机制中统一了多种协调行为，并作为数据增强训练单一模型，推理时通过选择所需掩码实现可控生成。块级扩散目标避免了重复编解码循环。
Result: 在 InterHuman 和 Inter-X 基准上达到最先进性能，提升了文本-动作对齐、真实感和长程连续性。
Conclusion: InterCMDM 有效结合了因果性与协作建模，为双人交互生成提供了一种可控且稳定的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Full Bayesian Reinforcement Learning via LF-IBIS
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a sequential decision-making framework in which an agent learns optimal policies through interaction with an environment by maximizing cumulative rewards. Among RL methods, Bayesian Reinforcement Learning (BRL) addresses common practical challenges related to data scarcity by leveraging prior knowledge about the environment and sequential belief updates. However, most BRL approaches require an explicit likelihood function, which is frequently inaccessible or intractable in real-world settings. We propose Likelihood-Free Iterated Batch Importance Sampling (LF-IBIS), a novel algorithm for BRL that updates the agent's beliefs online as new interactions become available. By combining Approximate Bayesian Computation with Iterated Batch Importance Sampling, LF-IBIS enables full Bayesian inference in settings where the environment dynamics are not described by an explicit or tractable likelihood. The method yields approximate posterior distributions over both environment parameters and optimal policies, providing a quantification of policy uncertainty useful for a Bayesian treatment of the exploration-exploitation trade-off. We test the method on a simulation study in response-adaptive randomization in clinical trials, where closed-form posteriors enable validation. Additional experiments address settings where the posterior has no closed form and illustrate online policy updating based on the posterior distribution of the optimal policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LF-IBIS算法，一种用于全贝叶斯强化学习的无似然方法，结合近似贝叶斯计算与迭代批重要性采样，在环境动态无显式似然时仍能进行贝叶斯推断，并输出环境参数和最优策略的后验分布。在临床试验的响应自适应随机化模拟中验证，并展示无封闭形式后验时的在线策略更新。
Motivation: 实际强化学习中，环境动态常缺乏显式或可处理的似然函数，而现有贝叶斯强化学习方法通常需要似然，限制了应用。
Method: 提出LF-IBIS（无似然迭代批重要性采样），结合近似贝叶斯计算（ABC）与迭代批重要性采样（IBIS），在线更新智能体的信念，实现无需似然的完全贝叶斯推断。
Result: 在临床试验的响应自适应随机化模拟中，由于存在封闭形式后验，方法得到验证；此外，在无封闭形式后验的设定中也展示了基于最优策略后验分布的在线策略更新。
Conclusion: LF-IBIS使贝叶斯强化学习应用于似然不可得或难处理的场景，提供策略不确定性量化，有助于探索-利用权衡的贝叶斯处理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Meta-Benchmarks for Financial-Services LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Public LLM leaderboards optimise for global average performance and do not capture the specific cognitive demands of financial-services work: a model that leads on MMLU-Pro may underperform on document-grounded compliance reasoning, and a coding leader may handle multi-turn customer interactions poorly. We present a meta-benchmarking framework that organises 452 publicly reported benchmarks into 41 O*NET Generalized Work Activities and aggregates those into 38 BIAN banking business domains spanning sales, operations, risk, and support work. A multiplicative weighting scheme (discrimination x coverage x recency), computed over a rolling model window, rewards benchmarks that still separate the best models, are widely reported, and remain in active use, suppressing saturated legacy tests automatically. These weights scale the K-factor in a pairwise Elo tournament, producing cross-benchmark-comparable work-activity scores without raw score normalisation; business-domain scores are weighted averages of the constituent work-activity Elos. We demonstrate the framework on a point-in-time public snapshot covering 288 models across 25 organisations as of June 2026, and describe the methodology, full taxonomy, design decisions, and limitations with the aim of making the approach reproducible for institutions facing similar selection and governance challenges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对金融服务业对LLM评估的特殊需求，提出了一个元基准框架（meta-benchmarking framework），将452个公开基准映射到41个O*NET通用工作活动，再聚合到38个BIAN银行业务领域。采用乘性加权方案（区分度×覆盖率×新颖性）在滚动模型窗口上计算权重，并通过配对Elo锦标赛生成跨基准可比较的工作活动分数，无需原始分数归一化。在截至2026年6月的288个模型快照上展示了框架。
Motivation: 现有公开LLM排行榜优化的是全局平均性能，无法捕捉金融服务业特有的认知需求，例如MMLU-Pro领先的模型可能在文档合规推理上表现不佳，代码擅长的模型可能在多轮客户交互中处理差。
Method: 提出元基准框架：将452个公开基准按O*NET通用工作活动分类（41类），并聚合到BIAN银行业务领域（38个）。采用乘性加权方案（区分度×覆盖率×新颖性）在滚动模型窗口上计算权重，抑制饱和的遗留基准。用这些权重缩放配对Elo锦标赛中的K因子，得到跨基准可比的工作活动分数，业务领域分数为子活动Elo的加权平均。
Result: 摘要报告在截至2026年6月的公开快照上（288个模型，25个组织）演示了该框架，并描述了完整的分类体系、设计决策和局限性。
Conclusion: 该框架旨在为面临类似LLM选型和治理挑战的金融机构提供可复现的方法论，但摘要强调其局限性和设计决策。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReQuest: Rethinking-based Question-Aware Frame Selection for Long-Form Video QA
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced video understanding, yet long-form video QA remains challenging under fixed input token budgets, where uniform sampling can be inefficient for evidence localization. We propose ReQuest , an uncertainty-driven, question-adaptive keyframe selection pipeline that aligns question intent with relevant video content through selective computation. ReQuest integrates (i) a lightweight question-aware selector distilled from MLLM-generated supervision, (ii) Re-thinking Routing that triggers additional inference only when the model is uncertain with a length-adaptive criterion, and (iii) uncertainty-guided adaptive non-maximum suppression that selects temporally diverse frames while adjusting spacing based on question difficulty. As a plug-andplay method, ReQuest improves long-video QA without modifying or fine-tuning the underlying MLLM. Experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench demonstrate consistent accuracy gains with competitive computational cost, with particularly strong improvements in medium and long video regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出ReQuest，一种基于不确定性的问题自适应关键帧选择方法，用于长视频问答。通过轻量级问题感知选择器、重新思考路由和不确定性引导的自适应非极大值抑制，在固定token预算下提升证据定位效率。在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench上取得一致准确率提升。
Motivation: 长视频问答在固定输入token预算下，均匀采样难以有效定位证据，需自适应选择关键帧以对齐问题意图。
Method: 集成三个组件：从MLLM生成监督中蒸馏的轻量级问题感知选择器；基于长度自适应准则仅在模型不确定时触发额外推理的重新思考路由；以及根据问题难度调整间距并选择时间多样帧的不确定性引导自适应非极大值抑制。
Result: 在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench上获得一致准确率提升，计算成本有竞争力，在中长视频场景改进尤为明显。
Conclusion: 作为即插即用方法，无需修改或微调底层MLLM即可提升长视频QA性能。

papers.title: Predicting Closed-Loop Performance of Latent World Models: Offline Checkpoint Selection for MPC and Model-Based RL Under Non-Markovian Rewards in LunarLander
papers.abstract_en: We study how to predict the downstream closed-loop performance of a learned latent world model from validation-time diagnostics alone. Choosing the right checkpoint from a world-model training run is difficult: validation loss and multi-step prediction RMSE keep improving long after closed-loop performance has collapsed. We present a suite of structural validation-time diagnostics drawn from optimal-control theory and apply them to Gymnasium's LunarLander v3, which features shaped rewards. We train an RSSM [5, 4] world model on it and treat per checkpoint CEM-MPC return as the oracle for closed-loop quality. By evaluating 40 metrics against this oracle, we find that the strongest single predictor is the Reward Observability Fraction (ROF), which measures the reward predictor's dependence on the observable subspace. We combine ROF with three structural regularizers into a single-number offline checkpoint selection score, the Composite Reward Observability Fraction (CROF). The CROF-selected world model trains a model-based A2C policy that beats a fairly evaluated model-free A2C baseline by ~24.5 return points while using ~65x fewer real-environment interactions, and the same world model also drives a strong zero-shot CEM-MPC policy. Code and data: https://github.com/nsmoly/LunarLander_RSSM.
papers.comment: Preprint, 19 pages (16 main text + 3 pages appendix), 7 figures, 4 tables. Video: https://youtu.be/4PxHFW_TYUw , Code: https://github.com/nsmoly/LunarLander_RSSM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何从验证时诊断指标预测学习到的潜世界模型的闭环控制性能。作者发现验证损失和多步预测RMSE在闭环性能下降后仍持续改善，因此提出一套基于最优控制理论的诊断指标，并在LunarLander v3（具有形状奖励）上训练RSSM世界模型。通过40个指标与CEM-MPC回报的比较，发现奖励可观测性分数（ROF）是最强的单指标预测器。结合ROF与三个结构正则化项，得到复合奖励可观测性分数（CROF），用于离线选择检查点。CROF选择的世界模型训练的基于模型的A2C策略比无模型A2C基线高出约24.5回报点，同时使用约65倍少的真实环境交互，且同一世界模型驱动零样本CEM-MPC策略。
Motivation: 训练潜世界模型时，验证损失和多步预测RMSE在闭环性能崩溃后仍持续改进，导致难以从检查点中选择最优模型。作者希望仅通过验证时诊断指标预测下游闭环性能，从而进行离线检查点选择。
Method: 提出一套基于最优控制理论的验证时诊断指标，包括奖励可观测性分数（ROF）和三个结构正则化项，组合成复合奖励可观测性分数（CROF）。在LunarLander v3上用RSSM世界模型进行实验，以CEM-MPC回报作为闭环质量的标准，评估40个指标与或acles的相关性。
Result: ROF是最强的单指标预测器。CROF选择的世界模型训练的基于模型的A2C策略比无模型A2C基线高出约24.5回报点，且使用约65倍少的真实环境交互；同一世界模型驱动的零样本CEM-MPC策略也表现强劲。
Conclusion: 作者强调CROF能有效离线选择世界模型检查点，在基于模型的强化学习中显著降低环境交互次数，并提升性能。论文的局限性可能在于方法仅在LunarLander v3一个环境上验证，且奖励具有形状性质。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reformalization of the Jordan Curve Theorem
papers.abstract_en: We present a case study in reformalization, a variant of autoformalization in which the input proof is not natural language but a formal development in a different proof assistant. Concretely, we report three reformalizations of the Jordan Curve Theorem: from Mizar to Lean, from HOL Light to Lean, and from HOL Light to Agda. We analyse the results and identify pipeline design choices that matter for practical reformalization tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示了Jordan曲线定理的重形式化 (reformalization) 案例研究，即将不同证明助手（Mizar、HOL Light）中的形式化证明迁移到Lean和Agda。作者分析了结果并识别了实际重形式化任务中重要的管道设计选择。
Motivation: 重形式化是自动形式化的一种变体，其输入不是自然语言而是不同证明助手中的形式化开发。研究旨在理解如何有效进行这种跨系统的证明迁移。
Method: 报告了三个重形式化实验：从Mizar到Lean、从HOL Light到Lean以及从HOL Light到Agda，通过实际案例比较了不同管道设计选择的效果。
Result: 成功完成了三个重形式化任务，并分析了过程中的关键设计决策（如表示细节、自动化和手动干涉的权衡）。
Conclusion: 重形式化是可行的，但需要仔细设计管道；不同证明助手之间的语义差异是主要挑战。

papers.title: Quantum-Inspired Vision: Leveraging Wave-Particle Duality for Low-Illumination Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: This study provides a theoretical expansion of the recent Data Relativistic Uncertainty (DRU) framework by formalizing a physics-to-AI paradigm for image enhancement. By modeling images as probabilistic wave functions rather than deterministic states, the paradigm explicitly integrates wave-particle duality to illustrate the system flow of how DRU leverages the intrinsic physical uncertainty of light, a dimension requiring further theoretical discussion. Consequently, this paradigm provides a rigorous Explainable AI (XAI) approach that enhances the interpretability of how DRU mitigates illumination bias and maintains robustness against data noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对近期提出的数据相对论不确定性 (Data Relativistic Uncertainty, DRU) 框架进行了理论扩展，通过将图像建模为概率波函数而非确定性状态，正式建立了从物理到人工智能的图像增强范式。该范式明确引入了波粒二象性，以说明 DRU 如何利用光的固有物理不确定性来减轻光照偏差并保持对数据噪声的鲁棒性，同时提供了可解释人工智能 (XAI) 的严格方法。
Motivation: 低光照图像增强中，传统方法通常将图像视为确定性状态，忽略了光的物理不确定性。DRU 框架虽然有效，但其背后的物理-人工智能原理尚需进一步理论讨论。本文旨在通过系统阐述波粒二象性在该框架中的作用，填补这一理论空白。
Method: 通过形式化概率波函数表示图像，将 DRU 框架置于量子启发范式中，明确展示波粒二象性如何驱动系统流程，从而提供一个可解释的理论基础，说明 DRU 如何利用光的固有不确定性来增强图像。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果；主要贡献是理论上的形式化与解释性提升，提供了一个严格的 XAI 方法来理解 DRU 框架减轻光照偏差和对抗噪声的机制。
Conclusion: 该研究通过将量子物理中的波粒二象性引入图像增强，为 DRU 框架提供了严谨的可解释性，有望推动物理启发式 AI 在低光照视觉任务中的理论发展。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: DRL-CLBA: A Clean Label Backdoor Attack for Speech Classification via DDPG Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models for speech classification are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where malicious triggers cause misclassification at inference time. While sample-specific attacks can bypass many defenses, they often rely on poisoned label attack, making them detectable via manual data defense. In this paper, we propose DRL-CLBA, a novel clean label backdoor attack for speech classification that leverages Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) reinforcement learning. We also utilize deep audio steganography to embed sample-specific triggers into source audio, creating feature-space anchors. The proposed reinforcement learning framework effectively optimizes target samples toward trigger-bearing anchor points in the model's deep latent space, enabling label-migration-free poisoning of target samples. Experimental results across three datasets and four different DNNs demonstrate that DRL-CLBA achieves a high attack success rate, effectively bypassing some backdoor defenses. The attack demonstrates strong resistance against fine-tuning, pruning, and spectral signature defenses, exposing critical vulnerabilities in speech-controlled systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对语音分类模型的清洁标签后门攻击方法DRL-CLBA，利用深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）强化学习优化目标样本，通过深度音频隐写术嵌入样本特定触发器，在模型深层隐空间创建特征空间锚点，实现无需标签迁移的投毒攻击。实验在三个数据集和四种DNN上取得高攻击成功率，并能绕过微调、剪枝和谱签名等防御。
Motivation: 现有语音分类后门攻击多为中毒标签攻击，易被人工数据防御检测；样本特定攻击虽能绕过多数防御，但依赖标签迁移。本文旨在实现无需标签迁移的清洁标签后门攻击，以增强攻击隐蔽性。
Method: 使用DDPG强化学习框架优化目标样本，将其向触发器对应的特征空间锚点靠拢；同时采用深度音频隐写术将样本特定触发器嵌入源音频，实现清洁标签投毒。
Result: 在三个数据集和四种DNN上，DRL-CLBA实现高攻击成功率，并能有效绕过微调、剪枝和谱签名防御，暴露语音控制系统的关键漏洞。
Conclusion: DRL-CLBA展示了清洁标签后门攻击在语音分类中的有效性，强调了现有防御机制的不足，需要开发更强鲁棒性的防御方法。

papers.title: Beyond Pixel Diffs: Benchmarking Image Change Captioning for Web UI Visual Regression Testing
papers.abstract_en: Visual regression testing (VRT) is a standard quality assurance step in modern software release pipelines. On every change, it re-renders user interface (UI) screenshots, compares each one against an approved baseline image, and routes any detected difference to a human reviewer who decides whether it is an intended update or an unintended regression. A widely used approach, especially in open-source and continuous-integration pipelines, is pixel-level comparison, which is semantically blind and treats rendering noise and genuine defects identically, producing large volumes of false positives that force developers and testers to spend substantial time and effort manually reviewing flagged differences at every release cycle. Industry tools apply machine learning to VRT, but lack public evaluation. More critically, no dataset or benchmark exists to support natural language descriptions of UI changes, a capability that tells testers what changed in words instead of leaving them to interpret a binary flag or a highlighted region. To address the gap, we propose a new task, Web UI Image Change Captioning (WUICC), which sits at the intersection of VRT and image difference captioning (IDC), and release WUICC-bench, its first dataset and benchmark for the task. We evaluate eleven representative IDC methods, together with two zero-shot general-purpose LLMs. We find that: (1) these methods tend to struggle in the Web UI domain due to its layout diversity, dense text, and fine-grained changes, and (2) yet the trained methods already suppress non-meaningful visual noise far more selectively than the pixel-level comparison VRT relies on, providing a solid foundation for future domain-specific research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Web UI图像变化描述（WUICC）任务和基准数据集WUICC-bench，用于视觉回归测试（VRT）。作者评估了11种图像差异描述（IDC）方法和2个零样本通用大语言模型，发现现有方法在Web UI领域因布局多样性、密集文本和细粒度变化而表现挣扎，但训练方法已能比像素级比较更选择性抑制非语义噪声。
Motivation: 视觉回归测试中像素级比较产生大量误报，缺乏自然语言描述UI变化的数据集和基准，导致人工审查耗时费力。
Method: 定义WUICC任务，构建包含Web UI屏幕截图对和自然语言变化描述的基准数据集WUICC-bench，系统评估11种IDC方法和2个零样本LLM。
Result: 现有IDC方法和LLM在Web UI领域表现不佳，但训练方法相比像素级比较能更选择性抑制非语义噪声。
Conclusion: 该基准为未来Web UI领域特定研究提供了基础，但现有方法仍需要针对布局多样性和细粒度变化进行改进。

papers.title: Distributionally Robust Listwise Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Existing robust preference optimization for language-model alignment mainly studies pairwise supervision and places robustness at the dataset, prompt, or preference-pair level. We instead study listwise preference optimization under ranking-label uncertainty: given a prompt and a candidate list, the observed ranking over that list may be ambiguous due to annotator inconsistency, near-ties, lossy rankwise feedback, or reward-model noise. We propose a pointwise total-variation robust Plackett--Luce objective that directly robustifies the ranking label conditional on the candidate list. The robust loss admits an exact decomposition into the nominal PL loss plus a worst-case PL correction, and the worst-case ranking is obtained by sorting current implicit scores in ascending order, reducing the inner maximization from $K!$ enumeration to $O(K\log K)$. This tractable structure yields strong offline and online optimization guarantees. In the offline fixed-list setting, the robust objective is convex and projected stochastic subgradient reaches global $ε$-suboptimality with $O(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity. In the online policy-induced setting, where candidate lists are generated by the current policy, we establish weak convexity and $\widetilde O(ε^{-2})$ Moreau-envelope stationarity. Experiments in offline LLM alignment show that the proposed robust correction largely preserves performance under clean labels and improves robustness under noise. In online alignment, it makes reward-model-ranked candidate expansion more reliable and improves both reward-model and external GPT-4 judge metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对列表式偏好优化中的排序标签不确定性（如标注者不一致、近似平局、奖励模型噪声），提出一种逐点全变差稳健的Plackett-Luce目标函数。该稳健损失可分解为名义PL损失加上最坏情况PL修正，其中最坏情况排序可通过当前隐式分数升序排序得到，将内层最大化从K!枚举降至O(K log K)。在离线固定列表设置中，该目标是凸的，投影随机次梯度达到全局ε-次优性的样本复杂度为O(ε^{-2})；在线策略诱导设置中，证明了弱凸性和Õ(ε^{-2})的Moreau包驻点性。实验表明，在离线LLM对齐中稳健修正能在干净标签下保持性能并在噪声下提升鲁棒性；在线对齐中使基于奖励模型的候选扩展更可靠，并改善奖励模型和外部GPT-4评估指标。
Motivation: 现有稳健偏好优化主要针对成对监督，并在数据集、提示或偏好对层面引入鲁棒性，但忽略了列表式偏好优化中排序标签的不确定性（如标注者不一致、近似平局、奖励模型噪声）。
Method: 提出点wise全变差稳健Plackett-Luce目标，直接对候选列表条件下的排序标签进行稳健化；利用最坏情况排序等于当前隐式分数升序排序的性质，将内层最大化复杂度从K!降至O(K log K)。
Result: 在离线固定列表设置中达到O(ε^{-2})样本复杂度；在线设置中达到Õ(ε^{-2})驻点性。实验表明，该方法在干净标签下保持性能，在噪声下提升鲁棒性，并在在线对齐中改善奖励模型和GPT-4评估指标。
Conclusion: 该稳健方法能够有效处理列表式偏好优化中的标签不确定性，并具有可计算的优化保证和实证优势。

papers.title: Generic Expert Coverage for Pruning SparseMixture-of-Experts Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models contain substantial structured redundancy among routed experts, but pruning them without downstream calibration data remains challenging. Existing expert-pruning methods typically rely on a single aggregated importance score, which can bias the retained set toward experts favored by dominant calibration patterns. We propose \textbf{Generic TB-Coverage}, a coverage-aware expert pruning method that uses only generic text corpora (WikiText2 and C4) for calibration. Instead of collapsing expert utility into one score, our method profiles per-expert utility separately on each corpus and enforces a fixed-budget coverage rule that preserves high-utility experts from each corpus before constructing the final pruning mask. Across Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B and DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Base at 25\%, 50\%, and 75\% retention budgets, our method improves average accuracy on six common zero-shot benchmarks over random pruning, REAP, and ExpertSparsity, while also reducing perplexity degradation on WikiText2 and C4. The gains are largest under aggressive pruning (25\% and 50\% retain), suggesting that preserving cross-corpus expert coverage is an effective generic-data prior for MoE pruning. Our improvements hold with fixed pruning budgets and no downstream calibration data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需下游校准数据的MoE语言模型剪枝方法Generic TB-Coverage，通过使用通用文本语料库（WikiText2和C4）对每个专家的效用进行独立评估，并强制执行固定预算的覆盖规则，以保留各语料库中高效用专家。在Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B和DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Base模型上，以25%、50%和75%的保留预算进行实验，该方法在六个零样本基准上平均准确率优于随机剪枝、REAP和ExpertSparsity，同时减少了困惑度退化。
Motivation: 现有MoE专家剪枝方法通常依赖单一的聚合重要性分数，这可能导致保留集偏向于主导校准模式的专家，且在下游校准数据缺失时表现不佳。
Method: 提出Generic TB-Coverage，一种覆盖感知的专家剪枝方法，使用通用文本语料库（WikiText2和C4）进行校准，对每个语料库分别评估专家效用，并强制执行固定预算的覆盖规则，从各语料库中保留高效用专家，然后构建最终剪枝掩码。
Result: 在Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B和DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Base上，以25%、50%和75%的保留预算，该方法在六个零样本基准上平均准确率优于随机剪枝、REAP和ExpertSparsity，并降低了WikiText2和C4上的困惑度退化；在激进剪枝（25%和50%保留）下增益最大。
Conclusion: 该方法表明，保持跨语料库的专家覆盖是一种有效的通用数据先验，可在固定剪枝预算且无下游校准数据的情况下改进MoE剪枝。

papers.title: COMFYCLAW: Self-Evolving Skill Harnesses for Image Generation Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Agents are increasingly used to construct workflows and assist humans in completing recurring tasks more efficiently. As these workflows become repeated and domain-specific, agent memory and reusable skills become increasingly important: agents should be able to recall workflow patterns, execution constraints, and user preferences from previous runs. We study this problem in workflow-based image generation and introduce COMFYCLAW, an agentic skill evolution harness for controlling ComfyUI workflows. COMFYCLAW formulates workflow construction as typed graph editing, exposes tools organized by construction stage, automatically reverts invalid edits, and uses a region-level vision-language model (VLM) verifier to translate visual failures into actionable repair suggestions. The framework further evolves a progressively disclosed skill library, where trajectories, execution errors, and verifier feedback from previous runs are distilled into reusable Agent Skills. Across four benchmark splits, three agent models, and two image backbones, COMFYCLAW achieves the best average image-generation evaluation score across all six agent configurations, outperforming a verifier-only baseline without skill evolution. Human annotations further show that annotators prefer COMFYCLAW over variants without skill evolution. Our results suggest that skill evolution is an effective mechanism for improving agent reliability and performance in recurring visual workflow construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COMFYCLAW，一个用于控制 ComfyUI 图像生成工作流的智能体技能进化框架。它将工作流构建建模为带类型图编辑，提供按构建阶段组织的工具，自动回退无效编辑，并使用区域级视觉语言模型 (VLM) 验证器将视觉失败转化为可操作的修复建议。框架进一步演进一个渐进式披露的技能库，将先前运行中的轨迹、执行错误和验证器反馈提炼为可复用的 Agent Skills。在四个基准、三个智能体模型和两个图像骨干上的实验表明，COMFYCLAW 在所有六种智能体配置中取得了最佳平均图像生成评估分数，优于没有技能进化的纯验证器基线。
Motivation: 随着工作流变得重复且领域特定，智能体需要从先前运行中回忆工作流模式、执行约束和用户偏好，但现有方法缺乏有效的技能进化机制。
Method: 引入 COMFYCLAW 框架，核心包括：将工作流构建形式化为类型图编辑；按构建阶段组织工具；自动回滚无效编辑；区域级 VLM 验证器将视觉失败转为可操作修复建议；以及通过逐步披露的技能库，将轨迹、错误和反馈蒸馏为可重用的 Agent Skills。
Result: 在四个基准、三个智能体模型和两个图像骨干上，COMFYCLAW 在所有六种配置中实现了最佳平均图像生成评估分数，超过了无技能进化的纯验证器基线。人工评估显示，标注者更偏好 COMFYCLAW 而非无技能进化的变体。
Conclusion: 技能进化是提高智能体在重复视觉工作流构建中可靠性和性能的有效机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Consistent Scene Understanding in 3D Gaussian Splatting via Multi-Cue Mask Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Reliable instance-level scene understanding is a fundamental prerequisite for object-level interactions and high-fidelity 3D representations. While current methods often leverage 2D foundation segmentation models to obtain these priors, their 2D-centric design typically yields fragmented masks and inconsistent predictions across different views. To address these issues, we propose a novel framework that produces consistent 2D instance masks to guide the optimization of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) feature fields. Our framework consists of three main stages. (1) Multi-Cue Extraction that generates synergistic semantic, geometric, and structural priors from input images. (2) Multi-Cue-Guided Mask Merging process that consolidates fragmented masks using a composite merge score derived from semantic, depth, and edge cues. (3) Cross-View Mask Matching that establishes globally consistent identity assignments across all viewpoints. By transforming viewpoint-specific segments into coherent 3D primitives, our approach enables stable 3D instance segmentation and effective downstream editing tasks. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves cross-view consistency and segmentation stability over existing baselines while maintaining high-fidelity photometric reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多线索掩膜细化框架，用于在3D高斯泼溅中实现一致的实例级场景理解。该方法通过多线索提取、掩膜合并和跨视图匹配，生成一致的2D实例掩膜以指导3DGS特征场优化，显著提升跨视图一致性和分割稳定性。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖2D基础分割模型获取先验，但2D设计导致掩膜碎片化和跨视图预测不一致，影响3D场景理解的可靠性。
Method: 提出三阶段框架：多线索提取（语义、几何、结构先验）、多线索引导掩膜合并（基于语义、深度、边缘线索的合并分数）、跨视图掩膜匹配（全局身份分配），将视图特定片段转化为一致3D基元。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在跨视图一致性和分割稳定性上显著优于现有基线，同时保持高保真光度重建。
Conclusion: 该框架通过多线索细化与跨视图匹配，有效解决了2D先验的不一致问题，为3DGS场景理解提供了稳定基础。

papers.title: LASER: A Corrective Lens for LVLMs via Visual Attention Preservation and Sink Suppression
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong reasoning ability but suffer from visual forgetting during long-horizon decoding, where attention progressively drifts away from visual evidence. Existing methods largely treat this issue as a late-stage attention decay problem or attempt to mitigate it through heuristic reminders or post-hoc attention lifting. Through systematic empirical analysis, we find that performance degradation under visual forgetting is largely driven by two overlooked factors: early-stage attention decay disrupts evidence acquisition, and attention concentration on a subset of task-irrelevant visual sink tokens. Motivated by these insights, we propose LASER, a post-training framework that regulates both the visual attention trajectory and intra-visual token attention distribution during reasoning. Technically, LASER introduces two complementary rewards: a Visual Grounding Reward, which encourages the model to maintain attention on semantically salient visual tokens throughout decoding, and a Sink Suppression Reward, which penalizes excessive attention concentration on visual sink tokens. Together, these rewards preserve early-stage grounding while preventing attention collapse onto uninformative regions. Extensive experiments on eight benchmark datasets demonstrate that LASER consistently outperforms strong baselines, validating attention-aware training as an effective remedy for visual forgetting.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在长序列解码中的视觉遗忘问题，提出LASER后训练框架。通过系统分析发现，性能下降主要由早期注意力衰减和注意力集中在与任务无关的视觉汇合令牌（sink tokens）两个因素导致。LASER引入视觉锚定奖励（Visual Grounding Reward）和汇合抑制奖励（Sink Suppression Reward），分别鼓励模型维持对语义显著视觉令牌的注意力、惩罚对视觉汇合令牌的过度关注。在八个基准数据集上，LASER一致优于强基线，验证了注意力感知训练对缓解视觉遗忘的有效性。
Motivation: LVLM在长序列解码时注意力逐渐偏离视觉证据，现有方法未能充分解决早期注意力衰减和注意力集中在无关视觉令牌的问题。
Method: 提出LASER后训练框架，包含两个互补奖励：视觉锚定奖励（维持对语义显著视觉令牌的注意力）和汇合抑制奖励（惩罚对视觉汇合令牌的过度注意力），共同调节解码期间的视觉注意力轨迹和令牌内注意力分布。
Result: 在八个基准数据集上，LASER一致优于强基线，证明注意力感知训练能有效缓解视觉遗忘。
Conclusion: 通过针对早期注意力衰减和注意力集中问题的奖励机制，可有效缓解LVLM的视觉遗忘，提升长序列解码性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pmeta-TLA: Backdoor Attacks for Speech Classification Models via Meta-Learning with Timbre Leakage Attack
papers.abstract_en: Recently, speech classification methods have gained widespread adoption in intelligent gadgets. Current study indicates that backdoor attacks provide a substantial security concern to these models, underscoring the pressing necessity to investigate additional potential attack techniques to expose and prevent such risks. This work discusses the vulnerability of current speech triggers to detection by deep neural network defenders and introduces the Timbre Leakage Attack (TLA). The suggested trigger disseminates timbre information at the frame level within the deep self-supervised features, producing poisoned samples that appear natural to human perception. Furthermore, we introduce Pmeta-TLA, an innovative training mechanism for embedding numerous backdoors one time. This method proposes a multi-backdoor injection training strategy using meta-learning and Projected Conflicting Gradients (PCGrad) and introduces TLA as a multi-target attack tool within it. We performed tests on data-poisoning backdoor attacks in keyword spotting tasks utilizing some deep neural network models. Experimental results indicate that the proposed strategy attains superior Attack efficacy, enhanced stealthiness, robustness, and a reduced attack cost relative to baseline methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语音分类模型易受后门攻击的问题，提出了一种基于元学习的音色泄露攻击（TLA）方法。该方法在帧级别传播音色信息生成看似自然的毒化样本，并引入Pmeta-TLA训练机制，利用元学习和投影冲突梯度（PCGrad）一次性嵌入多个后门。在关键词检测任务上的实验表明，该方法相比基线具有更好的攻击效果、隐蔽性、鲁棒性和更低的攻击成本。
Motivation: 现有后门攻击触发器容易被深度防御网络检测到，亟需探索更隐蔽的攻击技术以暴露和防范此类安全风险。
Method: 提出音色泄露攻击（TLA），在深度自监督特征的帧级别散布音色信息生成自然感知的毒化样本；并设计Pmeta-TLA训练机制，结合元学习和投影冲突梯度（PCGrad）实现一次性注入多个后门，同时作为多目标攻击工具。
Result: 在关键词检测任务上的实验显示，所提策略相对于基线方法取得了优越的攻击效能、增强了隐蔽性和鲁棒性，并降低了攻击成本。
Conclusion: 本文揭示并提出了更隐蔽的后门攻击方法，对语音分类模型的安全性构成威胁，有助于后续防御研究。

papers.title: Structure-Aware Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting has demonstrated remarkable potential in novel view synthesis. In contrast to small-scale scenes, large-scale scenes inevitably contain sparsely observed regions with excessively sparse initial points. In this case, supervising Gaussians initialized from low-frequency sparse points with high-frequency images often induces uncontrolled densification and redundant primitives, degrading both efficiency and quality. Intuitively, this issue can be mitigated with scheduling strategies, which can be categorized into two paradigms: modulating target signal frequency via densification and modulating sampling frequency via image resolution. However, previous scheduling strategies are primarily hardcoded, failing to perceive the convergence behavior of scene frequency. To address this, we reframe the scene reconstruction problem from the perspective of signal structure recovery and propose SIG, a novel scheduler that synchronizes image supervision with Gaussian frequencies. Specifically, we derive the average sampling frequency and bandwidth of 3D representations, and then regulate the training image resolution and the Gaussian densification process based on scene frequency convergence. Furthermore, we introduce Sphere-Constrained Gaussians, which leverage the spatial prior of initialized point clouds to control Gaussian optimization. Our framework enables frequency-consistent, geometry-aware, and floater-free training, achieving state-of-the-art performance by a substantial margin in both efficiency and rendering quality in large-scale scenes. The code is available at: https://github.com/weiyixue999/Signal_Structure_Aware_Gaussian
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模场景3D高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting）中稀疏观测区域导致的不受控密集化和冗余基元问题，提出信号结构感知的调度器SIG。该方法通过推导3D表示的采样频率和带宽，同步调节训练图像分辨率和高斯密集化过程，并引入球面约束高斯（Sphere-Constrained Gaussians）利用点云空间先验。实验表明，该方法在大规模场景的重建效率和渲染质量上均显著超越了现有方法。
Motivation: 现有大规模场景3D高斯溅射在稀疏观测区域因初始点过少，用高频图像监督低频稀疏点会引发不受控密集化和冗余基元，降低效率和质量。已有的调度策略多为硬编码，未能感知场景频率的收敛行为。
Method: 提出SIG调度器，从信号结构恢复角度重新定义重建问题：推导3D表示的平均采样频率和带宽，根据场景频率收敛动态调节训练图像分辨率和高斯密集化过程；并引入球面约束高斯，利用初始化点云的空间先验约束高斯优化。
Result: 摘要声称在大规模场景中，该方法在效率和渲染质量上均大幅达到最先进性能（state-of-the-art）。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了频率一致、几何感知、无漂浮物（floater-free）的训练，显著提升大规模场景重建质量和效率。代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Frequency Shift Physics-Informed Extreme Learning Machine for Solving High-Frequency Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: Solving partial differential equations (PDEs) with high-frequency solutions remains a central challenge in physics-informed machine learning due to spectral bias -- the tendency of neural networks to learn low-frequency components preferentially. This paper proposes a Frequency Shift Physics-Informed Extreme Learning Machine (FS-PIELM) framework that addresses this limitation through an additive mechanism for weight initialization. Rather than multiplying random weights by a scaling factor, the method translates the mean of the Gaussian weight distribution while keeping the variance fixed at unity, thereby avoiding the variance amplification inherent in scaling-based methods. Two variants are developed: FS-PIELM-L assigns independent frequency magnitudes to individual neurons, while FS-PIELM-G groups neurons for improved robustness. Theoretical analysis shows that the frequency variance under the proposed framework remains bounded and approaches unity regardless of target frequency, in contrast to the quadratic growth of conventional approaches. The method preserves the computational efficiency of extreme learning machines, requiring only a single linear solve. Experiments on seven benchmark problems spanning six equation types -- Helmholtz, wave, Poisson, Klein-Gordon, heat, and advection-diffusion -- on both regular and complex geometries show that the linear variant achieves the best accuracy in six of seven cases, with improvements of one to nearly five orders of magnitude over existing PIELM variants. The code and data accompanying this manuscript will be made publicly available at https://github.com/xgxgnpu/Physics-informed-vibe-coding/tree/main/FS-PIELM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出频率位移物理信息极端学习机（FS-PIELM）框架，通过加性权重初始化机制解决高频偏微分方程求解中的谱偏差问题。理论分析表明频率方差有界，实验在七个基准问题（涵盖Helmholtz、波动、泊松等六种方程类型）上显示精度提升最多近五个数量级。
Motivation: 物理信息机器学习中神经网络存在谱偏差，倾向于学习低频分量，难以求解高频PDE，亟需一种能突破该限制的方法。
Method: 提出FS-PIELM，采用加性机制平移高斯权重分布的均值而非缩放，保持方差固定为1，避免方差放大。开发两个变体：FS-PIELM-L为单个神经元分配独立频率，FS-PIELM-G对神经元分组以提高鲁棒性。
Result: 在七种基准问题中，线性变体在六个问题上取得最佳精度，相比现有PIELM变体提升1到近5个数量级，且计算效率仅需一次线性求解。
Conclusion: 该方法保证了频率方差有界，避免了传统方法中与目标频率的平方增长，为高频PDE求解提供了高效且准确的框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Mathematical Introduction to Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: These notes give a proof-oriented introduction to diffusion models from the viewpoint of sampling, tracing a single arc from classical sampling dynamics to modern diffusion samplers, their error analysis, and inference-time control. Throughout, the material is layered into core definitions and identities proved in full, representative estimates proved under simplifying assumptions, and research-level theorems stated with a proof roadmap. The intended audience is beginning graduate students with a background in probability but no prior exposure to stochastic differential equations, stochastic numerics, or diffusion models.
papers.comment: Lecture notes for the John Tukey Summer Graduate School on Mathematics of Generative Models at SLMath (June 22nd, 2026 -- July 2nd, 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这些讲义从采样视角给出了扩散模型的数学入门，覆盖从经典采样动力学到现代扩散采样器的单一主线，并包含误差分析与推理时控制。全文分层呈现：核心定义与恒等式给出完整证明，代表性估计在简化假设下证明，研究级定理提供证明路线图。目标读者为具有概率背景但未接触随机微分方程、随机数值或扩散模型的研究生。
Motivation: 缺乏一份从采样角度系统介绍扩散模型数学基础的讲义，便于概率背景的研究生快速入门。
Method: 讲义采用分层结构，从定义和恒等式的完整证明，到简化假设下的代表性估计，再到研究级定理的证明框架。
Result: 通过统一经典与现代扩散采样器，提供了自包含的数学推导和误差分析。
Conclusion: 本文是一份教学讲义，以数学严谨性为特点，旨在为初学者提供扩散模型的采样视角入门。
Relevance: 0
