papers.title: Epistemic Goggles: A Pretrained Module that Induces an Epistemic Frame via Gradient Editing
papers.abstract_en: Finetuning a language model on documents that are explicitly annotated as fictional results in a model that still actually believes the documents' core claims, an effect known as Negation Neglect. In our evaluations, models trained on documents prefixed and suffixed with such annotations correctly identify the relevant claims as fictional only about 9% of the time. To address this, we introduce Goggles, a learned module that intervenes on the finetuning gradient rather than the data. During supervised finetuning, a Goggles module edits the gradients an LLM LoRA receives, imparting a chosen epistemic frame (the stance the model takes toward the nature of what it reads) to whatever the documents teach. A Goggles instance is trained once for a given base model, frame, and LoRA configuration, then applied frozen to documents it was never trained on. Trained through Goggles on those same documents, now carrying no fictional annotation, the model flags the content as fictional roughly 91% of the time, while preserving capability (GPQA and TruthfulQA match or exceed baseline). The same architecture supports other frames: a Goggles instance can be trained to treat documents as "part of an AI safety evaluation by Redwood Research" rather than simply as fiction. The imparted frame persists under continued finetuning that pushes back toward the claim, where prior interventions revert. Goggles suggests a path toward training language models on known-misaligned data without absorbing the behaviors that data demonstrates.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables. Code at https://github.com/JoshuaSP/epistemic-goggles and generated documents, questions, and teacher rollouts at https://huggingface.co/datasets/joshuapenman/epistemic-goggles-artifacts
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型微调时对虚构文档内容仍会相信的问题（否定忽略效应），提出Epistemic Goggles模块，通过编辑梯度而非数据来赋予模型特定的认知框架。实验表明，训练后的模型在无虚构标注的情况下，约91%的时间能将内容标记为虚构，同时保持能力（GPQA和TruthfulQA匹配或超过基线）。该模块支持其他认知框架，且框架在后续微调中持续存在。
Motivation: 语言模型微调时即使文档明确标注为虚构，模型仍会相信其核心主张（否定忽略效应），导致模型学习到错误信息。
Method: 提出Goggles模块，在监督微调期间干预LoRA的梯度，从而向模型传递选定的认知框架（如将文档视为虚构）。Goggles实例针对特定基座模型、框架和LoRA配置训练一次，然后冻结应用于未见过的文档。
Result: 训练后的模型在无虚构标注的文档上，约91%的时间能够正确识别为虚构，而基线仅约9%；同时GPQA和TruthfulQA指标匹配或超过基线。框架在后续对抗性微调中仍能保持。
Conclusion: Goggles模块提供了一种方法，使语言模型可以在已知有偏差的数据上训练而不吸收其行为，支持多种认知框架。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对语言模型微调时对虚构文档内容仍会相信的问题（否定忽略效应），提出Epistemic Goggles模块，通过编辑梯度而非数据来赋予模型特定的认知框架。实验表明，训练后的模型在无虚构标注的情况下，约91%的时间能将内容标记为虚构，同时保持能力（GPQA和TruthfulQA匹配或超过基线）。该模块支持其他认知框架，且框架在后续微调中持续存在。
summary_sections.motivation: 语言模型微调时即使文档明确标注为虚构，模型仍会相信其核心主张（否定忽略效应），导致模型学习到错误信息。
summary_sections.method: 提出Goggles模块，在监督微调期间干预LoRA的梯度，从而向模型传递选定的认知框架（如将文档视为虚构）。Goggles实例针对特定基座模型、框架和LoRA配置训练一次，然后冻结应用于未见过的文档。
summary_sections.result: 训练后的模型在无虚构标注的文档上，约91%的时间能够正确识别为虚构，而基线仅约9%；同时GPQA和TruthfulQA指标匹配或超过基线。框架在后续对抗性微调中仍能保持。
summary_sections.conclusion: Goggles模块提供了一种方法，使语言模型可以在已知有偏差的数据上训练而不吸收其行为，支持多种认知框架。

papers.title: Model Merging as Probabilistic Inference in Fine-Tuning Parameter Space
papers.abstract_en: Model merging aims to combine existing single-task solutions into a multi-task solution without additional data-driven fine-tuning.~Most existing approaches achieve this using geometric properties of local solution spaces. However, such geometric views provide limited guidance for scoring how statistically useful each task-specific update direction is across tasks during merging. To address this, we formulate model merging from a new perspective of probabilistic inference under a product-of-experts (PoE) scenario where each single-task solution defines an energy-based expert model (EBM) over the merged parameters. We show that several existing model merging methods arise as special cases of our framework under energy designs that impose implicit Gaussian assumptions on directional residuals between merged and task-specific models. Empirically, we find that these residuals are often heavy-tailed which exposes a mismatch with the imposed light-tailed Gaussian structures. We address this with a heavy-tailed PoE design based on Cauchy experts, which better captures the observed residual behavior while admitting a provably convergent inference procedure. Experiments across multiple tasks and architectures show significant improvements over state-of-the-arts baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/MinhLong210/PoE-EBM-Merging.git.
papers.comment: Accepted for Publication at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 将模型合并问题重新形式化为概率推断，在产品-of-专家（PoE）框架下，每个单任务微化解定义基于能量的模型。研究发现现有方法隐含高斯假设，与实际残差的重尾分布不匹配，因此提出基于柯西专家的重尾PoE设计，并证明推理过程收敛。在多个任务和架构上的实验显示该方法显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有模型合并方法多依赖几何性质，缺乏对任务特定更新方向统计有效性的评估，需要概率推断视角以更好地利用各任务的方向信息。
Method: 提出产品-of-专家（PoE）概率推断框架，每个单任务解作为能量基专家模型。分析发现现有方法隐含高斯假设导致残差重尾不匹配，因此设计基于柯西专家的重尾PoE，并保证推理收敛。
Result: 在多个任务和架构上的实验表明，该方法显著优于现有基线（SOTA）。
Conclusion: 该概率推断框架统一了多种现有方法，并通过重尾分布更好地建模残差，从而提升模型合并性能。代码已开源。

papers.title: WARP: Weight-Space Analysis for Recovering Training Data Portfolios
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are routinely released to the public, yet the data recipes used to train them -- such as domain mixture weights that determine how different sources are sampled -- are rarely disclosed. This creates an access asymmetry: researchers study the resulting models but lack visibility into the training distribution that produces them. Prior works for inferring training data, such as membership inference, detect at the level of individual samples and thus cannot characterize the global composition of the training corpus. We introduce WARP, a framework that recovers a fine-tuned model's training mixtures directly from its released weights. WARP interpolates between the base and fine-tuned models using model merging, generating pseudo-checkpoints that approximate the missing training trajectory and expose a geometric footprint of the training data in the weight space. From these simulated footprints, WARP extracts geometric features and maps them to domain proportions using either a parameter-free softmax readout or an MLP projector trained on synthetic mixtures. In controlled experiments with BERT and GPT-2, WARP recovers domain mixtures with an average MAE as low as 0.046 and 0.104 respectively, outperforming membership inference and a variant with access to the true training trajectory.
papers.comment: This work appears in the ICML 2026 Workshop on Weight-Space Symmetries (WSS): from Foundations to Practical Applications. Our source code is available at github.com/SprocketLab/WARP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WARP 是一个从已发布模型的权重中恢复训练数据混合的框架。它通过模型合并生成伪检查点近似训练轨迹，提取几何特征并映射到域比例。在 BERT 和 GPT-2 上的实验表明，WARP 的平均 MAE 低至 0.046 和 0.104，优于成员推断和可访问真实轨迹的变体。
Motivation: 基础模型的数据配方（如域混合权重）通常不公开，导致研究者无法了解训练分布。现有的成员推断方法只能检测单个样本，无法表征全局训练语料组成。
Method: WARP 通过模型合并插值基模型和微调模型，生成伪检查点模拟缺失的训练轨迹；从中提取几何特征，并使用无参数 softmax 读出器或基于合成混合训练的 MLP 投影器，将特征映射到域比例。
Result: 在受控实验中，WARP 在 BERT 和 GPT-2 上恢复域混合的平均 MAE 分别低至 0.046 和 0.104，性能优于成员推断和可访问真实训练轨迹的变体方法。
Conclusion: WARP 能够仅从发布的权重中有效恢复微调模型的训练数据混合，为模型透明度提供了一种新途径。

papers.title: Beyond Gradient-Based Attacks: Adversarial Robustness and Explainability Stability in Cybersecurity Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial attacks on cybersecurity classifiers pose a dual threat: degrading predictions and destabilising the SHAP-based explanations that security analysts rely on to understand and triage alerts. We extend our prior MLP conference study to Random Forest and XGBoost across four tabular security datasets (phishing URLs, UNSW-NB15, NF-ToN-IoT, HIKARI-2021), evaluating five attacks including three black-box methods applicable to non-differentiable tree models. We introduce the Explainability Stability Index (ESI), a scalar metric computed from TreeSHAP attribution drift under adversarial perturbation, reported on the same [0,1] scale as the Robustness Index (RI). A key finding is that gradient-based black-box attacks (ZOO) produce degenerate results against XGBoost (apparent RI ~0.98) due to piecewise-constant prediction surfaces, while score-based Square Attack reveals genuine vulnerability (RI ~0.36). These degenerate perturbations still drive substantial attribution drift: XGBoost ESI ~0.06-0.16 despite near-perfect ZOO robustness, versus 0.14-0.29 for RF, showing that prediction robustness and explanation stability are distinct axes requiring joint measurement. A two-axis framework (gradient dependence, query efficiency) explains the observed attack ranking and yields practical guidance for tree ensemble evaluation. A step-size ablation explains a counterintuitive PGD anomaly on z-score normalised tabular data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究网络安全分类器（随机森林、XGBoost）在对抗攻击下的预测鲁棒性与基于SHAP的可解释性稳定性，引入可解释性稳定性指数（ESI）联合评估两者。实验发现基于梯度的黑盒攻击（ZOO）在XGBoost上产生虚假的高鲁棒性（RI~0.98），但实际归因漂移显著（ESI~0.06-0.16），表明预测与解释稳定性是独立维度。
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击评估多关注预测精度下降，但忽视了对安全分析师依赖的SHAP解释稳定性的破坏；且树模型因不可微性导致梯度攻击失效，需系统性评估。
Method: 在四个表格安全数据集上，对随机森林和XGBoost实施五种攻击（含三种黑盒方法），计算鲁棒性指数（RI）和新提出的可解释性稳定性指数（ESI），基于TreeSHAP归因漂移。同时提出两轴框架（梯度依赖、查询效率）分析攻击效果。
Result: ZOO攻击在XGBoost上产生退化结果（RI~0.98），但Square Attack揭示真实脆弱性（RI~0.36）；XGBoost的ESI为0.06-0.16，RF为0.14-0.29，说明归因漂移与预测鲁棒性不相关。
Conclusion: 预测鲁棒性与解释稳定性需联合评估，两轴框架可为树集成模型的对抗评估提供实用指导。

papers.title: SCAPE: Accurate and Efficient LLM Training with Extreme Sparse Communication
papers.abstract_en: Communication increasingly dominates the cost of Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training, especially under data-parallel and sharded training schemes, where gradient synchronization and parameter reconstruction overhead increase with model size and system scale. Existing communication-reduction methods either sparsify raw gradients, which can be unstable for modern Adam-style optimizers at high sparsity, or quantize communication, whose savings are fundamentally bounded by bit width and often incur additional runtime overhead. We present SCAPE, a communication-efficient distributed optimizer for LLM training that exploits the stability of AdamS's first-moment to enable aggressive sparsification without loss of LLM quality. Instead of constructing masks from raw gradients, SCAPE derives them from first-moment-based statistics, partitions mask generation across workers to align with optimizer sharding, and delays mask usage by one step so that mask synchronization can overlap with computation. SCAPE also reconstructs the quantities required for second-moment updates from a single synchronized sparse buffer, avoiding an additional collective. We implement SCAPE in Megatron-LM and evaluate its convergence by pre-training GPT-345M on OpenWebText and Llama-500M on SlimPajama-6B using 32 NVIDIA GH200 GPUs on TACC Vista. In both models, SCAPE preserves training stability, validation loss, and downstream task accuracy under 90\% and 99\% sparsity. For Llama-500M, SCAPE reduces end-to-end pre-training wall-clock time by up to 43.3\% while maintaining model quality comparable to dense AdamW and AdamS. For Llama-1.8B, SCAPE achieves up to 3.26$\times$ speedup per step compared to dense AdamS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCAPE，一种面向大语言模型训练的通信高效分布式优化器。SCAPE 利用 AdamS 一阶矩的稳定性，从一阶矩统计量而非原始梯度中构建稀疏掩码，实现 90%-99% 稀疏度下的梯度稀疏化，且不损失模型质量。在 Megatron-LM 中实现，使用 32 块 NVIDIA GH200 GPU 预训练 GPT-345M 和 Llama-500M 模型，在 99% 稀疏度下保持验证损失和下游任务精度，对 Llama-500M 端到端训练加速达 43.3%，对 Llama-1.8B 单步加速最高 3.26 倍。
Motivation: 大语言模型预训练中通信开销日益主导成本，现有方法（梯度稀疏化对 Adam 类优化器不稳定，或量化通信节省有限且带来额外开销）难以兼顾高效与稳定。
Method: SCAPE 从 AdamS 的一阶矩统计量生成稀疏掩码（而非原始梯度），将掩码生成分布到各工作节点以对齐优化器分片，延迟掩码使用一步以使掩码同步与计算重叠，并从单个同步稀疏缓冲区重建二阶矩更新所需量，避免额外集合通信。
Result: 在 GPT-345M (OpenWebText) 和 Llama-500M (SlimPajama-6B) 上，SCAPE 在 90% 和 99% 稀疏度下保持训练稳定性、验证损失和下游任务精度。对 Llama-500M 端到端 wall-clock 时间减少 43.3%，对 Llama-1.8B 每步比密集 AdamS 加速 3.26 倍。
Conclusion: SCAPE 通过基于一阶矩的稀疏化实现激进通信压缩，在保持模型质量的同时显著加速 LLM 训练，适用于大规模分布式训练场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ICDepth: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Video Depth Estimation via In-Context Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Monocular video depth estimation requires temporal consistency, geometric accuracy, and generalization across diverse scenarios, yet existing methods struggle to achieve all three simultaneously. Discriminative models excel at per-frame accuracy but suffer from temporal drift due to limited context windows, while generative methods improve consistency and generalization at the cost of extensive training data (10M+ samples) and lack of geometric precision. In response to these issues, we introduce \textbf{ICDepth}, a framework that adapts pre-trained text-to-video diffusion transformers for video depth estimation via In-Context Conditioning (ICC), leveraging their rich spatial-temporal priors. To address key challenges in transferring ICC from generation to dense prediction, we propose: (1)~\textbf{SAND-Attention}, which ensures precise spatial-temporal alignment via shared RoPE and enforces unidirectional attention to prevent noise contamination; (2)~\textbf{SRFM}, which injects DINOv2 semantic and resolution priors to enhance geometric precision. ICDepth achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks with remarkable data efficiency, trained on only 0.8M frames ($6$--$13\times$ less than competing generative methods), while demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization to diverse domains.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://xuanhuahe.github.io/ICDepth/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ICDepth框架，利用预训练的文本到视频扩散变换器进行视频深度估计，通过上下文条件化（ICC）充分利用时空先验。针对从生成任务转移到密集预测任务的挑战，提出了SAND-Attention实现精确时空对齐，以及SRFM注入DINOv2语义和分辨率先验提升几何精度。该方法仅用80万帧数据（比竞争生成方法少6-13倍）就在多个基准上取得最先进结果，并展现强大的零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有单目视频深度估计方法难以同时实现时间一致性、几何精度和泛化能力：判别式模型受限于上下文窗口导致时间漂移，生成式模型需要大量训练数据（1000万+样本）且缺乏几何精度。
Method: 基于预训练文本到视频扩散变换器，提出上下文条件化（ICC）框架；设计SAND-Attention（共享RoPE和单向注意力）防止噪声污染，以及SRFM（注入DINOv2语义和分辨率先验）增强几何精度。
Result: 在多个基准上取得最先进结果，仅用80万帧训练数据（比竞争生成方法少6-13倍），并展示强零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: ICDepth验证了将扩散先验从生成任务迁移到密集预测任务的有效性，通过上下文条件化实现了数据高效且泛化性强的视频深度估计。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有单目视频深度估计方法难以同时实现时间一致性、几何精度和泛化能力：判别式模型受限于上下文窗口导致时间漂移，生成式模型需要大量训练数据（1000万+样本）且缺乏几何精度。
summary_sections.method: 基于预训练文本到视频扩散变换器，提出上下文条件化（ICC）框架；设计SAND-Attention（共享RoPE和单向注意力）防止噪声污染，以及SRFM（注入DINOv2语义和分辨率先验）增强几何精度。
summary_sections.result: 在多个基准上取得最先进结果，仅用80万帧训练数据（比竞争生成方法少6-13倍），并展示强零样本泛化能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: ICDepth验证了将扩散先验从生成任务迁移到密集预测任务的有效性，通过上下文条件化实现了数据高效且泛化性强的视频深度估计。

papers.title: A Deep Learning Earth System Model Simulation of Indian Monsoon Intraseasonal and Interannual Variability
papers.abstract_en: With the data-driven artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) models having demonstrated their ability to extend the prediction horizon of large-scale weather at a fraction of computational cost of numerical weather prediction models, a pertinent question is, could these models do the same for sub-seasonal to seasonal (S2S) prediction? A key challenge in developing a S2S prediction system is the requirement for a coupled ocean-atmosphere Earth system emulator that can stably simulate the observed intraseasonal and interannual variability with fidelity. In the rapidly evolving field of AI/ML weather models, such a deep learning 3D ocean-atmosphere coupled model has become available, called SamudrACE. With our interest in developing an AI/ML S2S model for Indian monsoon, here we examine the extent to which SamudrACE faithfully simulates Indian monsoon intraseasonal and interannual variability. Compared to observation, we found biases in SamudrACE's simulation of monsoon intraseasonal and interannual variability. Our systematic documentation and analyses of these biases provide a useful benchmark for improving not only SamudrACE but also coupled emulators in general and could fast track the development of a deep learning 3D global S2S prediction system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了深度学习地球系统模型SamudrACE在模拟印度季风季节内和年际变率方面的表现。通过与观测对比，发现该模型存在偏差，并系统记录了这些偏差，为改进耦合仿真器以及开发深度学习S2S预测系统提供了基准。
Motivation: 开发基于AI/ML的季节到次季节（S2S）预测系统需要稳定的海气耦合地球系统仿真器，而现有深度学习模型在模拟季风变率方面的能力尚未充分验证。
Method: 利用已发布的深度学习三维海气耦合模型SamudrACE，将其模拟结果与观测数据对比，系统分析和文档化印度季风季节内和年际变率的偏差。
Result: SamudrACE在模拟印度季风季节内和年际变率方面存在偏差，论文提供了这些偏差的系统文档和分析。
Conclusion: 这些偏差记录可作为改进SamudrACE及其他耦合仿真器的基准，有助于加速开发深度学习三维全球S2S预测系统。

papers.title: HistoSeg++: Delving deeper with attention and multiscale feature fusion for biomarker segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Segmentation of biomarkers in medical images is frequently viewed as a first step towards medical image analysis in any bioinformatics or biomedical application. Despite progress, existing methods still struggle to capture information at multiple scales and to perform upsampling effectively across different datasets. These shortcomings often result in suboptimal generalization capabilities. Recently, architectures belonging to the Nested-UNet family excel in capturing multiscale contextual information and upsample them effectively. In this work, We propose a novel Nested-UNet architecture that effectively captures multi-scale contextual information. It includes inner and outer attention units to enhance focus during upsampling, along with channel-wise feature recalibration using squeeze-and-excitation modules, leading to improved segmentation performance. Additionally, the architecture integrates an edge-aware loss to emphasize boundary accuracy by assigning greater importance to edge regions. Tested extensively on three publicly available benchmark datasets. Our method demonstrates a generalization performance superior to existing Nested-UNet methods. Code: https://github.com/saadwazir/histosegplusplus
papers.comment: Published in the Proceedings of ICBBE 2025. The Version of Record is available at https://doi.org/10.1145/3794209.3794211
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种改进的Nested-UNet架构用于医学图像中生物标志物分割，通过引入内外注意力单元（inner and outer attention units）增强上采样过程中的关注，并使用Squeeze-and-Excitation模块进行通道特征重标定，同时结合边缘感知损失（edge-aware loss）提升边界精度。在三个公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法的泛化性能优于现有Nested-UNet方法。
Motivation: 现有医学图像分割方法在捕获多尺度上下文信息和有效上采样方面存在不足，导致泛化能力差。
Method: 提出一种新的Nested-UNet架构，包含内外注意力单元以增强上采样焦点，Squeeze-and-Excitation模块实现通道特征重标定，并集成边缘感知损失以强调边界区域。
Result: 在三个公开基准数据集上测试，该方法展现出优于现有Nested-UNet方法的泛化性能。
Conclusion: 通过注意力机制和边缘感知损失，该架构能有效提升多尺度上下文信息的捕获和边界分割精度。

papers.title: Separating Expert Retention from Autonomous Source Inference in Raw-ECG-Replay-Free Continual ECG Deployment
papers.abstract_en: In multi-source ECG deployment, models may need to incorporate new data sources when earlier raw ECGs cannot be retained or replayed. Freezing a pretrained backbone and assigning each source an isolated classifier prevents parameter interference, but deployment still requires selecting an expert when source metadata are unavailable. We study this distinction through \ours{}, an incremental expert bank built on frozen 1024-dimensional ECGFounder features. Each arriving domain adds a balanced-softmax linear expert, while a lightweight router is fitted only on retained training features and domain labels from sources observed so far. A validation-calibrated margin rule fuses the two most likely experts instead of committing to a single routed expert. On CPSC, PTB-XL, Georgia, and Chapman-Shaoxing, source-aware expert selection reaches $0.7915\pm0.0036$ Macro-F1 and a matched offline independent-head reference reaches $0.7885\pm0.0009$, supporting strong source-aware expert retention. Without source IDs, an MLP router reaches $0.7756\pm0.0027$ and top-2 margin fusion reaches $0.7782\pm0.0022$. The top-2 gain over hard MLP routing is small ($+0.0026$), with a 95\% confidence interval from paired bootstrap that includes zero. Across three domain orders, the top-2-to-oracle gap remains $0.0111$--$0.0133$, identifying autonomous source inference as the main remaining bottleneck. No raw ECGs are replayed, but frozen training features are retained for router updates; the method is therefore not memory-free.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多源心电图（ECG）持续部署中的专家保留与自主源推断问题。采用冻结预训练骨干（ECGFounder）和独立线性专家，通过轻量路由器进行源推断，并引入验证校准的top-2边际融合策略。在四个ECG数据集上，源感知专家选择达到了接近离线独立头参考的性能，但无源ID时路由器性能下降，top-2融合提升有限，表明自主源推断是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 在多源ECG部署中，模型需整合新数据源，但原始ECG数据无法保留或重放。现有方法冻结骨干并分配独立分类器可防止参数干扰，但源元数据不可用时如何选择专家成为关键问题。
Method: 提出增量专家库（incremental expert bank），基于冻结的1024维ECGFounder特征，每个新领域添加一个平衡softmax线性专家，并通过保留的训练特征和领域标签训练轻量路由器。采用验证校准的边际规则融合top-2最可能专家，而非单一路由专家。
Result: 在CPSC、PTB-XL、Georgia和Chapman-Shaoxing数据集上，源感知专家选择达到0.7915±0.0036 Macro-F1，匹配离线独立头参考（0.7885±0.0009）。无源ID时，MLP路由器达0.7756±0.0027，top-2边际融合达0.7782±0.0022，提升较小且置信区间包含零。三种领域顺序下，top-2到oracle差距为0.0111–0.0133。
Conclusion: 方法能有效保留源感知专家，但自主源推断是主要瓶颈。未重放原始ECG，但保留了冻结训练特征用于路由器更新，因此并非完全无内存。

papers.title: UniWind: Toward Unified Day-Ahead Wind Power Forecasting via Physics-Informed State Routing
papers.abstract_en: Day-ahead wind power forecasting is essential for cost-effective power-system operation. It is primarily driven by future meteorological conditions while retaining temporal dependencies in power generation. In practice, observed wind-farm power often entangles physically available power with local environmental effects and latent operational states, such as shutdowns and curtailment. Existing physical models provide useful constraints but adapt poorly across wind farms, whereas data-driven models can capture rich correlations but often conflate meteorological effects with state-induced deviations. In this study, we propose UniWind, a wind power forecasting model based on physics-informed state routing. UniWind first employs a Physical Prior Estimator to construct a site-calibrated physical prior by combining site-conditioned monotonic warping with a shared physical power curve. It further applies a physical upper-bound constraint to shape this prior as a soft envelope of available wind power generation. UniWind then proposes a Latent State Encoder to model operating-state embeddings and transforms the physical prior into final power forecasts through a State-aware Power Corrector, which uses knowledge-guided supervised state routing and bounded, state-specific expert correction. Full-shot and cross-farm zero-shot experiments on more than 20 real-world datasets demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of UniWind.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniWind，一种基于物理信息状态路由的日前风电功率预测模型。该模型通过物理先验估计器结合站点条件单调扭曲和共享物理功率曲线，生成站点校准的物理先验，并施加物理上界约束。随后通过潜在状态编码器建模运行状态嵌入，利用状态感知功率校正器将物理先验转换为最终功率预测。在超过20个真实数据集上进行全样本和跨风场零样本实验，验证了UniWind的准确性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有物理模型适应性差，数据驱动模型混淆气象效应与状态偏差，无法有效处理风电场停运、限电等潜在运行状态导致的功率偏差。
Method: 提出UniWind，包含物理先验估计器（站点条件单调扭曲+共享物理功率曲线+物理上界约束）、潜在状态编码器和状态感知功率校正器（知识引导监督状态路由+有界状态特定专家校正）。
Result: 在20多个真实数据集上的全样本和跨风场零样本实验表明UniWind具有高准确性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: UniWind通过物理信息状态路由统一了物理模型和數據驅動模型的优势，有效处理了风电场运行状态引起的功率偏差。

papers.title: Temporal and Cross-Modal Alignment for Enhanced Audiovisual Video Captioning
papers.abstract_en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced video understanding, achieving precise temporal and cross-modal alignment in audiovisual video captioning remains a formidable challenge. Most existing approaches suffer from modality detachment and temporal incoherence, failing to accurately bind auditory events to visual entities or capture complex causal dynamics. To address these deficiencies, we propose TCA-Captioner, a framework specifically engineered to enhance Temporal and Cross-Modal Alignment for audiovisual video captioning. We first introduce the Observer-Checker-Corrector (OCC) framework, an iterative refinement strategy that generates high-fidelity, meticulously grounded training data. Leveraging a curated high-density human interaction dataset, TCA-Captioner is optimized to model sophisticated audiovisual interactions. Furthermore, we present TCA-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark utilizing a Decoupled Evaluation Protocol to isolate and quantify model proficiency in audiovisual binding and temporal relational reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TCA-Captioner sets a new standard for temporally-coherent and synchronized audiovisual narratives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视听视频字幕生成中模态分离与时间不连贯的问题，提出TCA-Captioner框架，通过Observer-Checker-Corrector (OCC)迭代细化策略生成高保真训练数据，并构建TCA-Bench诊断基准。实验表明该方法在时间同步的视听叙事上达到新标准。
Motivation: 现有方法在视听视频字幕中难以实现精确的时间与跨模态对齐，常出现模态脱节和时间不连贯，无法准确绑定听觉事件与视觉实体或捕获复杂因果动态。
Method: 提出TCA-Captioner框架，包含Observer-Checker-Corrector (OCC)迭代细化策略以生成高质量训练数据，并利用高密度人机交互数据集进行优化。同时构建TCA-Bench基准，采用解耦评估协议量化模型能力。
Result: 实验表明TCA-Captioner在时间连贯和同步的视听叙事上设立新标准，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: TCA-Captioner通过增强时间和跨模态对齐，提升了视听视频字幕的生成质量，其诊断基准有助于评估相关能力。

papers.title: Revisiting Decentralized Online Convex Optimization with Compressed Communication
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized online convex optimization (D-OCO) is a popular framework for distributed applications with streaming data. To tackle the communication bottleneck, previous studies have investigated D-OCO with compressed communication and proposed several algorithms that are variants of online gradient descent (OGD). However, for D-OCO with exact communication, the best existing algorithms are variants of follow-the-regularized-leader (FTRL). In this paper, for the first time, we propose two FTRL-type algorithms for D-OCO with compressed communication. Compared with OGD-type algorithms, our algorithms are more elegant in both algorithmic design and theoretical analysis. The key insight is that the dual update mechanism of FTRL allows us to make a simple application of the technique for average consensus with communication compression. More specifically, our first algorithm considers the full-information setting, and can match the existing regret bounds. Our second algorithm is designed for the bandit setting, and can significantly improve both the regret bounds and communication costs of existing algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次提出两种基于 Follow-the-Regularized-Leader (FTRL) 的去中心化在线凸优化 (D-OCO) 压缩通信算法。在完全信息设定下，该算法匹配现有遗憾界；在在线学习 (bandit) 设定下，显著改善遗憾界与通信成本。
Motivation: 现有 D-OCO 压缩通信算法多为在线梯度下降 (OGD) 变体，缺乏利用更优雅的 FTRL 框架的尝试。本文旨在填补这一空白，并利用 FTRL 的对偶更新机制简化压缩通信技术的应用。
Method: 提出两种 FTRL 类型的算法：第一种针对完全信息设定，第二种针对在线学习 (bandit) 设定。核心思想是利用 FTRL 的对偶更新机制，将平均共识 (average consensus) 技术简单应用于压缩通信场景。
Result: 在完全信息设定下，算法匹配现有遗憾界；在在线学习设定下，算法显著改进遗憾界并降低通信成本。
Conclusion: 本文展示了 FTRL 框架在压缩通信 D-OCO 中的优越性，为后续研究提供了新的理论工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unified Panoramic-Gaussian Representation for Monocular 4D Scene Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: 4D scene synthesis from monocular videos has made significant progress in recent years. However, existing methods are typically constrained by view interpolation. As a result, they struggle to infer unseen regions beyond the observed views. In this paper, we reformulate the task as 4D scene synthesis with unseen regions, which extends beyond traditional interpolation settings. Camera-conditioned video generation enables unseen region synthesis by guiding generation along specified cameras. However, these methods lack explicit 3D priors and are optimized with random camera trajectories. This design leads to severe inconsistencies under large trajectory deviations. To address this limitation, we build a unified training and inference framework with panoramic trajectory guidance. While this design improves cross-view consistency, the panoramic representation alone fails to model dynamic content effectively. Object motion in panoramic space introduces scale and shape distortions. To address this, we propose PanoGaussian, a unified Panoramic-Gaussian representation that distills the panoramic representation into an explicit dynamic Gaussian representation to capture dynamic physical priors of the 4D scene. Experiments demonstrate that PanoGaussian achieves consistent 4D scene synthesis even under large viewpoint variations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PanoGaussian，一种统一的全景-高斯表示方法，用于从单目视频中合成4D场景。该方法通过全景轨迹引导和显式动态高斯表示，解决了现有方法在较大视角变化下的不一致性问题，实现了跨视图一致的4D场景合成。
Motivation: 现有单目视频4D场景合成方法受限于视图插值，难以推断未观察到的区域，且基于相机条件的视频生成方法缺乏显式3D先验，在大轨迹偏差下存在严重不一致性。
Method: 构建统一训练和推理框架，采用全景轨迹引导提高跨视图一致性；提出全景-高斯表示（PanoGaussian），将全景表示蒸馏为显式动态高斯表示，以捕捉4D场景的动态物理先验。
Result: 实验表明，PanoGaussian在大视角变化下仍能实现一致的4D场景合成。
Conclusion: 全景-高斯表示有效结合了全景表示的全局一致性和动态高斯表示的物理先验，为单目4D场景合成提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diverse Evidence, Better Forecasts: Multi-Agent Deliberation Under Information Asymmetry
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems are increasingly used for forecasting future events, as deliberation among multiple LLMs is believed to improve reasoning and calibration. Yet existing approaches overlook a critical design choice: what information each agent receives. When all agents are given identical evidence, deliberation collapses into herding rather than genuine belief revision, leaving multi-agent systems little better than a single agent. We identify this as a fundamental gap and propose designed information asymmetry to close it: by partitioning evidence into shared public and disjoint private subsets, each agent holds exclusive knowledge that can only reach others through deliberation. We theoretically show that this decomposition reduces inter-agent error correlation, and instantiate it in InfoDelphi, a framework combining relevance-aware evidence routing, rationale-based iterative deliberation, and confidence-weighted aggregation. On PolyGym, a benchmark of 375 binary forecasting questions derived from real-world prediction markets, InfoDelphi outperforms the strongest single-agent and multi-agent baselines by 12--18% in Brier score and 4--8 percentage points in accuracy. More detailed experiments confirm that removing information asymmetry eliminates most deliberation gains, establishing diversity of input as the key enabler of effective multi-agent reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现多智能体系统在预测时若所有智能体接收相同信息，则 deliberation 退化为从众（herding）而非真正的信念修正。作者提出信息不对称设计，将证据划分为共享公共子集和不相交的私有子集，使每个智能体拥有专属知识。基于此提出 InfoDelphi 框架，结合证据路由、迭代协商和置信加权聚合。在 PolyGym 基准（375个二进制预测问题）上，Brier score 提升12-18%，准确率提升4-8个百分点。
Motivation: 现有多智能体预测方法忽略了每个智能体接收信息的分布设计，导致同质化信息下 deliberation 无效，无法超越单智能体。
Method: 提出 InfoDelphi 框架，包含相关性感知的证据路由（将证据分为公共和私有）、基于理由的迭代协商、以及置信加权聚合。理论上证明了信息分解降低智能体间误差相关性。
Result: 在 PolyGym 基准上，InfoDelphi 相比最强单智能体和多智能体基线，Brier score 改善12-18%，准确率提高4-8个百分点。实验表明去除信息不对称会消除大部分协商收益。
Conclusion: 输入多样性而非单纯增加智能体数量是多智能体推理有效性的关键，设计信息不对称可显著提升预测表现。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Message Passing Based Two-Timescale Bayesian Learning for Joint Channel and Memory Hardware Impairments Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Hardware impairments in massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) receivers introduce inter-symbol memory and inter-element coupling, severely degrading channel estimation. This paper employs a residual recurrent gated unit (RGRU) to model the intra-slot memory of the hardware impairments and proposes a message-passing-based two-timescale Bayesian deep learning (MP-TTBDL) framework for joint channel and impairment tracking. Owing to small-scale fading, the wireless channel varies rapidly across slots, whereas hardware impairments drift slowly due to hardware aging and environmental variations. To capture these distinct physical timescales, a fastvarying Markov prior and a slow-varying Gaussian Markov prior are assigned to the sparse channel and the network parameters, respectively. Based on a multi-slot factor graph formulation, a message-passing algorithm is developed. Specifically, the inter-slot messages admit closed-form updates, while the intra-slot factor graph, due to its complex recurrent structure, is partitioned into a channel tracking module and an impairments calibration module. The channel tracking module performs sparse channel estimation via turbo orthogonal approximate message passing (Turbo-OAMP), and the impairments calibration module updates the impairment parameters via a specially designed deep approximate message passing (DAMP) procedure, with the two modules iteratively exchanging extrinsic information through expectation propagation (EP) until convergence. Simulation results show that the proposed framework robustly achieves lower channel estimation error than conventional compensators followed by channel estimation across different online impairment scenarios and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模MIMO接收机中硬件损伤引入的符号间记忆和阵元间耦合问题，提出基于消息传递的双时间尺度贝叶斯深度学习（MP-TTBDL）框架，联合跟踪信道和硬件损伤。利用残差递归门控单元（RGRU）建模硬件损伤的时隙内记忆，并分别对稀疏信道和网络参数赋予快变马尔可夫先验和慢变高斯马尔可夫先验。基于多时隙因子图设计消息传递算法，其中信道跟踪模块采用Turbo-OAMP，损伤校准模块采用深度近似消息传递（DAMP），两者通过期望传播（EP）交换外信息。仿真表明，该方法在不同损伤场景和信噪比下均能比传统补偿器加信道估计方案获得更低的信道估计误差。
Motivation: 大规模MIMO接收机硬件损伤导致符号间记忆和阵元间耦合，严重降低信道估计性能。现有方法通常将损伤视为静态或简单补偿，未能充分利用不同物理量（信道快变、损伤慢变）的时间尺度差异，且缺乏联合跟踪框架。
Method: 提出MP-TTBDL框架：使用RGRU建模硬件损伤的时隙内记忆；基于多时隙因子图，对稀疏信道采用快变马尔可夫先验，对网络参数采用慢变高斯马尔可夫先验；设计消息传递算法，其中信道跟踪模块用Turbo-OAMP进行稀疏估计，损伤校准模块用专门设计的DAMP更新损伤参数，两个模块通过EP迭代交换外信息。
Result: 仿真结果表明，该框架在不同的在线损伤场景和信噪比条件下，均能获得比传统补偿器加信道估计方案更低的信道估计误差。
Conclusion: 所提框架通过双时间尺度建模和消息传递联合优化，能鲁棒地跟踪信道和慢变硬件损伤，提升信道估计精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models What to See and Where to Look
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing VLAs' training relies heavily on text-centric visual question answering and chain-of-thought reasoning data, which emphasizes linguistic reasoning rather than action-grounded planning. As a result, the learned representations capture semantic knowledge but lack spatial dependencies crucial for reliable trajectory prediction. We propose DriveTeach-VLA, a framework that explicitly teaches VLAs what to see and where to look. Driving-aware Vision Distillation (DVD) injects driving-specific perceptual priors into the vision encoder, while 2D Trajectory-Guided Prompts (2D-TGP) provide spatial conditioning aligned with feasible driving trajectories. Together, they form a vision-guided learning pipeline: what to see (DVD pretraining) - where to look (TGP-guided SFT) - how to act (TGP-guided GRPO). DriveTeach-VLA achieves the state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM and nuScenes. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ShivaTeam/DriveTeach-VLA.
papers.comment: The paper has been accepted by ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DriveTeach-VLA框架，针对现有视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型在端到端自动驾驶中过度依赖语言推理而缺乏动作导向空间表示的问题，显式教导模型“看什么”和“看哪里”。通过驾驶感知视觉蒸馏(DVD)注入驾驶先验知识，并利用2D轨迹引导提示(2D-TGP)提供与可行轨迹对齐的空间条件，形成“看什么-看哪里-如何动作”的流水线。在NAVSIM和nuScenes基准上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型训练依赖于文本中心的视觉问答和思维链数据，强调语言推理而非行动导向规划，导致学习的表示缺乏对可靠轨迹预测至关重要的空间依赖性。
Method: 提出DriveTeach-VLA框架，包含两个核心组件：驾驶感知视觉蒸馏(DVD)用于将驾驶特定感知先验注入视觉编码器，以及2D轨迹引导提示(2D-TGP)用于提供与可行驾驶轨迹对齐的空间条件。采用三阶段学习流程：DVD预训练（看什么）、TGP引导的监督微调（看哪里）、TGP引导的GRPO（如何动作）。
Result: 在NAVSIM和nuScenes自动驾驶基准上取得最优性能（state-of-the-art），具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: DriveTeach-VLA通过显式教导VLA模型关注动作相关的视觉信息，有效提升了自动驾驶中的轨迹预测能力，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Domain Generalization via Text-Anchored Information Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: Visual recognition models often fail when deployed in new environments. Domain Generalization (DG) addresses this by learning representations that remain invariant to environment-specific variations. Recent approaches increasingly rely on large vision-language models, assuming that preserving their expressive visual representations improves robustness. However, we show that such visual expressiveness can instead propagate spurious cues that tie representations to the training environments, hindering invariant learning. We therefore discard visual guidance and instead treat the language embedding space as the primary source of domain invariance, naturally acting as an information bottleneck that preserves core semantics while suppressing domain-specific variations. Extensive experiments across diverse backbones exhibit state-of-the-art performance and further analyze what makes guidance effective for robust generalization. These findings shift the focus of DG from improving representations to designing supervision that enforces invariance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对领域泛化问题，提出使用语言嵌入空间作为信息瓶颈来抑制域特定变化，从而学习不变表示。实验表明该方法在各种骨干网络上达到SOTA性能，并分析了有效指导设计的原则。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖大型视觉-语言模型保留视觉表达性，但可能传播与训练环境相关的虚假线索，阻碍不变学习。本文旨在设计更好的监督方式来强制不变性。
Method: 抛弃视觉指导，将语言嵌入空间作为域不变性的主要来源，作为信息瓶颈（information bottleneck），保留核心语义同时抑制域特定变化。
Result: 在多种骨干网络上实验，达到最先进的性能，并揭示了有效指导有助于鲁棒泛化的因素。
Conclusion: 本文发现将领域泛化的焦点从改进表示转向设计强制不变性的监督方式。

papers.title: CALM: Interpretable Cross-Modal Alignment for Biomarker Discovery from Unpaired Data
papers.abstract_en: The interaction between brain structure and genetic influences is key to understanding neuropsychiatric disorders. However, most large-scale datasets are unimodal, providing either neuroimaging or genetics data. We propose CALM, a framework that learns interpretable associations between brain ROIs and genetic pathways from completely disjoint populations. CALM aligns the two modalities in a shared latent space via linear projections that simultaneously match the class-conditional latent distributions and ensure group separability. These projections provide interpretable pathway--ROI associations. When trained on unimodal imaging and genetics datasets, CALM generalizes to an unseen paired dataset, outperforming several state-of-the-art methods and ablation baselines. We also demonstrate stability of the learned associations against a paired baseline. Our experiments on autism spectrum disorder reveal immune and metabolic pathways linked to specific cortical regions and are consistent with established literature. Thus, CALM opens the door to leveraging large unimodal repositories for studying cross-modal interactions in brain disorders across disparate datasets.

papers.title: Plug-and-Play Volumetric Reconstruction for Compressive Sensing Light-Sheet Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: We investigate volumetric reconstruction for compressive sensing light-sheet microscopy (CS-LSM), where fast volumetric imaging is achieved by encoding multiple axial planes into each camera exposure. To recover the underlying volume from highly multiplexed measurements, we propose a plug-and-play (PnP) framework that flexibly incorporates any user-specified denoiser into the reconstruction process. Building on a slice-based formulation, we further introduce an axial-coupled model that exploits correlations between adjacent slices to improve volumetric continuity. For efficient computation, we derive a Woodbury-based update for the data-consistency step in both the slice-based and axial-coupled formulations, and employ a Gauss-Seidel sweep for the denoising step in the axial-coupled model. Under a weakly convex regularization assumption, we establish subsequential convergence of the proposed algorithm. Experiments on synthetic and real zebrafish-heart data demonstrate that the proposed framework successfully recovers cellular structures from compressed measurements, and provide practical insights into the comparative performance of commonly used denoisers within the PnP framework under the CS-LSM setup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对压缩感知光片显微镜（CS-LSM）中的体素重建问题，提出了一种即插即用（PnP）框架，可灵活集成任意用户指定的去噪器。在基于切片的公式基础上，引入轴向耦合模型以利用相邻切片间的相关性改善体积连续性。通过Woodbury更新实现数据一致性步骤的高效计算，并在轴向耦合模型中使用高斯-赛德尔迭代进行去噪步骤。在弱凸正则化假设下，证明了算法的子序列收敛性。在合成数据和真实斑马鱼心脏数据上的实验表明，该框架能从压缩测量中成功恢复细胞结构。
Motivation: CS-LSM通过将多个轴向平面编码到每次相机曝光中实现快速体积成像，但需要从高度复用的测量中恢复原始体积，这是一个病态逆问题。现有方法缺乏灵活性和高效性。
Method: 提出PnP框架，支持任意去噪器；引入轴向耦合模型增强体积连续性；推导基于Woodbury的数据一致性步骤更新；采用高斯-赛德尔迭代进行轴向耦合模型中的去噪步骤；在弱凸正则化下证明算法收敛性。
Result: 在合成数据和真实斑马鱼心脏数据上成功恢复细胞结构，并提供了CS-LSM设置下常用去噪器在PnP框架中的性能比较。
Conclusion: 该PnP框架为CS-LSM提供了一种灵活且高效的体积重建方法，轴向耦合模型改善了体积连续性，算法具有收敛保证。

papers.title: Boosting Ultrasound Image Classification via Attribute-Guided Dual-Branch Framework
papers.abstract_en: Ultrasound image classification is essential for computer-aided diagnosis. However, current methods often neglect clinical priors, leading to poor generalization in challenging scenarios and a lack of interpretability that limits clinical adoption. To address these issues, we aim to develop a medical-prior module that can be seamlessly integrated into existing pipelines to enhance both diagnostic performance and interpretability. In this paper, we propose an attribute-guided dual-branch framework for ultrasound classification that introduces domain-agnostic medical attribute priors, improving generalization while offering interpretable evidence. Specifically, a baseline branch follows conventional architectures and predicts image categories via a fully connected classifier. An attribute-guided branch injects domain-agnostic attributes as priors and produces human-interpretable decision cues. Finally, an adaptive decision module fuses the two branches in a data-dependent manner to yield the final prediction. Experiments across diverse ultrasound classification tasks demonstrate that our approach can be integrated into multiple backbones and state-of-the-art methods with low overhead, consistently improving accuracy and interpretability. Code is available at: https://github.com/zhaobo253-crypto/AttrGuide.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对超声图像分类中忽视临床先验导致泛化差和缺乏可解释性的问题，提出属性引导双分支框架（Attribute-Guided Dual-Branch Framework）。该框架包含一个基线分支（baseline branch）和一个属性引导分支（attribute-guided branch），后者注入领域无关的医学属性先验，提供可解释的决策线索，最后通过自适应决策模块融合两分支。实验表明该方法可集成到多种骨干网络和现有方法中，一致提升准确率和可解释性，且开销低。
Motivation: 当前超声图像分类方法忽视临床先验，导致在困难场景下泛化差且缺乏可解释性，限制了临床应用。
Method: 提出属性引导双分支框架：基线分支沿用传统架构；属性引导分支注入领域无关的医学属性先验，产生可解释决策线索；自适应决策模块以数据驱动方式融合两分支输出最终预测。
Result: 在多个超声分类任务上，该方法可集成到多种骨干网络及现有先进方法中，一致提升准确率和可解释性，且额外开销低。
Conclusion: 通过引入医学属性先验作为可解释决策线索，所提框架能同时提升性能和可解释性，易集成到现有流程中。

papers.title: AgenticDataBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Data Agents
papers.abstract_en: Data science aims to derive actionable insights from heterogeneous raw data, unlocking the value of the massive amounts of data generated in modern society. Automating this process is essential to reducing labor-intensive efforts for data scientists and enabling scalable data-driven applications. Recently, large language model (LLM)-based data agents have emerged as a promising solution to automate data science workflows. However, the field lacks comprehensive benchmarks to rigorously evaluate these agents across diverse scenarios with fine-grained granularity. To address this gap, we propose AgenticDataBench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring realistic tasks spanning diverse domains with fine-grained ground-truth labels. This enables evaluations to capture the diversity and complexity of data science workflows and the detailed performance of agents. First, to cover diverse domains, we collect real datasets and tasks from 15 vertical domains, including 5 real-world B2B use cases from a leading fintech company. Second, to remove redundancy in real-world tasks and generate high-quality tasks for domains lacking real data, we introduce data science skills, recurring data-centric operational patterns, and quantify benchmark coverage by the number of skills included. Representative skills are extracted from large-scale task solutions on Stack Overflow using skill-aligned hierarchical clustering. Third, for real-world business tasks, we select task-solution pairs that maximize diversity in skill composition, ensuring broad coverage of practical scenarios. Fourth, to generate realistic tasks for devise domains without real tasks, we propose a systematic LLM-based task generation approach to create workflows and tasks based on these skills. Finally, we evaluate state-of-the-art data agents using our annotated benchmark and open-sourced testbed, providing detailed skill-level insights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgenticDataBench，一个面向数据科学自动化的综合基准，包含来自15个垂直领域的真实数据集和任务，包括金融科技公司的B2B用例。通过数据科学技能层次聚类和LLM生成任务，评估了最先进的数据代理。
Motivation: 当前缺乏全面且细粒度的基准来评估基于大语言模型的数据代理，现有基准无法覆盖数据科学工作流的多样性和复杂性。
Method: 收集15个领域的真实数据集和任务，引入数据科学技能概念，通过Stack Overflow任务聚类提取代表性技能，并利用LLM生成缺少真实任务的领域的工作流。
Result: 基于注释基准和开源测试平台评估了最先进的数据代理，提供了详细的技能级洞察。
Conclusion: AgenticDataBench为数据代理提供了更全面的评估框架，可覆盖实际数据科学工作流的多样性。

papers.title: DeadPool: Resilient LLM Training with Hot-Swapping via Zero-Overhead Checkpoint
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art large language model (LLM) training takes tens of thousands of graphics processing units (GPUs) for months and encounters failures across the software and hardware stack. Existing fault-tolerance mechanisms either impose non-trivial overhead during failure-free execution or suffer from prolonged recovery latency, particularly under scenarios where a small subset of compute nodes experience permanent failures. %The tradeoff between failure-free overhead and recovery latency forms a space forms a Pareto frontier We present DeadPool to simultaneously address both optimization objectives. DeadPool incorporates a fault-tolerance mechanism that restores LLM training via hot-swapping, namely by replacing failed nodes with spare nodes without terminating the complete job. The hot-swapping of DeadPool is enabled by two ideas: First, it exploits an off-critical-path in-memory checkpointing mechanism for spatial redundancy. Second, it introduces a communicator reconstruction protocol that replaces failed nodes with spare nodes at runtime. DeadPool efficiently overlaps the in-memory checkpointing with computation, thus introducing zero overhead during error-free execution. Upon permanent node failures, DeadPool can rebuild memory states with minimal recomputation by leveraging in-memory checkpoints. We evaluate DeadPool across scales (up to 512 NVIDIA A100 GPUs) and LLMs (up to 65B parameters), and observe zero checkpoint overhead with hot-swapping recovery completing in under 40 seconds. These results show that DeadPool simultaneously achieves both zero-overhead error-free execution and extremely low recovery cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeadPool，一种用于大语言模型（LLM）训练的热替换容错机制，通过离路径内存检查点和运行时通信器重建协议，在故障无开销的情况下实现节点热替换。在512 NVIDIA A100 GPU和65B参数模型上，检查点开销为零，热替换恢复时间低于40秒。
Motivation: 现有LLM训练容错机制在无故障时引入非平凡开销，或恢复延迟较长，特别是永久性节点故障场景。
Method: 利用离路径内存检查点实现空间冗余，并设计通信器重建协议在运行时用备用节点替换故障节点，将内存检查点与计算高效重叠，实现零开销。
Result: 在512 GPU规模和65B参数模型上，无故障执行时检查点开销为零，永久节点故障时热替换恢复时间低于40秒。
Conclusion: DeadPool同时实现了零开销的无故障执行和极低的恢复成本。

papers.title: Multi-Resolution Flow Matching: Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration via Staged Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Hardware-agnostic strategies for accelerating text-to-image diffusion, such as timestep distillation and feature caching, can reduce inference time without custom kernels or system-level optimization. Among them, multi-resolution generation strategies have recently received broad attention, attaining more than 5x speedup without any training. However, the design of performing upsampling in the latent space, together with the selective modification of partial regions, causes these methods to exhibit noticeable blurring or artifacts. To this end, we propose MrFlow, a training-free multi-resolution acceleration strategy for pretrained flow-matching models built upon a staged low-to-high-resolution pipeline. MrFlow first rapidly generates the main structure at low resolution, then performs super-resolution in the pixel space using a lightweight pretrained GAN-based model, subsequently injects low-strength noise to enable high-frequency resampling, and finally refines the details at high resolution. Quantitative and qualitative results on FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image show that MrFlow exploits the quadratic token reduction and reduced step requirement of low-resolution sampling to achieve 10x end-to-end acceleration while keeping OneIG within a 1% gap relative to that before acceleration, significantly surpassing other training-free acceleration strategies, and requiring no training or runtime dynamic identification whatsoever. MrFlow can further be directly combined orthogonally with pre-trained timestep distillation strategies, achieving even higher generation acceleration of up to 25x.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MrFlow，一种无训练的、用于预训练流匹配模型的多分辨率加速策略，采用从低到高分辨率的流水线，在FLUX.1-dev和Qwen-Image上实现10倍端到端加速，保持OneIG在1%差距内，并可结合蒸馏达到25倍加速。
Motivation: 现有无训练多分辨率加速方法在潜在空间上采样结合局部修改会导致模糊或伪影，本文旨在解决该问题以提升加速质量。
Method: MrFlow首先在低分辨率快速生成主体结构，然后使用轻量级预训练GAN模型在像素空间进行超分辨率，随后注入低强度噪声以重采样高频，最后在高分辨率细化细节。

Conclusion: MrFlow无需训练或运行时动态辨识，能与现有蒸馏策略正交结合，实现更高加速效率。

summary_sections.method: MrFlow首先在低分辨率快速生成主体结构，然后使用轻量级预训练GAN模型在像素空间进行超分辨率，随后注入低强度噪声以重采样高频，最后在高分辨率细化细节。
summary_sections.result: 在FLUX.1-dev和Qwen-Image上实现10倍加速，OneIG保持在加速前1%差距内，显著优于其他无训练加速策略；可正交结合预训练蒸馏策略达到25倍加速。
summary_sections.conclusion: MrFlow无需训练或运行时动态辨识，能与现有蒸馏策略正交结合，实现更高加速效率。

papers.title: Autonomous discovery of traffic laws with AI traffic scientists
papers.abstract_en: Universal traffic laws describe recurrent patterns in congestion, mobility and driving behavior across cities, providing a scientific basis for transportation planning, management and control. Their discovery, however, remains expert-driven, requiring candidate regularities to be identified from heterogeneous observational evidence or validated through intervention experiments. Although autonomous artificial intelligence (AI) systems have advanced scientific discovery in controlled laboratory settings, extending them to complex transportation domains remains a challenge. Here we present TrafficSci, an agentic AI system that formulates traffic-law discovery as an iterative, auditable workflow integrating evidence scoping, critic-judge hypothesis induction, and observational-interventional validation. Across four case studies spanning population, network, control and trajectory scales, TrafficSci autonomously rediscovers three established traffic laws and identifies an unreported intrinsic temporal memory scale in urban driving behavior, statistically consistent across eight cities and two trajectory datasets. TrafficSci provides a route for extending AI-driven scientific discovery from controlled domains to complex urban systems.
papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: TrafficSci为将AI驱动的科学发现从受控领域扩展到复杂城市系统提供了一条途径。

papers.title: Bridging 3D Gaussians and Semantic Occupancy for Comprehensive Open-Vocabulary Scene Understanding from Unposed Images
papers.abstract_en: Comprehensive 3D scene understanding from sparse, unposed images requires a model to recover renderable geometry, open-vocabulary semantics, and free/occupied 3D space without relying on external camera calibration. Recent feed-forward Gaussian methods improve pose-free reconstruction and semantic rendering, but their Gaussian primitives are mainly optimized through image-space objectives and remain weakly constrained in unobserved regions. We propose \textit{COVScene}, a pose-free semantic Gaussian framework that couples renderable Gaussian primitives with a dense semantic occupancy field through differentiable volumetric lifting. Instead of converting Gaussians to voxels only at evaluation time, COVScene lifts the predicted semantic Gaussians inside the training computation graph, so volumetric regularization provides gradients to Gaussian opacity, geometry, and semantic features. The framework combines a semantic-aware Geometry Transformer, multi-task Gaussian decoding, geometric foundation distillation, and occupancy entropy regularization to support novel view synthesis, open-vocabulary semantic querying, and semantic occupancy prediction within a single representation. Experiments on ScanNet and ScanNet++ show that COVScene maintains competitive rendering quality, improves open-vocabulary segmentation, and achieves stronger semantic occupancy prediction than the self-supervised baseline without direct voxel-level supervision.
papers.comment: Hu Zhu, Bohan Li, and Xianda Guo contributed equally. Corresponding author: Wenjun Zeng
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COVScene，一种无位姿语义高斯框架，通过可微分体积提升将可渲染高斯原语与密集语义占用场耦合，在训练计算图中对语义高斯进行体积正则化。该方法结合语义感知几何变换器、多任务高斯解码、几何基础蒸馏和占用熵正则化，在单一表示中支持新视角合成、开放词汇语义查询和语义占用预测。在 ScanNet 和 ScanNet++ 上的实验表明，COVScene 在保持渲染质量的同时，改进了开放词汇分割，并在无直接体素监督下实现了更强的语义占用预测。
Motivation: 现有前馈高斯方法主要优化图像空间目标，导致未观测区域的约束弱，难以同时恢复可渲染几何、开放词汇语义和自由/占用空间。
Method: 提出 COVScene，通过可微分体积提升将语义高斯提升到密集占用场，在训练计算图中提供体积正则化梯度；结合语义感知几何变换器、多任务高斯解码、几何基础蒸馏和占用熵正则化。
Result: 在 ScanNet 和 ScanNet++ 上，COVScene 维持了有竞争力的渲染质量，改进了开放词汇分割，并在语义占用预测上优于自监督基线。
Conclusion: COVScene 通过联合优化高斯原语和语义占用场，实现无位姿场景下的综合 3D 理解，统一了多个任务于单一表示。

papers.title: DRDN: Decoupled Representation Dynamic Network for From-Scratch ViT Class-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic expansion methods for class-incremental learning (CIL) protect task-specific knowledge by growing dedicated tokens or subnetworks, yet our analyses suggest that classification supervision alone does not sufficiently preserve task-agnostic shared backbone representations over long incremental sequences. We identify two intertwined challenges: cross-task confusion from sequential training on predominantly current-task data, which biases decision boundaries toward recent tasks; and under-optimized shared representations in the backbone that cap long-term discriminability as tasks accumulate. We propose the Decoupled Representation Dynamic Network (DRDN), which addresses these challenges via two orthogonal mechanisms. For shared backbone representations, DRDN continuously applies masked image modeling (MIM) at every incremental step, with reconstruction gradients routed exclusively through the backbone, encouraging it to retain general visual structure beyond class-discriminative cues. For task-specific discrimination, DRDN employs hierarchical task token expansion across all transformer layers, with a modified per-task attention rule that reduces inter-task interference. We support this design with accuracy degradation analysis and cross-task confusion rate measurements. In the from-scratch ViT CIL setting (no external pretraining), DRDN consistently improves over strong token-expansion baselines with comparable backbone scale. On CIFAR100-B0 (10 steps), DRDN achieves 77.19% average accuracy, outperforming DKT by 1.36 points and DyTox by 3.53 points, with an advantage that grows at longer incremental sequences. Multi-seed validation confirms stability (+/-0.31%). The MIM decoder is active only during training, adding no inference-time parameters or computation.
papers.comment: 10 pages, IEEEtran journal format. Preprint submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对从头训练的ViT类增量学习（CIL）中共享主干表示退化与任务间干扰问题，提出解耦表示动态网络（DRDN）。DRDN在每一步增量中持续应用掩码图像建模（MIM）仅作用于主干，保留通用视觉结构；同时通过层次任务令牌扩展和修改的每任务注意力规则减少交叉任务混淆。在CIFAR100-B0（10步）上平均准确率77.19%，超过DKT和DyTox，且较长序列优势更明显。
Motivation: 现有动态扩展方法在类增量学习中主要依赖分类损失，导致共享主干表示随任务积累而退化，且顺序训练造成交叉任务混淆，限制长期判别能力。
Method: 提出双机制框架：1）在每个增量步骤对主干施加掩码图像建模（MIM），重建梯度仅回传至主干，强迫其保持视觉结构；2）在所有Transformer层进行层次任务令牌扩展，并采用修改的每任务注意力规则降低任务间干扰。
Result: 在CIFAR100-B0（10步）设置下，DRDN平均准确率77.19%，比DKT高1.36点，比DyTox高3.53点，且优势随增量步数增加而扩大。多种子验证标准差±0.31%。MIM解码器仅训练时激活，不增加推理开销。
Conclusion: DRDN通过解耦共享表示保留与任务特异性学习，有效提升从头训练ViT在类增量学习中的长期性能，且推理时无额外参数或计算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Segment 3D Gaussians via Launching Virtual Drones
papers.abstract_en: Interactive segmentation of 3D Gaussians offers a compelling opportunity for real-time manipulation of 3D scenes, thanks to the real-time rendering capability of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). However, existing methods require a time-consuming per-scene setup - typically tens of seconds or even minutes - before interactive segmentation can begin on a raw 3DGS scene. This setup involves multi-view mask preparation, mask lifting, and feature distillation, creating a major bottleneck for online applications. To address this limitation, we aim to completely eliminate the setup stage for interactive 3DGS segmentation while keeping the segmentation time practical (under 1 second). In this work, we present SAGO (Segment Any Gaussians Online), a novel setup-free framework for interactive 3DGS segmentation. By introducing virtual drones, our method reframes the 3D segmentation problem as an online Next-Best-View (NBV) planning task formulated within a Markov process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAGO can extract clean 3D assets directly from 3D Gaussians with sub-second latency, thereby enabling a broad range of downstream applications such as object manipulation and scene editing. Moreover, our method achieves over a 50x speedup compared to the previous setup-free 3DGS segmentation frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGO（Segment Any Gaussians Online），一个无需预设置的交互式 3DGS 分割框架，通过引入虚拟无人机将 3D 分割问题转化为马尔可夫过程中的在线 Next-Best-View 规划任务，实现亚秒级延迟的 3D 资产提取，相较于此前无设置框架加速超 50 倍。
Motivation: 现有交互式 3DGS 分割方法需要耗时数秒甚至数分钟的场景预设置（多视角掩膜准备、掩膜提升、特征蒸馏），限制了在线应用。
Method: 提出 SAGO，利用虚拟无人机将 3D 分割建模为马尔可夫过程中在线 Next-Best-View 规划任务，完全消除预设置阶段。
Result: 在 3DGS 场景中实现亚秒级交互分割，相比之前无设置方法提速超 50 倍，并支持物体操作和场景编辑等下游应用。
Conclusion: SAGO 成功消除了 3DGS 交互式分割的预设置瓶颈，保持了实用分割时间（<1 秒）。

papers.title: MKGR: Multimodal Knowledge-Graph Representation Learning for Cold-Start Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate protein-protein interaction (PPI) prediction is central to functional genomics, disease mechanism discovery, and drug development. A difficult setting arises when candidate interactions include proteins that have no observed PPI edges during training, where models relying on network topology alone often lose useful context. This paper presents \method, a multimodal representation framework for cold-start PPI prediction. \method\ combines region-aware protein sequence encoding with four protein-centered biomedical knowledge graphs, including protein-drug, protein-disease, protein-miRNA, and protein-lncRNA associations. The sequence branch extracts contextual representations from structurally informed sequence regions, while graph attention encoders learn modality-specific protein embeddings from sparse biomedical associations. A bridge reconstruction objective regularizes graph learning by recovering shared protein-entity associations, and a pair-level gating module adaptively integrates sequence and graph evidence for each candidate protein pair. Experiments on two benchmark datasets under novel-old and novel-novel cold-start settings show that \method\ consistently outperforms competitive sequence, network, and knowledge-graph baselines across ACC, F1, AUC, AUPR, and MCC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MKGR，一个多模态表示学习框架，用于冷启动场景下的蛋白质相互作用（PPI）预测。该方法结合区域感知的蛋白质序列编码与四个生物医学知识图谱（蛋白质-药物、蛋白质-疾病、蛋白质-miRNA、蛋白质-lncRNA），通过桥接重建目标和成对门控模块整合序列与图证据。实验在两种冷启动设置下展示了该方法在ACC、F1、AUC、AUPR和MCC指标上优于序列、网络和知识图谱基线。
Motivation: 现有PPI预测方法在冷启动场景（候选蛋白质在训练中无观察到的PPI边）下表现不佳，因为仅依赖网络拓扑会丢失有用上下文。需要一种能融合序列和多种生物医学知识图谱信息的方法。
Method: MKGR包含序列分支（区域感知蛋白质序列编码）和图分支（对四个生物医学知识图谱使用图注意力编码器）。引入桥接重建目标正则化图学习，以及成对门控模块自适应整合序列与图证据。
Result: 在两个基准数据集上的novel-old和novel-novel冷启动设置下，MKGR在ACC、F1、AUC、AUPR和MCC指标上一致优于序列、网络和知识图谱基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调MKGR通过多模态融合有效改善了冷启动PPI预测，但未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-THuMBS: Multi-person Tracking of 3D Human Meshes Beyond Video Shots
papers.abstract_en: Tracking multi-person 3D human meshes from in-the-wild videos is a highly challenging problem due to complex interactions, frequent occlusions, and severe truncation inherent in unconstrained environments. While recent approaches have improved robustness against these issues, they largely overlook the critical challenge prevalent in real-world footage: frequent shot changes. These abrupt transitions in camera viewpoints often cause existing methods to lose track of human identities and fail in reconstructing temporally coherent trajectories. Although several recent works have explored 3D human mesh tracking under shot changes, they are still limited to single-person scenarios, making them inadequate for real-world videos where multiple people interact and appear simultaneously. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-THuMBS (Multi-person Tracking of 3D Human Meshes Beyond Video Shots) that leverages a state-of-the-art 3D scene prior to reconstruct the two boundary frames in a single shared 3D space. Human meshes are then registered within the shared 3D space, maintaining per-person identity and motion consistency across shot changes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach yields significant improvements in 3D human mesh recovery, camera pose estimation, and identity tracking, thereby ensuring high-fidelity motion reconstruction with consistent identity preservation across shots compared to previous state-of-the-art methods.

papers.title: Spatial Support Matters: Geometry-Aware Graph Fusion for Rainfall Field Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Fine-scale rainfall reconstruction is critical for urban flood modeling, but real rainfall sensing systems observe the field through incompatible spatial supports: gauges measure points, microwave links measure paths, and radar/satellite products measure gridded areas. These differences in measurement support impose geometrically distinct constraints on the rainfall field, yet existing heterogeneous graph approaches reconcile such sources in feature space, giving each its own embedding while discarding the geometry of its support. We propose a geometry-aware multi-support heterogeneous graph neural network that represents each observation according to its support type (0D point, 1D line, or 2D grid) as a distinct node layer, and fuses them through cross-support message passing into a point-support prediction layer from which the field is reconstructed. An inductive masked-node formulation decouples prediction resolution from sensing resolution, allowing the same trained model to reconstruct the field at user-defined target locations or display grids. On Singapore data, the proposed method reduces RMSE by 23.2\% over the classical interpolation baseline, inverse-distance weighting, and consistently outperforms other neural architectures such as convolutional fusion and support-agnostic heterogeneous graph baselines. A generalization study using data from Sydney, Australia lets us characterize when multi-support fusion helps: the available skill appears to depend on gauge spacing relative to the spatial correlation length of the field, so fusion delivers the largest gains where the field is under-sampled relative to its correlation length and little when it is already resolved. Code and models will be open-sourced upon paper acceptance.

TL;DR: 本文针对降雨观测中不同空间支持（点、线、面）的异质数据融合问题，提出几何感知的多支持异构图神经网络。方法将每种支持类型作为独立节点层，通过跨支持消息传递融合为点支持预测层，从而重建降雨场。在新加坡数据上，RMSE比经典插值方法IDW降低23.2%，并优于其他神经网络基线。泛化实验表明，融合增益取决于测站间距与空间相关长度的对比：欠采样时增益最大。
Motivation: 现有异构图方法在特征空间融合多源降雨数据，忽略了不同测量支持（点、线、面）的几何约束，导致重建精度受限。
Method: 提出几何感知的多支持异构图神经网络，为0D点、1D线、2D网格各建一个节点层，通过跨支持消息传递将信息聚合到点支持预测层；采用归纳式掩码节点机制，使预测分辨率与感知分辨率解耦。

Conclusion: 几何感知的多支持融合能有效利用空间支持信息，提升降雨场重建精度；融合收益受限于测站密度与空间相关性的关系。

papers.title: Scaling with Confidence: Calibrating Confidence of LLMs for Adaptive Test Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) with reinforcement learning (RL) has significantly advanced their performance on reasoning and question-answering tasks. However, prevailing RL reward designs typically prioritize response correctness, neglecting to incentivize models to express their confidence accurately. This leads to a critical problem: performance gains are often accompanied by poor calibration between confidence and accuracy, misleading models to overconfidently hallucinate when uncertain. To address this limitation, we propose $\textbf{C}$orrectness and $\textbf{C}$onfidence $\textbf{C}$alibration $\textbf{R}$einforcement $\textbf{L}$earning ($\textbf{C3RL}$), a novel RL algorithm integrating correctness, calibration and dataset-informed reference accuracy rewards together. Comprehensive evaluation across 8 text and multimodal datasets demonstrates that C3RL enhances calibration without sacrificing accuracy, outperforming the current state-of-the-art method in both performance and calibration metrics. Utilizing the well-calibrated verbalized confidence from C3RL, we further introduce $\textbf{C}$onfidence-based $\textbf{A}$daptive Test Time $\textbf{S}$caling ($\textbf{CAS}$), an adjustable inference-time strategy that allocates computational resources based on response confidence. Experiments show that CAS surpasses majority voting on both in-domain and out-of-domain datasets while reducing the inference budget by up to 12.33 times. We believe the synergy of C3RL and CAS paves the way for deploying more reliable and resource-efficient LLMs. The code, data and models will be released.

TL;DR: 本文提出C3RL算法，通过强化学习同时优化正确性和置信度校准，使LLM能准确表达不确定性。基于C3RL的置信度，进一步提出CAS自适应推理策略，根据置信度动态分配计算资源，相比多数投票可降低最多12.33倍推理预算。
Motivation: 现有强化学习奖励设计只关注回答正确性，导致模型置信度与准确性不匹配，使模型在不确定时过度自信地产生幻觉。
Method: 提出C3RL（Correctness and Confidence Calibration Reinforcement Learning），将正确性、校准性和数据集参考准确性奖励整合；并基于C3RL的置信度提出CAS（Confidence-based Adaptive Test Time Scaling），在推理时按置信度调整计算资源。
Result: 在8个文本和多模态数据集上，C3RL在保持精度的同时提升校准性，优于当前最优方法；CAS在域内和域外数据集上超越多数投票，同时推理预算降低最多12.33倍。
Conclusion: C3RL与CAS协同为部署更可靠且资源高效的LLM提供了新路径。

papers.title: Profit-Based Counterfactual Explanations for Product Improvement: A Case Study of Manga Sales in Japan
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual explanation (CE) is widely used to enhance the interpretability of machine learning models and support data-driven decision-making based on model predictions. However, existing CE methods typically require two exogenously specified inputs: a desired output value (target) and a distance function that quantifies changes in explanatory variables. In regression settings, neither the validity of target specification nor the practical interpretation of the distance metric has been sufficiently addressed. Furthermore, most existing CE methods focus on altering predictions rather than optimizing a decision objective, even though real-world decision-making often requires explicit objective maximization. To address these limitations, we formulate CE as a profit maximization problem in management and marketing contexts and propose a framework termed profit-based counterfactual explanation (PBCE). PBCE eliminates the need for exogenous target specification by directly maximizing profit as the primary optimization objective. Concurrently, the distance term is reinterpreted as the cost of modifying product attributes, providing a clear and economically grounded interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对传统反事实解释（CE）在回归设置中需要外生指定目标和距离函数的问题，提出基于利润的反事实解释（PBCE），将CE形式化为利润最大化问题，并在日本漫画销售案例中验证其有效性。
Motivation: 现有CE方法需要外生指定目标值和距离函数，缺乏经济解释，且通常以改变预测为目标而非优化决策目标。
Method: 提出PBCE框架，将CE重新表述为利润最大化问题，直接最大化利润作为优化目标，距离项重新解释为修改产品属性的成本。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，但案例研究展示了PBCE在日本漫画销售中的应用。
Conclusion: PBCE消除了外生目标指定的需要，并为距离项提供了经济解释，适用于管理和营销中的产品改进决策。

papers.title: SINA: A Fully Automated Circuit Schematic Image to Netlist Generator Using Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) have revolutionized Electronic Design Automation (EDA), particularly through Large Language Models (LLMs) for circuit design tasks. However, their application to analog and mixed-signal domains remains limited by the lack of machine-readable representations of existing circuit design knowledge. Circuit schematic images found in research manuscripts, textbooks, and websites constitute a vast repository of validated designs; however, these visual representations cannot be directly processed by EDA tools. Converting them into machine-readable netlists is essential for enabling simulation, verification, and building comprehensive databases for AI-based models. Current conversion methods lack generalization across both Integrated Circuit (IC) and Printed Circuit Board (PCB) level schematics. Moreover, they struggle with component recognition and connectivity inference, and fail to distinguish between connected junctions and crossing wires. In this paper, we propose SINA, an open-source circuit schematic image-to-netlist generator. SINA is a fully automated pipeline that integrates deep learning for robust component detection, connected-component labeling for accurate connectivity inference, Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for component reference designator extraction, and a Vision-Language Model (VLM) for reliable reference designator assignment. SINA handles both IC- and PCB-level schematics and incorporates dedicated crossing-wires detection to differentiate wire intersections from connections. We validate the correctness of the generated netlists using graph isomorphism techniques. Our experiments demonstrate an overall netlist generation accuracy of 96.67%, which is 2.72x higher compared to state-of-the-art approaches.

TL;DR: 论文提出SINA，一个全自动的电路原理图图像到网表（netlist）生成器。SINA集成了深度学习组件检测、连通分量标注、OCR和视觉语言模型（VLM），能够处理IC和PCB级原理图，并具有交叉线检测功能。实验表明，网表生成准确率96.67%，比现有方法高2.72倍。

papers.title: SemHash-LLM: A Multi-Granularity Semantic Hashing Framework for Document Deduplication
papers.abstract_en: Large scale document deduplication must preserve semantic equivalence while remaining efficient over massive corpora. We present SemHash LLM, a multi granularity framework that unifies semantic projection hashing, attention weighted MinHash, contrastive boundary learning, and selective LLM based adjudication. The method combines character, token, and document level signals through gated fusion, then applies a cascaded filtering pipeline for efficient candidate reduction. Semantic projection hashing learns compact binary codes in distilled LLM embedding space, while attention weighted Min- Hash suppresses boilerplate and emphasizes informative content. Adaptive decision boundaries and uncertainty estimation further improve robustness across template pollution, short text perturbation, containment, and viral fragments. Experiments show that SemHash LLM achieves strong duplicate detection quality with less than one percent neural verification cost.

papers.title: BOUNDARY_SYNC: Measuring Communication-Induced Representational Coupling in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed as communicating agents, does inter-agent communication cause outputs to converge? We introduce BOUNDARY_SYNC, a protocol measuring representational coupling via the Coupling Amplification Factor (CAF = JSD_cond / JSD_baseline), where CAF < 1 indicates homogenization and CAF > 1 indicates diversification. In controlled GPT-4o experiments (N=30, ~9,900 API calls), we measure coupling in text and image communication. Key findings: (1) text communication causes significant homogenization (CAF=0.803 [0.740, 0.873], d=1.30, p<0.001), confirmed by no-communication ablation and prompt-perturbation controls; (2) image communication also homogenizes under within-modality baselines (CAF=0.834 [0.811, 0.858]), with comparable proportional effect; (3) group size moderates coupling direction -- K=5 produces homogenization while K=3 yields CAF > 1.0 (point estimates 1.14 and 1.06, CI pending), suggesting a directional shift toward diversification; (4) cross-model replication shows extreme variation (CAF 0.034-0.803), with DeepSeek dominated by format artifacts; (5) coupling is stateless -- driven by prompt context rather than cumulative updating, with continuous consensus producing monotonic convergence. These results establish LLM agent coupling as real, measurable, and controllable at the prompt level, with direct implications for multi-agent system design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BOUNDARY_SYNC协议，通过耦合放大因子（CAF）度量多智能体LLM系统中智能体间通信导致的输出收敛程度。实验表明文本通信导致显著同质化（CAF=0.803），图像通信也有类似效果，组大小可调节耦合方向，且耦合由提示上下文驱动而非累积更新。
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统中，智能体间通信可能导致输出趋同或分化，但缺乏统一的度量指标与实验表征。本文旨在量化该现象并探索影响因素。
Method: 提出BOUNDARY_SYNC协议，定义CAF = JSD_cond / JSD_baseline，通过controlled GPT-4o实验（N=30，约9900次API调用）测量文本和图像通信中的表征耦合，并设置无通信消融和提示扰动对照。
Result: 文本通信导致显著同质化（CAF=0.803，Cohen's d=1.30，p<0.001）；图像通信也在同模态基线内同质化（CAF=0.834）；组大小K=5产生同质化，K=3则CAF>1.0指向多样化；跨模型复制显示CAF在0.034-0.803之间的极端变化；耦合由提示上下文驱动，无状态累积。
Conclusion: 本文建立了LLM智能体耦合作为真实、可测量且可在提示层面控制的现象，对多智能体系统设计有直接启示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Safe and Adaptive Cloud Healing: Verifying LLM-Generated Recovery Plans with a Neural-Symbolic World Model
papers.abstract_en: As the scale and complexity of cloud-based AI systems continue to escalate, ensuring service reliability through rapid fault detection and adaptive recovery has become a critical challenge. While existing approaches integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) for semantic understanding and Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for policy optimization, they often rely on sequential, loosely coupled architectures that underutilize the generative and reasoning capabilities of LLMs. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift with PASE, a Planning-Aware Semantic self-healing engine, a novel fault self-healing framework that reconceptualizes recovery as a neuro-symbolic program synthesis task. PASE employs an LLM as a core Plan Synthesis Engine to generate structured recovery plans from a library of semantic primitives. A Neural-Symbolic World Model verifies plan feasibility through simulation, while a Meta-Prompt Optimizer, trained via DRL, learns to generate optimal prompts that guide the LLM's planning process. This tight reason-plan-verify-adapt loop enables dynamic, context-aware recovery strategy generation beyond predefined action spaces. Experiments on a real-world cloud fault injection dataset demonstrate that PASE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, reducing average system recovery time by over 40% and improving fault detection accuracy in unknown fault scenarios. Our framework advances autonomous system management by unifying LLM-based reasoning with model-assisted verification and meta-learned guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PASE，一种规划感知语义自愈引擎，将云系统故障恢复重新构想为神经符号程序合成任务。PASE利用LLM作为核心计划合成引擎生成结构化恢复计划，通过神经-符号世界模型模拟验证可行性，并使用基于DRL的元提示优化器学习最优提示。在真实云故障注入数据集上，平均系统恢复时间减少40%以上，未知故障场景下故障检测准确率提升。
Motivation: 现有方法结合LLM和DRL但采用顺序松散耦合架构，未能充分利用LLM的生成和推理能力，导致恢复策略受限于预定义动作空间。
Method: PASE框架包含三个组件：LLM作为计划合成引擎从语义原语库生成恢复计划；神经-符号世界模型通过模拟验证计划可行性；元提示优化器通过DRL学习生成最优提示以引导LLM规划。三者形成紧密的推理-规划-验证-适应循环。
Result: 在真实云故障注入数据集上，PASE将平均系统恢复时间降低40%以上，并在未知故障场景下提高了故障检测准确率。
Conclusion: 通过统一LLM推理、模型辅助验证和元学习引导，PASE实现了动态、上下文感知的恢复策略生成，推进了自主系统管理。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hawk: Harnessing Hardware-Aware Knowledge for High-Performance NPU Kernel Generation
papers.abstract_en: Developing high-performance kernels for Neural Processing Units (NPUs) is a critical industry bottleneck, requiring developers to manually navigate implicit hardware constraints and strict memory hierarchies. While large language models offer immense automation potential, they fail catastrophically on NPUs due to a fundamental lack of hardware-specific priors. Naively transplanting code snippets from similar NPU kernels may pass the compiler, but it consistently triggers runtime crashes and performance degradation by blindly violating underlying hardware constraints. To overcome this, we introduce Hawk, a training-free framework that harnesses hardware-aware knowledge through three core modules: (1) Run-Time Knowledge Synthesis Module, which employs a Triple-Part Executable Knowledge Representation to inherently couple the error context with executable semantics; (2) Bottleneck-Aware Knowledge Retrieval Module, which implements a 2D-Retrieval paradigm to project queries into orthogonal syntactic and hardware-aligned semantic spaces; and (3) Effect-Driven Knowledge Distillation Module, which leverages LLM-driven semantic arbitration to continuously distill the knowledge by pruning errors and consolidating redundancies based on the empirical execution feedback. Extensive evaluations on real-world NPU workloads demonstrate that Hawk elevates generation accuracy from 49.4% to 80.0%, while achieving up to a 2.2x execution speedup over state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Hawk，一个无需训练的框架，通过硬件感知知识生成高性能NPU内核。它包含运行时知识综合、瓶颈感知检索和效果驱动蒸馏三个模块，将生成准确率从49.4%提升至80.0%，并实现高达2.2倍的执行加速。
Motivation: NPU内核开发是行业瓶颈，现有方法（包括LLM）因缺乏硬件特定先验知识而经常导致运行时崩溃和性能下降。
Method: Hawk框架包含三个模块：运行时知识综合模块（三重可执行知识表示）、瓶颈感知知识检索模块（2D检索范式）和效果驱动知识蒸馏模块（基于执行反馈的LLM语义仲裁）。
Result: 在真实NPU负载上，Hawk将生成准确率从49.4%提升至80.0%，并在执行速度上比最先进基线快2.2倍。
Conclusion: Hawk通过硬件感知知识有效解决了NPU内核生成中的崩溃和性能问题，但摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: VLAFlow: A Unified Training Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models via Co-training and Future Latent Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have recently advanced robotic manipulation, yet the effects of different robot-data pre-training paradigms remain difficult to compare because existing models often differ in architecture, data, action space, and evaluation protocol. We present VLAFlow (Vision-Language-Action Flow), a unified flow-matching framework for controlled comparison of VLA training objectives. Using a heterogeneous robot corpus, OXEMix, containing approximately 5,000 hours of data from DROID, OpenX-Embodiment, OpenX-Augmented, and RoboCOIN, we evaluate four paradigms under the same pi0-style architecture, shared VLM backbone, action expert, and 14-dimensional action space: action-only modeling (MindPI), language-supervised co-training (MindLPI), future latent alignment (MindWPI), and their combination (MindLWPI). Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv show that action-only pre-training is sensitive to heterogeneous data. In contrast, language supervision helps preserve vision-language generalization, while future latent alignment improves state-transition and action-outcome modeling. By combining both signals, MindLWPI achieves the most stable overall transfer performance across benchmarks. These results suggest a meta-action space view: language and future latent representations provide complementary intermediate constraints that make heterogeneous action supervision smoother and more transferable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VLAFlow，一个统一的流匹配框架，用于比较视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的不同训练范式。通过构建包含约5000小时机器人数据的异构语料库OXEMix，在相同架构下评估了四种训练范式：纯动作建模、语言监督协同训练、未来潜在对齐及其组合。实验表明，未来潜在对齐有助于状态转移和动作结果建模，语言监督保持视觉语言泛化，两者结合在LIBERO等基准上取得最稳定的迁移性能。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在架构、数据、动作空间和评估协议上差异大，难以比较不同预训练范式的影响，需要一个统一的框架进行可控比较。
Method: 提出VLAFlow框架，采用流匹配（flow matching）训练，使用异构机器人数据集OXEMix（包含DROID、OpenX-Embodiment等），在pi0风格架构下，共享VLM骨干和动作专家，定义14维动作空间，评估四种训练范式：MindPI（仅动作）、MindLPI（加语言监督）、MindWPI（加未来潜在对齐）、MindLWPI（组合两者）。
Result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和SimplerEnv上实验表明：纯动作预训练对异构数据敏感；语言监督有助于保持视觉语言泛化；未来潜在对齐改善状态转移和动作结果建模；两者组合（MindLWPI）获得最稳定的迁移性能。
Conclusion: 语言和未来潜在表征提供了互补的中间约束，使异构动作监督更平滑和可迁移，支持元动作空间（meta-action space）的观点。
Relevance: 0
