papers.title: ADVENT: LLM-Driven Automatic Predicate Invention for ILP
papers.abstract_en: Predicate invention (PI), the creation of new predicates to extend the hypothesis space, remains a critical bottleneck in Inductive Logic Programming (ILP). Existing methods rely on domain expertise and produce semantically opaque predicates, hindering adaptation to unfamiliar domains and cross-task reuse. We present ADVENT, an LLM-driven PI mechanism for ILP. ADVENT pairs LLM abductive generation with Prolog deductive verification, forming an iterative loop in which concrete execution results guide the LLM to refine candidate predicates. The mechanism leverages Large Language Models to identify implicit patterns in structured relational data and invent auxiliary predicates with meaningful names and definitions. Invented predicates and learned rules accumulate in a knowledge pool for cross-task reuse. Experiments on nine poker-hand concepts across seven LLMs show that LLM-driven PI achieves 58% success rate where ILP alone fails entirely, formal verification raises this to 80%, and the knowledge pool yields gains up to +31 percentage points, while producing human-interpretable rules. These results suggest that ADVENT offers a promising direction for automating predicate invention and enabling cross-task knowledge reuse in ILP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ADVENT 是一种由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的归纳逻辑编程（ILP）谓词发明机制，通过 LLM 溯因生成与 Prolog 演绎验证的迭代循环，自动发明具有语义名称的辅助谓词，并累积到知识池中以供跨任务复用。在七种 LLM 上的扑克牌概念实验中，LLM 驱动的谓词发明实现了 58% 的成功率（纯 ILP 完全失败），形式验证将其提升至 80%，知识池带来最多 +31 个百分点的增益，同时生成人类可解释的规则。
Motivation: 现有 ILP 中的谓词发明依赖领域专家且产生语义不透明的谓词，难以适应陌生领域和跨任务复用。
Method: ADVENT 将 LLM 的溯因生成与 Prolog 的演绎验证结合成迭代循环，利用 LLM 从结构化关系数据中识别隐含模式，自动发明具有有意义名称和定义的辅助谓词，并将结果存入知识池。
Result: 在七个 LLM 上对九个扑克牌概念进行实验：LLM 驱动 PI 成功率 58%（纯 ILP 为 0%），形式验证后升至 80%，知识池复用带来最多 +31 个百分点增益，且生成规则可解释。
Conclusion: ADVENT 为自动化谓词发明和 ILP 中的跨任务知识复用提供了有前景的方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EO-Agents: A Three-Agent LLM Pipeline for Earth Observation Hypothesis Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have recently been explored for scientific hypothesis generation, but most prior work relies on unstructured literature and free-form textual claims. We present a pipeline for Earth observation that grounds hypothesis generation directly in the NASA Earth Observation Knowledge Graph. A heterogeneous graph neural network trained on historical co-usage relations ranks candidate dataset pairings, and a three-agent LLM pipeline filters, generates, and evaluates structured research hypotheses. Applied to 1,475 NASA datasets, the system produces 160 hypotheses spanning multiple Earth-science domains, including ecohydrology, glaciology, aerosol--cloud interactions, vegetation phenology, and stratospheric chemistry. Model-predicted novel dataset pairings are rated nearly as plausible as held-out real co-usages from the literature, indicating that the pipeline surfaces scientifically coherent yet unexplored combinations. A 2*2*2 factorial experiment across GPT-5.2 and Claude Sonnet 4.6 shows that hypothesis rankings remain stable, while absolute scores depend strongly on judge identity, highlighting limitations of single-judge LLM evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 AI for Science Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EO-Agents，一个基于三个LLM智能体的流水线，用于地球观测假设生成。该方法将假设生成直接锚定在NASA地球观测知识图谱上，利用异构图表征学习排序候选数据集组合，并通过三个LLM智能体过滤、生成和评估结构化研究假设。应用于1475个NASA数据集，生成了160个跨多个地球科学领域的假设，模型预测的新颖数据集组合被认为与文献中实际使用组合几乎一样可信。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的科学假设生成大多依赖非结构化文献和自由文本声明，缺乏与结构化知识图谱的直接结合，难以产生可验证的地球观测假设。
Method: 提出三阶段流水线：首先使用基于历史共现关系训练的异构图表征学习网络对候选数据集组合进行排序；然后通过三个LLM智能体（过滤、生成、评估）逐步处理，最终产出结构化研究假设。
Result: 在1475个NASA数据集上生成160个假设，覆盖生态水文、冰川学、气溶胶-云相互作用等多个领域。模型预测的新颖数据集组合与文献中实际使用的组合在可信度上相当。使用GPT-5.2和Claude Sonnet 4.6的2×2×2因子实验表明假设排名稳定，但绝对分数强烈依赖于评判者身份。

papers.title: MVFusion-GS: Motion-Variance Guided Temporal Attention for High-Quality Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis for static scenes. Extending it to dynamic scenes via deformation fields has recently attracted significant attention, particularly for dynamic scene reconstructionband distractor-free. However, existing deformation networks lack explicit motion awareness: they neither capture long-term motion intensity nor exploit short-term temporal coherence, leading to inaccurate foreground deformation and pseudo-static residuals in the background. We present MVFusion-GS, a method that enhances deformation networks with two complementary motion-aware mechanisms. The Motion-Variance Guided Refinement aggregates per-Gaussian deformation statistics across time to estimate motion variance and uses it to guide dynamic-static separation during deformation prediction. The MotionFormer Temporal Attention module applies Transformer self-attention over neighboring timesteps to model local motion dependencies and improve temporal consistency. Extensive experiments on both dynamic scene reconstruction and distractor-free reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, showing that explicit motion awareness improves both foreground motion modeling and static background reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态3D高斯泼溅中的形变网络缺乏显式运动感知的问题，提出MVFusion-GS，通过运动方差引导细化和MotionFormer时间注意力模块增强运动建模。在动态场景重建和无干扰重建基准上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有动态3DGS的形变网络无法捕捉长期运动强度或利用短期时间一致性，导致前景形变不准确和背景伪静态残差。
Method: 提出运动方差引导细化模块，聚合每高斯形变统计量估计运动方差，指导动态-静态分离；MotionFormer时间注意力模块对相邻时间步应用Transformer自注意力，建模局部运动依赖性。
Result: 在动态场景重建和无干扰重建基准上达到最先进性能，显式运动感知改进了前景运动建模和静态背景重建。
Conclusion: 显式运动感知机制可有效增强动态场景的形变网络，提升动态与静态区域的重建质量。

papers.title: Geometric Signatures of Reasoning: A Spectral Perspective on Task Hardness
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning enables large language models (LLMs) to solve complex problems by generating intermediate reasoning steps. While much attention has been paid to the length and content of these reasoning chains, far less is known about their internal geometry. We study the \emph{geometry} of CoT trajectories in the hidden state space of transformer models, formalizing each reasoning chain as a discrete curve in $\mathbb{R}^d$ and characterizing it through spectral, positional, and kinematic geometric functionals. We introduce the effective dimension $d_ρ$ as a measure of trajectory complexity and show theoretically that trajectories with flatter eigenvalue spectra correspond to harder tasks, as they explore more of the hidden dimensions. Lastly, we explore how kinematic features of the trajectory, mean position, positional dispersion, initial and current hidden states, mean velocity, mean speed, and speed dispersion, can be used to predict solution correctness before generation is complete, and may inform future early-stopping strategies. Experimentally, on mathematical reasoning problems from the MATH500 dataset, $d_ρ$ achieves $0.93$ AUC in distinguishing easy from hard problems, while kinematic features potentially can predict correctness from only the first $20\%$ of generated tokens. These correctness signatures transfer across questions of varying difficulty, establishing that the shape of a model's internal reasoning trajectory is a principled window into both task hardness and solution quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从几何角度研究大型语言模型（LLM）中思维链（CoT）推理的内部轨迹，将其视为隐藏状态空间中的离散曲线，并通过谱分析、位置和运动学几何泛函进行刻画。引入有效维度 d_ρ 作为轨迹复杂度的度量，理论上证明平坦特征值谱的轨迹对应更困难的任务。实验上，在 MATH500 数据集上，d_ρ 在区分易/难问题上达到 0.93 AUC，运动学特征可从生成的前 20% token 预测答案正确性。
Motivation: 现有研究关注推理链的长度和内容，但对内部几何结构知之甚少。本文旨在揭示 CoT 轨迹的几何性质与任务难度、解答正确性的关系。
Method: 将推理链形式化为 R^d 中的离散曲线，使用谱、位置和运动学几何泛函（如有效维度 d_ρ、平均速度、速度离散度等）进行表征，并理论分析谱平坦性与任务难度的联系。
Result: 在 MATH500 数学推理问题上，d_ρ 以 0.93 AUC 区分难易问题；运动学特征仅用前 20% token 即可预测正确性，且跨难度问题迁移。
Conclusion: 模型内部推理轨迹的形状为任务难度和解答质量提供了原理性窗口，未来可用于早期停止策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Trends for Lie Detector Oversight in Preference Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deceptive behavior in LLMs is costly to monitor and prevent, motivating approaches such as Scalable Oversight via Lie Detectors (SOLiD) (Cundy & Gleave, 2025), which uses lie detectors to identify responses for review by high-cost labelers. In this paper, we scale SOLiD to larger models and evaluate it in more diverse and realistic preference-learning settings. We find favorable scaling: undetected deception drops from 34% for 1B-parameter models to 14% for 405B-parameter models at a detector true positive rate of 99%, and expensive human labelers can be removed entirely from the fine-tuning phase without a statistically significant increase in deception. However, SOLiD is sensitive to distribution shift between detector training and preference-training data, which can drive detector false positive rates to impractical levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨可扩展监督方法SOLiD在更大语言模型和更多样化偏好学习设置中的表现。实验表明，随着模型规模从1B增加到405B，未检测到的欺骗率从34%降至14%，且可以在微调阶段完全移除昂贵的人工标注者而不显著增加欺骗。但SOLiD对检测器训练与偏好训练数据之间的分布偏移敏感，可能导致误报率过高。
Motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）的欺骗行为监控成本高昂，需要可扩展的监督方法。SOLiD方法通过测谎仪识别需高成本标注者审查的响应，但其在更大模型和更现实场景中的有效性尚未充分验证。
Method: 将SOLiD扩展到规模更大的模型（最高405B参数），并在更多样化和真实的偏好学习设置中评估，测量检测器真正例率为99%时未检测到的欺骗率，并测试去除人类标注者的影响。
Result: 未检测到的欺骗率从1B模型的34%降至405B模型的14%；移除微调阶段的全部人工标注者后，未发现统计学上显著的欺骗增加。但分布偏移导致检测器误报率升至不实用的水平。
Conclusion: SOLiD在更大模型上表现出良好的扩展趋势，但需解决分布偏移问题以保持实际可用性。

papers.title: DiPS: Dialogue Policy Selection for High-Stakes Persuasion Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) often struggle with persuasion in high-stakes scenarios. People's individual personalities and concerns require tailored strategies rather than a one-size-fits-all approach. To address this challenge, we focus on a fire-rescue scenario in which an operator must persuade a resident to evacuate as a high-stakes persuasion domain and propose Dialogue Policy Selection (DiPS), a Q-learning framework to dynamically select persuasion strategies adapted to the evolving conversational context. Specifically, we train a critic, trained to maximize the chance of evacuation success, to select a persuasion policy at each turn based on the resident's recent utterances.We then evaluate DiPS against multiple baselines in both simulated and real human interactions. We find that DiPS achieves higher evacuation success than a zero-shot LLM and generic RAG-augmented approach.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 27th Annual Meeting of the Special Interest Group on Discourse and Dialogue (SIGDIAL 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DiPS，一个基于Q-learning的对话策略选择框架，用于高风险说服场景（如消防疏散）。它训练一个critic来动态选择说服策略，实验表明DiPS在模拟和真实人类交互中撤离成功率高于zero-shot LLM和通用RAG方法。
Motivation: 大语言模型在高风险说服场景中常缺乏适应个体个性的策略，需要一种动态调整说服方法的能力。
Method: 提出DiPS框架，使用Q-learning训练一个critic，在每个回合根据居民最近发言选择最优说服策略。
Result: 在模拟和真实人类交互中，DiPS的撤离成功率高于zero-shot LLM和通用检索增强生成（RAG）方法。
Conclusion: 动态选择说服策略能有效提升高风险场景下的说服效果，Q-learning框架具有优势。

papers.title: Mind the Gap: Standard 3DGS Evaluation Primarily Measures Near-Trajectory Interpolation
papers.abstract_en: Standard MipNeRF360-style 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) evaluation holds out every N-th frame -- but these frames have trained neighbors on both sides, so the metric measures near-trajectory interpolation rather than spatial generalization. We introduce a fair matched-count protocol that isolates this effect: both arms train on the same number of images and differ only in whether the holdout is spread evenly (interpolation) or forms a contiguous spatial sector (extrapolation). Our primary finding is a large, consistent interpolation-extrapolation gap of 3~12dB -- several times the differences typically reported between competing methods. The gap is robust to training noise, is in two cases large enough to flip a method ranking under multi-seed confirmation, and -- crucially -- persists across three representation families, including a non-Gaussian volumetric neural radiance field (NeRF), so it reflects spatial coverage rather than any one representation. Diagnostically, it is dominated by a diffuse/geometry-proxy component and tracks each view's angular distance to its nearest training view, a zero-cost signal that also guides capture planning; loss-side regularization yields only marginal gains. Standard holdouts remain useful for near-trajectory rendering but should not, alone, be read as evidence of spatial generalization. Prior work notes protocol sensitivity; ours is, to our knowledge, the first to combine matched-count paired holdout, cross-representation quantification, and a diagnostic analysis Table 1. We describe a spatial-holdout benchmark toolkit with standardized splits and baselines for 16 scenes, which we are preparing for public release.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本研究揭示标准的3DGS评估方法（如MipNeRF360风格）实际上主要测量的是近轨迹插值而非空间泛化能力，因为留出的帧在两侧都有训练邻居。作者提出了一种公平的匹配计数协议来隔离这一效应，发现在插值与外推之间存在着3~12dB的一致差距，这一差距远大于通常报告的方法间差异，并且跨多种表示（包括NeRF）都存在。
Motivation: 当前3DGS标准的MipNeRF360风格评估存在一个被忽视的偏差：留出帧实际上被训练帧包围，因此指标反映的是近轨迹插值而非真正的空间泛化能力。
Method: 提出匹配计数（matched-count）协议：两种方案使用相同数量的训练图像，区别仅在于留出帧是均匀分布（插值）还是连续空间扇区（外推），从而量化插值-外推差距。
Result: 观察到插值-外推间存在3~12dB的一致差距，是竞争方法间典型差异的数倍；在两种场景下，多种子确认足以翻转方法排名；该差距在三种表示家族（包括非高斯体素神经辐射场）中均存在。
Conclusion: 标准留出协议对近轨迹渲染仍然有用，但不应用作空间泛化的证据；研究提供了诊断分析和16场景的基准工具包。

papers.title: Boosting Infrared Small Target Detection via Logit-Domain Contrast and Adaptive Shape Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) remains challenging due to tiny target size, low signal-to-noise ratio, severe foreground-background imbalance, and blurred boundaries in complex scenes. Existing methods usually rely on post-activation probability-domain supervision for discrimination, where weak targets and strong clutter may produce saturated and close probabilities, limiting weak-target discrimination. Meanwhile, blurred boundaries and halo-like predictions mainly stem from thermal diffusion, tiny target scale, boundary uncertainty, and insufficient explicit contour constraints. To address these issues, we propose Adaptive-Contrastive SLSIoU (AC-SLSIoU), a plug-and-play discriminative and shape-aware loss for IRSTD. Specifically, a Logit-Domain Margin Constraint (LDMC) is introduced to enlarge the response gap between targets and informative hard negatives in the logit space, thereby enhancing weak-target discrimination. Adaptive Boundary Suppression (ABS) applies scale-aware annular penalties to refine target contours and suppress halo-like overflow responses. In addition, False-Alarm Focal Loss assigns larger weights to high-probability negative samples, further penalizing persistent high-confidence false alarms. Without introducing extra inference overhead, the proposed method can be seamlessly integrated into existing detectors and consistently improves both detection accuracy and shape quality. Extensive experiments and cross-backbone evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness, robustness, and generalization ability of the proposed method for infrared small target detection.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种即插即用的损失函数 AC-SLSIoU，用于红外小目标检测（IRSTD）。该方法通过 Logit 域间隔约束（LDMC）扩大目标与难负例的响应差距，增强弱目标判别；自适应边界抑制（ABS）施加尺度感知环形惩罚以细化轮廓并抑制光晕伪影；误报焦点损失（False-Alarm Focal Loss）加大对高置信度负样本的惩罚。无需额外推理开销，可集成到现有检测器中，提升检测精度和形状质量。
Motivation: 现有 IRSTD 方法在复杂场景中面临弱目标与强杂波概率饱和、边界模糊和光晕预测等问题，主要源于热扩散、目标尺度小、边界不确定性和缺乏显式轮廓约束。
Method: 提出 AC-SLSIoU 损失，包含三个组件：Logit 域间隔约束（LDMC）在 logit 空间扩大目标与难负例的间隔；自适应边界抑制（ABS）根据目标尺度施加环形惩罚以细化轮廓；误报焦点损失（False-Alarm Focal Loss）赋予高概率负样本更大权重以抑制持续误报。
Result: 大量实验和跨骨干网络评估表明，该方法在多个 IRSTD 数据集上一致提升了检测准确率和形状质量，且不增加推理开销。
Conclusion: 该方法作为即插即用的损失模块，能有效提升红外小目标检测的判别能力和形状保真度，具有良好的鲁棒性和泛化性。

papers.title: X-LogSMask: Expand Transformer for Graph-Structured Data
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have become general-purpose architectures, but their all-to-all self-attention is poorly matched to graph data, whose interactions are sparse, structured and multi-scale. Existing Graph Transformers address this mismatch through structural encodings, hybrid message-passing modules or learned attention constraints, often introducing additional complexity and limited interpretability. Here we introduce X-LogSMask, an explainable multi-head logarithmic structural mask that injects symmetrically normalized graph topology directly into attention logits. The logarithmic transform converts structural connectivity into a topology-aware gating signal, suppressing unsupported node interactions while preserving feature-dependent attention. By assigning different powers of the normalized adjacency matrix to different attention heads, X-LogSMask gives each head a defined structural radius and supports multi-hop information propagation within a single layer. We further show that a standard Transformer encoder can be interpreted as one-step message passing on a complete graph, motivating X-LogSMask as a topology-constrained alternative to unrestricted self-attention. Across 20 node-, edge- and graph-level benchmarks, Transformers equipped with X-LogSMask achieve state-of-the-art performance on 13 datasets and remain competitive in a lightweight one-layer configuration. These results show that simple, interpretable structural masks can make self-attention an effective graph-learning operator without changing the Transformer architecture. The code is available at https://github.com/LiLeyan-0120/X-LogSMask.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出X-LogSMask，一种可解释的多头对数结构掩码，将归一化图拓扑直接注入注意力logits，使标准Transformer无需更改架构即可有效处理图数据。通过对不同注意力头赋予不同幂次的邻接矩阵，实现单层内多跳信息传播。在20个节点、边和图级基准上，配备X-LogSMask的Transformer在13个数据集上达到最先进性能，且单层配置仍具竞争力。
Motivation: 现有Transformer的全局自注意力机制不适用于稀疏、结构化、多尺度的图数据；现有图Transformer通过结构编码或混合消息传递模块解决，但增加了复杂性且可解释性有限。
Method: 提出X-LogSMask，一种可解释的多头对数结构掩码：将对称归一化邻接矩阵的对数变换作为注意力logits的门控信号，抑制不支持节点交互；不同注意力头使用不同幂次的邻接矩阵，实现不同结构半径和多跳传播。
Result: 在20个节点、边和图级基准上，配备X-LogSMask的Transformer在13个数据集上达到最先进性能；单层配置下仍保持竞争力，且模型轻量。
Conclusion: 简单、可解释的结构掩码能使自注意力成为有效的图学习算子，无需更改Transformer架构。

papers.title: Evolutionary Feature Engineering for Structured Data
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used as open-ended search operators in evolutionary optimization. We introduce Evolutionary Feature Engineering (EFE), a framework for using LLM-based evolution to discover preprocessing transformations for structured data. EFE represents transformations as Python programs with a standardized fit/transform interface, allowing them to be inserted directly into existing machine learning pipelines. During evolution, candidate programs are refined using dataset context, summary statistics, and downstream performance feedback on validation set. We instantiate EFE in two settings. For time-series forecasting, EFE-Time learns invertible, dataset-specific normalizations that improve off-the-shelf time-series foundation models. It reduces forecasting errors (MASE, WQL, MAE) 3% or more when averaged across datasets and improvements are as much as 19% on the COVID-Deaths dataset. Notably, these improvements occur with recent TSFMs such as Chronos-2. For tabular prediction, EFE-Tab evolves compact feature programs that add useful interpretable features and remove redundant ones, improving or matching existing LLM-based feature-engineering methods. We found EFE-Tab to be particularly effective on classical decision trees, where small sets of evolved features yield competitive accuracy while preserving interpretability. Overall, EFE demonstrates that LLM-based evolution can improve both accuracy and interpretability when automatically tackling structured data.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出演化特征工程（EFE）框架，利用基于LLM的进化优化自动发现结构化数据的预处理变换。EFE将变换表示为Python程序，并集成到现有机器学习流水线中。在时间序列预测中，EFE-Time学习可逆的规范化方法，降低预测误差（MASE、WQL、MAE）平均3%以上，在COVID-Deaths数据集上提升达19%；在表格预测中，EFE-Tab演化出紧凑的特征程序，提升或匹配现有基于LLM的特征工程方法，尤其在经典决策树上表现良好。
Motivation: 结构化数据（时间序列和表格数据）的特征工程通常依赖手工或简单的方法，难以自动发现有效的预处理变换，而LLM的进化优化潜力尚未充分挖掘。
Method: 提出EFE框架，使用LLM作为进化搜索算子，通过标准化fit/transform接口表示Python程序，利用数据集上下文、统计摘要和验证集的下游性能反馈进行迭代优化。
Result: 在时间序列预测上，EFE-Time使Chronos-2等基础模型预测误差（MASE、WQL、MAE）平均降低3%以上，部分数据集提升19%；在表格预测上，EFE-Tab与现有LLM特征工程方法相当或更优，且生成的紧凑特征集保持了决策树的准确性。
Conclusion: 基于LLM的进化特征工程能同时提升结构数据的准确性和可解释性，适用于时间序列和表格任务。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: DriveWeaver: Point-Conditioned Video Inpainting for Controllable Vehicle Insertion in Autonomous Driving Simulation
papers.abstract_en: A pivotal step in autonomous driving simulation involves inserting foreground vehicles with predefined trajectories into simulated scenes. This process enhances scene diversity and facilitates the creation of various corner cases for testing and improving autonomous driving models. However, existing methods often rely on pre-reconstructed 3D assets, which frequently lead to lighting inconsistencies between the inserted foreground and the background. Moreover, the reliance on limited, manually-curated 3D assets hinders large-scale deployment. To address these challenges, we propose DriveWeaver, a novel framework for controllable vehicle insertion in autonomous driving simulation. Specifically, for a masked target insertion area, DriveWeaver performs video inpainting conditioned on vehicle point clouds to generate high-quality, temporally consistent vehicles. This video-inpainting-based approach ensures seamless blending between the foreground and background, while the readily available point cloud conditions enable superior generalization. To support long-term generation, we further design a global-to-local hierarchical inpainting strategy, ensuring the consistent identity and appearance of the inserted vehicles. Meanwhile, we extract explicit 3D Gaussian representations of the inserted vehicles through an urban reconstruction pipeline to enable real-time rendering for autonomous driving simulation. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms existing baselines in visual realism and geometric consistency, providing a robust tool for scalable autonomous driving scene augmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DriveWeaver 提出一种基于点云条件视频修补的框架，用于在自动驾驶仿真中可控地插入前景车辆。该方法通过全局到局部的层次化修补策略保证车辆身份和外观一致性，并利用3D高斯表示实现实时渲染，在各种数据集上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖预重建的3D资产，导致插入前景与背景之间的光照不一致，且受限于有限的手工3D资产，难以大规模部署。
Method: 提出 DriveWeaver 框架，对掩码目标区域进行点云条件视频修补；采用全局到局部的层次化修补策略以保持长期生成的一致性；通过城市重建管线提取显式3D高斯表示以实现实时渲染。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在视觉真实感和几何一致性方面优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 为自动驾驶场景增强提供了一种鲁棒且可扩展的工具，解决了光照一致性和泛化性问题。

papers.title: A Self-Evolving Agentic System for Automated Generation and Execution of Biological Protocols
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous wet-lab experimentation requires more than plausible protocol text: biological intent, quantitative procedures, device constraints and experimental feedback must remain aligned from protocol and SOP design to code and physical execution. We developed ProtoPilot, a self-evolving multi-agent system, together with an expert-grounded benchmark and evaluation framework for testing this conversion as an experimental automation problem. The framework spans 294 synthetic-biology and molecular-biology tasks derived from 98 gold-standard protocols, wet-lab expert rubrics, device-level validity gates and real experimental tests. ProtoPilot incorporates layer-wise verifiability, multi-agent orchestration and a runtime-updated skill library to generate protocols, expand SOPs, synthesize SDK-compliant code and revise workflows from wet-lab feedback. It achieved a Top@3 expert-preference rate of 90.2%, an overall protocol-to-code gate pass rate of 89.5% and an Opentrons pass rate of 88.24%, compared with 32.35% for OpenTrons-AI. Wet-lab validation produced interpretable readouts, Sanger-confirmed products and feedback-corrected PCA-assembled DNA targets, establishing a verifiable route to autonomous experimentation. Together, these results show that the evaluation framework captures execution-relevant requirements for autonomous wet-lab automation, and that ProtoPilot can meet them by converting protocol and code generation into validated execution and feedback-guided revision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProtoPilot，一个自进化的多智能体系统，用于从生物协议文本自动生成并执行实验代码。系统包含分层验证、多智能体编排和运行时更新的技能库，在 294 个合成生物学和分子生物学任务上，Top@3 专家偏好率达到 90.2%，协议到代码的通过率 89.5%，Opentrons 通过率 88.24%（对比 OpenTrons-AI 的 32.35%）。湿实验验证产生了可解释的读出结果和 Sanger 测序确认的产物，表明系统能够实现自主实验自动化。
Motivation: 自主湿实验需要协议、SOP、设备约束和实验反馈之间保持对齐，而现有系统仅生成看似合理的协议文本，无法保证可执行性。
Method: ProtoPilot 是一个自进化的多智能体系统，包含分层验证、多智能体编排以及运行时更新的技能库，能够生成协议、扩展 SOP、合成符合 SDK 的代码，并根据湿实验反馈修订工作流。
Result: 在 294 个任务上，Top@3 专家偏好率 90.2%，协议到代码门控通过率 89.5%，Opentrons 通过率 88.24%，显著高于 OpenTrons-AI 的 32.35%；湿实验验证产生了可解释的读出结果和 Sanger 确认的产物。
Conclusion: ProtoPilot 通过将协议和代码生成转化为可验证的执行和反馈引导的修订，实现了自主湿实验的可验证路径。

papers.title: WorldOdysseyBench: An Open-World Benchmark for Long-Horizon Stability of Interactive World Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in interactive world models (IWMs), existing benchmarks evaluate action following only at trajectory level and ignore memory and interaction physics. We introduce WorldOdysseyBench, an open-world benchmark for long-horizon stability across four dimensions, each with tailored innovations: (i) Action: per-frame action metric bypassing cross-model semantic scale disparity and exposing failures hidden by trajectory; (ii) Vision: segment-based drift metric capturing non-monotonic mid-sequence collapse missed by start-vs-end comparisons; (iii) Physics: controllability-gated evaluation over mechanics, optics, and 3D consistency, scoring plausibility under faithful action execution; (iv) Memory: action-decoupled protocol evaluating scene memory via transition-localized 3D point-cloud reconstruction and subject memory via tracking-plus-VLM reasoning. The benchmark comprises 600+ test cases across Nature, Urban, and Indoor scenes in first/third-person views with WASD 10-60s continuous interaction. Evaluating 10+ open/closed-source models reveals none reliably satisfies all dimensions; even the best achieves only moderate scores. Advances on WorldOdysseyBench are steps toward IWMs that are stable, physically grounded, memory-faithful, and deployable in real-world applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WorldOdysseyBench，一个用于评估交互世界模型（IWM）长程稳定性的开放世界基准。该基准覆盖动作、视觉、物理和记忆四个维度，包含 600 多个测试用例，涵盖自然、城市和室内场景，支持第一/第三人称视角下的 WASD 连续交互。评估了 10 多个开源和闭源模型，发现没有模型能在所有维度上表现可靠，最佳模型也仅达到中等分数。
Motivation: 现有基准仅评估轨迹级别的动作遵循，忽略了记忆和交互物理，缺乏对交互世界模型长程稳定性的全面评估。
Method: 提出包含四个维度的基准：动作维度采用逐帧动作度量，避免跨模型尺度差异；视觉维度采用基于片段的漂移度量，捕捉非单调的中间序列崩溃；物理维度通过可控性门控评估力学、光学和3D一致性；记忆维度通过动作解耦的协议评估场景记忆（基于过渡局部化的3D点云重建）和主体记忆（基于跟踪加VLM推理）。
Result: 在 10 多个开源和闭源模型上的评估显示，没有模型能够可靠满足所有四个维度，最佳模型也仅达到中等分数。
Conclusion: WorldOdysseyBench 是迈向稳定、物理可信、记忆忠实且可在真实世界部署的交互世界模型的重要步骤。

papers.title: DynFly: Dynamic-Aware Continuous Trajectory Generation for UAV Vision-Language Navigation in Urban Environments
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal large models have significantly improved UAV vision-language navigation (UAV-VLN) by enhancing high-level perception and reasoning. However, existing methods mainly focus on predicting discrete actions, local targets, or sparse waypoints, while the continuous transition from navigation intent to executable UAV motion remains weakly modeled. This motion-interface gap limits the continuity, stability, and executability of generated UAV trajectories. To address this gap, we propose DynFly, a dynamic-aware continuous trajectory generation framework that bridges high-level navigation reasoning and executable UAV motion. DynFly bridges high-level navigation intent and continuous UAV motion through a lightweight trajectory generation layer. Specifically, it represents expert trajectories in B-spline control-point space and employs a Spline-DiT generator to learn conditional trajectory generation via flow matching. Furthermore, we introduce UAV-oriented dynamic-aware supervision over position, finite-difference velocity, finite-difference acceleration, heading consistency, and local target alignment, enabling the generated trajectories to better satisfy UAV motion characteristics. And our trajectory generation framework can also be integrated with an existing UAV-VLN framework while preserving its original visual-language reasoning pipeline. Extensive experiments on the OpenUAV UAV-VLN benchmark show that DynFly improves both navigation performance and trajectory quality. On the Test Unseen Full split, DynFly improves the strongest baseline by 4.69 NDTW, 2.40 SDTW, 2.14 SR points and 4.87 OSR points, while reducing NE by 4.51 m.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynFly，一种动态感知的连续轨迹生成框架，用于解决无人机视觉语言导航中从高层意图到可执行动作之间的运动接口差距。DynFly 使用 B 样条控制点和 Spline-DiT 生成器，通过流匹配学习条件轨迹生成，并引入无人机导向的动态感知监督（位置、速度、加速度、航向一致性和局部目标对齐）。在 OpenUAV 基准上的实验表明，该方法在导航性能和轨迹质量上均有提升。
Motivation: 现有方法主要预测离散动作、局部目标或稀疏航点，缺乏从导航意图到连续无人机运动的建模，导致生成轨迹的连续性、稳定性和可执行性不足。
Method: 提出 DynFly 框架，包括用 B 样条控制点表示专家轨迹，使用 Spline-DiT 生成器通过流匹配学习条件生成，并引入无人机导向的动态感知监督（位置、速度、加速度、航向一致性、局部目标对齐）。该框架可嵌入现有 UAV-VLN 系统而不改变其视觉语言推理流程。
Result: 在 OpenUAV 基准的 Test Unseen Full 上，DynFly 相比最强基线提升 NDTW 4.69，SDTW 2.40，SR 2.14，OSR 4.87 点，NE 降低 4.51 米。
Conclusion: DynFly 通过连续轨迹生成层弥合了高层导航推理与可执行无人机运动之间的间隙，改善了轨迹的质量和可执行性。

papers.title: What Memory Do GUI Agents Really Need? From Passive Records to Active Task-Driving States
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI agents increasingly face long-horizon tasks that require reading, updating, and reusing task-relevant data across pages and applications. Existing methods treat memory largely as passive storage, where past observations are accumulated and retrieved when needed. Yet retrieving a value does not reveal its current role in the workflow. The agent must still infer from accumulated records whether the value should be used now, has already been used, or must wait for a later dependency. This implicit reconstruction becomes unreliable in long trajectories with repeated values, distractors, and outdated states, causing repeated or missed operations. To address this, we propose Active Task Driving Memory (ATMem), which shifts GUI-agent memory from passive storage to an actively maintained execution state. ATMem maintains task-relevant information as a continually updated execution state that links each value to its role and current status, enabling action selection based on the current workflow state. While supervised fine-tuning enables the agent to construct ATMem, it does not teach when ATMem is beneficial. We therefore introduce STR-GRPO, an online reinforcement learning method that encourages selective use of ATMem based on its contribution to task completion. STR-GRPO contrasts memory-on and memory-off rollouts to estimate when memory use improves execution, while memory-cost-aware reward discourages costly memory usage that does not improve execution. To evaluate whether agents can complete all in-scope work while avoiding out-of-scope actions, we build a challenging mobile benchmark. From a list of near identical entries, agents must act on every entry that satisfies the instruction and reject entries that violate its constraints. We further introduce App-Level Progress and Scope-Aware F1 to measure these two dimensions separately.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Active Task Driving Memory (ATMem)，将GUI智能体的记忆从被动存储转变为主动维护的执行状态，每个值关联其角色和当前状态。同时提出STR-GRPO在线强化学习方法，通过对比有无记忆的rollout并引入记忆成本感知奖励，鼓励选择性使用记忆。作者构建了移动基准，并引入App-Level Progress和Scope-Aware F1两个指标分别衡量任务进度和范围准确性。
Motivation: 现有GUI代理将记忆视为被动存储，需要从历史记录中隐式推断当前值的使用状态，在长轨迹中容易因重复值、干扰项和过期状态而导致重复或遗漏操作。
Method: 提出ATMem，维护持续更新的执行状态，将每个值与其角色和状态关联。提出STR-GRPO在线强化学习，通过对比记忆开启和关闭的rollout，并加入记忆成本感知奖励，鼓励在有利时选择性使用ATMem。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但构建了从近似相同条目中识别所需操作的移动基准，并引入App-Level Progress和Scope-Aware F1分别衡量任务进度和范围准确性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调GUI代理记忆应从被动存储转向主动执行状态，STR-GRPO能根据记忆对任务完成的贡献进行选择性启用，避免无益的高成本记忆使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond the Expressivity-Trainability Paradox: A Dynamical Lie Algebra Perspective on Navigating Barren Plateaus in Quantum Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: As Quantum Machine Learning (QML) transitions toward practical implementation, the field faces a critical architectural bottleneck that challenges the fundamental assumptions of classical statistical learning theory. In classical deep learning, increasing model capacity typically risks overfitting. However, this study advances a counter-intuitive paradigm: unstructured contemporary QML architectures suffer from a profound state of quantum underfitting, driven by the "expressivity-trainability paradox." We demonstrate that the vast Hilbert space capacity of Parameterized Quantum Circuits (PQCs)-traditionally chased as the source of quantum advantage is the direct mathematical cause of Barren Plateaus (BPs), where gradient landscapes become exponentially flat. By synthesizing recent breakthroughs in Dynamical Lie Algebras (DLAs) and Geometric QML, we establish a comprehensive framework linking the algebraic dimension of circuit generators to their optimization dynamics. Furthermore, we empirically validate this framework on a non-linear binary classification task, illuminating a uniquely quantum manifestation of the bias-variance tradeoff: while unstructured architectures achieve near-perfect training accuracy via unscalable parameterization (quantum overfitting), embedding group-theoretic geometric priors acts as a structural regularizer. By restricting the DLA growth to a polynomial regime, our symmetry-preserving approach sacrifices raw memorization capacity to guarantee scalable, gradient-rich training landscapes, offering a robust roadmap for "Trainability-by-Design" in scalable quantum neural networks.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures; added missing co-author, incorporated MBL literature in Section 2.4, and included Author Contributions and AI disclosure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对量子机器学习中参数化量子电路（PQC）因巨大希尔伯特空间容量导致的贫瘠高原（Barren Plateaus）问题，提出利用动力李代数（DLA）和几何量子机器学习框架，通过限制DLA生长至多项式规模，牺牲原始记忆容量以保证可梯度训练。实验验证了量子特有的偏差-方差权衡。
Motivation: 经典统计学习理论假设增加模型容量可能过拟合，但量子机器学习中非结构化的当代架构存在量子欠拟合问题，即表达性-可训练性悖论导致的可训练性瓶颈。
Method: 综合动力李代数（DLA）和几何量子机器学习的最新成果，建立联系电路生成器代数维度与优化动力学的框架；通过嵌入群论几何先验作为结构正则化器，限制DLA生长至多项式规模。
Result: 在非线性二分类任务上验证了该框架，表明非结构化架构通过不可扩展参数化达到近乎完美训练精度（量子过拟合），而对称性保持方法可保证可扩展的、富含梯度的训练景观。
Conclusion: 提出"Trainability-by-Design"方法，为可扩展量子神经网络提供鲁棒路线图。

papers.title: Resolving superposition in AI for interpretability and cross-modal alignment in patient-neuronal images
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence is transforming our capability to solve biological challenges. In dimensionality bottleneck regimes exacerbated by high-dimensional biological data, neural networks force distinct concepts into the lower dimensions known as superposition. Although this superposition is widely known to hinder interpretability, its impact on corrupting the geometry of latent spaces remains critically overlooked. Here, we utilized sparse autoencoders (SAEs) trained on over 100,000 multiplexed images of patient-derived Parkinson's disease and healthy neurons to resolve superposition. This approach bypasses the mathematical non-uniqueness of feature attribution by shifting to interpretable latent representation analysis. We theoretically and empirically demonstrate that superposition contaminates representational metric spaces, and thereby SAEs successfully recover geometric fidelity. By treating these geometrically purified representations as single-cell state vectors, we adapted single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data analysis methodologies directly to the image domain. Finally, we introduce GW-map, utilizing Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport to align these image representations with authentic scRNA-seq data de novo. This coupling reconstructs hierarchical neuronal pathology pathways such as Calcium-AIS scaffold, without reference spatial transcriptomics, establishing a scalable foundation for spatial biology. Code is available at https://github.com/jijihihi/Bio\_superposition
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures (plus 14 in appendix), 1 table, preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）解析患者神经元图像中神经网络隐藏层的叠加（superposition）问题，恢复潜在空间的几何保真度，并通过Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输实现图像表示与真实单细胞RNA-seq数据的跨模态对齐，从而重建病理学通路。
Motivation: 高维生物数据迫使神经网络在低维瓶颈中产生叠加，损害可解释性和潜在空间几何结构，现有方法无法解决该问题。
Method: 使用超过10万张帕金森病与健康神经元多重成像数据训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）来解析叠加；将净化后的表示视为单细胞状态向量，并引入GW-map利用Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输实现与scRNA-seq数据的新颖对齐。
Result: 理论证明并实验验证叠加污染表示度量空间，SAE成功恢复几何保真度；GW-map无需参考空间转录组学即可重构层次化神经病理通路（如Calcium-AIS脚手架）。
Conclusion: 该方法为空间生物学提供了可扩展的基础，克服了特征归因的数学非唯一性，但需要进一步验证在不同疾病和图像模态中的泛化能力。

papers.title: Language-Assisted Super-Resolution from Real-World Low-Resolution Patches
papers.abstract_en: Single image super-resolution aims to reconstruct high-resolution (HR) images from low-resolution (LR) inputs. Training SR models typically requires paired HR-LR data, which is difficult to obtain in reality. As a result, most methods synthesize LR images by artificially degrading HR images with handcrafted kernels or camera ISP adjustments. However, these synthetic degradations fail to capture the complexity of real LR images, leading to poor generalization in practice. To address this, we observe that even within a single high-quality image, regions at different depths exhibit varying resolutions, where distant regions act as LR patches and closer ones as HR patches. This allows the extraction of real, degradation-induced LR patches from real images. Since these LR patches lack paired HR counterparts, we propose LA-SR (Language Assistant for SR), a novel framework for unpaired SR. The key idea of LA-SR is to redefine unpaired SR in the language space, using vision-language models to bridge the LR-HR gap. LA-SR projects images into a semantically rich space representing both content and quality, and applies two language-guided losses: linguistic content loss to preserve semantic fidelity, and linguistic quality loss to enhance perceptual realism. With this alignment, LA-SR effectively super-resolves real LR inputs, producing realistic outputs that overcome the limitations of synthetic-data-trained methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LA-SR框架，利用视觉语言模型在语言空间中解决真实低分辨率补丁的未配对超分辨率问题。通过从单张高质量图像中提取不同深度对应的真实低分辨率区域作为训练数据，并应用语言内容损失和质量损失进行对齐，该方法无需人工合成退化就能生成逼真的高分辨率输出。
Motivation: 现有超分辨率方法依赖人工合成低分辨率图像，无法模拟真实退化，导致模型在真实场景中泛化能力差。
Method: 提出LA-SR框架，使用视觉语言模型将图像投影到语义丰富的语言空间，并设计两种语言引导损失：语言内容损失保持语义一致性，语言质量损失提升感知真实感，实现未配对的真实低分辨率到高分辨率映射。
Result: 该方法在真实低分辨率输入上能生成逼真的高分辨率输出，克服了基于合成数据训练的方法的局限性。
Conclusion: 通过将未配对超分辨率问题重新定义在语言空间中，利用视觉语言模型对齐不同分辨率图像的内容与质量，有效解决了真实场景中的超分辨率挑战。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有超分辨率方法依赖人工合成低分辨率图像，无法模拟真实退化，导致模型在真实场景中泛化能力差。
summary_sections.method: 提出LA-SR框架，使用视觉语言模型将图像投影到语义丰富的语言空间，并设计两种语言引导损失：语言内容损失保持语义一致性，语言质量损失提升感知真实感，实现未配对的真实低分辨率到高分辨率映射。
summary_sections.result: 该方法在真实低分辨率输入上能生成逼真的高分辨率输出，克服了基于合成数据训练的方法的局限性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过将未配对超分辨率问题重新定义在语言空间中，利用视觉语言模型对齐不同分辨率图像的内容与质量，有效解决了真实场景中的超分辨率挑战。

papers.title: Spatial Reasoning via Modality Switching Between Language and Symbolic Representation
papers.abstract_en: Human reasoning is inherently multimodal: when problems become difficult, we rarely think in words alone. We often externalize our reasoning by sketching diagrams or drawing grids to understand the underlying conceptual structure and avoid mistakes. Building on this premise, our research investigates: (a) whether grounding multi-hop textual-spatial stories into geometry-aware modalities, such as layouts or grids, improves reasoning compared to natural language-based inference; and (b) whether a model can decide when to rely on natural language reasoning and when to switch to a structured modality. We address these questions by introducing a switching metric based on trustworthiness and complexity signals, which estimates when grounding a spatial story into structure is likely to improve performance. This takes a first step toward principled modality selection in Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning. Across our settings, switching from natural language-based reasoning to a grid-based representation improves LLM performance by up to 42%, highlighting the importance of modality choice in shaping reasoning outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在大型语言模型（LLM）推理中，是否可以通过将多跳文本-空间故事接地到几何感知模态（如布局或网格）来改善推理，并引入一种基于可信度和复杂性信号的切换度量，以决定何时使用自然语言推理、何时切换到结构化模态。实验表明，从自然语言切换到网格表示可将LLM性能提升高达42%。
Motivation: 人类推理本质上是多模态的，在困难问题中常常通过画图来外部化推理。论文探究将文本-空间故事接地到几何感知模态是否能提升推理，以及模型是否能自主决定何时切换。
Method: 引入基于可信度和复杂性信号的切换度量，估计何时将空间故事接地到结构（如网格）能够提升性能，从而实现LLM推理中的模态选择。
Result: 在多种设置下，从基于自然语言的推理切换到网格表示可将LLM性能提升高达42%。
Conclusion: 该工作向原则性的模态选择迈出了第一步，强调了模态选择对推理结果的重要影响。

papers.title: ISM:Self-Improving Strategy Memory for Continual Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We propose Intelligent Schema Memory (ISM), a self-evolving memory-augmented system that improves mathematical reasoning for a frozen LLM under continual learning with hard episodic resets. ISM maintains a compact, self-refined bank of strategy schemas learned from both successful and failed episodes, with symbolic tools that check intermediate steps and certify answers. Without updating model parameters, ISM outperforms passive, retrieval, and reflection baselines on MATH-Hard and OlympiadBench, using 64% and 86% fewer schemas respectively than the strongest passive baseline. These results show that small, actively maintained, and verified strategy memories can support reliable continual mathematical reasoning under strict episodic isolation. The codebase is available at https://github.com/pdx97/ISM .
papers.comment: 3rd AI for Math Workshop at ICML 2026 Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出智能模式记忆（ISM），一种自进化的记忆增强系统，使冻结的大语言模型（LLM）在硬性情节重置的连续学习中提升数学推理能力。ISM维护一个紧凑、自我精炼的策略模式库，从成功和失败的情节中学习，并利用符号工具检验中间步骤和验证答案。在不更新模型参数的情况下，ISM在MATH-Hard和OlympiadBench上超越被动、检索和反思基线，且使用的模式数量分别比最强被动基线少64%和86%。
Motivation: 现有方法在连续数学推理中面临灾难性遗忘和无效记忆策略的挑战，需要一种不更新参数且能高效利用经验的系统。
Method: ISM通过维护一个自精炼的策略模式库，从成功和失败的经验中学习，结合符号检验工具确保正确性，并在硬性情节重置下持续改进。
Result: 在MATH-Hard和OlympiadBench上超越被动、检索和反思基线，使用模式数量减少64%和86%。
Conclusion: 小规模、主动维护且经过验证的策略记忆能够在严格情节隔离下支持可靠的连续数学推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ClawArena-Team: Benchmarking Subagent Orchestration and Dynamic Workflows in Language-Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Production large language-model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed not as lone problem-solvers but as managers: a main model creates specialized subagents, delegates work, and orchestrates their parallel, asynchronous returns through dynamic workflows. Whether one model can actually run such a team is largely unmeasured: existing benchmarks score a policy's own task-solving or a fixed multi-agent system's emergent behavior, but none isolate the management ability of the single LLM acting as leader. We introduce ClawArena-Team, a benchmark of 41 multi-turn, multimodal, multi-directory scenarios spanning 258 evaluation rounds and 72 staged updates that measures this management ability. The main agent is deliberately constrained: it natively perceives only text and directly accesses only part of the workspace. It commands a fixed, locally served subagent pool, so score differences reflect management skill, not raw capability. All scoring is execution-based with no LLM judge: an overall score -- the Subagent-Management Score (SMS) -- multiplies task correctness by a least-privilege and modality-routing factor. Across twelve proprietary, community-hosted, and self-hosted models, experiments show that the management bottleneck is privilege granting rather than perception (no model exceeds 50% workspace-permission precision); that cost and management quality are decoupled (API cost spans over 100 times while the overall score spans under 4 times, with the cheapest open models on the Pareto frontier); and that most leaderboard scores cluster within a 9.9-point band while orchestration behaviors diverge by more than an order of magnitude. Code is available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/ClawArena.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ClawArena-Team基准，用于评估LLM作为管理者的子代理编排与动态工作流能力。该基准包含41个多轮、多模态、多目录场景，通过执行评估计算子代理管理得分（SMS）。实验表明管理瓶颈在于权限授予而非感知，成本与管理质量解耦，且大多数模型得分集中在9.9分范围内。
Motivation: 现有基准未单独测量LLM作为领导者管理子代理的能力，而是评估策略自身的任务解决或固定多代理系统的涌现行为。
Method: 设计41个多轮多模态多目录场景的主代理受限环境，主代理仅能感知文本和访问部分工作空间，指挥固定本地子代理池，评分基于执行且无LLM裁判，SMS乘以任务正确性与最小权限和模态路由因子。
Result: 在12个模型上，管理瓶颈是权限授予（无模型超过50%工作空间权限精度），成本与管理质量解耦（API成本跨度超100倍，SMS跨度不到4倍），最便宜开源模型处于帕累托前沿，大多数得分聚集在9.9分范围内但编排行为差异超过一个数量级。
Conclusion: 基准揭示了LLM管理能力的瓶颈和成本解耦现象，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: McMg: A Learned Phase-Space Multi-channel Multigrid Preconditioner for Helmholtz Equation
papers.abstract_en: Solving heterogeneous Helmholtz equations at high wavenumbers remains challenging because the discretized operator is indefinite, pollution degrades phase accuracy, and scalar coarse-grid correction can discard the local phase and propagation-direction information carried by oscillatory errors. We propose Multi-channel Multigrid (McMg), a learned phase-space multigrid preconditioner for heterogeneous Helmholtz equations. Rather than predicting the solution directly, McMg maps residuals to corrections within an iterative framework. Its central idea is to coarsen physical space while retaining unresolved local wave information in the channel dimension: each coarse node carries a learned packet of amplitude, phase, direction, and scattering coefficients rather than a single scalar unknown. The architecture combines linear multi-channel transfer operators with locally adaptive stencils, neural PDE operators, and medium-dependent smoothers whose coefficients are generated from the wave speed. For a fixed medium, the V-cycle is linear in the residual; nonlinear physical features are computed once in a setup phase and cached, so each online iteration reduces to convolutions with fixed coefficients. We further study generalization across scales. Models trained on small domains transfer directly to larger domains and higher effective wavenumbers, and a Layer-by-Layer Progressive Finetuning (LLPF) strategy improves large-domain scalability by adding new coarse levels while finetuning only the newly introduced parameters. Numerical experiments on high-frequency, high-contrast, and large-scale three-dimensional problems demonstrate that McMg requires substantially fewer iterations and less wall-clock time than strong classical baselines, while consistently outperforming existing neural preconditioners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为多通道多重网格（McMg）的学习型相空间预条件子，用于求解高波数下异质亥姆霍兹方程。该方法在粗化的物理空间中保留未解析的局部波信息（振幅、相位、方向等）作为通道，结合线性多通道传输算子、局部自适应模板和依赖波速的平滑器，实现了与残差线性的V循环。数值实验表明，在高频、高对比度和大规模三维问题上，McMg相比经典基线和现有神经预条件子，显著减少了迭代次数和计算时间。
Motivation: 高波数下的异质亥姆霍兹方程离散后是不定矩阵，污染效应降低相位精度，且标量粗网格校正会丢失振荡误差携带的局部相位和传播方向信息。现有方法难以高效求解。
Method: 提出多通道多重网格（McMg）预条件子。核心思想是粗化物理空间时，在通道维度保留未解析的局部波信息：每个粗节点携带一个学习的包（包含振幅、相位、方向、散射系数），而非单个标量未知。架构结合线性多通道传输算子、局部自适应模板、神经PDE算子和依赖波速的平滑器。对于固定介质，V循环与残差线性，非线性特征在一次设置阶段计算并缓存，在线迭代仅为固定系数的卷积。还提出逐层渐进微调（LLPF）策略以提升大规模域的可扩展性。
Result: 高频、高对比度和大规模三维问题的数值实验表明，McMg相比强经典基线和现有神经预条件子，需要更少的迭代次数和更少的墙钟时间，且一致优于现有神经预条件子。此外，小域训练的模型可直接迁移到大域和更高有效波数，LLPF策略进一步改善了大域的可扩展性。
Conclusion: McMg通过在学习型多网格框架中保留粗网格上的局部波信息，有效解决了高波数亥姆霍兹方程求解中的相位精度和污染问题，数值实验证明了其效率和可扩展性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Translating Natural Language to Strategic Temporal Specifications via LLMs
papers.abstract_en: A rigorous formalization of system requirements is a fundamental prerequisite for the verification of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS). However, writing correct formal specifications is well known as an error-prone, time-consuming, and expertise-intensive task. This difficulty is further accentuated in MAS, where requirements must capture strategic abilities and temporal objectives. At present, there is no established methodology for deriving MAS specifications from natural language. We present a framework for translating Natural Language descriptions of strategic requirements into well-formed ATL/ATL* formulas using Large Language Models (LLMs). Since no available dataset supports supervised learning for the NL-to-ATL/ATL* translation task, we create and curate a novel expert-validated dataset, employed for training and evaluating fine-tuned models. On a held-out test set, evaluated under the LLM judge that best agrees with expert annotations, in-domain fine-tuning of small open-weight models (3 - 7B parameters) matches strong few-shot proprietary API baselines. Our best fine-tuned system reaches 0.84 semantic accuracy, statistically on par with 0.86 for the strongest few-shot proprietary baseline, while keeping requirements on-premises. We further find that judge reliability is inverse to generator strength. The open-weight Llama-3.3-70B tracks human verdicts most closely, whereas the strongest proprietary models are the least reliable judges, over-rejecting faithful paraphrases of the reference. To assess the practical applicability of the generated specifications, we embed our tool to an existing strategic logics model checker, enabling non-expert users to specify strategic properties in natural language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于大语言模型（LLMs）的框架，用于将自然语言描述的战略需求转化为形式化的ATL/ATL*时序逻辑公式，以支持多智能体系统的验证。由于缺乏可用数据集，作者创建了一个专家验证的数据集，并微调了参数在3-7B之间的开源模型。在测试集上，微调模型达到了0.84的语义准确率，与强大的少样本专有API基线（0.86）在统计上相当。此外，研究发现审判者（judge）的可靠性与生成器强度成反比，最强的专有模型作为审判者时最不可靠，倾向于错误拒绝忠实复述。
Motivation: 在多智能体系统（MAS）中，将自然语言需求转化为正确的形式化规格（如ATL/ATL*）是困难且易错的，目前缺乏系统化的方法。
Method: 构建了一个专家验证的自然语言到ATL/ATL*的数据集，并对小规模开源LLMs（3-7B参数）进行领域内微调。
Result: 微调模型在测试集上达到0.84语义准确率，与最强专有API基线（0.86）在统计上相当；开源的Llama-3.3-70B作为审判者最接近人类判断，而最强专有模型作为审判者最不可靠。
Conclusion: 微调开源小模型可以匹敌专有API的翻译性能，同时保持需求处理在本地；审判者可靠性需谨慎选择，强模型不一定是最佳裁判。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 构建了一个专家验证的自然语言到ATL/ATL*的数据集，并对小规模开源LLMs（3-7B参数）进行领域内微调。
summary_sections.result: 微调模型在测试集上达到0.84语义准确率，与最强专有API基线（0.86）在统计上相当；开源的Llama-3.3-70B作为审判者最接近人类判断，而最强专有模型作为审判者最不可靠。
summary_sections.conclusion: 微调开源小模型可以匹敌专有API的翻译性能，同时保持需求处理在本地；审判者可靠性需谨慎选择，强模型不一定是最佳裁判。

papers.title: Argus: Metric Panoramic 3D Reconstruction for Indoor Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Metric feed-forward 3D reconstruction for panoramic data remains under-explored due to the lack of large-scale panoramic RGB-D training data. We present Realsee3D, a hybrid dataset of 10K indoor scenes (1K real, 9K synthetic) with 299K panoramic viewpoints and precise metric annotations, and Argus, a feed-forward network trained on it for metric panoramic 3D reconstruction. In the sparse unordered capture setting of Realsee3D, a poorly chosen coordinate anchor can cause global pose drift. Argus addresses this with a learned covisibility module that selects the geometrically optimal reference view to anchor the metric world frame. To further improve multi-task learning, we decompose the bidirectional pixel-to-world mapping into interpretable sub-steps with per-step supervision and cross-coordinate joint constraints, reinforcing geometric consistency across prediction branches. On the Realsee3D benchmark, Argus achieves state-of-the-art metric performance in camera pose estimation, depth estimation, and point cloud reconstruction. Project page: https://argus-paper.realsee.ai.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对室内场景的度量全景三维重建问题，提出了包含1K真实和9K合成场景的混合数据集Realsee3D，以及基于前馈神经网络的Argus方法。Argus通过学习的共视模块选择最优参考视图来缓解全局位姿漂移，并将双向像素-世界映射分解为可解释子步骤，辅以逐步骤监督和跨坐标联合约束，在Realsee3D基准上实现了相机位姿估计、深度估计和点云重建的最优度量性能。
Motivation: 现有度量前馈三维重建方法缺乏大规模全景RGB-D训练数据，且在稀疏无序捕捉场景中，不恰当的坐标锚点会导致全局位姿漂移。
Method: 构建了包含10K室内场景（1K真实、9K合成）及299K全景视角的Realsee3D混合数据集；提出Argus网络，采用学习的共视模块选择几何最优参考视图来锚定度量世界坐标系，并将双向像素-世界映射分解为可解释子步骤，每个步骤有监督信号和跨坐标联合约束以增强几何一致性。
Result: 在Realsee3D基准上，Argus在相机位姿估计、深度估计和点云重建任务中均达到最先进的度量性能。
Conclusion: 论文强调其提出的混合数据集和Argus方法填补了度量全景三维重建的空白，并在多任务学习场景中验证了其几何一致性设计。

papers.title: SAGA: Scene-Aware, Goal-Evolving Agents for Long-Horizon CivRealm Strategy Planning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon strategic planning in complex strategy games demands concurrent reasoning across multiple decision domains under imperfect information and sparse reward. Existing LLM-based agents suffer from three systematic failures: scene blindness from raw tile coordinates, context overflow and domain coupling from monolithic state dumps, and shallow cross-game learning that treats each episode in isolation. We present SAGA, an LLM multi-agent framework with three mechanisms each directly targeting one class of failure: (i) a Map-Semantic Scene Graph that encodes typed spatial relations among game entities into per-unit natural-language context, resolving spatial blindness without global token inflation; (ii) a Tool-Augmented Planner that pulls fine-grained domain state on demand and dispatches per-domain directives to dedicated specialist controllers, eliminating context overflow, domain coupling, and mechanical constraint violations; and (iii) a Dual-Horizon Feedback Loop that combines periodic within-game goal generation with structured cross-game causal post-mortem, enabling principled strategic evolution without manual reward engineering. Evaluated on FreeCiv, SAGA attains the highest mean civilization score -- the environment's sole sparse objective reward -- with lower variance than the two strongest baselines, and is the only method that significantly surpasses every baseline on infrastructure construction, the resource axis most readily sacrificed under multi-objective conflict. It outscores the two strongest baselines in most head-to-head games while cutting output tokens (the dominant decoding cost) by 27%. Equipped with the cross-game evolution module, SAGA reaches the highest end-of-chain score across five successive episodes. Ablation studies confirm that each architectural component contributes independently to this advantage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAGA，一个针对长期策略游戏FreeCiv的LLM多智能体框架，通过地图语义场景图、工具增强规划器和双视野反馈循环三个机制，分别解决场景盲、上下文溢出和跨游戏学习浅的问题。实验表明，SAGA在稀疏奖励环境下获得最高平均文明分数，方差低于最强基线，输出tokens减少27%，且每个组件独立贡献优势。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在复杂策略游戏中存在三大系统性问题：原始瓦片坐标导致的场景盲、整体状态转储引发的上下文溢出和领域耦合、以及孤立处理每局游戏导致的浅层跨游戏学习。
Method: 提出SAGA框架，包含三个关键机制：(i) 地图语义场景图，将实体间空间关系编码为每个单位的自然语言上下文，避免全局token膨胀；(ii) 工具增强规划器，按需拉取细粒度领域状态并分派指令给专用控制器，消除上下文溢出和领域耦合；(iii) 双视野反馈循环，结合局内目标生成和跨游戏因果事后分析，实现无需手动奖励工程的策略演化。
Result: 在FreeCiv上，SAGA获得最高平均文明分数（环境唯一稀疏奖励），方差低于两个最强基线；在基础设施建造（多目标冲突中最易被牺牲的资源轴）上显著超越每个基线；在多数直接对战中胜出两个最强基线，同时输出tokens减少27%；配备跨游戏演化模块后，连续五局达到最高末端分数。
Conclusion: 消融实验证实每个架构组件独立贡献于整体优势，SAGA通过解耦空间感知、领域分解和跨游戏学习有效提升了长期策略规划性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Active Quantum Kernel Acquisition for Gaussian Process Regression
papers.abstract_en: Quantum kernel estimation on near-term hardware is shot-budgeted: every entry of the kernel Gram matrix is a Bernoulli expectation that must be sampled with a finite number of circuit executions. Recent work on quantum kernel classification has shown that allocating shots non-uniformly across kernel entries, weighted by their downstream task sensitivity, can reduce the shot budget required to reach a target accuracy. We extend this idea to Gaussian process (GP) regression, a setting whose downstream quantities (full-spectrum posterior variance, log-determinant, marginal likelihood) couple to kernel error more tightly than the sign-only outputs of classification. We derive three closed-form pair-level sensitivities predictive coupling $|α_iα_j|$, leave-one-out residual, and marginal-likelihood gradient and plug them into a Neyman-style minimum-variance allocation rule. To prevent catastrophic over-concentration when the warm-up sensitivity estimate is itself noisy, we add a high uniform coverage floor justified by a Frobenius lower bound on the missing-entry perturbation. On four UCI benchmarks and two synthetic RBF + Bernoulli controlled studies, the resulting allocator delivers $10$--$21\%$ test-RMSE improvement over uniform allocation across the moderate-budget regime. The gain transfers (i) to genuine ZZ and Pauli-Z quantum kernels on quantum-natural data ($-13$--$15\%$ at low budget, $p<0.05$ paired) and (ii) to four downstream tasks (Bayesian quadrature, heteroscedastic regression, hyperparameter learning, multi-output Cokriging). On UCI features embedded into a ZZ kernel the gain disappears, consistent with the exponential-concentration regime where shot allocation has nothing to exploit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对近端量子硬件上核矩阵估计的shot预算问题，将非均匀shot分配方法从分类扩展到高斯过程回归，推导了三种闭式对级灵敏度（具体为|α_iα_j|、留一残差和边际似然梯度），并加入基于Frobenius下界的均匀覆盖底限以防止噪声导致的过度集中。在四个UCI基准和两个合成控制研究中，与均匀分配相比，测试RMSE提升10-21%；在真实ZZ和Pauli-Z量子核上，低预算时RMSE降低13-15%（p<0.05），增益在四个下游任务中均有体现，但在UCI特征嵌入ZZ核时增益消失，符合指数集中区预期。
Motivation: 分类任务中非均匀shot分配已证明可节省预算，但高斯过程回归中下游量（如后验方差、对数行列式）与核误差的耦合更紧密，现有方法的适用性未知，需要针对性设计。
Method: 推导三种闭式对级灵敏度（结合|α_iα_j|、留一残差和边际似然梯度），基于Neyman最小方差分配规则确定各核条目的shot数，并加入Frobenius下界约束的均匀覆盖底限以避免初始噪声导致的过度集中。
Result: 在四个UCI基准和两个合成控制实验中，测试RMSE提升10-21%；在真实ZZ和Pauli-Z量子核上，低预算时RMSE降低13-15%（p<0.05）；增益在贝叶斯求积、异方差回归、超参数学习和多输出Cokriging等四个下游任务中均显著；但在UCI特征嵌入ZZ核时增益消失，符合指数集中区。
Conclusion: 非均匀shot分配可有效减少高斯过程回归的shot预算，但性能增益在高维指数集中数据上可能消失，该工作扩展了量子核采样的自适应策略。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Four Types of LLM Reliance and Their Predictors Among Undergraduate Writers: A Mixed-Methods Study at a Minority-Serving R1 University
papers.abstract_en: Although most undergraduates now use large language models (LLMs), a form of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) for academic writing, no validated method distinguishes the qualitatively different ways students rely on them. Existing instruments assess reliance solely by frequency of use, a measure that, as this study shows, inadvertently rewards dependence on AI rather than recognizing students' own intellectual contribution. Conducted at a public minority-serving university and grounded in the AI Literacy Framework, Expectancy-Value Theory, and Biggs's Presage-Process-Product model, the study drew on 382 undergraduates, 14 interviews, and 396 open-ended survey responses. Four distinct reliance types were identified and confirmed: Strategic (34.3%), Instrumental (30.9%), Dialogic (30.4%), and Dependent (4.5%). Students' value and cost beliefs predicted the intensity of their reliance on LLMs, whereas their AI literacy predicted the type of reliance they adopted, indicating that differentiated support is needed. Notably, Strategic users, those who engaged AI most deliberately, scored lowest on standard outcome measures. This pattern reflects a limitation of current instruments, which index AI's contribution rather than writing quality, thereby penalizing students who show the greatest independent thinking. Analysis also revealed an additional group, roughly 13%, who declined to use AI for ethical rather than practical reasons, and who existing frameworks overlook. These findings carry implications for AI literacy programs, the measurement of student learning outcomes, and equitable AI policy at minority-serving institutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究基于AI素养框架、期望-价值理论和Biggs模型，在少数族裔服务型R1大学通过382名本科生、14次访谈和396份开放问卷，识别并验证了四种不同的LLM依赖类型：策略型(34.3%)、工具型(30.9%)、对话型(30.4%)和依赖型(4.5%)。研究发现学生的价值与成本信念预测依赖强度，而AI素养预测依赖类型，且策略型用户在标准结果测量中得分最低，反映了当前工具仅衡量AI贡献而非写作质量的缺陷。另外约13%的学生因伦理原因拒绝使用AI。
Motivation: 现有研究仅通过使用频率衡量学生对LLM的依赖，但这种方式会无意中奖赏对AI的依赖而非认可学生的独立思考，且缺乏区分不同依赖类型的有效方法。
Method: 采用混合方法：对382名本科生进行问卷调查，14次深度访谈，收集396份开放式回答。基于AI素养框架、期望-价值理论和Biggs的预兆-过程-产品模型进行分析，通过聚类和定性分析识别依赖类型。
Result: 识别出四种依赖类型（策略型、工具型、对话型、依赖型），且学生价值与成本信念预测依赖强度，AI素养预测依赖类型。策略型用户（最刻意使用AI）在标准结果测量中得分最低，表明现有工具惩罚独立思考。还有约13%的学生因伦理原因拒绝使用AI。
Conclusion: 研究暗示需要对不同依赖类型的学生提供差异化支持，AI素养项目应关注使用质量而非频率，且现有评估工具需改进以反映写作质量而非AI贡献，尤其对少数族裔服务机构具有政策意义。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 研究暗示需要对不同依赖类型的学生提供差异化支持，AI素养项目应关注使用质量而非频率，且现有评估工具需改进以反映写作质量而非AI贡献，尤其对少数族裔服务机构具有政策意义。

papers.title: Search for Truth from Reasoning: A Dynamic Representation Editing Framework for Steering LLM Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Current approaches to enhance Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, such as Chain-of-Thought and "Wait" prompts, primarily encourage models to think more, yet often fail to guide them toward Truth. While Representation Editing (RepE) offers a intrinsic control, its application to dynamic reasoning trajectories remains underexplored. In this work, we bridge this gap by investigating the geometry of truth within unfolding reasoning chains. We uncover three critical insights: (1) Truth is encoded at the sentence level and is entangled with latent reasoning patterns; (2) Effective intervention follows an Uncertainty Principle and a Decay Effect, requiring localization to early, high-entropy forks; (3) Naive steering vectors suffer from noise, risking collateral damage to correct trajectories. Based on these findings, we propose DynaSteer, a dynamic RepE framework. DynaSteer employs pattern clustering to disentangle reasoning manifolds and utilizes Fisher-LDA to project purified truth. By dynamically monitoring lookahead entropy, it selectively steers and rolls back trajectories only when necessary. Comprehensive experimental results on several MATH benchmark verify the effectiveness of DynaSteer, and experiments on out-of-domain coding tasks further confirm its generalization ability. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/tianlwang/DynaSteer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynaSteer，一种动态表示编辑框架，用于引导大语言模型 (LLM) 的推理轨迹走向真理。基于三个关键发现：真理在句子级别编码且与潜在推理模式纠缠、有效干预需集中在早期高熵分支、朴素转向向量存在噪声。DynaSteer 通过模式聚类解耦推理流形，利用 Fisher-LDA 投影纯净真理，并动态监控前瞻熵进行选择性干预和回滚。在 MATH 基准和编码任务上验证了有效性和泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有增强 LLM 推理的方法（如 CoT 和 Wait 提示）主要鼓励模型多思考，但未能有效引导其走向真理，而表示编辑 (RepE) 虽有内在控制能力，但在动态推理轨迹中的应用尚未充分探索。
Method: DynaSteer 框架：首先通过模式聚类解耦推理流形，然后使用 Fisher-LDA 从噪声中投影纯净真理向量，最后动态监控前瞻熵（lookahead entropy）以决定在何时何处进行干预和回滚，将干预集中在早期高熵分支点。
Result: 在多个 MATH 基准上验证了 DynaSteer 的有效性，并在域外编码任务上进一步确认了其泛化能力。
Conclusion: DynaSteer 通过动态、自适应的表示编辑，有效引导 LLM 推理轨迹趋向真理，且具有良好的泛化性；代码已开源。

papers.title: KernelSight-LM: A Kernel-Level LLM Inference Simulator
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) move into production serving, practitioners must rapidly evaluate inference performance across diverse hardware, models, and serving parameters to meet cost and latency targets. However, the end-to-end behavior of LLMs couples serving-layer policies with low-level GPU kernel execution and rapidly evolving architectures, forcing slow, deployment-specific benchmarking that is hard to generalize. We present KernelSight-LM, a fine-grained inference simulator that models token-level execution and produces kernel-level latency breakdowns. It decomposes each serving step into a roofline kernel model with a learned efficiency term, a communication model, and a host-overhead model, composed through a discrete-event scheduler that also captures mechanisms like prefix caching and continuous batching. KernelSight-LM offers two prediction tiers that trade target-GPU data for accuracy. The cross-generation tier uses no target-GPU measurements, only hardware specifications and kernel microbenchmarks from previously profiled GPUs, and predicts per-kernel latency on an unseen GPU generation to 12.1% error, a 1.8x improvement over the roofline baseline (22.0%). A second target-measured tier adds one model-agnostic kernel-microbenchmark sweep on the target GPU, sharpening per-kernel error to 3.8%, a 7.3x improvement over a comparable baseline (27.7%). Both tiers require far less target-GPU data than the prior systems they extend. In our simulator, these predictions yield end-to-end median (p50) errors across six model families of 15.4%, 12.8%, and 3.0% (TTFT, TPOT, throughput) in the cross-generation tier and 14.3%, 6.2%, and 2.7% in the target-measured tier, matching dedicated profiling tools while collecting far less on-device data. Beyond prediction, its kernel-level bottleneck breakdowns support hardware/software co-design and capacity planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KernelSight-LM是一个细粒度的大语言模型推理模拟器，将每个服务步骤分解为roofline kernel模型（带学习效率项）、通信模型和主机开销模型，通过离散事件调度器组合，支持前缀缓存和连续批处理等机制。它提供两个预测层级：跨代层级（无需目标GPU数据，仅靠硬件规格和先前GPU的微基准测试）预测未见GPU的每kernel延迟误差12.1%，比roofline基线提升1.8倍；目标测量层级（增加目标GPU上的一次模型无关微基准扫描）将误差降至3.8%，比基线提升7.3倍。在端到端模拟中，跨代层级在六个模型族上的TTFT、TPOT和吞吐量中位数误差分别为15.4%、12.8%和3.0%，目标测量层级分别为14.3%、6.2%和2.7%，匹配专用分析工具且收集更少数据。
Motivation: LLM生产部署中，不同硬件、模型和服务参数下的推理性能评估依赖慢速、特定部署的基准测试，难以泛化；现有方法耦合服务层策略与底层GPU内核执行，缺乏细粒度可移植的预测能力。
Method: 提出KernelSight-LM，将推理步骤分解为基于roofline的内核模型（含学习的效率项）、通信模型和主机开销模型，通过离散事件调度器集成，并支持前缀缓存和连续批处理。提供两层级预测：跨代层级仅用硬件规格和先前GPU微基准数据，目标测量层级增加一个模型无关的GPU微基准扫描。
Result: 跨代层级预测未见GPU上的每kernel延迟误差12.1%（比roofline基线22.0%提升1.8倍）；目标测量层级误差3.8%（比基线27.7%提升7.3倍）。端到端模拟中，跨代层级TTFT、TPOT、吞吐量中位数误差分别为15.4%、12.8%、3.0%；目标测量层级为14.3%、6.2%、2.7%。
Conclusion: KernelSight-LM能以极少的设备数据实现与专用分析工具相当的预测精度，其内核级瓶颈分解支持软硬件协同设计和容量规划，为LLM推理性能评估提供了高效且可转移的模拟方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TempAct: Advancing Temporal Plausibility in Autoregressive Video Generation via Planner-Executor RL
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable low-latency streaming generation by synthesizing videos chunk by chunk with cached visual context, but this chunk-wise formulation makes temporal instruction following ambiguous. A single global prompt does not specify which sub-event should be realized in each chunk, while naively switching to step-wise prompts often leads to delayed reactions, blended step semantics, and error propagation across prompt transitions. These failures are difficult to address with supervised fine-tuning or distillation alone: SFT suffers from exposure bias, while rollout-based distillation still optimizes low-level denoising or teacher-distribution matching rather than directly enforcing action ordering and prompt-transition correctness. We address these challenges with TempAct, a planner--executor reinforcement learning framework that jointly optimizes temporal decomposition and step-conditioned execution for temporally plausible AR video generation. TempAct uses an LLM planner to explore span-aware step prompts that are executable by the video model, and trains an AR diffusion executor to follow these prompts under its own generated histories. Its key mechanism is hierarchical group exploration: candidate plans form planning groups, and each plan induces an execution group of multiple continuations from a shared visual context, enabling plan-level credit assignment for long-horizon temporal outcomes and executor-level credit assignment for prompt-switch behavior. We further design hierarchical rewards that combine plan-quality and full-video temporal feedback for the planner with local transition-level step-following rewards, aesthetic regularization, and KL constraints for the executor. Experiments on Self-Forcing and LongLive show that TempAct improves temporal consistency while preserving overall visual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TempAct 提出规划器-执行器强化学习框架，用于提升自回归视频扩散模型的时间合理性。LLM 规划器生成可执行的步骤提示，AR 扩散执行器在自生成历史条件下跟随提示，通过层次化组探索和奖励设计改善时间一致性和提示转换正确性。在 Self-Forcing 和 LongLive 上实验证明该方法改进了时间一致性，同时保持视觉质量。
Motivation: 自回归视频生成逐块合成视频，但单一全局提示无法明确每个块应实现的子事件，逐步提示又导致延迟反应、语义混合和错误传播。监督微调或蒸馏难以解决这些时间指令遵循问题。
Method: 提出 TempAct 框架，包含 LLM 规划器（探索跨度感知的步骤提示）和 AR 扩散执行器（在自生成历史下跟随提示）。核心机制为层次化组探索：候选计划形成规划组，每个计划从共享视觉上下文生成多个执行分支，实现规划级和执行级的信用分配。奖励函数组合了规划质量、视频时间反馈（规划器）以及局部过渡步骤跟随奖励、美学正则化与 KL 约束（执行器）。
Result: 在 Self-Forcing 和 LongLive 数据集上，TempAct 提升了时间一致性，同时保持了整体视觉质量。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过规划器-执行器 RL 联合优化时间分解和步骤条件执行，可有效解决自回归视频生成中的时间指令遵循问题。

papers.title: DiffRGD: An Inference-Time Diffusion Guidance Through Riemannian Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: Recently, diffusion models have been widely adopted in generative modeling and have served as foundational models for many image generation tasks. To control the generation without costly re-training or fine-tuning, many works seek inference-time guidance methods to steer the latent via a differentiable objective at inference time. However, these methods cannot effectively preserve the original Gaussian distribution because they introduce distributional drift, thereby degrading the sample quality. To address this gap, we propose DiffRGD, a distribution-aware guidance framework that explicitly preserves the latent Gaussian structure. DiffRGD formulates each sampling step as a constrained optimization problem on a spherical manifold induced by the latent Gaussian distribution, and solves it efficiently via Riemannian Gradient Descent (RGD). DiffRGD is a plug-and-play method that can be seamlessly integrated into any pre-trained diffusion model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiffRGD outperforms previous methods in most image restoration and conditional generation tasks. Our project page is available at https://diffrgd.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiffRGD，一种推理时扩散引导框架，通过黎曼梯度下降（Riemannian Gradient Descent）在球形流形上求解约束优化，以保持潜在高斯分布，避免分布漂移导致的样本质量下降。该方法可即插即用于预训练扩散模型，并在图像恢复和条件生成任务上优于以往方法。
Motivation: 现有推理时引导方法会引入分布漂移，破坏潜在高斯分布，降低样本质量。
Method: 将每个采样步骤形式化为潜在高斯分布诱导的球形流形上的约束优化问题，并使用黎曼梯度下降高效求解。
Result: 在大多数图像恢复和条件生成任务上优于先前方法，且无需重新训练或微调。
Conclusion: DiffRGD 是一种分布感知的即插即用引导框架，能有效保持潜在高斯结构，提升生成质量。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: MemoBench: Benchmarking World Modeling in Dynamically Changing Environments
papers.abstract_en: Video generation models aspire to simulate dynamic environments, and several benchmarks now evaluate memory consistency across frames. However, most assess consistency only while the target remains in view, and the few that force objects out of view evaluate static scenes where nothing changes during occlusion. To bridge this gap, we introduce MemoBench, a diagnostic benchmark built around the disappear-and-reappear paradigm in dynamically changing environments: a target object undergoes a physical process, disappears from view, and must be correctly recovered in its updated state upon reappearance. We curate 360 ground-truth clips spanning synthetic and real-world scenes, and design an evaluation suite combining automated metrics with VQA-based assessment across four diagnostic pillars. Evaluation of eight state-of-the-art models reveals key insights and open challenges regarding memory consistency under the disappear-and-reappear paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemoBench是一个诊断基准，专注于在动态变化环境中评估视频生成模型对物体消失后再出现的记忆一致性。它包含360个真实和合成场景的剪辑，通过自动化指标和VQA评估四个诊断支柱。对八个模型的评估揭示了物体消失后再出现范式下的记忆一致性关键挑战。
Motivation: 现有视频生成基准主要评估目标在视野内的记忆一致性，少数评估遮挡场景的基准仅处理静态场景（遮挡期间无变化）。论文旨在填补动态变化环境中物体消失后再出现的记忆一致性评估空白。
Method: 构建MemoBench基准，包含360个视频剪辑（合成和真实场景），采用消失-再出现范式：目标物体经历物理过程后离开视野，在重新出现时必须被正确恢复为更新后的状态。评估套件结合自动化指标和基于VQA的四个诊断支柱。
Result: 评估了八个最先进模型，揭示了在消失-再出现范式下记忆一致性的关键见解和开放挑战。
Conclusion: MemoBench为视频生成模型的动态环境记忆一致性提供了新的评估标准，并指出了当前模型在物体遮挡后状态恢复方面的不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graph it first! Enabling Reasoning on Long-form Egocentric Videos through Scene Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Existing multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) face significant challenges in processing long video sequences due to strict input token limitations. As a result, current video understanding approaches, especially in egocentric settings characterized by complex dynamics, frequent state changes, and moving cameras, are forced to massively subsample frames. This leads to severe loss of temporal and contextual information, constraining their ability to perform fine-grained video reasoning. In this work, we introduce a framework for egocentric video question answering (VQA) that overcomes these input constraints through Egocentric Scene Graphs (EgoSGs), i.e., temporally grounded, structured representations that capture objects, attributes, spatial relations, and interactions over time. By representing videos as compact, text-based scene graphs, our method preserves the essential visual and temporal information of the original video in a symbolic form that drastically reduces input length while maintaining semantic richness. Crucially, this enables MLLMs to reason efficiently over entire video sequences within their token budget. On HD-EPIC VQA, our method achieves state-of-the-art results, outperforming strong video-based baselines on multiple models and suggesting that structured, temporally grounded representations like EgoSGs can bridge long-form egocentric video understanding and the context limitations of today's MLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于第一人称场景图（EgoSGs）的方法，将长视频压缩为结构化文本表示，使多模态大模型在 token 预算内进行视频问答，在 HD-EPIC VQA 上取得 SOTA。

papers.title: Shift Variant Image Degradation and Restoration Using Singular Value Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Shift-variant image degradation is frequently encountered in practical imaging systems where the point spread function (PSF) varies across the image field due to motion, optical aberrations, atmospheric turbulence, or sensor-related effects. Unlike shift-invariant, shift-variant degradation presents significant challenges for image restoration because the degradation process cannot be represented by a single convolution kernel. This paper proposes a singular value decomposition (SVD)-based framework for restoring images degraded by shift-variant motion blur. The proposed approach determines the contribution of small singular values using a singular-value energy retention criterion. Specifically, the number of small singular values is selected based on a specified percentage of cumulative singular-value energy, providing a systematic approach for controlling noise amplification while preserving useful image information. The degradation model is formulated using a position-dependent PSF represented by a shift-variant imaging operator. Three representative one dimensional shift-variant motion PSFs are considered: bidirectional linear motion, Gaussian motion, and simple harmonic motion. The image degradation process is modeled as a linear system, and SVD is employed to analyze and invert the corresponding degradation operator. The singular-value representation provides insight into the ill-conditioned nature of the restoration problem and enables the development of stable inversion techniques. The proposed SVD-based restoration algorithm is applied to three degraded images. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in recovering image details and reducing blur artifacts under different motion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于奇异值分解（SVD）的框架，用于恢复由移位变化运动模糊降质的图像。通过奇异值能量保留准则控制小奇异值的贡献，在抑制噪声放大的同时保留图像信息。实验在三种一维移位变化运动PSF（双向线性运动、高斯运动、简谐运动）上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 实际成像系统中点扩散函数（PSF）随位置变化导致移位变化降质，传统单一卷积核无法建模，给图像恢复带来挑战。
Method: 提出SVD框架，将降质模型表示为移位变化成像算子，利用SVD分析并求逆；通过设定累积奇异值能量百分比来选择保留的奇异值数量，实现稳定逆。
Result: 在三种运动模糊模型下，实验表明所提方法能有效恢复图像细节、减少模糊伪影。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确给出局限性，但强调该方法提供了控制噪声放大和保留图像信息的系统方法，揭示了问题的病态性。

papers.title: When Do Conservation Laws Survive Learned Representations? Certified Horizons for Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: We ask a representation-learning question about physical world models: when does a conservation law remain certifiable after a model learns a latent representation? A certified horizon bounds -- in advance, from measurable model defects -- how many steps a rollout provably stays on a physical invariant's level set. The key design choice is what is certified: not a learned latent Hamiltonian or a learned scalar witness (a model can conserve either while drifting in true energy), but the decoded physical invariant obtained by decoding the latent state and evaluating the known invariant. Around this object we derive shell-horizon certificates whose budget decomposes into representation, readout, and latent-dynamics defects, with a monotone alignment bridge through which a soft learned witness yields a certified horizon for the decoded invariant, and test them across state, learned-lift, and pixel observations on conservative systems. Conservation certificates can survive learned representation, but not all geometric priors survive equally. Hard canonical symplectic structure yields the longest horizons in known phase coordinates yet does not cross a learned chart, whereas a controlled-Lipschitz-aligned soft invariant survives in the nonlinear learned-representation settings we test -- two lift systems, with the gain growing with nonlinearity, and pixels. Pixel certification is recovered on a readout-stable sub-tube, and the Kepler problem exposes a geometric boundary. The central object is therefore not a latent Hamiltonian, but a decoded physical invariant whose robustness to representation learning can be measured, certified, and falsified.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究物理世界模型中学习到的潜在表示对守恒律可证明性的影响，提出一种基于解码后物理不变量的认证时域方法。该方法将预算分解为表示、读出和潜在动力学缺陷，并利用单调对齐桥将软学习证据转化为认证时域。实验在状态、学习提升和像素观察三种设置下进行，发现硬规范辛结构在已知相坐标下时域最长但无法跨图表，而受控Lipschitz对齐的软不变量在非线性设置中表现更好。
Motivation: 现有潜在世界模型可能在表示学习中丢失守恒律，需要一种可认证的方法保证模型在特定步数内保持物理不变性，从而提升模型在物理模拟中的可靠性和可解释性。
Method: 提出认证时域概念，将预算分解为表示缺陷、读出缺陷和潜在动力学缺陷；通过单调对齐桥，将软学习证据转化为对解码后物理不变量的认证时域，并在状态、学习提升和像素观测下进行测试。
Result: 实验表明，硬规范辛结构在已知相坐标下获得最长认证时域但无法跨越学习图表；受控Lipschitz对齐的软不变量在非线性学习表示设置中表现更好，且增益随非线性度增长；像素认证在读出稳定的子管中恢复，开普勒问题暴露了几何边界。
Conclusion: 核心对象并非潜在哈密顿量，而是解码后的物理不变量；其对表示学习的鲁棒性可测量、可认证且可证伪，不同几何先验的生存能力差异显著。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PatternGSL: A Structured Specification Language for Template-Free and Simulation-Ready 3D Garments
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing realistic, physically plausible garments from a single image remains a fundamental challenge. Template-free methods capture surface geometry but lack explicit sewing structure for simulation; while programmatic systems are simulation-ready but constrained by predefined templates. This reveals a fundamental representation gap between geometric reconstruction and structured garment construction. We present PatternGSL, a structured garment representation in the form of a template-free and learnable specification language that encodes complete sewing patterns, including panel boundaries, parameterized seams, and explicit stitch topology, in a compact and standardized form. PatternGSL preserves the physical rigor of pattern-based models while removing template dependence, elevating sewing structure as a first-class target for generative modeling. We further propose a vision-language framework that predicts PatternGSL specifications directly from a single image and decodes them into garments using lightweight deterministic validity handling, without optimization-based refinement or manual cleanup. In addition, we introduce PatternGSLData, the first large-scale image-to-GSL paired dataset comprising 300K samples with complete sewing pattern annotations, enabling supervised VLM training for structured garment reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate improved pattern accuracy over prior baselines, explicit sewing-structure recovery, reliable cloth simulation, and pattern-level editing through the same deterministic decoding pipeline. Code and data-processing scripts will be released at https://lagrangeli.github.io/PatternGSL/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种名为 PatternGSL 的无模板、可学习的结构化服装表示语言，将完整缝制图案（包括面板边界、参数化接缝和显式针脚拓扑）编码为紧凑标准化形式。结合视觉语言框架，从单张图像直接预测 PatternGSL 规格，并通过轻量确定性处理解码成可仿真服装。同时发布包含 30 万样本的大规模图像-GSL 配对数据集 PatternGSLData，实验证明在图案准确性、缝制结构恢复、布料仿真可靠性及图案级编辑方面优于先前基准。
Motivation: 现有单张图像重建服装方法中，无模板方法捕捉表面几何但缺乏缝制结构，无法仿真；程序化系统基于预定义模板，仿真就绪但受模板限制。存在几何重建与结构化服装构造之间的表示鸿沟。
Method: 提出 PatternGSL——一种无模板、可学习的结构化服装规格语言，编码缝制图案（面板、接缝、针脚拓扑）。基于此设计视觉语言框架，通过轻量确定性有效性处理从单张图直接预测并解码为可仿真服装，无需优化或手动清理。
Result: 在图案准确性、缝制结构恢复、布料仿真可靠性和图案级编辑方面优于先前基准，通过同一确定性解码管线实现。
Conclusion: PatternGSL 将缝制结构提升为生成建模的一等目标，同时保持物理严谨性和模板独立性，为单图服装重建提供了新的表示和框架。
