papers.title: SPAR: Semantic-Pixel Self-Alignment and Adaptive Routing for Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in visual understanding but remain constrained in visual generation due to the fundamental feature discrepancy between semantic perception and pixel-level reconstruction. Bridging this gap requires overcoming two core challenges: endowing semantic encoders with high-fidelity reconstruction capabilities, and effectively aligning generative models with semantic spaces without relying on external teachers. To this end, we propose a novel unified multimodal framework featuring \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{P}ixel self-alignment and \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{R}outing (\textbf{SPAR}). First, to reconcile semantic perception with pixel-level reconstruction, we introduce an asymmetric dual-stream unified tokenizer. A lightweight semantic stream anchors discriminative features, while a Transformer-augmented pixel stream recovers fine-grained visual details into a unified compact latent space. Second, to eliminate external dependencies, we propose a self-aligned generation paradigm that natively leverages this optimized tokenizer as an internal alignment teacher for the diffusion model. Furthermore, to facilitate flexible multimodal interaction within this unified space, we introduce Dynamic Token Routing, which enables each token to adaptively aggregate multi-layer MLLM features based on its distinct semantic demands. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPAR establishes the state-of-the-art for unified architectures, achieving exceptional generation and reconstruction quality while preserving foundational visual understanding capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SPAR框架，通过语义-像素自对齐和自适应路由，统一多模态大语言模型的视觉理解与生成能力。核心包括非对称双流统一分词器（语义流+Transformer增强像素流）和自对齐生成范式，无需外部教师模型。动态令牌路由允许每个令牌根据语义需求自适应聚合多层MLLM特征。在统一架构上达到最先进水平，保持理解能力的同时提升生成与重建质量。
Motivation: 现有MLLM在视觉理解上成功，但视觉生成受限于语义感知与像素级重建之间的特征差异。需要解决两个挑战：赋予语义编码器高保真重建能力，以及在没有外部教师的情况下对齐生成模型与语义空间。
Method: 提出SPAR框架，包含：1) 非对称双流统一分词器（轻量语义流+Transformer增强像素流）将细粒度视觉细节压缩到统一潜在空间；2) 自对齐生成范式，利用优化后的分词器作为扩散模型的内部对齐教师；3) 动态令牌路由，让每个令牌根据语义需求自适应聚合多层MLLM特征。
Result: 实验表明SPAR在统一架构上达到最先进水平，在生成和重建质量上表现优异，同时保留了基础视觉理解能力。
Conclusion: SPAR通过自对齐和自适应路由有效弥合了语义感知与像素重建之间的差距，为统一多模态模型提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GroundEval: A Deterministic Replacement for LLM-as-Judge in Stateful Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Before letting an agent operate over real context, can you prove it used the right evidence? GroundEval turns that question into a deterministic test of what the agent searched, fetched, cited, and was permitted to access. In one case study, two frontier LLM judges scored a plausible agent response 0.85 and higher. But the trace told a different story: the agent had never retrieved the artifact its answer depended on, yielding a GroundEval score of 0.000. We introduce GroundEval, a judge-free framework for evaluating agents against grounded, time-bounded, and access-controlled evidence. GroundEval uses a domain configuration to generate questions, lets the agent choose how to answer, and then scores both the final answer and the recorded trajectory that produced it. The benchmark targets three failures that LLM-as-judge evaluation struggles to detect: whether an agent checked before claiming absence, reasoned only from evidence available to the actor at the relevant time, and used the correct causal mechanism rather than a plausible one. These correspond to three tracks: Silence, Perspective, and Counterfactual. GroundEval exposes when plausible answers rest on invalid evidence paths, and produces structured per-question diagnostics that pair tool activity with the agent's turn-level narration, making each score inspectable rather than merely reported. Our case studies suggest this failure mode is common rather than exceptional, one that final-answer and judge-based evaluation cannot detect by construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GroundEval，一个无需人工判断（LLM-as-Judge）的确定性框架，用于评估有状态智能体在搜索、获取、引用和访问控制方面的行为。通过域配置生成问题，记录智能体的轨迹和最终答案，并基于证据路径进行评分。案例研究表明，智能体可能给出看似合理的答案但实际上从未检索到相关证据，而传统判断方法无法检测这种失败。
Motivation: 现有的 LLM-as-Judge 评估方法无法可靠检测智能体是否使用了正确的证据，例如智能体可能回答正确但基于错误的或有偏的证据路径，而最终答案评分无法暴露这一问题。
Method: GroundEval 使用域配置生成测试问题，智能体自由选择回答方式，然后系统同时对最终答案和记录的执行轨迹进行评分。轨迹包括搜索、获取、引用和访问控制等信息。针对三种常见失败模式设计了对应测试：沉默（Silence）、视角（Perspective）和反事实（Counterfactual），并提供每个问题的结构化诊断。
Result: 案例研究中，两个前沿 LLM 判断者对看似合理的智能体回答给出 0.85 以上的分数，但 GroundEval 检测到智能体从未检索到其答案所依赖的原始数据，得分为 0.000。这表明此类失败并不罕见，而基于最终答案或判断者的评估无法发现。
Conclusion: GroundEval 提供了一个可检查、可解释的评估方式，特别适合需要严格证据链和安全性的智能体应用。作者认为其方法能够补充或替代 LLM-as-Judge 评估，尤其在检测无效证据路径方面具有优势。

papers.title: Precision Recall Controllable Radiology Report Generation via Hybrid Natural Language and Clinical Reward Learning
papers.abstract_en: Automated radiology report generation (RRG) has gained increasing attention because it can reduce the heavy workload of clinical report writing. However, most existing methods mainly optimize for natural language generation (NLG) metrics that focus on language fluency, while providing little control over clinically important factors such as precision and recall. As consequence, generated reports may be fluent but not well aligned with different clinical needs. To address this challenge, we propose a reinforcement learning framework for precision recall controllable RRG, where a control parameter explicitly adjusts the trade-off between clinical precision and recall during inference. This design allows the model to flexibly generate reports according to different clinical requirements. To ensure clinical correctness, we introduce a clinical reward into the training objective, which helps improve clinical efficacy (CE) beyond standard language-based optimization. In addition, we apply a group-relative training strategy that normalizes rewards within each training group, reducing reward variance and improving training stability. Extensive experiments on the MIMIC-CXR dataset show that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both NLG and CE evaluation metrics, while providing reliable control over the CE precision recall trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于强化学习的放射学报告生成框架，通过引入临床奖励和控制参数，允许在推理时显式调整临床精确度与召回率的权衡。在MIMIC-CXR数据集上，该方法在自然语言生成和临床效能指标上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有放射学报告生成方法主要优化语言流畅性，缺乏对临床精确度和召回率的控制，生成的报告可能流畅但不符合不同临床需求。
Method: 提出强化学习框架，包含一个控制参数以在推理时调整临床精确度与召回率的权衡，并引入临床奖励改进训练目标，同时使用组相对训练策略归一化奖励以提高稳定性。
Result: 在MIMIC-CXR数据集上，该方法在自然语言生成和临床效能指标上一致优于现有方法，并能可靠控制临床精确度与召回率的权衡。
Conclusion: 该方法通过临床奖励和控制参数实现了临床需求驱动的放射学报告生成，平衡了语言流畅性和临床准确性。

papers.title: Orthogonal Discrepancy Kernels for Learning with Partial Physics
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a semi-parametric framework for nonlinear system identification, which decouples discrepancy functions from physics-based components. Orthogonal Gaussian process regression balances sparse parameter selection (the white box) with discrepancy learning (the black box) to produce interpretable models from incomplete physics.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种半参数框架用于非线性系统辨识，通过正交高斯过程回归将差异函数与基于物理的组件解耦，平衡稀疏参数选择（白盒）与差异学习（黑盒），从而从不完整的物理模型中生成可解释模型。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理不完整物理模型时难以平衡可解释性与拟合精度，缺乏有效解耦物理组件与差异项的手段。
Method: 引入正交高斯过程回归，利用正交性约束使差异学习与物理参数选择互不干扰，实现稀疏参数选择与黑盒差异学习的平衡。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称该方法能从不完整物理模型中生成可解释模型。
Conclusion: 该框架适用于系统辨识领域，特别是当物理模型不完整时需要同时保持可解释性和拟合能力的情形。

papers.title: Power Systems Agent Benchmark: Executable Evaluation of AI Agents in Electric Power Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Executable evaluation -- checking the consequences of an agent's actions with a program rather than grading its prose -- has become a prominent way to assess tool-using AI agents in software settings. Electric power engineering has not yet had an analogous benchmark: language-model use is still dominated by retrieval and text question answering, while agents acting on power-system artifacts remain mostly academic prototypes. We introduce the Power Systems Agent Benchmark, an executable benchmark for power-engineering agents. An agent receives a structured task and returns a structured solution; a deterministic evaluator recomputes the engineering quantities, checks operational constraints, and returns a feasibility flag, a normalized score, and explicit violations. The benchmark contains 41 task families across eight areas of power engineering, from power flow and protection to stability, microgrids, reliability, power quality, and forecasting. Each task is grounded in a citable source, standard, or documented engineering formulation. To resist contamination, held-out cases are synthesized on demand by per-family generators from private seeds: the construction is inspectable, but the instances remain private. In a reference evaluation with three command-line agents, the strongest score near the compact tier's ceiling, a smaller open model trails, and public and held-out performance are broadly consistent; a separate public-split grid with OpenCode and Aider probes harness effects. The reference evaluation doubles as quality control: unanimous failures flag candidate task or evaluator defects, and it exposed a latent evaluator bug missed by self-consistency checks. The evaluators are compact deterministic surrogates, but the task contract allows their internals to be upgraded to simulator-backed checks without changing how tasks are posed or solved.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出电力系统智能体基准（Power Systems Agent Benchmark），这是一个可执行的基准测试，用于评估电力工程领域中使用工具的AI智能体。基准包含41个任务族，覆盖潮流、保护、稳定性、微电网、可靠性、电能质量和预测等八个领域，每个任务都有确定性评估器返回可行性标志、归一化分数和违规明细。参考评估显示，最强命令行智能体接近小型任务集的上限，而小型开放模型表现较差，公开与留出任务性能基本一致。
Motivation: 电力工程领域缺乏类似软件工程中可执行评估的智能体基准，现有语言模型应用以检索和文本问答为主，作用于电力系统工件的智能体仍停留在学术原型阶段。
Method: 构建包含41个任务族、八个电力工程领域的可执行基准，每个任务植根于可引用来源、标准或工程公式。通过基于私有种子的按族生成器合成留出案例以防止污染。评估器是确定性替代程序，可升级为仿真器支持。
Result: 在三个命令行智能体参考评估中，最强模型接近小型任务集上限，小型开放模型表现落后；公开与留出任务性能大致一致。评估还发现了一个潜在评估器错误，该错误未被自一致性检查发现。
Conclusion: 该基准为电力工程智能体提供了可执行的标准化评估方法，其评估器可升级，任务格式统一，有助于推动该领域智能体研究。

papers.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Reservoir Computing
papers.abstract_en: Reservoir computing offers a lightweight framework for forecasting dynamical systems but may struggle to capture long-range dependencies due to limited representational capacity. Conventional reservoir computing recurrently uses fixed reservoirs with hyperparameter sensitivity, while the next generation reservoir computing removes recurrence at the cost of rapidly growing feature dimensions. Here, we develop Kolmogorov-Arnold Reservoir Computing (KARC), which replaces reservoirs with explicit basis-function expansions inspired by the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem. We rigorously show that KARC is a lightweight design of Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs), preserving the potential expressive capacity of KANs while admitting efficient closed-form training of reservoir computing. At comparable cost, KARC outperforms existing reservoir computing methods on challenging benchmarks including partial differential equations. It can also be integrated with generative diffusion models for facilitating text-to-image generation. This work thus establishes a principled bridge between reservoir computing and KANs, yielding a unified framework for efficient dynamical forecasting and generative modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Kolmogorov-Arnold Reservoir Computing (KARC)，用基于Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理的显式基函数展开替换传统水库，保留了KAN的表达能力并允许高效闭式训练。在偏微分方程等基准上超越现有水库计算方法，并能集成扩散模型进行文本到图像生成。
Motivation: 传统水库计算难以捕捉长程依赖，且对超参数敏感；下一代水库计算去掉了循环但导致特征维度快速增长。需要一种轻量级且表达能力更强的框架。
Method: 受Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理启发，用显式基函数展开替换水库，设计为KAN的轻量版本，同时保留水库计算的高效闭式训练。
Result: 在偏微分方程等挑战性基准上，以相当成本优于现有水库计算方法；还可与生成扩散模型集成以促进文本到图像生成。
Conclusion: 本文在水库计算和KAN之间建立了原理性桥梁，提供了一个统一的框架用于高效动力系统预测和生成建模。

papers.title: Motion-Focused Latent Action Enables Cross-Embodiment VLA Training from Human EgoVideos
papers.abstract_en: Training generalist Vision-Language-Action(VLA) models typically requires massive, diverse robotic datasets with high-fidelity action annotations. While egocentric human manipulation videos are abundant and capture significant environmental diversity, the absence of action labels makes them difficult to use in conventional training paradigms. To address this, we propose a latent-action-based framework designed to extract general action priors from unlabeled human videos. The architecture features a Hybrid Disentangled VQ-VAE that decouples motion dynamics from environmental backgrounds through physical masks, enabling the construction of a cross-embodiment action codebook. By pre-training on human videos with the codebook, the VLM backbone learns deep representations of action intent. For adaptation to specific embodiments, we introduce an intent-perception decoupling strategy where the VLM predicts the action intent while a separate frozen visual encoder provides state-specific features to the action expert, thereby reducing action hallucinations. Results in simulation and real-world environments show that our method, pre-trained exclusively on unlabeled human videos, performs competitively with state-of-the-art VLA models trained on massive annotated datasets, requiring only 50 trajectories for downstream adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于潜在动作的框架，从无标注的人类第一人称视频中提取通用动作先验，用于训练跨实体视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。通过混合解耦VQ-VAE分离运动动态与背景，构建跨实体动作码本，并在仿真和真实环境中验证仅需50条轨迹的下游适配即可与基于大规模标注数据集训练的SOTA模型竞争。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖大规模带标注机器人数据集，而人类第一人称操作视频丰富但缺乏动作标签，难以直接用于训练。本文旨在利用无标注人类视频中的动作先验，减少对昂贵标注数据的依赖。
Method: 提出Hybrid Disentangled VQ-VAE架构，通过物理掩码解耦运动动态与环境背景，构建跨实体动作码本；采用意图-感知解耦策略，VLM预测动作意图，冻结的视觉编码器提供状态特征给动作专家，减少动作幻觉。
Result: 在仿真和真实场景中，仅使用无标注人类视频预训练，下游适配仅需50条轨迹，即可与现有使用大规模标注数据集训练的SOTA VLA模型性能相当。
Conclusion: 该方法证明了从无标注人类视频学习通用动作先验的可行性，为降低VLA模型对标注数据的依赖提供了新路径。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖大规模带标注机器人数据集，而人类第一人称操作视频丰富但缺乏动作标签，难以直接用于训练。本文旨在利用无标注人类视频中的动作先验，减少对昂贵标注数据的依赖。
summary_sections.method: 提出Hybrid Disentangled VQ-VAE架构，通过物理掩码解耦运动动态与环境背景，构建跨实体动作码本；采用意图-感知解耦策略，VLM预测动作意图，冻结的视觉编码器提供状态特征给动作专家，减少动作幻觉。
summary_sections.result: 在仿真和真实场景中，仅使用无标注人类视频预训练，下游适配仅需50条轨迹，即可与现有使用大规模标注数据集训练的SOTA VLA模型性能相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法证明了从无标注人类视频学习通用动作先验的可行性，为降低VLA模型对标注数据的依赖提供了新路径。

papers.title: Horizon-Uniform Sensitivity Certificates for Finite-Horizon Pontryagin Systems
papers.abstract_en: Finite-horizon optimal-control computations repeatedly solve two-point Pontryagin boundary value problems whose conditioning can deteriorate as the horizon grows. We give a verifiable data-level certificate under which it does not. Hyperbolicity of the reduced state--costate transition matrix, together with scaled stable--unstable boundary transversality, yields an endpoint-corrected Green inverse with horizon-independent constants and weighted contractions transfer this inverse to the nonlinear problem, so the original Pontryagin endpoint rows $x_0=x_{\rm in}$ and $p_T=r_x(x_T,y)$ carry a unique local stationary branch whose first-order expansion and Lipschitz constants are uniform in the horizon. Consequently the finite-horizon feedback map is horizon-uniformly Lipschitz, first-order expandable, and satisfies an exact shrinking-horizon consistency identity. Symplectic and Riccati criteria certify the hypotheses from matrix data: every stabilizable definite linear-quadratic system with invertible dynamics and a locally concave terminal Hessian at the reference qualifies. Reproducible computations illustrate both certificates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对有限时域庞特里亚金最优控制问题，给出了一个可验证的数据层证书，保证当水平增加时两点边值问题的条件数不发散。通过证明约化状态-协态转移矩阵的双曲性以及缩放稳定-不稳定边界横截性，构造了端点修正的格林逆矩阵，其常数与水平无关，并将此逆通过加权收缩传递给非线性问题。结果表明原始庞特里亚金端点行存在唯一的局部驻点分支，其一阶展开和Lipschitz常数关于水平一致有界。
Motivation: 有限时域最优控制计算中，庞特里亚金两点边值问题的条件数会随着时域增长而恶化，需要一种可验证的条件来保证其良态性。
Method: 通过分析约化状态-协态传递矩阵的双曲性，结合稳定-不稳定边界横截性的缩放，构造与水平无关的格林逆矩阵，并利用加权收缩将逆矩阵扩展到非线性问题。
Result: 给出了可验证的矩阵数据条件（如可镇定线性二次系统、凹终端Hessian等），使得边值问题存在唯一的局部驻点分支，且反馈映射关于时域一致Lipschitz、可一阶展开并满足精确的收缩一致性恒等式。
Conclusion: 该证书适用于所有满足条件的最优控制问题，且可通过矩阵数据（如Riccati方程）验证，展示了可复现的计算实例。

papers.title: HarnessX: A Composable, Adaptive, and Evolvable Agent Harness Foundry
papers.abstract_en: AI agent performance depends critically on the runtime harness, comprising the prompts, tools, memory, and control flow that mediate how a model observes, reasons, and acts. Yet today's harnesses remain largely hand-crafted and static: each new model or task still demands bespoke scaffolding, and the rich traces produced during execution are rarely distilled back into systematic improvement. We introduce HarnessX, a foundry for composable, adaptive, and evolvable agent harnesses. HarnessX assembles typed harness primitives via a substitution algebra, adapts them through AEGIS, a trace-driven multi-agent evolution engine grounded in an operational mirror between symbolic adaptation and reinforcement learning, and closes the harness-model loop by turning trajectories into both harness updates and model training signal. Across five benchmarks (ALFWorld, GAIA, WebShop, tau^3-Bench, and SWE-bench Verified), HarnessX yields an average gain of +14.5% (up to +44.0%), with gains largest where baselines are lowest. These results suggest that agent progress need not come from model scaling alone: composing and evolving runtime interfaces from execution feedback is an actionable and complementary lever. The complete codebase will be open-sourced in a future release.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HarnessX，一个可组合、自适应且可演化的 agent 运行时框架（harness foundry），通过类型化的原语和替代代数构建 harness，利用 AEGIS 引擎进行轨迹驱动的多智能体演化，并将执行轨迹反馈到 harness 更新和模型训练中。在五个基准（ALFWorld、GAIA、WebShop、tau^3-Bench、SWE-bench Verified）上，平均性能提升 14.5%（最高 44.0%），表明从执行反馈中组合和演化运行时接口是模型缩放之外的有效补充手段。
Motivation: 当前 AI agent 的运行时 harness（包含提示、工具、记忆和控制流）大多手工构建且静态，每个新模型或任务需要定制化支架，执行产生的丰富轨迹很少被系统性地用于改进。
Method: HarnessX 框架包含三个部分：1) 通过替代代数组合类型化的 harness 原语；2) AEGIS 引擎，一种基于轨道的多智能体演化机制，在符号适应与强化学习之间建立操作镜像；3) 闭合 harness-模型循环，将轨迹转化为 harness 更新和模型训练信号。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、GAIA、WebShop、tau^3-Bench 和 SWE-bench Verified 五个基准上，平均性能提升 14.5%，其中基线最低的任务提升高达 44.0%。
Conclusion: 实验表明，通过执行反馈来组合和演化 agent 的运行时接口是可行的，且能与模型缩放互补。完整代码库将在未来开源。

papers.title: When Sample Selection Bias Precipitates Model Collapse
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of recursive training on synthetic data can alleviate data scarcity but risks model collapse, where repeated training erodes distributional tails and homogenizes outputs. Data selection is widely viewed as a remedy, yet its reliability depends critically on the reference distribution used by the verifier. We show that in low-resource verification regimes, where each verifier observes only a small, fragmented, and biased slice of the target manifold, selection itself becomes biased. This situation naturally arises in low-resource data silos such as healthcare consortia or proprietary financial institutions, where raw data cannot be pooled and local references are inherently incomplete. As a result, selection preferentially retains samples aligned with the local manifold while pruning globally relevant tail modes, turning from a safeguard against collapse into a mechanism that precipitates it. We theoretically prove that such siloed selection accelerates collapse and induces power-law diversity decay. As an initial mitigation, we construct Wasserstein proxy references from multiple silos without sharing raw data. Empirical results confirm that local-reference selection fails on skewed distributions, whereas collaborative proxy references mitigate diversity degradation, suggesting that recursive synthetic-data pipelines require particular caution when real-data coverage is fragmented or scarce.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究了递归训练合成数据时的样本选择偏差如何加速模型崩溃。理论证明，在低资源验证场景下，每个验证器只观察到目标流形的小片段，此时数据选择会偏向局部流形而修剪全局尾模式，反而加剧模型崩溃。通过多个数据孤岛构建Wasserstein代理参考可在不共享原始数据的情况下缓解多样性退化。
Motivation: 递归训练合成数据可能导致模型崩溃，数据选择通常被视为补救措施，但其可靠性依赖于验证器使用的参考分布。在低资源数据孤岛场景下，局部参考不完整，选择本身会引入偏差，反而促成崩溃。
Method: 理论分析证明了孤岛式选择加速崩溃并导致幂律多样性衰减；提出一种初步缓解方法，即在不共享原始数据的情况下，从多个数据孤岛构建Wasserstein代理参考。
Result: 实证结果确认局部参考选择在偏态分布上失败，而协作代理参考能够缓解多样性退化。
Conclusion: 递归合成数据管道在真实数据覆盖碎片化或稀缺时需要特别谨慎。

papers.title: Morphology-Aware Sample Assignment: Overcoming IoU Insensitivity for Surface Defect Detection
papers.abstract_en: Intersection-over-Union (IoU), as a pivotal metric for evaluating the spatial alignment between candidate proposals and ground-truth annotations, directly determines the quality of positive sample sets and the training efficacy of visual detection models. Through theoretical modeling and analysis, we uncover a non-sensitive region on the IoU response curve, within which samples yield nearly identical IoU scores despite distinct geometric overlaps. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a set of morphological similarity metrics covering area, shape, and aspect ratio, to refine the positive sample assignment process, thereby ensuring more discriminative and reliable matching. A supplementary matching score is derived via mean-based aggregation of these multidimensional similarities, compensating for the intrinsic limitation of IoU in representing structural correspondence. Theoretically, incorporating morphological similarity reshapes the response distribution of the matching function, yielding both effective directional gradients and polygon-like iso-response contours, which tightly confine high-response regions around each ground-truth instance and substantially enhance the precision of positive sample selection. Experiments based on the YOLOv9 framework demonstrate consistent performance gains on both NEUDET and GC10- DET datasets. Notably, the proposed approach is fully plug-and-play and incurs zero additional inference overhead, thereby ensuring deployment efficiency for industrial visual inspection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对目标检测中IoU（交并比）对几何重叠区分不敏感的问题，引入形态相似性度量（面积、形状、宽高比）来改进正样本分配过程。理论上，形态相似性使匹配函数的响应分布产生有效的方向梯度与多边形等高线，将高响应区域紧密约束在真实实例周围。在YOLOv9框架上的实验在NEUDET和GC10-DET数据集上取得一致性能提升，且方法即插即用、无额外推理开销。
Motivation: IoU作为衡量候选框与真实框对齐程度的指标，在响应曲线上存在非敏感区域，使得几何重叠差异较大的样本产生几乎相同的IoU分数，导致正样本集质量下降，影响检测模型训练效果。
Method: 提出一套形态相似性度量（面积、形状、宽高比），通过均值聚合得到补充匹配分数，与IoU结合以细化正样本分配。理论上，这种方法重塑了匹配函数的响应分布，产生有效方向梯度与多边形等高线。
Result: 基于YOLOv9框架的实验在NEUDET和GC10-DET数据集上均显示一致性能提升，且方法即插即用，无额外推理开销。
Conclusion: 该方法克服了IoU在表面缺陷检测中表示结构对应性的固有限制，提高了正样本选择精度，适用于工业视觉检测的部署。

papers.title: GF-DiT: Scheduling Parallelism for Diffusion Transformer Serving
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become the dominant architecture for image and video generation, creating growing demand for efficient DiT serving. Existing systems assign each request a fixed parallel configuration throughout its lifetime. However, DiT workloads exhibit substantial heterogeneity across requests, execution stages, and system conditions, making static parallelism inefficient and often leading to poor GPU utilization and degraded service quality. This paper argues that DiT serving should treat GPU parallelism as a first-class schedulable resource. We present GF-DiT, a policy-programmable runtime for elastic DiT serving that dynamically adapts the parallelism of running requests according to workload demands and service objectives. GF-DiT introduces an asynchronous execution abstraction that decomposes requests into independently schedulable trajectory tasks and enables online GPU reallocation. To make elastic parallelism practical, GF-DiT further proposes group-free collectives, a lightweight communication abstraction that supports low-overhead online formation and reconfiguration of arbitrary execution groups. We implement GF-DiT in vLLM-Omni and evaluate it on representative image and video diffusion workloads. Compared with fixed-pipeline execution with static parallelism, GF-DiT improves throughput by up to 6.01$\times$, reduces mean latency by up to 95%, lowers SLO violation rates by up to 90%, and reduces communication-group setup overhead from 778 ms to approximately 60 $μ$s. Our code is available at https://github.com/SJTU-Liquid/GF-DiT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GF-DiT，一个专为扩散变换器（DiT）推理服务设计的弹性并行调度运行时系统。它通过将请求分解为可独立调度的轨迹任务（trajectory tasks）并引入无组集合通信（group-free collectives），实现运行时 GPU 并行性的动态调整。实验表明，相比静态并行方案，GF-DiT 在图像和视频扩散任务上吞吐量提升最高 6.01 倍，平均延迟降低最多 95%，SLO 违反率降低最多 90%，通信组建立开销从 778 毫秒降至约 60 微秒。
Motivation: 现有 DiT 服务系统为每个请求分配固定的并行配置，但 DiT 工作负载在请求、执行阶段和系统条件上存在显著异构性，导致 GPU 利用率低和服务质量下降。
Method: 提出 GF-DiT，包括 (1) 异步执行抽象，将请求分解为独立可调度的轨迹任务，支持在线 GPU 重分配； (2) 无组集合通信抽象，支持低开销的任意执行组在线形成和重配置。在 vLLM-Omni 中实现。
Result: 在代表性图像和视频扩散工作负载上，相比固定流水线静态并行，GF-DiT 吞吐量提升达 6.01 倍，平均延迟降低达 95%，SLO 违反率降低达 90%，通信组建立开销从 778 ms 降至约 60 μs。
Conclusion: GF-DiT 展示了将 GPU 并行性作为可调度资源进行弹性管理的可行性，为 DiT 服务提供了更高效的运行时方案。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在代表性图像和视频扩散工作负载上，相比固定流水线静态并行，GF-DiT 吞吐量提升达 6.01 倍，平均延迟降低达 95%，SLO 违反率降低达 90%，通信组建立开销从 778 ms 降至约 60 μs。
summary_sections.conclusion: GF-DiT 展示了将 GPU 并行性作为可调度资源进行弹性管理的可行性，为 DiT 服务提供了更高效的运行时方案。

papers.title: Certified World Models: Predictability Across Configuration, Horizon, and Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Scale buys interpolation; structure buys certifiable transfer. A world model's average error does not say whether a particular rollout can be trusted, or for how long. For equivariant latent world models we give a predictability certificate: a computable region spanning configuration, horizon, and resolution. Under exact equivariance, rollout error is invariant over the monoid generated by k primitive symmetries and is certified from the k generators (Theorem A); universal orbit-flatness over equivariant targets characterizes equivariance at the function level (Lemma 2), so an unconstrained architecture cannot certify the property by construction. Approximate orbit-transfer defects propagate by the finite-time Lyapunov spectrum (Theorem B): expanding channels give a logarithmic horizon $T_j(ε)\sim\log(1/ε)/λ_j$, neutral channels accumulate recurrent defect linearly, and contracting channels accumulate a bounded nonzero floor. Exact conserved charge values are certified to all horizons only at zero defect; with one-step defect $η$, charge-value error grows at most as $Tη$. Empirically, on a 40-dimensional learned model a $\mathbb{Z}_N$-equivariant network recovers the full Lyapunov spectrum ($R^2=0.98$-$0.99$) where dense and recurrent baselines fail. A cone/adapted-metric certificate reads an a-priori horizon off the model's own Jacobian, tight on uniformly hyperbolic dynamics and self-abstaining elsewhere; the resulting horizon improves a budgeted re-observation decision. For public non-equivariant world models the tangent spectrum gives a training-free candidate horizon, paired with a held-out divergence cross-check that abstains or corrects when the learned loop over-promises.
papers.comment: 56 pages. v3: evidence hardening -- pendulum-ring mechanism doubled to n=30 seeds (Fisher p=9.5e-6), 5-task x 7-checkpoint multitask audit (0/35 cells reach the calibration band), certificate start-spread and measured episode-sensitivity analyses; prose pass; conclusions unchanged. papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为等变潜在世界模型提供可预测性证书，该证书可以计算一个覆盖配置、时域和分辨率的可验证区域，从而保证任意rollout的误差边界。理论证明包括基于等变性的最优证书定理和有限时间Lyapunov谱缺陷传播定理，实验上在40维学习模型上恢复了完整的Lyapunov谱（R^2=0.98-0.99）。
Motivation: 世界模型的平均误差无法指示单个rollout的可信度或有效时长，需要一种可计算且可验证的预测性保证。
Method: 利用精确等变性，推导出可预测性证书的理论基础（定理A和B），并通过有限时间Lyapunov谱分析缺陷传播；实验采用ZN-等变网络对高维模型进行验证。
Result: 在40维学习模型上，ZN-等变网络恢复了完整Lyapunov谱（R^2=0.98-0.99），优于稠密和循环基线；从模型Jacobian导出的锥/适应度量证书可给出先验时域。
Conclusion: 该证书可为非等变世界模型提供无训练的候选时域，并配合交叉检查以应对过度承诺。

papers.title: Estimating Individualized Treatment Effects in Acute Ischemic Stroke with Causal Transformation Models (TRAM-DAG): A Multi-Centre Observational Study with External RCT Validation
papers.abstract_en: Personalized medicine in acute ischemic stroke requires moving beyond average treatment effects (ATE) to individualized treatment effect (ITE) estimates to support treatment decisions. In acute ischemic stroke, mechanical thrombectomy has been shown to be more effective on average than lysis in randomized controlled trials (RCTs), such as the MR CLEAN study. We aim to identify which individual patients benefit most from mechanical thrombectomy compared to lysis. The outcome of interest is the modified Rankin Scale (mRS) at three months, an ordinal measure of functional disability (0: no symptoms, 6: death). We demonstrate that causal transformation models on directed acyclic graphs (TRAM-DAG) can be used for ITE estimation after being fitted on observational MAGIC multi-center stroke patient data. To ensure comparability with the MR CLEAN population, which we use for validation, we train the TRAM-DAG on a MAGIC sub-population with NIHSS at admission >= 6, corresponding to one inclusion criterion of MR CLEAN. The fitted model is then used to estimate ITEs for stroke patients in the MR CLEAN population. While these ITE estimates cannot be confirmed experimentally, we show that their average is consistent with the trial's reported ATE. Furthermore, the ITE estimates correctly rank trial patients by their observed frequency of a good outcome (mRS at three months <= 2). These findings support the use of causal models like TRAM-DAG for personalized decision-making in stroke care and highlight their ability to bridge the gap between observational evidence and clinical trials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本研究使用因果转换模型（TRAM-DAG）在急性缺血性中风患者数据上估计个体化治疗效果（ITE），以比较机械取栓与溶栓的疗效。基于观察性MAGIC数据训练模型，并在MR CLEAN随机对照试验人群上验证，发现ITE估计的平均值与试验报告的ATE一致，且能正确排序患者的好结果概率。
Motivation: 急性缺血性中风治疗需从平均治疗效果转向个体化治疗效果，以支持个体化治疗决策。现有随机对照试验仅提供平均效果，无法识别哪些患者从机械取栓中受益最大。
Method: 应用因果转换模型（TRAM-DAG）于有向无环图（DAG）框架，在观察性MAGIC多中心数据上训练，然后用于对MR CLEAN试验患者进行ITE估计。训练子集限制在NIHSS≥6的患者，以匹配MR CLEAN纳入标准。
Result: ITE估计的平均值与MR CLEAN试验报告的ATE一致，并且能正确根据患者观察到的良好结局（mRS≤2）频率进行排序。
Conclusion: 因果模型如TRAM-DAG可用于中风护理中的个体化决策，弥合观察性证据与临床试验之间的差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: eCream-MedCorpus A Large-Scale Corpus of Clinical Notes for Italian
papers.abstract_en: We present eCream-MedCorpus, a new and unique large-scale dataset of clinical notes produced in Emergency Departments of Italian hospitals. The corpus, in its current version, is composed of approximately 4 million clinical notes fully anonymized, covering diverse phases of patient care during the stay in the emergency department. In addition, a subset of about six thousand notes has been manually annotated by clinical experts through a structured Case Report Form (CRF) containing 132 items relevant for two patient situations in emergency departments, dyspnea and loss of consciousness. Items may assume numerical values (e.g., for blood saturation), categorical (e.g., for level of consciousness ), binary (e.g., for presence of traumas), and mixed value types. The annotation process involved multiple clinicians and underwent iterative revision to resolve ambiguities in item formulation, resulting in a richly structured (although high imbalanced) resource. The dataset aims to fill a relevant gap of data able to support both the development and the use of Large Language Models in concrete medical applications. We describe the data collection protocol, the on-site anonymisation pipeline, corpus statistics, and the annotation scheme. Finally, we propose CRF-filling as a novel structured information extraction benchmark, and provide zero-shot baseline resulting from Gemma-27B and MedGemma-27B. To the best of our knowledge, eCream-MedCorpus is the largest freely available dataset of clinical notes existing for the Italian language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布了 eCream-MedCorpus，一个大规模意大利语急诊科临床笔记数据集，包含约400万条匿名化笔记，其中约6000条由临床专家按照包含132个项目的结构化病例报告表（CRF）进行标注，涵盖呼吸困难和意识丧失两种急诊情景。数据集旨在填补意大利语临床文本的空白，支持大语言模型在医疗中的应用。
Motivation: 意大利语临床文本数据稀缺，限制了大型语言模型在意大利医疗场景中的开发与应用。
Method: 从意大利医院急诊科收集临床笔记，经过现场匿名化处理，并采用迭代修订的多专家标注流程，对子集进行结构化CRF标注。
Result: 提供了目前最大的意大利语临床笔记免费数据集；使用 Gemma-27B 和 MedGemma-27B 在 CRF 填充任务上取得了零样本基线结果。
Conclusion: 该数据集可用于推动意大利语临床自然语言处理研究，特别是结构化信息提取（如 CRF 填充）任务。

papers.title: DarkVGGT: Seeing Through Darkness Using Thermal Geometry without Daylight Tax
papers.abstract_en: Recent feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods have demonstrated strong performance and flexibility in efficient end-to-end scene geometry estimation from image streams. However, their reliance on visible-light appearance makes them vulnerable in dark and low-visibility environments, where RGB cues are severely degraded and geometric evidence becomes ambiguous. To address this challenge, we propose DarkVGGT, an RGB-T feed-forward geometry framework that uses physics-aware thermal modeling for robust 3D estimation in low-light scenes. DarkVGGT introduces two complementary modules. First, physics-inspired thermal factorization extracts emissive-dominant, geometry-consistent thermal cues while isolating sparse reflective residuals that may introduce geometric ambiguity. Second, geometry-shared thermal routing isolates modality-invariant geometric structures from thermal-specific patterns, selectively injecting reliability-aware structural guidance into the RGB stream. Together, these components enable accurate thermal-informed geometry estimation under degraded RGB conditions while largely preserving performance in well-lit environments. Experiments on low-visibility RGB-T benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in both depth and camera pose estimation over existing feed-forward geometry baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DarkVGGT，一种 RGB-T 前馈几何框架，利用物理感知热建模在低光照场景下实现鲁棒的三维几何估计。框架包含热因子分解和几何共享热路由两个模块，从热成像中提取几何一致线索并注入 RGB 流，在低可见度基准上改进深度和相机位姿估计。
Motivation: 现有前馈三维重建方法依赖可见光外观，在黑暗和低可见度环境中 RGB 线索严重退化，几何证据模糊，亟需一种不依赖可见光的方法。
Method: 引入物理感知热因子分解，提取发射主导的几何一致热线索并隔离反射残差；同时使用几何共享热路由，分离模态不变几何结构，将可靠性感知的结构指导注入 RGB 流。
Result: 在低可见度 RGB-T 基准上，DarkVGGT 在深度和相机位姿估计上均优于现有前馈几何基线。
Conclusion: 热成像能够为低光照下的三维几何估计提供有效线索，且该方法在良好光照环境下仍能保持性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Token Not Taken: Sampling, State, and the Stochasticity of AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems can behave differently across runs: the same request may produce a different plan, a different tool call, a different code edit, or a different final answer. Such variability arises from several layers that are often conflated. At the core of many current agents is a foundation model, a large pretrained model adaptable to many downstream tasks, embedded in an orchestration loop that plans, calls tools, observes results, and updates state. One explicit intrinsic source of variability in such systems is token generation: the model computes scores over possible next tokens, the scores are converted into probabilities, and a decoder may sample tokens using a pseudo-random number generator. A small sampled token difference can then cascade downstream into a different tool call, code path, search query, or agent state. Other sources of variability are extrinsic to token sampling, including changing environments, live data, serving infrastructure, batch effects, and numerical details. By separating these layers, this tutorial clarifies what it means to call agentic AI systems stochastic, when such variability can be reproduced under matched conditions, and why deterministic execution need not imply identical behavior in deployed settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇教程性论文探讨了智能体AI系统在不同运行中表现出的行为变异性，将其根源分为内在的token采样随机性和外在的环境、数据等因素。通过分离这些层次，论文澄清了何时可以称AI代理系统为随机的，以及在匹配条件下变异性如何可复现。
Motivation: 当前对AI代理系统随机性的讨论常常混淆多种变异来源，缺乏清晰的概念框架。
Method: 论文采用层次分解方法，将变异来源分为token采样的内在随机性以及外部环境、实时数据、服务基础设施等外在因素。
Result: 论文指出，token采样中的微小差异可能级联导致完全不同的工具调用、代码路径或代理状态；在匹配条件下部分变异性可复现，但确定性执行未必保证部署中行为一致。
Conclusion: 理解AI代理系统的随机性需要区分内在采样随机性与外在变异源，这对可复现性和可靠性评估具有重要意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Shared Semantics, Divergent Mechanisms: Unsupervised Feature Discovery by Aligning Semantics and Mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: As large language models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, there is a growing need for tools that audit not only model outputs but also the internal computations that produce them. Circuit analysis is a central approach in mechanistic interpretability, but it is typically target-conditioned, explaining a single prompt paired with a chosen completion. This target-conditioned setup can obscure heterogeneity across a model's continuation distribution. We introduce distribution-level unsupervised feature discovery, which clusters sampled continuations using both semantic content and sequence-level mechanistic attributions, without manually specifying target outputs. Our method represents each continuation with a semantic embedding and a prefix-to-continuation attribution signature, then optimizes a rate-distortion objective that trades off semantic coherence, mechanistic consistency, and cluster granularity. Across clustering and steering analyses, the discovered clusters expose continuation modes that single-view baselines miss and provide interventional evidence that cluster signatures correspond to actionable mechanistic factors. Overall, our approach complements circuit analysis and behavioral evaluation by providing a scalable audit of the mechanisms underlying a model's continuation distribution.
papers.comment: 40 pages; accepted as an ICML 2026 Spotlight; project page: https://merenova.github.io/distribution-level-feature-discovery/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文引入了一种分布级无监督特征发现方法，通过对模型生成的续写进行聚类，同时考虑语义内容和序列级机制归因，无需人工指定目标输出。该方法优化率失真目标，平衡语义一致性、机制一致性和簇粒度，在聚类和引导分析中揭示了单视图基线所遗漏的续写模式。
Motivation: 现有电路分析通常针对特定提示和完成对，无法捕捉模型续写分布中的异质性，缺乏可扩展的审计工具来检查模型内部机制。
Method: 对每个续写表示为一个语义嵌入和一个前缀到续写的归因签名，然后优化一个率失真目标，在语义一致性、机制一致性和簇粒度之间进行权衡，实现无监督聚类。
Result: 在聚类和引导分析中，该方法发现了单视图基线遗漏的续写模式，并提供干预证据表明簇签名对应可操作的机制因素。
Conclusion: 该方法通过提供对模型续写分布背后机制的可扩展审计，补充了电路分析和行为评估。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 现有电路分析通常针对特定提示和完成对，无法捕捉模型续写分布中的异质性，缺乏可扩展的审计工具来检查模型内部机制。
summary_sections.method: 对每个续写表示为一个语义嵌入和一个前缀到续写的归因签名，然后优化一个率失真目标，在语义一致性、机制一致性和簇粒度之间进行权衡，实现无监督聚类。
summary_sections.result: 在聚类和引导分析中，该方法发现了单视图基线遗漏的续写模式，并提供干预证据表明簇签名对应可操作的机制因素。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法通过提供对模型续写分布背后机制的可扩展审计，补充了电路分析和行为评估。

papers.title: Pointwise Complexity for Gaussian Fields: Upper Envelopes, Algorithmic Lower Bounds, and Separation
papers.abstract_en: We prove a variance-aware pointwise majorizing-measure theorem for centered Gaussian processes. Classical generic chaining characterizes the scalar quantity $\mathbb E\sup_{x\in T}X_x$; the theorem here gives a simultaneous high-probability envelope for the entire field. For an ambient prior $μ$, the envelope at $x$ is governed by a pointwise Fernique-Talagrand functional \[Φ_μ(x):=\int_0^{4σ(x)}\sqrt{\log\frac{1}{μ(B_d(x,\varepsilon))}}\,d\varepsilon,\] together with the corresponding Gaussian tail term. The theorem provides a reusable field-level refinement of classical generic chaining and a Gaussian-process counterpart of pointwise empirical-process bounds for deep neural networks. We also record a Bayesian algorithmic lower envelope from the interactive Fano/data-processing principle. For a known prior $π$, an observation channel, and a concrete estimator $\widehat t(Y)$, the lower bound is expressed through the exact ghost small-ball mass $\mathbb E_{Y\sim Q}π(B_d(\widehat t(Y),Δ))$, rather than a worst-case covering number. In Gaussian location experiments, comparison decoders convert Bayes location error into lower bounds on decision-aligned Gaussian ranges. We then construct an elementary example separating the usual Fano relaxation, the Bayesian algorithmic lower envelope, the pointwise Gaussian envelope, and the full-class minimax risk. Together, these results show that algorithmic lower bounds provide local-geometric validations of pointwise complexity for fixed estimators in overparameterized ambient classes, precisely in regimes where classical minimax theory becomes either too coarse or oracle-dependent. This separation can also be recast in minimax language as penalty-range information relaxation, highlighting an important question of algorithmic robustness for classical high-dimensional models and regularized algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了一个方差感知的点态主测度定理（variance-aware pointwise majorizing-measure theorem）用于中心高斯过程，给出了整个场的同步高概率包络，并通过交互式Fano/数据处理原理导出了贝叶斯算法下界。通过一个分离示例展示了经典Fano松弛、贝叶斯算法下界、点态高斯包络和全类极小极大风险之间的差异。
Motivation: 经典泛函链导引（generic chaining）仅刻画标量量 E[sup X_x]，缺乏对场中每个点的逐点复杂性刻画。现有极小极大理论在过参数化环境中变得过于粗糙或依赖oracle，需要更精细的局部几何验证。
Method: 提出点态Fernique-Talagrand泛函 Φ_μ(x) 并证明其作为高斯过程上包络的概率界；利用交互式Fano/数据处理原理导出贝叶斯算法下界，通过精确的ghost小球质量而不是最坏情况覆盖数来表达。
Result: 得到了一个可重用的场级泛化链导引精化；在Gaussian位置实验中，比较解码器将贝叶斯位置误差转化为算法一致的高斯范围下界；构造了一个分离示例，证明在过参数化环境中，算法下界提供了局部几何验证。
Conclusion: 这些结果表明，算法下界能够为过参数化环境中的固定估计器提供点态复杂性的局部几何验证，而这正是经典极小极大理论变得过于粗糙或依赖oracle的区域。该分离也可重新表述为惩罚范围信息松弛（penalty-range information relaxation），凸显了经典高维模型和正则化算法的算法鲁棒性问题。

papers.title: Style-CCL: Content-Preserving Style Transfer via Curriculum Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Content-Preserving Style transfer, given content and style references, remains challenging for Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) due to entangled content and style features. With a reverse triplet synthesis pipeline to build a million-scale training set and a dual-branch Style-Content DiT (SC-DiT) that decouples style and content via separate ROPE embeddings and causal masking, we observe that such a one-stage training paradigm on mixed style categories causes semantic styles to dominate, hindering texture style learning, and harming content preservation. To address these issues, we propose Style-CCL, a Multi-Stage Curriculum Continual Learning framework that trains SC-DiT from semantic (easy) to texture (hard) styles, and from clean to synthetic data, with Random Memory Rehearsal across stages to avoid catastrophic forgetting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our Style-CCL achieves state-of-the-art performance in three core metrics: style similarity, content consistency, and aesthetic quality.
papers.comment: code and models of QwenStyle are released at https://github.com/witcherofresearch/Qwen-Image-Style-Transfer/ and https://github.com/Tele-AI/TeleStyle/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散变换器（DiT）在内容保持风格迁移中内容与风格特征纠缠的问题，提出 Style-CCL 框架。该方法通过反向三元组合成流水线构建百万级训练集，并设计双分支 Style-Content DiT（SC-DiT），利用独立的 ROPE 嵌入和因果掩码解耦风格与内容。然而，单阶段训练导致语义风格主导，阻碍纹理风格学习并损害内容保持。为此，提出多阶段课程持续学习（Curriculum Continual Learning），从语义（简单）到纹理（困难）风格逐步训练，并在阶段间使用随机记忆复习防止灾难性遗忘。实验表明，Style-CCL 在风格相似性、内容一致性和美学质量三个核心指标上达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有扩散变换器（DiT）在内容保持风格迁移中，内容与风格特征高度纠缠，单阶段训练混合多种风格类别会导致语义风格主导，纹理风格学习受阻，从而损害内容保持。
Method: 提出 Style-CCL，一种多阶段课程持续学习框架：首先构建反向三元组合成流水线生成百万级训练集，设计双分支 SC-DiT 通过独立 ROPE 嵌入和因果掩码解耦风格与内容；然后从语义风格（简单）到纹理风格（困难）以及从干净数据到合成数据分阶段训练，并在各阶段间采用随机记忆复习（Random Memory Rehearsal）以避免灾难性遗忘。
Result: 摘要报告 Style-CCL 在风格相似性、内容一致性和美学质量三个核心指标上达到最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
Conclusion: 提出的多阶段课程持续学习策略有效解决了内容保持风格迁移中语义风格主导和纹理风格学习困难的问题，显著提升了风格迁移的质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Representing Research Attention as Contextually Structured Flows
papers.abstract_en: Research metrics use attention as evidence of societal impact. Yet attention serves as evidence only once interpreted, and its meaning depends on its contextual structure, not on volume alone. Altmetrics records signals in isolation, keeping a count of the attention an output received, or a sequence of when. We address this with attention flows, representations that situate an output's attention in the social settings where it occurs, the language expressing it, and the time over which it unfolds. To evaluate the flow, we build a benchmark of analogy queries, each testing whether the relationship between two outputs, applied to a third, yields a fourth. The count and sequence baselines fail to recover these relationships, whereas flows learned as dynamic contextualised representations recover them. The recovered structure also survives partial observation and rests on its contexts instead of volume. These findings support attention represented as contextually structured for research evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted at STi 2026 - International Conference on Science and Technology Indicators
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有研究指标中注意力（attention）仅被孤立地计数或记录时间序列、缺乏上下文结构的问题，提出注意力流（attention flows）表示，将输出的注意力置于其发生的社会环境、表达语言和时间展开中。通过在类比查询基准上的评估，计数和序列基线无法恢复输出间的关系，而动态上下文表示的注意力流能够恢复，并且该结构在部分观察下依然稳健，依赖于上下文而非体积。
Motivation: 现有研究指标使用注意力作为社会影响力的证据，但注意力的解释依赖于其上下文结构而非单纯的数量，而altmetrics仅记录孤立信号，缺乏对注意力情境结构的捕捉。
Method: 提出注意力流（attention flows），一种将输出的注意力置于社会情境、表达语言和时间维度中的动态上下文表示；并构建类比查询基准来评估表示的质量。
Result: 在类比查询基准上，计数和时间序列基线均无法恢复输出间的关系，而动态上下文表示的注意力流能够成功恢复，且该结构在部分观察下依然有效。
Conclusion: 研究结果表明，将注意力表示为上下文结构化形式更有助于研究评估，支持在科研评价中采用注意力流而非单纯计数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Absolute Scores: Relative Edit-induced Difference for Generalizable Image Aesthetic Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Traditional Image Aesthetic Assessment (IAA) methods mainly rely on regressing absolute Mean Opinion Scores (MOS). However, such a paradigm overlooks the inherently dynamic nature of human aesthetic perception, which relies on subconscious comparison against implicit visual references. Consequently, the lack of causal reasoning regarding aesthetic differences prevents models from learning generalizable aesthetic principles, thus limiting their generalization across diverse scenarios. In this work, we rethink the IAA task and propose Relative Edit-induced Difference Aesthetic learning (RED-Aes), a novel framework that leverages controllable image editing models to simulate the human aesthetic reasoning process. Instead of fitting absolute score distributions, RED-Aes explicitly learns the visual factors that drive aesthetic changes. To support this paradigm, we construct the RED-20k dataset, which comprises editing-based image pairs, quantitative aesthetic differences, and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. Furthermore, we introduce a three-stage training strategy guided by a relative ranking consistency reward, optimizing the model solely via relative supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RED-Aes achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple public benchmarks, exhibiting superior generalization capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出相对编辑诱导差异美学学习（RED-Aes）框架，利用可控图像编辑模型模拟人类审美推理过程，学习驱动美学变化的视觉因素，并构建包含编辑图像对、量化差异和思维链推理的RED-20k数据集。采用三阶段训练策略和相对排序一致性奖励优化模型，在多个图像美学评估基准上达到最优性能，展现了卓越的泛化能力。
Motivation: 传统图像美学评估方法依赖回归绝对平均意见分数，忽略了人类审美感知的动态性和比较性，导致模型缺乏因果推理能力，难以学习可泛化的美学原则，限制了跨场景泛化。
Method: 提出RED-Aes框架，使用可控图像编辑模型生成编辑前后的图像对，显式学习导致美学差异的视觉因素；构建RED-20k数据集，包含编辑对、量化差异和思维链推理；引入三阶段训练策略，通过相对排序一致性奖励进行优化，仅依赖相对监督。
Result: 在多个公开基准上取得最先进性能，尤其在泛化能力方面表现突出。
Conclusion: 通过相对编辑诱导差异学习，模型能够学习可泛化的美学原则，解决了传统绝对得分回归的局限性。

papers.title: Nonlocal Mean Field Schrödinger Bridge with Learned Interactions
papers.abstract_en: The Schrödinger Bridge Problem connects an initial distribution to a terminal one along a minimum-energy stochastic process. Its mean-field extension, the Mean-Field Schrödinger Bridge, governs interacting populations whose dynamics and costs depend on the collective distribution. When these interactions are nonlocal, their direct evaluation scales quadratically with the population size, making large ensembles intractable within FBSDE-based solvers. We replace these terms with neural surrogates in state and time, trained on empirical interaction values along sampled trajectories and embedded in a four-stage alternating scheme that updates the forward and backward potentials and the surrogates in turn, while preserving forward--backward consistency and the prescribed endpoint marginals. We derive Grönwall-type stability bounds quantifying how surrogate errors propagate to the generated trajectories under a small-gain condition. On crowd-navigation and high-dimensional opinion-dynamics benchmarks, the surrogates reproduce the trajectories obtained with exact evaluation at reduced training cost. The advantage is most significant when the interaction is a nonlinear functional of the measure, such as the normalized bounded-confidence drift, for which random-batch subsampling is biased and unstable whereas the learned surrogate remains accurate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非局部交互的平均场薛定谔桥问题，提出用神经网络替代非局部交互项，设计四阶段交替训练方案，保持前向后向一致性和边界分布。推导了Grönwall型稳定性界限，在人群导航和意见动力学基准上表明替代模型能以较低训练成本复现精确轨迹，尤其在非线性泛函交互中比随机批次采样更准确。
Motivation: 非局部交互的平均场薛定谔桥中，直接计算交互项随群体大小二次增长，使得基于FBSDE的求解器难以处理大规模群体。
Method: 用神经网络替代非局部交互项，在状态和时间上作为代理，在采样轨迹上训练，并嵌入四阶段交替方案，交替更新前向和后向势以及代理，同时保持前向后向一致性和端点边际分布。
Result: 在人群导航和高维意见动力学基准上，代理模型以较低训练成本复现了精确评估的轨迹。当交互是非线性泛函（如标准化有界置信漂移）时，优势最显著，随机批次子采样有偏且不稳定，而学习代理仍然准确。
Conclusion: 摘要指出代理模型在非局部交互中有效，并给出了稳定性理论保证。

summary_sections.method: 用神经网络替代非局部交互项，在状态和时间上作为代理，在采样轨迹上训练，并嵌入四阶段交替方案，交替更新前向和后向势以及代理，同时保持前向后向一致性和端点边际分布。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要指出代理模型在非局部交互中有效，并给出了稳定性理论保证。

papers.title: SkillDAG: Self-Evolving Typed Skill Graphs for LLM Skill Selection at Scale
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents adopt large skill libraries, selecting the right subset becomes a structural problem rather than a similarity-matching one: skills depend on, conflict with, specialize, or duplicate one another, a structure invisible to both full enumeration and embedding similarity. We present SkillDAG, which models inter-skill relationships as a typed directed graph and exposes it to an LLM agent as an inference-time, agent-callable structural retrieval interface, queried and evolved during execution rather than baked into a fixed retrieval pipeline: each search returns vector matches, typed-edge neighbors, and conflict signals, and a propose-then-commit protocol lets the agent register execution-backed edges so the graph accumulates structure across episodes. On ALFWorld and SkillsBench with MiniMax-M2.7, SkillDAG reaches 67.1% success and 27.3% reward, exceeding the strongest reported Graph-of-Skills baseline by +12.8 and +8.6 points; the advantage ports to gpt-5.2-codex, and intrinsic SkillsBench Ret@K rises from 65.5 to 78.2 under matched queries. These gains trace to isolable mechanisms: candidate ranking that stays robust as the pool grows 10x where a fixed seeding-diffusion pipeline degrades, and set-monotone online edits that enlarge ground-truth recall without evicting prior hits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillDAG，将大型技能库中技能之间的依赖、冲突、特化等关系建模为类型化有向图，为 LLM agent 提供推理时可调用的结构化检索接口。该接口结合向量匹配、类型边邻居和冲突信号，并通过提出-提交协议让 agent 注册执行反馈的边，使图结构在多个回合中累积演化。在 ALFWorld 和 SkillsBench 基准上，SkillDAG 达到 67.1% 成功率和 27.3% 奖励，分别超过最强基线 Graph-of-Skills 12.8 和 8.6 个点，且 SkillsBench Ret@K 从 65.5 提升至 78.2。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 在选择技能时通常依赖全枚举或嵌入相似度匹配，忽略了技能间存在的依赖、冲突、特化和重复等结构关系，导致选择不准确。
Method: SkillDAG 将技能间关系建模为类型化有向图，作为 agent 推理时可调用的结构化检索接口；采用提出-提交协议，允许 agent 在执行后注册经过验证的边，使图结构在线演化。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 和 SkillsBench 上，SkillDAG 达到 67.1% 成功率和 27.3% 奖励，比 Graph-of-Skills 基线分别提升 12.8 和 8.6 个点；SkillsBench Ret@K 从 65.5 提升至 78.2，且候选排名在技能池扩大 10 倍时保持稳健。
Conclusion: SkillDAG 通过建模技能间的结构关系并在线演化，显著提升了 LLM agent 在大型技能库中的技能选择性能，且候选排序的鲁棒性和在线编辑的单调扩展性是其关键优势。

papers.title: Exact equivariance, kept through training, buys zero-shot generalisation across the symmetry group
papers.abstract_en: A latent world model built from an equivariant encoder and predictor inherits a provable symmetry of its training loss: when the dynamics carries a group $G$ acting on latents by an orthogonal representation $ρ(g)$, the one-step prediction relMSE is exactly invariant across the whole group, so fitting a restricted slice of orientations mathematically determines it on the entire orbit. The symmetry survives a real Muon/AdamW+EMA+VICReg run -- composed residual $\sim 10^{-6}$ after training, under any optimiser (intrinsic Vector-Neuron/e3nn parametrisation) -- and one-step error is flat across the group (5-seed medians: equivariant $\times 1.00$ vs a higher-capacity non-equivariant baseline $\times 12.7$ in 2D, $\times 17.2$ in 3D), while that baseline fits the slice but breaks out-of-distribution. The flatness is not a synthetic artefact: on real-robot DROID end-effector trajectories the equivariant model stays flat across the orbit ($\times 1.000$, rotation residual $1.5\times 10^{-16}$) while a $4.5\times$-larger baseline degrades $\times 11$. One caution is load-bearing: flatness is necessary, not sufficient -- the theorem transports the in-distribution error level unchanged but does not lower it (3D relMSE $\approx 0.43$): across-group error is constant, not low. The same isometry lifts to a closed-loop corollary: under a matching equivariant planner the control error is invariant across the group -- float-floor-exact in 2D/SO(2), statistically flat in 3D/SE(3). Stress-tested against Sutton's Bitter Lesson (augmentation, scale, soft-equivariance), each closes at most the across-group task metric, never the float-floor exactness. This is the generalisation-side foundation of a certified-world-models programme (arXiv:2606.13092, 2606.24945, 2606.24946): flatness transports competence, and the trust bounds built on it are downstream products.
papers.comment: 112 pages, 19 figures. v2 adds programme lineage to companion papers (arXiv:2606.13092, 2606.24945, 2606.24946), engages the equivariance-at-scale debate (arXiv:2410.23179), and adds experimental hardening: 5-seed CIs, frame-averaging/canonicalization baselines, a real-robot DROID anchor, a scale-vs-exactness curve. Core claims unchanged. Code: https://github.com/TimothyWang418/se3-ejepa
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，由等变编码器和预测器构成的潜在世界模型在训练损失上具有严格的对称性：当动力学由群G通过正交表示作用于潜在空间时，单步预测relMSE在整个群上精确不变。该对称性在实际训练（Muon/AdamW+EMA+VICReg）后仍然保持，残余约10^{-6}，且一步误差在整个群上是平坦的（等变模型vs非等变基线在2D中为×1.00 vs ×12.7，在3D中为×1.00 vs ×17.2）。在真实机器人DROID数据上，等变模型保持平坦（×1.000），而4.5倍大的基线退化至×11。平坦性是必要但不充分的：定理将分布内误差水平原样传输但不降低（3D relMSE≈0.43）。闭环推论：在匹配等变规划器下，控制误差在全群上不变。论文还指出，数据增强、扩展、软等变性最多只能闭合跨群任务指标，无法达到浮点精确的等变性。
Motivation: 现有机模型在分布外泛化到训练中未见的对称群元素时性能退化，论文旨在证明严格等变性可以带来跨整个对称群的零样本泛化，并探究其必要条件与局限性。
Method: 构建由等变编码器和预测器组成的潜在世界模型，证明在群作用下的单步预测损失精确不变；通过Muon/AdamW+EMA+VICReg训练，并采用内在Vector-Neuron/e3nn参数化；通过理论分析和实验验证等变性的保持及误差平坦性。
Result: 实验表明，等变模型在2D/3D中一步误差平坦（×1.00），而非等变基线退化严重（×12.7/×17.2）；在真实机器人数据上，等变模型平坦（×1.000），较大基线退化（×11）。3D relMSE≈0.43（不低）。闭环控制误差在2D/SO(2)上浮点精确平坦，在3D/SE(3)上统计平坦。数据增强、规模扩大、软等变性无法达到浮点精确。
Conclusion: 严格等变性是实现跨对称群零样本泛化的核心机制，但平坦性仅保证误差水平不变而非降低；该工作是认证世界模型计划的基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPADER: Step-wise Peer Advantage with Diversity-Aware Exploration Rewards for Multi-Answer Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as tool-augmented agents to acquire information beyond parametric knowledge. While recent work has improved long-horizon tool-use reasoning, most approaches focus on tasks with a single correct answer. In contrast, many real-world queries require discovering a comprehensive set of valid answers, a setting known as Multi-Answer QA. This setting raises two challenges: fine-grained credit assignment over long search trajectories and reward alignment for sustained exploration beyond easy high-frequency entities. We propose SPADER, a reinforcement learning framework for long-horizon tool use in Multi-Answer QA. SPADER includes Step-wise Peer Advantage (SPA), a critic-free step-level credit assignment mechanism that aligns parallel trajectories by decision step and estimates advantages from peer returns. It also includes a diversity-aware exploration reward that promotes long-tail entity discovery by upweighting rare findings and downweighting redundant ones. Experiments on QAMPARI, Mintaka, WebQSP, and QUEST show that SPADER generally improves recall and overall F1 over prompting-based agents, outcome-supervised RL methods, and recent step-level supervision approaches. Our code and model weights are available at https://github.com/KhanCold/spader.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SPADER，一个面向多答案问答（Multi-Answer QA）场景下长程工具使用的强化学习框架。SPADER包含无评论家的步骤级信用分配机制（Step-wise Peer Advantage, SPA）和多样性感知探索奖励（diversity-aware exploration reward），旨在提升长尾实体发现和整体召回率。在QAMPARI、Mintaka等四个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在召回率和F1指标上优于基于提示的代理和结果监督强化学习方法。
Motivation: 现有工具增强语言模型主要针对单答案任务，而在需要发现多个有效答案的真实查询（多答案QA）中，面临长搜索轨迹的细粒度信用分配和激励持续探索（尤其对高频实体以外）的奖励对齐两大挑战。
Method: 提出SPADER框架，包含两个核心组件：1) Step-wise Peer Advantage (SPA)：一种无评论家的步骤级信用分配机制，通过按决策步骤对齐并行轨迹并用同伴回报估计优势；2) 多样性感知探索奖励：通过提高罕见发现的权重并降低冗余发现的权重来促进长尾实体发现。
Result: 在QAMPARI、Mintaka、WebQSP和QUEST四个多答案QA数据集上，SPADER在召回率和整体F1上普遍优于基于提示的代理、结果监督RL方法以及最近的步骤级监督方法。
Conclusion: SPADER通过步骤级信用分配和多样性奖励有效提升了多答案QA中长程工具使用的表现；代码和模型权重已开源。

papers.title: PE-means: Improved Differentially Private $k$-means Clustering through Private Evolution
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of differentially private (DP) $k$-means clustering in Euclidean space. Previous solutions rely on summing the private data directly, which induces a sensitivity proportional to the domain. We introduce PE-means, an extension of the private evolution (PE) algorithm (an increasingly popular method for synthetic data generation), to the problem of $k$-means clustering. The key advantage of PE is that it only computes a private histogram with constant sensitivity to guide the evolution. Our adaptation of PE includes new evolutionary operators for clustering, as well as other algorithmic improvements of independent interest. Overall, PE-means achieves an average improvement of 26% in clustering loss over state-of-the-art baselines such as Google's LSH-based algorithm and DP-Lloyd variants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PE-means，一种基于私有进化（PE）算法的差分隐私 k-means 聚类方法。PE 通过计算具有常数灵敏度的私有直方图来指导进化，避免了传统方法因直接求和私有数据导致的灵敏度与域大小成比例的问题。PE-means 在聚类损失上比现有最优基线（如 Google 的 LSH 算法和 DP-Lloyd 变体）平均改进 26%。
Motivation: 现有差分隐私 k-means 聚类方法直接对私有数据求和，导致灵敏度与数据域大小成比例，影响了隐私与效用的权衡。
Method: 将私有进化（PE）算法扩展到 k-means 聚类，设计了新的进化算子（如交叉、变异）并引入算法改进，仅通过私有直方图（常数灵敏度）驱动聚类中心的演化。
Result: 在聚类损失上平均比 Google 的 LSH 算法和 DP-Lloyd 等基线改进 26%。
Conclusion: PE-means 通过私有进化避免了直接求和的高灵敏度，实现了更好的差分隐私聚类效果，且进化算子设计具有独立价值。

papers.title: ResearchClawBench: A Benchmark for End-to-End Autonomous Scientific Research
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are increasingly used for scientific work, but their end-to-end autonomous research capability remains difficult to verify. We present ResearchClawBench, a benchmark for evaluating autonomous scientific research across 40 tasks from 10 scientific domains. Each task is grounded in a real published paper, provides related literature and raw data, and hides the target paper during evaluation. Expert-curated multimodal rubrics decompose the target scientific artifacts into weighted criteria, enabling evaluation of target-paper-level re-discovery while leaving room for new discovery. We evaluate seven autonomous research (auto-research) agents under a unified protocol and seventeen native LLMs through the lightweight ResearchHarness. Current systems remain far from reliable re-discovery: the strongest autonomous agent, Claude Code, averages 21.5, and the strongest ResearchHarness LLM, Claude-Opus-4.7, averages 20.7, with an LLM frontier mean of only 26.5. Error analysis shows that failures concentrate in experimental protocol mismatch, evidence mismatch, and missing scientific core. ResearchClawBench provides a reproducible evaluation frontier for measuring progress toward autonomous scientific research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ResearchClawBench 是一个用于评估端到端自主科学研究能力的基准，包含来自10个科学领域的40个任务，每个任务基于真实发表的论文并提供相关文献和原始数据。作者评估了多个自主研究代理和原生大语言模型，发现当前系统远未达到可靠的重新发现水平，最强者仅得分为21.5和20.7。
Motivation: 现有AI编程代理越来越多地用于科学工作，但其端到端的自主研究能力难以验证，需要一个标准化的基准来评估。
Method: 构建了包含40个任务的基准，每个任务基于真实论文，隐藏目标论文并利用专家策划的多模态评估量规，通过加权标准评估目标论文级别的重新发现。
Result: 最强自主代理Claude Code平均得分为21.5，最强ResearchHarness大语言模型Claude-Opus-4.7平均得分为20.7，LLM前沿平均得分仅为26.5；错误集中在实验协议不匹配、证据不匹配和缺少科学核心。
Conclusion: ResearchClawBench 提供了一个可重复的评估前沿，用于衡量自主科学研究的进展，但当前系统在可靠性上仍有很大差距。

papers.title: Unsupervised Semantic Segmentation Facilitates Model Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has produced a diverse landscape of vision transformers (ViTs) whose pretrained representations support a wide range of downstream tasks. Towards a better understanding of these models, a body of work has assessed the mechanics of their self-attention as well as the types of information captured across their representations, revealing, for example, stark differences between models trained with contrastive learning (CL) and masked image modeling (MIM). However, the total of these advances on model understanding has to date not yet fully permeated a larger community, where, e.g., insights that are specific to CL models are still at times generalized to MIM models. To make model understanding straightforward and intuitive for a broad community, we propose a simple and easily interpretable visualization protocol. Our protocol is based on visualizing unsupervised semantic segmentation results, yet by no means do we focus on top segmentation performance. Instead, our protocol allows us to easily convey model behavior that consistently emerges across images. Benchmarked on a diverse set of SSL models across layers and representations, our protocol allows us to gain novel insights into distinct positional biases and scaling behaviors, including, e.g., strong boundary artifacts in DINOv3-Large model tokens. These novel insights come on top of more easily conveying a range of previous findings. Our protocol further allows us to clearly visually convey and distinguish between positional effects and the closely related but distinct locality bias, the latter being much more extensively studied in the literature so far. Our protocol is publicly available, serving to catalyze further model understanding for a broad community.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文旨在通过无监督语义分割的可视化协议，直观地理解自监督视觉Transformer（ViT）的模型行为。该协议不追求分割性能，而是用于揭示不同层和表征中的位置偏差、尺度行为以及边界伪影等特征。研究在多种自监督学习模型上进行了基准测试，为模型理解提供了新视角。
Motivation: 现有自监督学习模型（如对比学习和掩码图像建模）的行为差异未被广泛理解，且社区中常将对比学习模型的结论泛化到掩码图像建模模型。需要一个简单直观的可视化方法来普及模型理解。
Method: 提出一种基于无监督语义分割的可视化协议，通过分割结果来展示模型在不同层和表征中的一致行为，而非追求最佳分割性能。
Result: 该协议在多种自监督模型上揭示了新颖的位置偏差和尺度行为，例如DINOv3-Large模型 token 中的强边界伪影，并清晰区分了位置效应和局域性偏差。
Conclusion: 该可视化协议为社区提供了一种直观的工具，有助于推动对自监督视觉Transformer的广泛理解。

papers.title: Gradient-Flow Optimization as Dynamic Random-Effects Inference: Testing and Early Stopping with Applications to Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Gradient-flow optimization is usually viewed as an algorithmic procedure for minimizing empirical loss, with training duration selected by validation or heuristic early stopping rules. We develop a statistical inference framework for gradient-flow training. We show that whenever fitted values evolve through a time-invariant positive semidefinite training operator, the output at each time is equivalent to the best linear unbiased predictor under a corresponding random-effects model. Training time then becomes a variance-component parameter governing variance reallocation from residual noise to structured signal. This turns two training decisions into inferential problems: whether training is needed becomes a variance-component test for signal beyond initialization, and how long to train becomes restricted maximum likelihood (REML) estimation of the training-time variance component. We show that the REML-guided early stopping rule selects the time at which optimized spectral losses become decorrelated from the training-operator eigenvalues. The asymptotic prediction optimality of the REML-guided early stopping time is established for fixed-design in-sample risk and random-design out-of-sample risk. Deep learning models in fixed-kernel gradient regimes provide canonical instantiations for our results. Numerical experiments and a UK Biobank proteomics application show competitive accuracy of the REML-guided early stopping time with reduced reliance on validation splits and repeated checkpoint evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将梯度流优化（gradient-flow optimization）视为动态随机效应推断（dynamic random-effects inference）的统计框架。作者证明当拟合值通过时不变半正定训练算子演化时，每个时刻的输出等价于对应随机效应模型下的最佳线性无偏预测。训练时间成为方差组分参数，控制残差噪声向结构化信号的方差重新分配。REML引导的早停规则选择优化谱损失与训练算子特征值解耦的时刻，并建立了渐近预测最优性。深度学习的固定核梯度回归是该框架的典型实例。
Motivation: 传统梯度流优化被视为经验损失最小化的算法过程，训练时长通过验证集或启发式早停规则确定，缺乏统计推断视角。作者希望将训练时长选择转化为统计推断问题，包括是否需要训练（方差组分检验）以及训练多久（REML估计）。
Method: 建立梯度流训练的输出与随机效应模型之间的等价关系，将训练时间视为方差组分参数，提出基于REML的早停规则，该规则选择优化谱损失与训练算子特征值解耦的时刻。
Result: 摘要报告REML引导的早停时间在固定设计样本内风险与随机设计样本外风险下具有渐近预测最优性。数值实验和UK Biobank蛋白质组学应用表明，该方法在减少验证集依赖和重复检查点评估的同时，达到竞争性精度。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个将梯度流训练决策转化为统计推断问题的通用框架，REML早停规则具有理论最优性和实际有效性，但当前分析限于固定核梯度回归设置，未涉及深度学习中更复杂的自适应训练动力学。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Unified Framework for the Evaluation of LLM Agentic Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs are increasingly deployed as agents, reliable assessment of their agentic capabilities has become essential. However, reported benchmark scores often jointly reflect model capability and the implementation choices each benchmark is packaged with, making cross-benchmark results difficult to interpret as clean measurements of the underlying model. In this work, we present a unified framework for the fair evaluation of LLM agentic capabilities. Driven by a unified configuration system, the framework integrates diverse benchmarks into a standardized instruction-tool-environment format, executes agents through a fixed ReAct-style architecture within a controllable sandbox, and provides an optional offline setting that replaces volatile live environments with curated snapshots, so that framework effects and environment effects can be analyzed separately. Building on this, we unify the evaluation methodology under each benchmark's original task-success criteria, while introducing unified metrics for resource consumption and a taxonomy for decision- and execution-level failure attribution. Within this framework, we adapt 7 widely used benchmarks spanning 24 domains across single-agent, multi-agent, and safety-critical scenarios, and conduct a large-scale empirical analysis over 400K rollouts and 5B tokens on 15 models. The results show that scaffold choice and environmental volatility materially shift benchmark outcomes in both directions, allowing our framework to disentangle intrinsic LLM capabilities from framework- and environment-induced artifacts. We further demonstrate its extensibility as a secure testbed for safety-critical domains. Codes and benchmarks at are available at https://github.com/whfeLingYu/A-Unified-Framework-for-the-Evaluation-of-LLM-Agentic-Capabilities, https://huggingface.co/datasets/whfeLingYu/Unified_Agent_Framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的框架，用于公平评估LLM的代理能力（agentic capabilities）。该框架通过统一配置系统，将多种基准测试整合为标准化的指令-工具-环境格式，并在可控沙箱中使用固定ReAct架构执行代理，同时提供离线设置以隔离框架和环境效应。基于该框架，作者整合了7个广泛使用的基准测试（涵盖24个领域，包括单代理、多代理和安全关键场景），并在15个模型上进行了大规模实证分析（超过40万次rollout和50亿token）。结果表明，脚手架选择和环境波动会显著改变基准结果，该框架能够将LLM的内在能力与框架和环境引入的伪影分离开来。
Motivation: 现有的LLM代理能力评估中，基准分数常常共同反映模型能力和各基准的特定实现选择，导致跨基准结果难以解释为模型能力的纯净度量。
Method: 提出一个统一的评估框架，包含：统一配置系统（将不同基准标准化为指令-工具-环境格式）、固定ReAct架构的执行沙箱、可选的离线设置（用静态快照替代动态环境），以及统一的资源消耗指标和决策/执行级故障分类法。
Result: 在15个模型、400K次rollout和50B token上的实验表明，脚手架选择和环境波动会显著改变基准结果，该框架能有效分离LLM内在能力与框架及环境引入的伪影。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种更公平的LLM代理能力评估方式，并可作为安全关键领域的可扩展测试平台。

papers.title: Enabling KV Caching of Shared Prefix for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Key-value (KV) caching for shared prefixes is essential for high-throughput large language model (LLM) serving, but it faces critical challenges in emerging diffusion language models (DLMs). In DLMs, bidirectional attention means that updating any token dynamically alters the entire context and its corresponding KVs. Thus, existing caching techniques developed for LLMs, which assume that KVs remain invariant once computed, corrupt the shared prefix KVs. Our experiments show that applying these techniques to DLMs causes model accuracy to collapse to near zero. To unlock high-throughput DLM serving, we propose bidirectional prefix caching, bicache, the first KV caching technique for shared prefixes in DLMs. bicache is designed based on key observations from our comprehensive analysis: shared prefix KVs remain stable and reusable in shallow layers, while the depth of shallow layers depends on the fraction of shared prefix tokens in each request. Thus, bicache dynamically identifies a safe layer depth for reusing shared prefix KVs and eliminates redundant computation. Evaluations demonstrate that bicache significantly improves serving throughput by 36.3%-98.3% compared to existing techniques without accuracy collapse (only 0-1.8% difference).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散语言模型（DLM）中共享前缀的KV缓存问题，提出双向前缀缓存（bicache）。传统LLM的KV缓存方法在DLM上会导致模型准确率崩溃至接近零，因为DLM的双向注意力使KV动态变化。bicache基于关键观察：共享前缀KV在浅层保持稳定可复用，且浅层深度取决于每个请求中共享前缀令牌的比例。bicache动态识别安全层深度以复用KV，消除冗余计算。实验表明，bicache将服务吞吐量提升36.3%-98.3%，且准确率仅下降0-1.8%。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存技术假设KV一旦计算即保持不变，但扩散语言模型的双向注意力导致KV随上下文动态更新，直接应用这些技术会使模型准确率崩溃，亟需针对DLM的共享前缀KV缓存方法。
Method: 提出bicache，基于两个关键观察：共享前缀KV在浅层保持稳定；浅层深度与共享前缀令牌比例相关。bicache动态计算安全层深度的阈值，在该深度以上复用共享前缀KV，以下重新计算。
Result: 在DLM服务中，bicache相比现有技术将吞吐量提升36.3%-98.3%，且准确率仅下降0-1.8%，避免准确率崩溃。
Conclusion: bicache首次为扩散语言模型实现共享前缀KV缓存，证明通过动态识别安全层深度可在不牺牲准确率的前提下大幅提升吞吐量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CaST-Bench: Benchmarking Causal Chain-Grounded Spatio-Temporal Reasoning for Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Cause-and-effect reasoning in video is a significant challenge for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), as it requires going beyond surface-level perception to a deeper understanding of causal mechanisms. However, existing benchmarks rarely provide the fine-grained, grounded evidence needed to rigorously evaluate this capability. To address this gap, we introduce CaST-Bench, a benchmark for Causal Chain-Grounded Spatio-Temporal Video Reasoning. CaST-Bench presents complex causal questions that require models to identify and localize a chain of multiple spatio-temporal evidences. Through a human-AI collaborative pipeline, we construct a high-quality dataset of 2,066 questions over 1,015 videos, with causal chains annotated by temporal segments and bounding-box tracks. Furthermore, we design a comprehensive evaluation suite with novel metrics that assess not only answer correctness but also the capability for visual evidence grounded reasoning. This grounding is crucial for improving accuracy by mitigating spurious correlations and for enhancing user trust by making models more transparent. Our experiments show that current VLMs struggle with causal questions, largely due to their limited ability to construct precise and grounded causal chains. This highlights an important direction for improving future VLMs. Homepage: https://woven-by-toyota.github.io/CaST-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CaST-Bench，一个用于视频问答中因果链接地时空推理的基准。通过人机协作构建包含2,066个问题和1,015个视频的数据集，因果链由时间片段与边界框轨迹注释。实验表明当前视觉语言模型在因果问题上表现困难，主要受限于无法构建精确接地的因果链。
Motivation: 现有视频问答基准缺乏细粒度的接地证据来严格评估因果关系推理能力，亟需一个能显式要求模型定位多步时空证据的评测环境。
Method: 采用人机协作管线构建高质量数据集，每个问题关联一个由时间片段和边界框轨迹组成的因果链。设计综合评估套件，包含答案正确性指标以及衡量视觉证据接地能力的新指标。
Result: 当前主流视觉语言模型在CaST-Bench上表现不佳，尤其在需要构建精确接地因果链的问题上显著落后，表明现有模型在因果链时空推理方面存在根本性局限。
Conclusion: 该基准揭示了提升VLM因果链接地推理能力的重要性，为未来模型改进提供了明确方向。

papers.title: Winner-Take-All bottlenecks enforce disentangled symbolic representations in multi-task learning
authors: Robert Legenstein (1) ((1) Graz University of Technology)
papers.abstract_en: Winner-take-all (WTA) networks constitute a central circuit motif in cortical networks of the brain. In addition, WTA-like activations are abundant in modern deep learning models in the form of the softmax activation for example in attention layers of transformers. While their role in the extraction of latent factors has been studied for relatively simple generative models, their role in the context of highly non-linearly entangled latent factors has remained elusive. In this article, we show that a WTA bottleneck within a deep neural network can enforce under certain well-defined conditions the extraction of categorical latent factors of the data in a multi-task learning setup. In particular, we prove that the representation that emerges in the WTA bottleneck is highly symbolic, where a single neuron or a population of neurons encodes the presence of a single abstract feature such as a specific object, color, or position. We furthermore show empirically on two datasets, that this also holds for architectures and setups that do not fully comply with the assumptions of our theorem and demonstrate the advantages of the acquired symbolic representation for generalization. Our proposed model provides insights into the generalization capabilities of deep neural networks with WTA-like components and may serve as an interface between symbolic and subsymbolic AI systems.
papers.comment: We have revised the theorem and its proof. We have also corrected some minor errors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究胜者全拿（WTA）瓶颈在多任务学习中如何强制学习解耦的符号表示。理论上证明在特定条件下，WTA瓶颈中的单个或一组神经元编码单个抽象特征（如物体、颜色、位置）。实验在两个人造数据集上验证了该性质，即使架构不完全符合定理假设，也表现出符号化表示的泛化优势。
Motivation: 虽然WTA激活（如softmax）在深度学习中广泛使用，但其在高非线性纠缠的潜在因子提取中的作用尚不明确。
Method: 在深度神经网络中引入WTA瓶颈，并给出正式定理条件，证明该瓶颈能迫使网络学习解耦的符号化表示。
Result: 理论证明表示是高度符号化的，每个神经元或神经元群体对应一个具体抽象特征；实验表明即使在偏离定理假设的设置下，符号表示仍成立且带来更好的泛化。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了含WTA组件的深度神经网络的泛化能力，并可能作为符号与子符号AI系统之间的接口。

papers.title: A Simplex Witness Certificate and Escape Force for Constant Collapse in Variational Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: We study exact constant collapse in variational autoencoders: the deterministic encoder mean becomes independent of the input. The prior remains the standard Gaussian. Before VAE training, we select a fixed teacher posterior from a GMM-based view of the data and attach a fixed latent-only simplex witness to the encoder mean. This construction yields two linked objects. The first is a certificate: if the witness prediction improves on the best constant predictor of the teacher, the encoder mean cannot be input-independent constant. The second is a local escape direction: on the collapsed manifold, the teacher residual gives a sample-dependent descent direction for the alignment loss. For any full-support teacher posterior, the same geometry also gives a closed-form latent code with zero teacher-witness alignment error. Its scaled versions trace a margin-energy path from the constant predictor to the exact teacher code, which quantifies non-collapse inside the protected witness subspace. We instantiate the method on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100. With searched unsupervised PCA-GMM teachers, vanilla VAEs fail the teacher-witness certificate in all five seeds on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, while RST variants pass in all five seeds. Under collapse-stress settings with \(β_{\mathrm{KL}}\in\{2,4,8\}\), vanilla VAE again fails in all seeds, whereas RST-alpha-prefit remains certificate-positive. Escape trajectories on both natural-image datasets increase the witness margin from a low-margin initialization and exhibit nonzero teacher-induced gradient norms. The analysis is confined to exact constant collapse of the encoder mean; generation quality, decoder use, and other collapse modes remain separate questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究变分自编码器（VAE）中编码器均值与输入无关的精确常数塌缩问题。通过构造基于GMM教师后验的单纯形证人（simplex witness），提出一种证人证书（witness certificate）用于检测塌缩，以及一种逃逸力（escape force）用于提供局部下降方向。在MNIST、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的实验表明，普通VAE在多数设置下无法通过证人证书，而RST变体（如RST-alpha-prefit）可以保持证书阳性。
Motivation: VAE训练中编码器均值可能退化为常数，导致潜在表示失效，但缺乏理论工具来准确检测和逃离这一塌缩。
Method: 在训练前选定基于GMM的固定教师后验，并将一个固定的单纯形证人附加到编码器均值上。证人预测若优于最佳常数预测，则证明编码器均值未塌缩；在塌缩流形上，教师残差提供对齐损失的样本依赖下降方向。
Result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，普通VAE在所有5个随机种子下均未通过证人证书，而RST变体全部通过；在β_KL∈{2,4,8}的塌缩应力设置下，普通VAE全部失败，RST-alpha-prefit保持证书阳性。逃逸轨迹从低边际初始化开始增加证人边际，且教师诱导梯度范数非零。
Conclusion: 该方法仅针对编码器均值的精确常数塌缩，生成质量、解码器使用及其他塌缩模式是独立问题。

papers.title: See Silhouettes in Motion with Neuromorphic Vision
papers.abstract_en: Quasi-bimodal objects, such as text, road signs, and barcodes, play a basic yet vital role in daily visual communication. By boiling these down to clear silhouettes, binarization uses a minimal language to convey essential vision cues for maximum downstream efficiency, especially for tasks that require simple geometric, topological reasoning rather than heavy appearance modeling. The catch is that frame-based imaging often struggles on mobile platforms like drones, self-driving cars, and underwater vehicles, in which rapid motion causes severe motion blur and harsh lighting washes out scene details. To overcome these physical limits, neuromorphic vision via event cameras, featuring microsecond time resolution and high dynamic range, steps in as a natural solution. Building upon this event-driven paradigm, we propose a simple yet effective dual-modal approach that harnesses the synergy between frames and events for training-free, real-time, high-frame-rate binarization on CPU-only devices. Extensive evaluations show that it earns competitive performance against leading techniques in reducing blur artifacts and delivers impressive improvements under challenging illumination at a lower computational cost. Besides, its asynchronous nature bypasses long-standing event-scarcity issues that break traditional time-binning reconstruction at fixed time slots, maintaining clear target shapes even at extreme kilohertz frame rates. Its binary results further serve as reliable representations to facilitate a range of downstream tasks. This work paves the way towards lightweight perception and interaction in embodied intelligence on resource-constrained edge platforms.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 15 figures, and 5 tables. This work is under review. Project page: https://github.com/pz-even/event_binarization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于神经形态视觉（事件相机）的无训练、实时、高帧率二值化方法，用于处理准双模态对象（如文本、路标、条形码）在快速运动或光照不良场景下的二值化问题。该方法利用帧与事件的协同作用，在CPU上实现高性能，在模糊伪影减少和极端光照条件下表现优异，并支持异步千赫兹帧率输出。
Motivation: 传统帧式相机在移动平台（无人机、自动驾驶汽车等）上因运动模糊和光照变化导致二值化困难，而事件相机具有微秒时间分辨率和宽动态范围，能够克服这些物理限制。
Method: 提出一种双模态方法，结合帧与事件进行无训练、实时、高帧率二值化，利用事件的异步特性避免传统时间分箱重构的事件稀疏问题，在CPU上即可运行。
Result: 与领先技术相比，该方法在减少模糊伪影方面取得竞争性性能，在挑战性光照下显著改善，且计算成本更低；在千赫兹帧率下仍能保持清晰目标形状，并支持下游任务。
Conclusion: 该工作为资源受限边缘平台上轻量级感知与交互奠定了基础，但仅针对准双模态对象的二值化，未涉及通用图像二值化或复杂纹理场景。
