papers.title: GenHOI: Generalized Hand-Object Pose Estimation with Occlusion Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Generalized 3D hand-object pose estimation from a single RGB image remains challenging due to the large variations in object appearances and interaction patterns, especially under heavy occlusion. We propose GenHOI, a framework for generalized hand-object pose estimation with occlusion awareness. GenHOI integrates hierarchical semantic knowledge with hand priors to enhance model generalization under challenging occlusion conditions. Specifically, we introduce a hierarchical semantic prompt that encodes object states, hand configurations, and interaction patterns via textual descriptions. This enables the model to learn abstract high-level representations of hand-object interactions for generalization to unseen objects and novel interactions while compensating for missing or ambiguous visual cues. To enable robust occlusion reasoning, we adopt a multi-modal masked modeling strategy over RGB images, predicted point clouds, and textual descriptions. Moreover, we leverage hand priors as stable spatial references to extract implicit interaction constraints. This allows reliable pose inference even under significant variations in object shapes and interaction patterns. Extensive experiments on the challenging DexYCB and HO3Dv2 benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in hand-object pose estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenHOI 是一个从单张 RGB 图像中估计手和物体三维姿态的通用框架，重点处理严重遮挡场景。它通过层次语义提示（编码物体状态、手部配置和交互模式）和多模态掩码建模策略，结合手部先验作为稳定空间参考，提升对未见物体和新交互的泛化能力。在 DexYCB 和 HO3Dv2 基准上达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: 单张 RGB 图像中手物三维姿态估计因物体外观和交互模式变化大、遮挡严重而泛化困难，现有方法难以处理未知物体和新交互。
Method: 提出层次语义提示（由文本描述编码物体状态、手部配置和交互模式）和多模态掩码建模（RGB图像、预测点云、文本描述），并利用手部先验作为稳定空间参考提取隐式交互约束。
Result: 在 DexYCB 和 HO3Dv2 基准上实现 SOTA 性能，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: GenHOI 通过层次语义提示和多模态掩码建模有效提升了手物姿态估计在遮挡和泛化场景下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Adaptive Contracts for Cost-Effective AI Delegation
papers.abstract_en: When organizations delegate text generation tasks to AI providers via pay-for-performance contracts, expected payments rise when evaluation is noisy. As evaluation methods become more elaborate, the economic benefits of decreased noise are often overshadowed by increased evaluation costs. In this work, we introduce adaptive contracts for AI delegation, which allow detailed evaluation to be performed selectively after observing an initial coarse signal in order to conserve resources. We make three sets of contributions: First, we provide efficient algorithms for computing optimal adaptive contracts under natural assumptions or when core problem dimensions are small, and prove hardness of approximation in the general unstructured case. We then formulate alternative models of randomized adaptive contracts and discuss their benefits and limitations. Finally, we empirically demonstrate the benefits of adaptivity over non-adaptive baselines using question-answering and code-generation datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究组织通过按绩效付费合约委托AI文本生成任务时，如何通过自适应合约在噪声评估与评估成本之间取得平衡。作者提出在观察到初始粗糙信号后选择性执行详细评估，以节省资源，并给出最优自适应合约的高效算法、随机变体模型以及实验验证。
Motivation: 现有按绩效付费合约中，评估噪声导致预期支付增加，而精细评估成本高昂，两者之间存在权衡。
Method: 引入自适应合约，允许根据初始粗信号决定是否进行详细评估；提出计算最优合约的高效算法（在自然假设或问题维度小时），并证明一般无结构情况下的近似难度；还提出了随机自适应合约模型。
Result: 在问答和代码生成数据集上，自适应合约相比非自适应基线显著降低了成本。
Conclusion: 自适应合约能有效降低AI委托中的总成本，但一般情况下的最优计算是困难的。

papers.title: EPOFusion: Exposure aware Progressive Optimization Method for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Overexposure caused by strong daylight and oncoming headlights frequently overwhelms visible sensors, resulting in critical information loss in visual perception. Infrared and visible image fusion can compensate for such degradation via multimodal complementarity. However, most fusion methods lack region-aware optimization for overexposed areas and cannot effectively exploit infrared cues in saturated regions, resulting in insufficient infrared detail preservation or redundant information in the fused results. To address this, we propose EPOFusion, an exposure-aware fusion framework. It uses a spatial guidance module to selectively preserve informative infrared cues in overexposed regions. In addition, an iterative decoding head equipped with a multiscale context fusion module progressively refines fused representations, enabling effective infrared compensation in degraded regions while maintaining visual consistency in normal regions. The infrared and visible overexposure (IVOE) dataset is constructed with a synthetic training subset for controlled supervision and a real-world test subset for generalization assessment, supporting exposure-aware learning and evaluation. Extensive experiments on MSRS, FMB, and the proposed IVOE benchmark show that EPOFusion improves information preservation and visual fidelity, achieving an average full-image MI gain of 28.7% over the best competing methods. Qualitative results further demonstrate effective compensation in saturated regions, and downstream evaluations confirm its benefits under challenging overexposed conditions. Code, results, and the IVOE dataset will be made available at https://github.com/warren-wzw/EPOFusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EPOFusion，一种曝光感知的红外与可见光图像融合框架，通过空间引导模块和迭代解码头在过曝区域选择性保留红外信息，并构建了红外可见光过曝数据集IVOE。实验表明在MSRS、FMB和IVOE上，平均全图互信息增益达28.7%。
Motivation: 现有融合方法缺乏对过曝区域的区域感知优化，无法有效利用红外线索，导致红外细节保留不足或冗余。
Method: 提出EPOFusion，包括空间引导模块选择性地保留过曝区域的红外信息，以及配备多尺度上下文融合模块的迭代解码头逐步细化融合表示，同时构建IVOE数据集支持曝光感知学习。
Result: 在MSRS、FMB和IVOE上，平均全图互信息增益比最佳方法高28.7%，定性结果和下游评估也证明了有效性。
Conclusion: 本文的曝光感知框架可以有效补偿过曝区域的信息损失，提升融合结果的信息保留和视觉保真度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Federated Conformal Prediction with Group-Conditional Guarantee
papers.abstract_en: Deploying trustworthy AI systems requires principled uncertainty quantification. Conformal prediction (CP) is a widely used framework for constructing prediction sets with distribution-free coverage guarantees. In many practical settings, including healthcare, finance, and mobile sensing, the calibration data required for CP are distributed across multiple clients, each with its own local data distribution. In this federated setting, data can often be partitioned into, potentially overlapping, groups, which may reflect client-specific strata or cross-cutting attributes such as demographic or semantic categories. We propose group-conditional federated conformal prediction (GC-FCP), a federated extension of conditional conformal calibration for a target mixture over prespecified groups. GC-FCP constructs mergeable, atom-stratified coresets from local calibration scores, enabling compact aggregation at the server when the number of active atoms is moderate. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets validate the performance of GC-FCP compared to centralized calibration baselines. The code of our work can be found at https://github.com/HaifengWen/GC-FCP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习中共形预测（conformal prediction）的组条件覆盖保证问题，提出GC-FCP方法。该方法构建可合并的原子分层coreset，在服务器端实现紧凑聚合，并在合成和真实数据集上验证了与集中式基线相当的性能。
Motivation: 在联邦设置中，校准数据分布在多个客户端，且数据常按组（如人口统计或语义类别）划分。现有共形预测方法未提供组条件的覆盖保证，限制了其在高风险场景（如医疗、金融）中的应用。
Method: 提出组条件联邦共形预测（GC-FCP），通过构建可合并的原子分层coreset，从本地校准分数中提取紧凑表示，并在服务器端聚合，以实现对指定组混合目标的组条件覆盖保证。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，GC-FCP的覆盖率和效率接近集中式校准基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调GC-FCP为联邦共形预测提供了组条件保证，并展示了其有效性，但未讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Experiments to Expertise: Scientific Knowledge Consolidation for AI-Driven Computational Physics
papers.abstract_en: While large language models (LLMs) have transformed AI agents into proficient executors of computational materials science, performing a hundred simulations does not make a researcher. What distinguishes research from routine execution is the progressive accumulation of knowledge - learning which approaches fail, recognizing patterns across systems, and applying understanding to new problems. However, the prevailing paradigm in AI-driven computational science treats each execution in isolation, largely discarding hard-won insights between runs. Here we present QMatSuite, an open-source platform closing this gap. Agents record findings with full provenance, retrieve knowledge before new calculations, and in dedicated reflection sessions correct erroneous findings and synthesize observations into cross-compound patterns. In benchmarks on a six-step quantum-mechanical simulation workflow, accumulated knowledge reduces reasoning overhead by 67% and improves accuracy from 47% to 3% deviation from literature - and when transferred to an unfamiliar material, achieves 1% deviation with zero pipeline failures.
papers.comment: v2: camera-ready version, accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on AI for Physics (AI4Physics@ICML 2026). 20 pages, 6 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QMatSuite平台，用于在AI驱动的计算材料科学中积累和复用实验知识。通过记录发现、检索知识、反思修正等步骤，平台在量子力学模拟工作流上减少了推理开销并提高了准确率，并展示了跨材料迁移的潜力。
Motivation: 当前AI计算科学中每次实验孤立进行，难以积累跨运行的知识，限制了研究能力的提升。
Method: QMatSuite平台：智能体记录结果与完整溯源，新计算前检索已有知识，并通过反思会话纠正错误、综合跨体系模式。
Result: 在六步量子力学模拟基准上，知识积累使推理开销降低67%，准确率从47%偏差降至3%；迁移到未知材料时，偏差降至1%且管道零故障。
Conclusion: 该方法能有效累积科学知识，提升AI在计算材料学中的研究效率与迁移能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SGMatch: Semantic-Guided Non-Rigid Shape Matching with Flow Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Establishing accurate point-to-point correspondences between non-rigid 3D shapes remains a critical challenge, particularly under non-isometric deformations and topological noise. Existing functional map pipelines suffer from ambiguities that geometric descriptors alone cannot resolve, and spatial inconsistencies inherent in the projection of truncated spectral bases to dense pointwise correspondences. In this paper, we introduce SGMatch, a learning-based framework that couples 3D-lifted semantic cues with trajectory-level feature transport regularization. Specifically, we design a Semantic-Guided Local Cross-Attention module that integrates semantic features from vision foundation models into geometric descriptors while preserving local structural continuity. Furthermore, we adapt conditional flow matching as a time-conditioned feature transport regularizer that promotes spatially coherent point-wise recovery. Experimental results on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SGMatch achieves competitive performance across near-isometric settings and consistent improvements under non-isometric deformations and topological noise.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 13 figures, 17 tables. Project Page: https://yetianwei.github.io/SGMatch/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SGMatch，一种结合语义引导与流正则化的非刚性3D形状匹配框架。通过引入视觉基础模型的语义特征和条件流匹配正则化，提升了非等距变形和拓扑噪声下的匹配性能。
Motivation: 现有功能映射方法在非等距变形和拓扑噪声下易产生歧义，几何描述符无法解决，且光谱基投影到稠密对应时存在空间不一致。
Method: 设计语义引导局部交叉注意力模块，将视觉基础模型的语义特征融入几何描述符，并采用条件流匹配作为时间条件特征传输正则化，促进空间一致的点对应恢复。
Result: 在多个基准上，SGMatch在近等距设置下取得有竞争力性能，并在非等距变形和拓扑噪声下实现一致改进。
Conclusion: 语义引导和流正则化结合能有效提升非刚性形状匹配的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WikiCLIP: An Efficient Contrastive Baseline for Open-domain Visual Entity Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Open-domain visual entity recognition (VER) seeks to associate images with entities in encyclopedic knowledge bases such as Wikipedia. Recent generative methods tailored for VER demonstrate strong performance but incur high computational costs, limiting their scalability and practical deployment. In this work, we revisit the contrastive paradigm for VER and introduce WikiCLIP, a simple yet effective framework that establishes a strong and efficient baseline for open-domain VER. WikiCLIP leverages large language model embeddings as knowledge-rich entity representations and enhances them with a Vision-Guided Knowledge Adaptor (VGKA) that aligns textual semantics with visual cues at the patch level. To further encourage fine-grained discrimination, a Hard Negative Synthesis Mechanism generates visually similar but semantically distinct negatives during training. Experimental results on popular open-domain VER benchmarks, such as OVEN, demonstrate that WikiCLIP significantly outperforms strong baselines. Specifically, WikiCLIP achieves a 16\% improvement on the challenging OVEN unseen set, while reducing inference latency by nearly 100 times compared with the leading generative model, AutoVER. The project page is available at https://artanic30.github.io/project_pages/WikiCLIP/
papers.comment: Accepted by CVPR26, codes and weights are publicly available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WikiCLIP，一个基于对比学习的开放域视觉实体识别框架，利用大语言模型嵌入作为知识丰富的实体表示，并通过视觉引导知识适配器在patch级别对齐文本语义与视觉线索，同时采用硬负样本合成机制提升细粒度判别能力。实验表明，在OVEN基准上，WikiCLIP在未见类别集上提升16%，推理延迟比生成模型AutoVER降低近100倍。
Motivation: 现有生成式视觉实体识别方法性能强但计算成本高，限制了实际部署，因此需要一种高效且性能相当的对比学习基线。
Method: 使用大语言模型嵌入作为实体表示，提出视觉引导知识适配器在patch级别对齐视觉与文本语义，并设计硬负样本合成机制生成视觉相似但语义不同的负样本以加强训练。
Result: 在OVEN基准上，WikiCLIP在未见类别集上提升16%，推理延迟比AutoVER降低近100倍。
Conclusion: WikiCLIP为开放域视觉实体识别提供了一个简单有效的对比学习基线，兼具高性能和高效性，但未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Restoring Linguistic Grounding in VLA Models via Train-Free Attention Recalibration
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to perform manipulation tasks directly from natural language instructions and are increasingly viewed as a foundation for generalist robotic policies. However, their reliability under Out-of-Distribution (OOD) instructions remains underexplored. In this paper, we reveal a critical failure mode in which VLA policies continue executing visually plausible actions even when the language instruction contradicts the scene. We refer to this phenomenon as linguistic blindness, where VLA policies prioritize visual priors over instruction semantics during action generation. To systematically analyze this issue, we introduce ICBench, a diagnostic benchmark constructed from the LIBERO dataset that probes language-action coupling by injecting controlled OOD instruction contradictions while keeping the visual environment unchanged. Evaluations on three representative VLA architectures, including Pi0, Pi0.5 and OpenVLA OFT, show that these models frequently succeed at tasks despite logically impossible instructions, revealing a strong visual bias in action generation. To mitigate this issue, we propose Instruction-Guided Attention Recalibration (IGAR), a train-free inference-time mechanism that rebalances attention distributions to restore the influence of language instructions. IGAR operates without retraining or architectural modification and can be directly applied to existing VLA models. Experiments across 30 LIBERO tasks demonstrate that IGAR substantially reduces erroneous execution under OOD contradictory instructions while preserving baseline task performance. We additionally validate the approach on a real Franka robotic arm, where IGAR effectively prevents manipulation triggered by inconsistent instructions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示VLA模型在指令与场景矛盾时存在“语言盲视”现象，即模型优先依赖视觉先验而非语言指令。提出训练无关的注意力重新校准机制IGAR，在不重训模型的情况下重新平衡注意力分布，恢复语言指令的影响。在LIBERO基准和真实机器人上验证了有效性。
Motivation: VLA模型在分布外指令下可靠性不足，尤其是当语言指令与场景矛盾时模型仍执行视觉上合理的动作，说明存在语言盲视问题，影响机器人策略的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出ICBench诊断基准和IGAR方法。ICBench通过注入矛盾指令测试语言-动作耦合；IGAR是一种无需训练的推理时注意力重新校准机制，通过调整注意力分布增强语言指令的影响。
Result: 在三个VLA架构（Pi0、Pi0.5、OpenVLA OFT）上，模型在矛盾指令下仍频繁成功执行任务，显示强视觉偏置。IGAR大幅减少矛盾指令下的错误执行，同时保持基线任务性能，并在真实Franka机械臂上验证。
Conclusion: VLA模型存在语言盲视问题，IGAR提供一种简单有效的修复方法，无需重训或架构修改，可提升模型对语言指令的遵循能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wiki-R1: Incentivizing Multimodal Reasoning for Knowledge-based VQA via Data and Sampling Curriculum
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) requires models to answer questions about an image by integrating external knowledge, posing significant challenges due to noisy retrieval and the structured, encyclopedic nature of the knowledge base. These characteristics create a distributional gap from pretrained multimodal large language models (MLLMs), making effective reasoning and domain adaptation difficult in the post-training stage. In this work, we propose \textit{Wiki-R1}, a data-generation-based curriculum reinforcement learning framework that systematically incentivizes reasoning in MLLMs for KB-VQA. Wiki-R1 constructs a sequence of training distributions aligned with the model's evolving capability, bridging the gap from pretraining to the KB-VQA target distribution. We introduce \textit{controllable curriculum data generation}, which manipulates the retriever to produce samples at desired difficulty levels, and a \textit{curriculum sampling strategy} that selects informative samples likely to yield non-zero advantages during RL updates. Sample difficulty is estimated using observed rewards and propagated to unobserved samples to guide learning. Experiments on two KB-VQA benchmarks, Encyclopedic VQA and InfoSeek, demonstrate that Wiki-R1 achieves new state-of-the-art results, improving accuracy from 35.5\% to 37.1\% on Encyclopedic VQA and from 40.1\% to 44.1\% on InfoSeek. The project page is available at https://artanic30.github.io/project_pages/WikiR1/.
papers.comment: Accepted by ICLR 26, code and weights are publicly available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Wiki-R1，一个基于数据生成的课程强化学习框架，用于激励多模态大语言模型在基于知识的视觉问答（KB-VQA）中的推理能力。通过可控课程数据生成和课程采样策略，在 Encyclopedic VQA 和 InfoSeek 两个基准上取得新 SOTA，准确率分别从 35.5% 提升至 37.1% 和从 40.1% 提升至 44.1%。
Motivation: KB-VQA 需要整合外部知识，但噪声检索和知识库的百科结构化特性导致与预训练 MLLM 的分布差距，使推理和领域适应困难。
Method: 提出 Wiki-R1 框架，包括可控课程数据生成（操纵检索器产生不同难度样本）和课程采样策略（选择可能产生非零优势的信息性样本），结合强化学习训练。
Result: 在 KB-VQA 基准上达到新 SOTA：Encyclopedic VQA 准确率 37.1%（提升 1.6%），InfoSeek 准确率 44.1%（提升 4.0%）。

papers.title: A Dual-Helix Governance Approach Towards Reliable Agentic Artificial Intelligence for WebGIS Development
papers.abstract_en: WebGIS development requires consistency, yet agentic AI often fails due to LLM context constraints, forgetting, stochasticity, instruction failure, and adaptation rigidity. We propose a dual-helix governance framework reframing these as structural problems rather than capacity deficits. Using a 3-track architecture (Knowledge, Behavior, Skills) and a persistent knowledge graph, it stabilizes execution by externalizing facts and enforcing protocols. Validation shows a governed agent successfully refactored a legacy WebGIS codebase (reducing cyclomatic complexity and improving maintainability), roughly halved trial-to-trial output variance relative to static prompting in a controlled experiment, and prevented common infodemic mapping errors in a 5-condition COVID-19 cartography ablation study. Operationalized via the open-source AgentLoom toolkit, this externalized governance provides the stability necessary for production-level geospatial engineering.
papers.comment: Paper submitted to and under review in Transactions in GIS

Method: 提出双螺旋治理框架，包含三轨道架构（Knowledge, Behavior, Skills）和持久知识图谱，通过外化事实和执行协议（externalized governance）来约束智能体行为，并开源实现AgentLoom。

Conclusion: 外化治理（externalized governance）为生产级地理空间工程提供了必要的稳定性，但适用范围限于WebGIS和类似领域。

papers.title: BRIGHT: A Collaborative Generalist-Specialist Foundation Model for Breast Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Generalist pathology foundation models (PFMs), pretrained on large-scale multi-organ datasets, have demonstrated remarkable predictive capabilities across diverse clinical applications. However, their proficiency on the full spectrum of clinically essential tasks within a specific organ system remains an open question due to the lack of large-scale validation cohorts for a single organ as well as the absence of a tailored training paradigm that can effectively translate broad histomorphological knowledge into the organ-specific expertise required for specialist-level interpretation. In this study, we propose BRIGHT, the first PFM specifically designed for breast pathology, trained on over 51,000 breast whole-slide images derived from a cohort of over 40,000 patients across 19 hospitals. BRIGHT employs a collaborative generalist-specialist framework to capture both universal and organ-specific features. To comprehensively evaluate the performance of PFMs on breast oncology, we curate the largest multi-institutional cohorts to date for downstream task development and evaluation, comprising over 25,000 WSIs across 10 hospitals. The validation cohorts cover the full spectrum of breast pathology across 25 distinct clinical tasks spanning diagnosis, biomarker prediction, treatment response and survival prediction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BRIGHT outperforms five leading generalist PFMs, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in 25 of 25 internal validation tasks and in 4 of 11 external validation tasks with excellent heatmap interpretability. By evaluating on large-scale validation cohorts, this study not only demonstrates BRIGHT's clinical utility in breast oncology but also validates a collaborative generalist-specialist paradigm, providing a scalable template for developing PFMs on a specific organ system, accelerating the translation of foundation models into ...
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BRIGHT，首个专为乳腺病理学设计的基础模型，基于超过51000张全切片图像（来自40,000+患者，19家医院）训练，采用协作通用-专家框架同时捕捉通用和器官特异性特征。在包含25个临床任务（涵盖诊断、生物标志物预测、治疗反应和生存预测）的最大规模多机构验证集上，BRIGHT在25/25内部任务和4/11外部任务上达到SOTA，并具有良好的热图可解释性。
Motivation: 现有的通用病理学基础模型在多器官数据上预训练，但在特定器官系统的全部临床必需任务上的能力尚不明确，缺乏单器官大规模验证集和针对器官特异性的训练范式。
Method: BRIGHT采用协作通用-专家框架，首先在大规模多器官数据上预训练通用特征，然后通过器官特异性微调或专家模块学习乳腺病理学特征。
Result: 在25个内部验证任务上全部达到SOTA，在11个外部验证任务中4个达到SOTA，优于5个领先的通用病理学基础模型。
Conclusion: BRIGHT验证了协作通用-专家范式在器官特异性病理学基础模型中的有效性，为其他器官系统开发类似模型提供了可扩展模板。

papers.title: Conformal Policy Control
papers.abstract_en: An agent must try new behaviors to explore and improve. In high-stakes environments, an agent that violates safety constraints may cause harm and must be taken offline, curtailing any future interaction. Imitating old behavior is safe, but excessive conservatism discourages exploration. How much behavior change is too much? We show how to use any safe reference policy as a probabilistic regulator for any optimized but untested policy. Conformal calibration on data from the safe policy determines how aggressively the new policy can act, while provably enforcing the user's declared risk tolerance. Unlike conservative optimization methods, we do not assume the user has identified the correct model class nor tuned any hyperparameters. Unlike previous conformal methods, our theory provides finite-sample guarantees even for non-monotonic bounded loss functions, and it introduces a new policy control setting. Our experiments on applications ranging from natural language question answering to biomolecular engineering show that safe exploration is not only possible from the first moment of deployment, but can also improve performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于共形校准的框架，利用任何安全参考策略作为概率调节器，控制新策略的行为变化程度，并保证用户指定的风险容忍度。该方法适用于高安全风险环境中的探索问题，不需要用户指定正确的模型类或调整超参数，且对非单调有界损失函数提供有限样本保证。实验涵盖自然语言问答和生物分子工程，表明安全探索从部署第一刻起即可实现并提升性能。
Motivation: 在高安全风险环境中，智能体探索可能违反安全约束，导致被迫下线。现有保守优化方法要求用户确定正确的模型类并调整超参数，而共形方法通常无法处理非单调损失函数。本文旨在提供一种无需这些假设的、可证明安全的行为控制方法。
Method: 使用任何安全参考策略作为概率调节器，通过共形校准（conformal calibration）在安全策略数据上校准新策略的激进程度，从而在有限样本下保证用户声明的风险容忍度。理论贡献包括对非单调有界损失函数的有限样本保证，并引入新的策略控制设置。
Result: 在自然语言问答和生物分子工程任务上的实验表明，该方法从部署第一刻起即可实现安全探索，并能够提升性能。
Conclusion: 本文提出的共形策略控制方法能在高安全风险环境中实现可证明安全且有效的探索，不依赖模型类正确指定或超参数调整，扩展了共形方法在策略控制中的应用。

papers.title: Recursive Models for Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Modern language models reason within bounded context, an inherent constraint that poses a fundamental barrier to long-horizon reasoning. We identify recursion as a core principle for overcoming this barrier, and propose recursive models as a minimal realization, where the model can recursively invoke itself to solve subtasks in isolated contexts. We prove that any computable problem admits a recursive decomposition of reasoning in which each subtask requires only exponentially smaller active context than standard autoregressive models; this strictly surpasses any context management approach confined to a single sequence, such as summarization. We further generalize our framework to modern agentic systems with arbitrary context processing and control flows, and prove that recursive models can achieve optimal power within this broader class. Experimentally, we test two settings: fine-tuning a pretrained base model for recursive SAT solving, and training a small model from scratch on Go traces generated by exact game-tree search. Both show improved long-horizon accuracy with small active contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出递归模型用于长程推理，模型可递归调用自身在隔离上下文中解决子任务。理论上证明任何可计算问题都存在递归分解，使每个子任务所需活动上下文指数级小于标准自回归模型，并超越摘要等单序列方法。实验在递归SAT求解和从零训练的Go轨迹上验证，在较小活动上下文下提升了长程准确率。
Motivation: 现代语言模型受限于有限上下文，难以处理长程推理任务；现有上下文管理方法（如摘要）受限于单序列，无法突破指数级上下文缩减。
Method: 提出递归模型，模型通过递归调用自身分解子任务，每个子任务在独立上下文中处理。理论分析其在可计算问题上的最优性，并扩展到现代智能体系统。实验包括微调预训练模型进行递归SAT求解，以及从零训练小模型在Go游戏树搜索轨迹上学习。
Result: 在SAT求解和Go轨迹实验中，递归模型在较小活动上下文下实现了更高的长程推理准确率，验证了理论优势。
Conclusion: 递归模型是实现长程推理的有效原则，理论上可达到任意上下文处理系统的最优能力，实际中通过小规模递归即可超越单序列方法。

papers.title: VaSST: Variational Inference for Symbolic Regression using Soft Symbolic Trees
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) has gained recent traction in AI-driven scientific discovery for learning closed-form physical laws. Yet existing methods are dominated by heuristic search or data-intensive approaches that often assume low-noise regimes and lack principled uncertainty quantification, while fully probabilistic SR formulations remain scarce. We introduce a scalable probabilistic framework for SR, VaSST, based on variational inference. VaSST uses soft symbolic trees, a continuous relaxation of symbolic expression trees in which discrete operator and feature assignments are replaced by probability distributions over allowable components. This transforms combinatorial symbolic search through an astronomically large expression space into efficient gradient-based optimization while preserving a coherent probabilistic interpretation. The learned soft representations induce posterior distributions over symbolic structures, enabling uncertainty quantification across plausible symbolic forms through posterior-aware symbolic model selection. On simulated experiments and the Feynman Symbolic Regression Database, VaSST achieves strong structural recovery and predictive accuracy compared to state-of-the-art competing SR methods.
papers.comment: 55 pages, 9 figures, 54 tables, Accepted at UAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VaSST，一个基于变分推断的可扩展概率符号回归框架。它使用软符号树（soft symbolic trees）将离散的符号表达式搜索转化为连续优化，并能够对符号结构进行不确定性量化。在模拟实验和费曼符号回归数据库上，与现有方法相比，VaSST 在结构恢复和预测准确性上表现良好。
Motivation: 现有符号回归方法主要依赖启发式搜索或数据密集型方法，通常假设低噪声环境，缺乏原则性的不确定性量化，而全概率的符号回归公式仍很稀缺。
Method: VaSST 基于变分推断，采用软符号树连续松弛离散的符号表达式树，将运算符和特征的离散分配替换为概率分布，从而将组合符号搜索转化为高效的梯度优化，同时保持概率解释。
Result: 在模拟实验和费曼符号回归数据库上，VaSST 在结构恢复和预测准确性方面优于现有符号回归方法。
Conclusion: VaSST 提供了一个可扩展的概率框架，能够进行不确定性量化，并适用于科学发现中的物理定律学习。

papers.title: Learning-based Multi-agent Race Strategies in Formula 1
papers.abstract_en: In Formula 1, race strategies are adapted according to evolving race conditions and competitors' actions. This paper proposes a reinforcement learning approach for multi-agent race strategy optimization. Agents learn to balance energy management, tire degradation, aerodynamic interaction, and pit-stop decisions. Building on a pre-trained single-agent policy, we introduce an interaction module that accounts for the behavior of competitors. The combination of the interaction module and a self-play training scheme generates competitive policies, and agents are ranked based on their relative performance. Results show that the agents adapt pit timing, tire selection, and energy allocation in response to opponents, achieving robust and consistent race performance. Because the framework relies only on information available during real races, it can support race strategists' decisions before and during races.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于强化学习(RL)的多智能体方法，用于优化F1比赛策略，包括能量管理、轮胎退化、空气动力学交互及进站决策。在预训练的单智能体策略基础上，引入交互模块以建模对手行为，并通过自我对弈训练产生竞争性策略，最终根据相对表现对智能体排序。实验表明，智能体能根据对手调整进站时机、轮胎选择和能量分配，实现稳健且一致的表现。由于框架仅依赖真实比赛中可用的信息，可支持赛前和赛中的策略决策。
Motivation: F1比赛策略需根据不断变化的比赛条件和对手动作实时调整，现有方法难以有效处理多智能体交互下的复杂优化问题。
Method: 基于预训练单智能体策略，添加一个考虑竞争者行为的交互模块，并结合自我对弈训练框架产生竞争性多智能体策略。
Result: 智能体在进站时机、轮胎选择和能量分配上自适应对手行为，达到稳健且一致的比赛表现。
Conclusion: 所提框架仅依赖真实比赛可用信息，能够支持赛车策略师的赛前及赛中决策。

papers.title: OmniGAIA: Towards Native Omni-Modal AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Human intelligence naturally intertwines omni-modal perception -- spanning vision, audio, and language -- with complex reasoning and tool usage to interact with the world. However, current multi-modal LLMs are primarily confined to bi-modal interactions (e.g., vision-language), lacking the unified cognitive capabilities required for general AI assistants. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniGAIA, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate omni-modal agents on tasks necessitating deep reasoning and multi-turn tool execution across video, audio, and image modalities. Constructed via a novel omni-modal event graph approach, OmniGAIA synthesizes complex, multi-hop queries derived from real-world data that require cross-modal reasoning and external tool integration. Furthermore, we propose OmniAtlas, a native omni-modal foundation agent under tool-integrated reasoning paradigm with active omni-modal perception. Trained on trajectories synthesized via a hindsight-guided tree exploration strategy and OmniDPO for fine-grained error correction, OmniAtlas effectively enhances the tool-use capabilities of existing open-source models. This work marks a step towards next-generation native omni-modal AI assistants for real-world scenarios.

papers.title: PreScience: A Dataset and Benchmark for Scientific Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Can AI systems trained on the existing scientific record forecast the advances that will follow? We introduce PreScience, a dataset and benchmark for scientific forecasting built around 98K recent AI research papers, together with companion papers covering author publication histories and citation links, yielding 502K papers in total. The resulting paper records include titles, abstracts, disambiguated author identities, influential references, topic labels, citation trajectories, and metadata snapshotted to respect temporal cutoffs. We instantiate seven exemplar tasks: five paper-anchored tasks -- contribution generation, collaborator prediction, prior work selection, citation count prediction, and future combination prediction -- and two aggregate topic trend forecasting variants. We develop baselines ranging from simple heuristics and embedding methods to frontier language models and agentic systems, and introduce LACER, an LLM-based metric for evaluating similarity of generated contribution descriptions that agrees better with human judgments than existing metrics. Finally, we compose task models to generate a 12-month synthetic corpus and find that the resulting papers are systematically less diverse and less novel than human-authored research from the same period. We release the PreScience dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/prescience) and code (https://github.com/allenai/prescience).
papers.comment: 11 pages (70 with bibliography and appendix), 3 figures (14 with appendix), 5 tables (18 with appendix), 1 algorithm in appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了PreScience，一个围绕9.8万篇AI研究论文及其关联数据构建的科学预测数据集与基准，包含502K篇论文。定义了七项预测任务（如贡献生成、合作者预测、引文预测等），并基于简单基线、嵌入方法、前沿语言模型及智能体系统建立基线。同时提出了LACER指标用于评估生成贡献描述的相似性。实验发现，生成语料库的多样性和新颖性低于同期人类论文。
Motivation: 现有AI系统能否基于已有科学记录预测未来科学进展尚不清楚，缺乏标准化的科学预测数据集与评估基准。
Method: 构建PreScience数据集，包含98K篇AI论文及作者、引文等关联数据；定义七项预测任务；采用多种基线方法（从简单启发式到大语言模型）；提出LACER评估指标。
Result: 生成语料库的多样性和新颖性低于同期人类论文，表明当前模型在科学预测中仍存在不足。
Conclusion: PreScience为科学预测提供了标准化的数据和评估框架，但生成模型的预测能力仍有限。

papers.title: $μ$pscaling small models: Principled warm starts and hyperparameter transfer
papers.abstract_en: Modern large-scale neural networks are often trained and released in multiple sizes to accommodate diverse inference budgets. To improve efficiency, recent work has explored model upscaling: initializing larger models from trained smaller ones to accelerate convergence. However, this method can be sensitive to hyperparameters that need to be tuned at the target upscaled model size, which is prohibitively costly to do directly. It remains unclear whether tuning hyperparameters on smaller models and extrapolating via scaling laws is sound in this setting. We address this with principled approaches to width-based upscaling and efficient hyperparameter tuning in this setting. Motivated by $μ$P and any-dimensional architectures, we introduce a general upscaling method that, like Net2Net, copies and perturbs weights, but uses theoretically grounded, width-dependent scalings for the perturbation noise and optimizer hyperparameters. First, we prove that under zero perturbation, the upscaled model is functionally equivalent to the base model throughout training. Second, we extend the $μ$P theory to enable infinite-width limit analysis and establish hyperparameter transfer for upscaled models, greatly reducing the tuning cost. We empirically demonstrate that this method is effective on realistic datasets and architectures.
papers.comment: 69 pages, 11 figures, closest to version to be published in ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于$\mu$P理论的有原则的宽度上扩方法，通过理论驱动的噪声缩放和优化器超参数迁移，使从小模型初始化的大模型在训练中保持功能等价并实现超参数迁移，大幅降低超参数调优成本。
Motivation: 现有模型上扩方法（如Net2Net）对超参数敏感，直接在大模型上调优代价高昂，且小模型超参数通过缩放定律外推缺乏理论保证。
Method: 提出一种宽度上扩方法：从训练好的小模型复制权重并添加遵循宽度相关缩放的扰动噪声，同时根据$\mu$P理论调整优化器超参数，使上扩后的模型在扰动为零时与基础模型功能等价，并扩展$\mu$P理论到无限宽极限以证明超参数迁移。
Result: 理论证明在零扰动下上扩模型与基础模型训练过程功能等价，实验表明该方法在真实数据集和架构上有效，能显著降低超参数调优成本。
Conclusion: 该方法通过理论驱动的缩放实现了小模型到大模型的高效超参数迁移，避免了直接在大模型上调优的高昂成本，但未涉及其他维度（如深度）的上扩。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: QTALE: Quantization-Robust Token-Adaptive Layer Execution for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) demand substantial computational and memory resources, posing challenges for efficient deployment. Two complementary approaches have emerged to address these issues: token-adaptive layer execution, which reduces floating-point operations (FLOPs) by selectively bypassing layers, and quantization, which lowers memory footprint by reducing weight precision. However, naively integrating these techniques leads to additional accuracy degradation due to reduced redundancy in token-adaptive models. We propose QTALE (Quantization-Robust Token-Adaptive Layer Execution for LLMs), a novel framework that enables seamless integration of token-adaptive execution with quantization while preserving accuracy. Conventional token-adaptive methods reduce redundancy in two ways: (1) by limiting the diversity of training paths explored during fine-tuning, and (2) by lowering the number of parameters actively involved in inference. To overcome these limitations, QTALE introduces two key components: (1) a training strategy that ensures diverse execution paths are actively explored during fine-tuning, and (2) a post-training mechanism that allows flexible adjustment of the execution ratio at inference to reintroduce redundancy when needed. Experimental results show that QTALE enables seamless integration of token-adaptive layer execution with quantization, while keeping the accuracy gap to quantization-only models below 0.5% on CommonsenseQA benchmarks. By combining tokenadaptive execution for FLOPs reduction and quantization for memory savings, QTALE provides an effective solution for efficient LLM deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QTALE 框架，旨在将 Token 自适应层执行与量化无缝集成，以兼顾 LLM 的推理效率与精度。传统 Token 自适应方法在结合量化时会因冗余减少导致精度下降，QTALE 通过多样化的训练路径探索和推理时灵活调整执行比例来克服此问题。实验表明，在 CommonsenseQA 基准上，QTALE 与仅量化模型的精度差距低于 0.5%。
Motivation: Token 自适应层执行和量化是两种互补的 LLM 加速技术，但直接结合会导致额外的精度损失，因为 Token 自适应模型本身已减少冗余，量化进一步压缩会加剧精度下降。
Method: QTALE 包含两个关键组件：1) 微调时确保模型探索多样化执行路径的训练策略；2) 推理后允许动态调整执行比例以在需要时重新引入冗余的机制。
Result: 在 CommonsenseQA 基准上，QTALE 将 Token 自适应执行与量化结合后的精度损失控制在仅量化模型的 0.5% 以内。
Conclusion: QTALE 通过引入训练和推理阶段的冗余补偿机制，实现了 Token 自适应执行与量化的有效融合，为 LLM 的高效部署提供了一种解决方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TimeChat-Captioner: Scripting Multi-Scene Videos with Time-Aware and Structural Audio-Visual Captions
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes Omni Dense Captioning, a novel task designed to generate continuous, fine-grained, and structured audio-visual narratives with explicit timestamps. To ensure dense semantic coverage, we introduce a six-dimensional structural schema to create "script-like" captions, enabling readers to vividly imagine the video content scene by scene, akin to a cinematographic screenplay. To facilitate research, we construct OmniDCBench, a high-quality, human-annotated benchmark, and propose SodaM, a unified metric that evaluates time-aware detailed descriptions while mitigating scene boundary ambiguity. Furthermore, we construct a training dataset, TimeChatCap-42K, and present TimeChat-Captioner-7B, a strong baseline trained via SFT and GRPO with task-specific rewards. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TimeChat-Captioner-7B achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing Gemini-2.5-Pro, while its generated dense descriptions significantly boost downstream capabilities in audio-visual reasoning (DailyOmni and WorldSense) and temporal grounding (Charades-STA). All datasets, models, and code are available at https://github.com/yaolinli/TimeChat-Captioner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Omni Dense Captioning任务，旨在生成连续、细粒度、带时间戳的结构化音视频叙事。为此，引入了六维结构模式来创建“脚本式”描述，构建了高质量人工标注基准OmniDCBench和统一评价指标SodaM，并训练了TimeChat-Captioner-7B模型（基于SFT和GRPO）。实验表明，该模型在多个基准上超越Gemini-2.5-Pro，其生成的密集描述显著提升下游音视频推理和时间定位能力。
Motivation: 现有视频描述方法缺乏连续的、细粒度的结构化描述，且缺少时间感知能力，难以像电影剧本一样场景化再现视频内容。
Method: 提出Omni Dense Captioning任务，采用六维结构模式生成带时间戳的脚本式描述。构建训练数据集TimeChatCap-42K，使用SFT和GRPO结合任务特定奖励训练TimeChat-Captioner-7B模型。
Result: TimeChat-Captioner-7B在OmniDCBench等基准上达到SOTA，超越Gemini-2.5-Pro，并在音视频推理（DailyOmni、WorldSense）和时间定位（Charades-STA）等下游任务上取得显著提升。
Conclusion: 论文提供了数据集、模型和代码的开源资源，表明该任务及模型有助于推动细粒度音视频理解的发展。

summary_sections.conclusion: 论文提供了数据集、模型和代码的开源资源，表明该任务及模型有助于推动细粒度音视频理解的发展。

papers.title: LEFT: Learnable Fusion of Tri-view Tokens for Unsupervised Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: As a fundamental data mining task, unsupervised time series anomaly detection (TSAD) aims to build a model for identifying abnormal timestamps without assuming the availability of annotations. A key challenge in unsupervised TSAD is that many anomalies are too subtle to exhibit detectable deviation in any single view (e.g., time domain), and instead manifest as inconsistencies across multiple views like time, frequency, and a mixture of resolutions. However, most cross-view methods rely on feature or score fusion and do not enforce analysis-synthesis consistency, meaning the frequency branch is not required to reconstruct the time signal through an inverse transform, and vice versa. In this paper, we present Learnable Fusion of Tri-view Tokens (LEFT), a unified unsupervised TSAD framework that models anomalies as inconsistencies across complementary representations. LEFT learns feature tokens from three views of the same input time series: frequency domain tokens that embed periodicity information, time domain tokens that capture local dynamics, and multi-scale tokens that learn abnormal patterns at varying time series granularities. By learning a set of adaptive Nyquist-constrained spectral filters, the original time series is rescaled into multiple resolutions and then encoded, allowing these multi-scale tokens to complement the extracted frequency and time domain information. When generating the fused representation, we introduce a novel objective that reconstructs fine-grained targets from coarser multi-scale structure, and put forward an innovative time-frequency cycle consistency constraint to explicitly regularize cross-view agreement. As cross-view agreement is explicitly regularized during training, LEFT can adopt lightweight tri-view encoders while maintaining effective coordination among the three views.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LEFT框架，一种无监督时间序列异常检测方法，通过从频域、时域和多尺度三视图学习特征令牌，并引入时频循环一致性约束和从粗到细的重建目标，显式正则化跨视图一致性，从而检测跨视图不一致的异常。
Motivation: 无监督时间序列异常检测中，细微异常难以在单视图（如时域）中检测，常表现为多视图（时域、频域、多尺度）间的不一致，但现有跨视图方法缺乏分析-合成一致性约束。
Method: 提出可学习三视图令牌融合框架LEFT，包括自适应奈奎斯特约束频谱滤波器实现多尺度编码，以及时频循环一致性约束和从粗到细的重建目标来正则化跨视图一致性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但声称LEFT通过显式正则化跨视图一致性，可采用轻量三视图编码器并保持有效协调。
Conclusion: 该框架通过强制跨视图一致性，能有效利用互补表示检测时间序列中的细微异常。

papers.title: Incremental (k, z)-Clustering on Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Given a weighted undirected graph, a number of clusters $k$, and an exponent $z$, the goal in the $(k, z)$-clustering problem on graphs is to select $k$ vertices as centers that minimize the sum of the distances raised to the power $z$ of each vertex to its closest center. In the dynamic setting, the graph is subject to adversarial edge updates, and the goal is to maintain explicitly an exact $(k, z)$-clustering solution in the induced shortest-path metric. While efficient dynamic $k$-center approximation algorithms on graphs exist [Cruciani et al. SODA 2024], to the best of our knowledge, no prior work provides similar results for the dynamic $(k,z)$-clustering problem. As the main result of this paper, we develop a randomized incremental $(k, z)$-clustering algorithm that maintains with high probability a constant-factor approximation in a graph undergoing edge insertions with a total update time of $\tilde O(k m^{1+o(1)}+ k^{1+\frac{1}λ} m)$, where $λ\geq 1$ is an arbitrary fixed constant. Our incremental algorithm consists of two stages. In the first stage, we maintain a constant-factor bicriteria approximate solution of size $\tilde{O}(k)$ with a total update time of $m^{1+o(1)}$ over all adversarial edge insertions. This first stage is an intricate adaptation of the bicriteria approximation algorithm by Mettu and Plaxton [Machine Learning 2004] to incremental graphs. One of our key technical results is that the radii in their algorithm can be assumed to be non-decreasing while the approximation ratio remains constant, a property that may be of independent interest. In the second stage, we maintain a constant-factor approximate $(k,z)$-clustering solution on a dynamic weighted instance induced by the bicriteria approximate solution. For this subproblem, we employ a dynamic spanner algorithm together with a static $(k,z)$-clustering algorithm.
papers.comment: In the Proceedings of ICALP 2026. Abstract shortened to meet arXiv limits
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态图中 (k,z)-聚类问题，提出了一个增量式随机算法，在边插入的图中维护常数因子近似解。算法分两阶段：第一阶段维护双准则近似解，第二阶段在动态加权实例上维护最终解。总更新时间为 $\tilde O(k m^{1+o(1)}+ k^{1+\frac{1}{\lambda}} m)$，其中 $\lambda \geq 1$ 为任意固定常数。
Motivation: 目前动态图中存在 k-中心问题的近似算法，但缺少 (k,z)-聚类问题的动态结果。本文填补这一空白。
Method: 采用两阶段增量算法。第一阶段将 Mettu 和 Plaxton 的双准则近似算法适配到增量图，关键证明半径非递减且近似比不变。第二阶段结合动态 spanner 算法和静态 (k,z)-聚类算法。
Result: 实现了高概率的常数因子近似，总更新时间为 $\tilde O(k m^{1+o(1)}+ k^{1+\frac{1}{\lambda}} m)$，适用于任意固定常数 $\lambda \geq 1$。
Conclusion: 本文首次为动态 (k,z)-聚类问题提供增量算法。主要技术贡献是证明 Mettu-Plaxton 算法中半径可保持非递减。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Language-Guided Transformer Tokenizer for Human Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we focus on motion discrete tokenization, which converts raw motion into compact discrete tokens--a process proven crucial for efficient motion generation. In this paradigm, increasing the number of tokens is a common approach to improving motion reconstruction quality, but more tokens make it more difficult for generative models to learn. To maintain high reconstruction quality while reducing generation complexity, we propose leveraging language to achieve efficient motion tokenization, which we term Language-Guided Tokenization (LG-Tok). LG-Tok aligns natural language with motion at the tokenization stage, yielding compact, high-level semantic representations. This approach not only strengthens both tokenization and detokenization but also simplifies the learning of generative models. Furthermore, existing tokenizers predominantly adopt convolutional architectures, whose local receptive fields struggle to support global language guidance. To this end, we propose a Transformer-based Tokenizer that leverages attention mechanisms to enable effective alignment between language and motion. Additionally, we design a language-drop scheme, in which language conditions are randomly removed during training, enabling the detokenizer to support language-free guidance during generation. On the HumanML3D and Motion-X generation benchmarks, LG-Tok achieves Top-1 scores of 0.542 and 0.582, outperforming state-of-the-art methods (MARDM: 0.500 and 0.528), and with FID scores of 0.057 and 0.088, respectively, versus 0.114 and 0.147. LG-Tok-mini uses only half the tokens while maintaining competitive performance (Top-1: 0.521/0.588, FID: 0.085/0.071), validating the efficiency of our semantic representations. Code and checkpoints are available at https://eanson023.github.io/LG-Tok/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语言指导标记化（LG-Tok），通过在标记化阶段对齐自然语言和运动，实现紧凑的高层语义表示，从而在保持高重建质量的同时降低生成复杂度。使用Transformer架构进行全局语言-运动对齐，并设计语言丢弃方案支持无语言引导的生成。在HumanML3D和Motion-X基准上，LG-Tok在Top-1和FID指标上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有运动离散标记化中，增加token数量虽能提高重建质量，但会增加生成模型的学习难度。需要一种紧凑高效的标记化方法，同时保持高质量重建。
Method: 提出LG-Tok，在标记化阶段用语言指导形成紧凑语义token；采用Transformer编码器通过注意力机制实现语言-运动的全局对齐；训练时随机丢弃语言条件，使解码器支持无语言引导的生成。
Result: 在HumanML3D上Top-1 0.542（MARDM: 0.500），FID 0.057（MARDM: 0.114）；Motion-X上Top-1 0.582（MARDM: 0.528），FID 0.088（MARDM: 0.147）。仅用一半token的LG-Tok-mini仍保持竞争性能（Top-1 0.521/0.588，FID 0.085/0.071）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调提出的语言指导标记化方法能有效减少生成复杂度，同时保持高重建质量，验证了语义表示的高效性。

papers.title: BRIDGE: Predicting Human Task Completion Time From Model Performance
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating the real-world capabilities of AI systems requires grounding benchmark performance in human-interpretable measures of task difficulty. Existing approaches that rely on direct human task completion time annotations are costly, noisy, and difficult to scale across benchmarks. In this work, we propose BRIDGE, a unified psychometric framework that learns a latent difficulty scale from model responses and anchors it to human task completion time. Using a two-parameter logistic Item Response Theory model, we jointly estimate latent task difficulty and model capability from model performance data across multiple benchmarks. We demonstrate that latent task difficulty varies linearly with the logarithm of human completion time, allowing human task completion time to be inferred for new benchmarks from model performance alone. Leveraging this alignment, we forecast frontier model capabilities in terms of human task length and independently reproduce METR's exponential scaling results, with the 50% solvable task horizon doubling approximately every 6 months.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BRIDGE，一个统一的心理测量框架，通过学习模型响应中的潜在难度尺度并将其与人类任务完成时间对齐。使用两参数逻辑斯蒂项目反应理论模型，从多个基准的模型性能数据中联合估计任务难度和模型能力，发现潜在难度与人类完成时间的对数成线性关系。该方法使得仅凭模型性能即可预测新基准上的人类完成时间，并独立复现了METR的指数缩放结果：50%可解任务视野每约6个月翻倍。
Motivation: 现有依赖直接人类任务完成时间标注的方法成本高、噪声大且难以跨基准扩展，需要一种可扩展的、基于模型性能的人类任务时间预测方法。
Method: 提出BRIDGE框架，采用两参数逻辑斯蒂项目反应理论模型，从模型在多个基准上的表现数据中联合估计潜在任务难度和模型能力，并通过线性映射将潜在难度与人类完成时间的对数相关联。
Result: 摘要表明潜在任务难度与人类完成时间的对数呈线性关系，从而可以从模型性能推断人类完成时间；独立复现了METR的指数缩放结果，即50%可解任务视野每约6个月翻倍。
Conclusion: BRIDGE提供了一种无需直接人类标注即可预测人类任务完成时间的方法，可解释AI系统能力的增长趋势，并验证了模型能力与人类时间尺度之间的可迁移关系。

papers.title: On the Role of Computation in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: How does the amount of compute available to a reinforcement learning (RL) policy affect its learning? Can policies using a fixed amount of parameters, still benefit from additional compute? The standard RL framework does not provide a language to answer these questions formally. Empirically, deep RL policies are often parameterized as neural networks with static architectures, conflating the amount of compute and the number of parameters. In this paper, we formalize compute bounded policies and prove that policies which use more compute can solve problems and generalize to longer-horizon tasks that are outside the scope of policies with less compute. Building on prior work in algorithmic learning and model-free planning, we propose a minimal architecture that can use a variable amount of compute. Our experiments complement our theory. On a set 31 different tasks spanning online and offline RL, we show that $(1)$ this architecture achieves stronger performance simply by using more compute, and $(2)$ stronger generalization on longer-horizon test tasks compared to standard feedforward networks or deep residual network using up to 5 times more parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了计算受限策略，证明了使用更多计算可以解决更长视野的任务，并提出了一种可变计算量的最小架构。实验在31个在线和离线RL任务上验证了该架构通过增加计算量可提升性能和泛化能力。
Motivation: 标准RL框架无法正式回答计算量对策略学习的影响，且深度RL策略通常参数化为固定架构的神经网络，混淆了计算量和参数数量。
Method: 形式化计算受限策略，提出一种基于算法学习和无模型规划的可变计算量最小架构。
Result: 在31个在线和离线RL任务上，该架构通过使用更多计算获得更强性能，并在更长视野测试任务上比标准前馈网络或深度残差网络（使用多达5倍参数）表现更强的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 论文强调了计算量在RL中的关键作用，所提架构可受益于更多计算而无需增加参数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Memora: A Harmonic Memory Representation Balancing Abstraction and Specificity
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory systems must accommodate continuously growing information while supporting efficient, context-aware retrieval for downstream tasks. Abstraction is essential for scaling agent memory, yet it often comes at the cost of specificity, obscuring the fine-grained details required for effective reasoning. We introduce Memora, a harmonic memory representation that structurally balances abstraction and specificity. Memora organizes information via its primary abstractions that index concrete memory values and consolidate related updates into unified memory entries, while cue anchors expand retrieval access across diverse aspects of the memory and connect related memories. Building on this structure, we employ a retrieval policy that actively exploits these memory connections to retrieve relevant information beyond direct semantic similarity. Theoretically, we show that standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Knowledge Graph (KG)-based memory systems emerge as special cases of our framework. Empirically, Memora establishes a new state-of-the-art on the LoCoMo and LongMemEval benchmarks, demonstrating better retrieval relevance and reasoning effectiveness as memory scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Memora是一种新的智能体记忆表示方法，通过主要抽象（primary abstractions）和线索锚点（cue anchors）结构性地平衡抽象与具体性，并利用记忆连接进行检索。理论上证明了标准RAG和知识图谱记忆是其特例。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval基准上取得了新的最优结果，随着记忆规模增大，检索相关性和推理有效性均有提升。
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统在追求抽象性以扩展记忆时，往往丢失了具体细节，导致推理能力下降。需要一种能同时兼顾抽象性和具体性的记忆表示方法。
Method: 提出Memora框架，通过主要抽象索引具体记忆值并合并相关更新，同时使用线索锚点扩展检索入口并连接相关记忆。采用主动利用这些结构连接的检索策略，超越直接语义相似性。
Result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval基准上达到新的最优性能，在记忆规模增大时显示更好的检索相关性和推理有效性。
Conclusion: Memora在理论上统一了标准RAG和知识图谱记忆作为其特例，在实践中为大规模智能体记忆提供了一种平衡抽象与具体性的有效方案。

papers.title: Adaptive Batch Sizes Using Non-Euclidean Gradient Noise Scales for Stochastic Sign and Spectral Descent
papers.abstract_en: To maximize hardware utilization, modern machine learning systems typically employ large constant or manually tuned batch size schedules, relying on heuristics that are brittle and costly to tune. Existing adaptive strategies based on gradient noise scale (GNS) offer a principled alternative. However, their assumption of SGD's Euclidean geometry creates a fundamental mismatch with popular optimizers based on generalized norms, such as signSGD / Signum ($\ell_\infty$) and stochastic spectral descent (specSGD) / Muon ($\mathcal{S}_\infty$). In this work, we derive gradient noise scales for signSGD and specSGD that naturally emerge from the geometry of their respective dual norms. To practically estimate these non-Euclidean metrics, we propose an efficient variance estimation procedure that leverages the local mini-batch gradients on different ranks in distributed data-parallel systems. Our experiments demonstrate that adaptive batch size strategies using non-Euclidean GNS enable us to match the validation loss of constant-batch baselines while reducing training steps by up to 66\% for Signum and Muon on a 160 million parameter Llama model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为符号梯度下降（signSGD/Signum）和随机谱下降（specSGD/Muon）推导了基于非欧几何的梯度噪声尺度（GNS），并提出高效方差估计方法，在分布式数据并行系统中利用不同进程的局部小批量梯度来估计这些指标。实验表明，基于非欧GNS的自适应批量大小策略在160M参数Llama模型上，可将训练步数减少高达66%的同时匹配固定批量基线的验证损失。
Motivation: 现有自适应批量大小方法基于SGD的欧几里得梯度噪声尺度，与使用广义范数（如ℓ∞和S∞）的优化器（signSGD/Signum、specSGD/Muon）存在几何不匹配，导致性能次优。
Method: 推导了signSGD和specSGD对应对偶范数的梯度噪声尺度，并提出一种利用分布式数据并行系统中各rank上小批量梯度的方差估计方法，以高效计算这些非欧度量。
Result: 在160M参数Llama模型上，使用非欧GNS的自适应批量策略相比固定批量基线，在匹配验证损失的同时减少了高达66%的训练步数。
Conclusion: 摘要指出非欧梯度噪声尺度能有效指导自适应批量大小选择，适用于基于广义范数的优化器，但未讨论该方法在其他模型或任务上的泛化性。

papers.title: On the Sample Efficiency of Inverse Dynamics Models for Semi-Supervised Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised imitation learning (SSIL) consists in learning a policy from a small dataset of action-labeled trajectories and a much larger dataset of action-free trajectories. Some SSIL methods learn an inverse dynamics model (IDM) to predict the action from the current state and the next state. An IDM can act as a policy when paired with a video model (VM-IDM) or as a label generator to perform behavior cloning on action-free data (IDM labeling). In this work, we first show that VM-IDM and IDM labeling learn the same policy in a limit case, which we call the IDM-based policy. We then argue that the previously observed advantage of IDM-based policies over behavior cloning is due to the superior sample efficiency of IDM learning, which we attribute to two causes: (i) the ground-truth IDM tends to be contained in a lower complexity hypothesis class relative to the expert policy, and (ii) the ground-truth IDM is often less stochastic than the expert policy. We argue these claims based on insights from statistical learning theory and novel experiments, including a study of IDM-based policies using recent architectures for unified video-action prediction (UVA). Motivated by these insights, we finally propose an improved version of the existing LAPO algorithm for latent action policy learning. We experiment on the Procgen, Push-T and LIBERO benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究半监督模仿学习（SSIL）中逆动力学模型（IDM）的样本效率。作者首先证明在极限情况下，VM-IDM和IDM labeling学习相同的IDM-based策略，然后从统计学习理论和实验角度论证IDM-based策略优于行为克隆的原因是IDM学习具有更高的样本效率，这归因于IDM的真值函数属于更低复杂度的假设类且通常比专家策略更少随机。最后提出改进的LAPO算法，并在Procgen、Push-T和LIBERO基准上实验。
Motivation: 半监督模仿学习利用少量动作标记数据和大量无动作数据训练策略，但IDM方法的样本效率优势原因尚不明确。本文旨在从理论上解释IDM-based策略为何更高效，并据此改进算法。
Method: 通过理论分析（统计学习理论）和实验（包括使用统一视频动作预测架构UVA）论证IDM样本效率的根源：真值IDM的复杂度更低且随机性更小。基于此提出改进的LAPO算法用于潜在动作策略学习。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但指出在Procgen、Push-T和LIBERO基准上进行了实验，并表明改进的LAPO算法优于现有方法。
Conclusion: IDM的样本效率优势源于其真值函数复杂度低和随机性小，这一发现可用于设计更高效的半监督模仿学习算法。

papers.title: Local exponential stability of mean-field Langevin descent-ascent and associated particle system
papers.abstract_en: We study the mean-field Langevin descent-ascent (MFL-DA), a coupled optimization dynamics on the space of probability measures for entropically regularized two-player zero-sum games, together with its associated interacting particle system. For general nonconvex-nonconcave payoffs, Wang and Chizat (COLT 2024) asked whether the original single-timescale MFL-DA converges to the mixed Nash equilibrium and, if so, at what rate. We prove a local affirmative answer in Wasserstein space: if the initial datum is sufficiently close to the mixed Nash equilibrium, then the mean-field dynamics converges to it exponentially fast at a quantitative rate. We further show that the finite-$N$ particle system inherits this stability up to times exponential in $N$, with an $N$-independent exponential rate modulo a finite-particle error floor. Combined with the recent counterexample of Mourrat and Pillaud-Vivien for MFL-DA, which shows that global convergence cannot hold in general, our theorem completes the positive local counterpart of the Wang-Chizat question: the mixed Nash equilibrium has a robust basin of attraction, stable under both the mean-field flow and its finite-particle approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究平均场Langevin下降-上升（MFL-DA）动力学及其关联的粒子系统，证明了在Wasserstein空间中，若初始分布足够接近混合纳什均衡，则动力学以指数速率局部收敛。进一步，有限粒子系统在指数时间内继承此稳定性。
Motivation: Wang和Chizat（COLT 2024）提出关于MFL-DA是否收敛到混合纳什均衡及其收敛速率的问题，本文旨在提供局部肯定回答。
Method: 利用Wasserstein空间中的局部分析，证明MFL-DA动力学在混合纳什均衡附近的指数稳定性，并推导有限粒子系统的收敛性质。
Result: 证明了当初始分布足够接近混合纳什均衡时，MFL-DA以定量指数速率收敛；有限粒子系统在指数时间（以粒子数N指数增长）内保持稳定性，且具有与N无关的指数速率（含有限粒子误差项）。
Conclusion: 本文与Mourrat和Pillaud-Vivien的反例互补，表明混合纳什均衡具有稳健的吸引域，在平均场流和有限粒子近似下均稳定。

papers.title: Spectral Imbalance Causes Forgetting in Low-Rank Continual Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient continual learning aims to adapt pre-trained models to sequential tasks without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. Most existing approaches treat continual learning as avoiding interference with past updates, rather than considering what properties make the current task-specific update naturally preserve previously acquired knowledge. From a knowledge-decomposition perspective, we observe that low-rank adaptations exhibit highly imbalanced singular value spectra: a few dominant components absorb most of the adaptation energy, thereby (i) more likely to disrupt previously acquired knowledge and (ii) making the update more vulnerable to interference from subsequent tasks. To enable explicit balance among components, we decouple the magnitude of the task update from its directional structure and formulate it as a constrained optimization problem on a restricted Stiefel manifold. We address this problem using a projected first-order method compatible with standard deep-learning optimizers used in vision-language models. Our method mitigates both backward and forward forgetting, consistently outperforming continual learning baselines. The implementation code is available at https://github.com/haodotgu/EBLoRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文从知识分解角度研究参数高效持续学习，发现低秩适应存在奇异值谱高度不平衡问题，导致遗忘。作者将任务更新的幅度与方向解耦，在受限Stiefel流形上构建约束优化，并用投影一阶方法求解。实验表明该方法在视觉-语言模型上优于持续学习基线，有效缓解后向和前向遗忘。
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法侧重于避免与过去更新干扰，而未考虑任务特定更新本身如何自然保留已有知识。低秩适应的奇异值谱高度不平衡会破坏已有知识并易受后续任务干扰。
Method: 将任务更新的幅度与方向结构解耦，在受限Stiefel流形上构建约束优化问题，采用与标准深度学习优化器兼容的投影一阶方法求解。
Result: 该方法在视觉-语言模型上持续优于持续学习基线，有效缓解后向和前向遗忘。
Conclusion: 通过对低秩适应分量进行显式平衡，可以同时减轻后向和前向遗忘。

papers.title: "What is a realistic forecast?" Assessing data-driven weather forecasts, a journey from verification to falsification
papers.abstract_en: The artificial intelligence revolution is fuelling a paradigm shift in weather forecasting: forecasts are generated with machine learning models trained on large datasets rather than with physics-based numerical models that solve partial differential equations. This new approach proved successful in improving forecast performance as measured with standard verification metrics such as the root mean squared error. At the same time, the realism of data-driven weather forecasts is often questioned and considered an Achilles' heel of machine learning models. How forecast realism can be defined and how this forecast attribute can be assessed are the two questions simultaneously addressed here. Inspired by the seminal work of Murphy (1993) on the definition of forecast goodness, we identify 3 types of realism: a functional realism measured by scoring functions, a structural realism related to the statistical characteristics of the forecasts, and a physical realism that is apprehended through the lenses of our scientific knowledge. This conceptual setting serves as a basis for the design of a new framework for the evaluation of data-driven weather models where falsification arises as a complementary process to the well-established diagnostic and verification tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨数据驱动天气预报的“现实性”(realism)问题，借鉴Murphy(1993)对预报好坏的分类，提出三种现实性：功能现实性（由评分函数衡量）、结构现实性（预报统计特征）和物理现实性（基于科学知识）。以此为基础，建立新的评估框架，引入证伪(falsification)作为传统诊断和验证的补充。
Motivation: 数据驱动天气预报虽在标准指标如均方根误差上表现优异，但其现实性常受质疑，被视为机器学习模型的致命弱点。如何定义和评估预报现实性成为关键问题。
Method: 受Murphy(1993)启发，将预报现实性分为三种类型：功能现实性（基于评分函数）、结构现实性（统计特征）和物理现实性（科学知识）。基于此概念设计新的评估框架，将证伪作为诊断和验证的补充过程。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验数值，而是提出一个概念框架，用于系统评估数据驱动天气预报的现实性，并强调证伪的作用。
Conclusion: 本文强调现实性评估是数据驱动天气预报的关键，所提出的三种现实性类型和证伪框架可为未来评估提供基础。

papers.title: Drive-JEPA: Video JEPA Meets Multimodal Trajectory Distillation for End-to-End Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving increasingly leverages self-supervised video pretraining to learn transferable planning representations. However, pretraining video world models for scene understanding has so far brought only limited improvements. This limitation is compounded by the inherent ambiguity of driving: each scene typically provides only a single human trajectory, making it difficult to learn multimodal behaviors. In this work, we propose Drive-JEPA, a framework that integrates Video Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) with multimodal trajectory distillation for end-to-end driving. First, we adapt V-JEPA for end-to-end driving, pretraining a ViT encoder on large-scale driving videos to produce predictive representations aligned with trajectory planning. Second, we introduce a proposal-centric planner that distills diverse simulator-generated trajectories alongside human trajectories, with a momentum-aware selection mechanism to promote stable and safe behavior. When evaluated on NAVSIM, the V-JEPA representation combined with a simple transformer-based decoder outperforms prior methods by 3 PDMS in the perception-free setting. The complete Drive-JEPA framework achieves 93.3 PDMS on v1 and 87.8 EPDMS on v2, setting a new state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Drive-JEPA 框架，将视频联合嵌入预测架构 (V-JEPA) 与多模态轨迹蒸馏结合，用于端到端自动驾驶。在 NAVSIM 基准上，感知无关设置下 V-JEPA 表示超越先前方法 3 PDMS，完整框架在 v1 达到 93.3 PDMS，v2 达到 87.8 EPDMS，创下最新最佳结果。
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶中，自监督视频预训练对场景理解提升有限，且每帧通常仅提供一条人类轨迹，难以学习多模态行为。
Method: 提出 Drive-JEPA：首先将 V-JEPA 适配至端到端驾驶，在大型驾驶视频上预训练 ViT 编码器，产生与轨迹规划对齐的预测表示；然后引入提案中心规划器，通过动量感知选择机制蒸馏多样化的模拟生成轨迹与人类轨迹。
Result: 在 NAVSIM 感知无关设置下，V-JEPA 表示超越先前方法 3 PDMS；完整框架在 v1 达到 93.3 PDMS，v2 达到 87.8 EPDMS，创下最新最佳。
Conclusion: V-JEPA 结合多模态轨迹蒸馏可有效提升端到端驾驶的规划性能。

papers.title: Reddy: An open-source toolbox for analyzing eddy-covariance measurements in heterogeneous environments
papers.abstract_en: Land-atmosphere exchange is mediated by turbulent fluxes that can be quantified using eddy-covariance (EC) measurements. EC has been widely used to measure ecosystem-scale vertical exchange between atmosphere and vegetation, and to test and refine atmospheric turbulence theories with the aim to improve the representation of turbulent fluxes in numerical models. Traditionally, research has focused on idealized, homogeneous and flat surfaces, but recent work increasingly targets turbulent exchange in complex, heterogeneous environments under non-ideal conditions, where challenges include advective fluxes, mesoscale circulations between contrasting surface types, and non-stationary nighttime turbulence. Here, we introduce the open-source R package Reddy, which combines multiple EC analysis methods into a single modular tool. Reddy enables users to tailor post-processing choices to site-specific conditions, supports station management and facilitates detailed scientific analyses. The package is accompanied by extensive documentation and a suite of Jupyter notebooks that provide hands-on introductions to EC data processing. We demonstrate Reddy using measurements from three Norwegian sites: (1) a morning transition following a strongly stably stratified night at an alpine tundra valley, (2) spectral and ogive analysis before and after an ice-cover transition at a boreal lake, and (3) fitting flux-variance relations at a permafrost-affected palsa peatland. Reddy extends existing EC software and helps moving towards a more holistic turbulence data analysis framework for heterogeneous, real-world environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍开源的R包Reddy，用于在异质环境下分析涡度协方差（EC）测量数据。该包整合多种EC分析方法，支持站点管理和用户自定义后处理，并提供Jupyter notebook教程。作者通过三个挪威站点（高山冻原谷地、北方湖泊、永久冻土泥炭沼泽）的案例展示其功能，旨在推动更全面的湍流数据分析框架。
Motivation: 传统EC研究多基于理想均匀平坦表面，而实际环境复杂、异质性强，存在平流、中尺度环流和非平稳夜间湍流等挑战，现有工具难以灵活应对。
Method: 开发开源R包Reddy，模块化集成多种EC分析方法，允许用户根据站点条件定制后处理流程，并附带文档和Jupyter notebook教程。
Result: 通过三个挪威站点的案例验证：高山冻原谷地的早晨过渡期、北方湖泊冰盖转换前后的谱和奥基夫分析、永久冻土泥炭地的通量-方差关系拟合。
Conclusion: Reddy扩展了现有EC软件，有助于形成更全面的异质真实环境湍流数据分析框架。

papers.title: When Does Predictive Inverse Dynamics Outperform Behavior Cloning?
papers.abstract_en: Behavior cloning (BC) is a practical offline imitation learning method, but it often fails when expert demonstrations are limited. Recent works have introduced a class of architectures named predictive inverse dynamics models (PIDMs) that combine a future-state predictor with an inverse dynamics model. While PIDMs often outperform BC, the reasons behind their benefits remain unclear. In this paper, we provide a theoretical explanation: PIDMs introduce a tradeoff. Conditioning the IDM on the predicted future state can significantly reduce variance, but the prediction itself introduces additional bias and variance. We establish conditions for PIDMs to achieve higher sample efficiency and lower prediction error than BC, with the gap widening when additional data sources are available. We validate the theoretical insights empirically in 2D navigation tasks, where BC requires up to five times (three times on average) more demonstrations than PIDM to reach comparable performance. Results are also illustrated in a complex 3D environment in a modern video game with high-dimensional visual inputs and stochastic transitions, where BC requires over 66\% more samples than PIDM.
papers.comment: To be published in proceedings of the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上解释了预测逆动力学模型（PIDMs）在离线模仿学习中的优势来源：PIDMs通过引入未来状态预测与逆动力学模型的组合，在方差和偏差之间进行权衡。论文证明了当额外数据可用时，PIDMs比行为克隆（BC）具有更高的样本效率和更低的预测误差，并在2D导航任务和复杂3D环境中验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 行为克隆（BC）在专家演示有限时经常失败，而预测逆动力学模型（PIDMs）虽然表现更好，但其优势原因尚不明确。
Method: 理论分析PIDMs的偏差-方差权衡，推导出PIDMs优于BC的条件，并在2D导航和3D视频游戏环境中进行实证验证。
Result: 在2D导航任务中，BC需要多达五倍（平均三倍）于PIDM的演示才能达到相当的性能；在复杂3D环境中，BC需要超过66%的额外样本。
Conclusion: PIDMs通过预测未来状态引入偏差但显著降低逆动力学模型的方差，从而在数据有限时优于BC，且额外数据源能扩大这一差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Why Can't I Open My Drawer? Mitigating Object-Driven Shortcuts in Zero-Shot Compositional Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Zero-Shot Compositional Action Recognition (ZS-CAR) requires recognizing novel verb-object combinations composed of previously observed primitives. In this work, we tackle a key failure mode: models predict verbs via object-driven shortcuts (i.e., relying on the labeled object class) rather than temporal evidence. We argue that sparse compositional supervision and verb-object learning asymmetry can promote object-driven shortcut learning. Our analysis with proposed diagnostic metrics shows that existing methods overfit to training co-occurrence patterns and underuse temporal verb cues, resulting in weak generalization to unseen compositions. To address object-driven shortcuts, we propose Robust COmpositional REpresentations (RCORE) with two components. Co-occurrence Prior Regularization (CPR) adds explicit supervision for unseen compositions and regularizes the model against frequent co-occurrence priors by treating them as hard negatives. Temporal Order Regularization for Composition (TORC) enforces temporal-order sensitivity to learn temporally grounded verb representations. Across Sth-com and EK100-com, RCORE reduces shortcut diagnostics and consequently improves compositional generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对零样本组合动作识别（ZS-CAR）中模型通过物体类别捷径预测动词的问题，提出鲁棒组合表示（RCORE）方法，包含共现先验正则化（CPR）和时序顺序正则化（TORC），在Sth-com和EK100-com基准上减少了物体驱动捷径并提升了组合泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有ZS-CAR模型过度依赖训练集中的物体-动词共现模式，忽视时序证据，导致对未见组合的泛化能力差。
Method: 提出两种正则化：CPR通过将频繁共现模式作为硬负例对未见组合添加显式监督；TORC强制模型学习时序顺序敏感性以获得基于时序的动词表示。
Result: 在Sth-com和EK100-com数据集上，RCORE减少了捷径诊断指标并提高了组合泛化性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提方法成功缓解了物体驱动的捷径学习，为ZS-CAR提供了更鲁棒的表示。

papers.title: One-Shot Feed-Forward 360$^{\circ}$ Animatable Avatar via Inpainted UV-Space Gaussian Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Building one-shot 3D animatable head avatars is an important yet challenging problem. Existing methods generally collapse under large camera pose variations, compromising the realism of 3D avatars. In this work, we propose a new framework to tackle the novel setting of one-shot 3D full-head animatable avatar reconstruction in a single forward pass via inpainted UV-space Gaussian modeling, enabling 360$^\circ$ rendering views and real-time animation. To facilitate efficient animation control, we model 3D head avatars with Gaussian primitives embedded on the surface of a parametric face model within the UV space, and project the input image features to the UV space, resulting in incomplete local UV feature maps. To inpaint the missing regions, we obtain knowledge of full-head geometry and textures from rich 3D full-head priors within a pretrained 3D generative adversarial network (GAN) for global full-head feature extraction and multi-view supervision. Specifically, to enhance the fidelity of 3D reconstruction during inpainting, we take advantage of the symmetric nature of the UV space and human faces to fuse incomplete yet detailed local UV feature maps with the extracted global full-head textures, resulting in inpainted UV Gaussian attribute maps for avatar modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method is the first to achieve high-quality 3D full-head animatable avatar modeling, significantly improving side and back views while outperforming state-of-the-art animation approaches, thereby improving the realism of 3D animatable avatars.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026. Project page: https://shaelynz.github.io/fhavatar/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单张图像重建全头可驱动3D化身的问题，提出一种单次前馈的360°可动化身方法。该方法通过在UV空间中嵌入参数化人脸模型表面的高斯基元，利用预训练3D GAN的全局先验补全不完整的UV特征图，实现高质量的全头建模与实时动画。实验表明，该方法首次实现高质量全头可驱动化身，显著改善侧面和后视图渲染效果，超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在大视角变化下容易崩溃，无法实现360°渲染，限制了3D化身的真实感。
Method: 提出UV空间高斯建模框架：将高斯基元嵌入参数化人脸模型表面，投影输入图像特征到UV空间得到不完整局部图；利用预训练3D GAN提取全局全头几何与纹理先验，结合UV空间和人脸的对称性，融合局部与全局特征，得到补全的UV高斯属性图用于化身建模。
Result: 首个实现高质量全头可驱动化身建模的方法，在侧面和后视图上显著提升，优于现有最先进动画方法，提高3D可驱动化身的真实感。
Conclusion: 方法在单次前馈中实现360°渲染和实时动画，利用UV空间补全和GAN先验有效解决了大视角问题，提升了可驱动化身质量。

papers.title: Adaptively trained Physics-informed Radial Basis Function Neural Networks for Solving Multi-asset Option Pricing Problems
papers.abstract_en: The present study investigates the numerical solution of Black-Scholes partial differential equation (PDE) for option valuation with multiple underlying assets. We develop a physics-informed (PI) machine learning algorithm based on a radial basis function neural network (RBFNN) that concurrently optimizes the network architecture and predicts the target option price. The physics-informed radial basis function neural network (PIRBFNN) combines the strengths of the traditional radial basis function collocation method and the physics-informed neural network machine learning approach to effectively solve PDE problems in the financial context. By employing a PDE residual-based technique to adaptively refine the distribution of hidden neurons during the training process, the PIRBFNN facilitates accurate and efficient handling of multidimensional option pricing models featuring non-smooth payoff conditions. The validity of the proposed method is demonstrated through a set of experiments encompassing a single-asset European put option, a double-asset exchange option, and a four-asset basket call option.

TL;DR: 本文研究基于物理信息径向基函数神经网络（PIRBFNN）求解多资产期权定价中的Black-Scholes PDE。该方法结合径向基函数配点法和物理信息神经网络，通过自适应隐藏神经元分布改进非光滑支付条件下的多维定价。实验包括单资产欧式看跌、双资产交换期权和四资产篮子看涨期权。

Result: 通过单资产欧式看跌、双资产交换期权和四资产篮子看涨期权的实验验证了方法的有效性。

papers.title: From One-to-One to Many-to-Many: Dynamic Cross-Layer Injection for Deep Vision-Language Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) create a severe visual feature bottleneck by using a crude, asymmetric connection that links only the output of the vision encoder to the input of the large language model (LLM). This static architecture fundamentally limits the ability of LLMs to achieve comprehensive alignment with hierarchical visual knowledge, compromising their capacity to accurately integrate local details with global semantics into coherent reasoning. To resolve this, we introduce Cross-Layer Injection (CLI), a novel and lightweight framework that forges a dynamic many-to-many bridge between the two modalities. CLI consists of two synergistic, parameter-efficient components: an Adaptive Multi-Projection (AMP) module that harmonizes features from diverse vision layers, and an Adaptive Gating Fusion (AGF) mechanism that empowers the LLM to selectively inject the most relevant visual information based on its real-time decoding context. We validate the effectiveness and versatility of CLI by integrating it into LLaVA-OneVision and LLaVA-1.5. Extensive experiments on 18 diverse benchmarks demonstrate significant performance improvements, establishing CLI as a scalable paradigm that unlocks deeper multimodal understanding by granting LLMs on-demand access to the full visual hierarchy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Cross-Layer Injection (CLI)框架，通过在视觉编码器和语言模型之间建立动态多对多连接，解决VLM中视觉特征瓶颈问题。CLI包含自适应多投影（AMP）和自适应门控融合（AGF）两个轻量组件，集成到LLaVA-OneVision和LLaVA-1.5后在18个基准上取得显著改进。
Motivation: 现有VLM采用静态的非对称连接，仅将视觉编码器输出连接到LLM输入，限制了LLM对层次化视觉知识的对齐能力，无法准确整合局部细节与全局语义。
Method: 提出CLI框架，包含自适应多投影（AMP）模块协调不同视觉层特征，以及自适应门控融合（AGF）机制允许LLM根据实时解码上下文选择性注入最相关视觉信息。
Result: 在18个多样化基准上的大量实验表明，集成CLI的LLaVA模型取得显著性能提升。
Conclusion: CLI作为一种可扩展范式，通过赋予LLM按需访问完整视觉层次的能力，解锁更深层次的多模态理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A General Neural Backbone for Mixed-Integer Linear Optimization via Dual Attention
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) is a foundational framework for combinatorial optimization across science and engineering, but remains hard to solve at scale due to NP-hardness. Recent learning-based methods typically model MILP instances as variable-constraint bipartite graphs and use Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for representation learning, yet their locality limits representation power. We propose an attention-driven neural backbone that adopts an element-centric view of variables and constraints, with dual attention performing parallel intra-type self-attention and inter-type cross-attention. Across three representative tasks at the instance, element, and solving-state levels, our model consistently outperforms conventional GNN-based architectures, highlighting attention-based, element-centric modeling as a powerful foundation for learning-enhanced combinatorial optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混合整数线性规划（MILP）问题，提出一种基于元素视角的双注意力神经网络骨干结构。该结构对变量和约束进行并行自注意力和交叉注意力，替代传统的图神经网络（GNN）。在实例级、元素级和求解状态级三类任务上，该方法一致优于GNN基线。
Motivation: 现有GNN因局部性限制了MILP实例的表示能力，难以捕获全局依赖。
Method: 提出元素中心视角，将变量和约束视为元素，通过双注意力机制（intra-type self-attention + inter-type cross-attention）进行并行处理。
Result: 在三个代表性任务（实例、元素、求解状态）上，该方法一致超越基于GNN的架构。
Conclusion: 基于注意力、元素中心的建模是学习增强组合优化的有力基础。

papers.title: Provably Finding a Hidden Dense Submatrix among Many Planted Dense Submatrices via Convex Programming
papers.abstract_en: We consider the densest submatrix problem, which seeks the submatrix of fixed size of a given binary matrix that contains the most nonzero entries. This problem is a natural generalization of fundamental problems in combinatorial optimization, e.g., the densest subgraph, maximum clique, and maximum edge biclique problems, and has wide application the study of complex networks. Much recent research has focused on the development of sufficient conditions for exact solution of the densest submatrix problem via convex relaxation. The vast majority of these sufficient conditions establish identification of the densest submatrix within a graph containing exactly one large dense submatrix hidden by noise. The assumptions of these underlying models are not observed in real-world networks, where the data may correspond to a matrix containing many dense submatrices of varying sizes. We extend and generalize these results to the more realistic setting where the input matrix may contain \emph{many} large dense subgraphs. Specifically, we establish sufficient conditions under which we can expect to solve the densest submatrix problem in polynomial time for random input matrices sampled from a generalization of the stochastic block model. Moreover, we also provide sufficient conditions for perfect recovery under a deterministic adversarial. Numerical experiments involving randomly generated problem instances and real-world collaboration and communication networks are used empirically to verify the theoretical phase-transitions to perfect recovery given by these sufficient conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在包含多个隐蔽稠密子矩阵的二进制矩阵中寻找最稠密子矩阵的问题。作者建立多项式时间求解的充分条件，适用于随机块模型推广下的随机输入矩阵和确定性对抗性矩阵。数值实验验证了理论相变界限。
Motivation: 现有工作通常假设图中只有一个被噪声隐藏的大稠密子矩阵，但实际网络数据可能包含多个不同大小的稠密子矩阵。本文旨在将此假设推广到更现实的多个稠密子矩阵场景。
Method: 通过凸松弛（convex relaxation）方法，提出广义随机块模型下的充分条件，保证多项式时间内找到固定大小的最稠密子矩阵，并给出确定性对抗模型下的完美恢复条件。
Result: 在随机生成的问题实例和真实世界协作与通信网络上，数值实验验证了理论相变到完美恢复的界限。
Conclusion: 论文将单稠密子矩阵识别条件扩展到了多子矩阵情形，但仅限于特定模型假设；实验支持理论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NarrativeTrack: Evaluating Entity-Centric Reasoning for Narrative Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive progress in vision-language reasoning, yet their ability to understand temporally unfolding narratives in videos remains underexplored. True narrative understanding requires grounding who is doing what, when, and where, maintaining coherent entity representations across dynamic visual and temporal contexts. We introduce NarrativeTrack, the first benchmark to evaluate narrative understanding in MLLMs through fine-grained entity-centric reasoning. Unlike existing benchmarks limited to short clips or coarse scene-level semantics, we decompose videos into constituent entities and examine their continuity via a Compositional Reasoning Progression (CRP), a structured evaluation framework that progressively increases narrative complexity across three dimensions: entity existence, entity changes, and entity ambiguity. CRP challenges models to advance from temporal persistence to contextual evolution and fine-grained perceptual reasoning. A fully automated entity-centric pipeline enables scalable extraction of temporally grounded entity representations, providing the foundation for CRP. Evaluations of state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal that models fail to robustly track entities across visual transitions and temporal dynamics, often hallucinating identity under context shifts. Open-source general-purpose MLLMs exhibit strong perceptual grounding but weak temporal coherence, while video-specific MLLMs capture temporal context yet hallucinate entities' contexts. These findings uncover a fundamental trade-off between perceptual grounding and temporal reasoning, indicating that narrative understanding emerges only from their integration. NarrativeTrack provides the first systematic framework to diagnose and advance temporally grounded narrative comprehension in MLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NarrativeTrack，首个通过细粒度实体中心推理评估多模态大模型（MLLM）叙事理解的基准。该基准将视频分解为实体，并通过组合推理进展（CRP）框架逐步增加叙事复杂度，从实体存在性、变化到歧义性评估模型。评估发现现有 MLLM 在视觉过渡和时间动态中难以稳健跟踪实体，存在感知基础与时间推理之间的权衡。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 在视频叙事理解方面研究不足，已有基准局限于短片段或粗粒度场景语义，缺乏对实体在动态视觉和时间上下文中连续性的系统评估。
Method: 构建 NarrativeTrack 基准，包含自动化的实体中心流水线以提取时间对齐的实体表示，并设计组合推理进展（CRP）评估框架，从实体存在性、实体变化和实体歧义三个维度逐步增加叙事复杂度。
Result: 对多种开源通用和视频专用 MLLM 的评估表明，模型在视觉转换和时间动态中无法稳健跟踪实体，常在上下文变化中产生身份幻觉；通用模型感知基础强但时间连贯性弱，视频专用模型时间上下文捕捉好但实体上下文易幻觉。
Conclusion: 叙事理解需要感知基础与时间推理的整合，NarrativeTrack 为诊断和提升 MLLM 的时间接地叙事理解提供了首个系统框架。
Relevance: 10
