papers.title: MetaTT: A Global Tensor-Train Adapter for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: We present MetaTT, a Tensor Train (TT) adapter framework for fine-tuning of pre-trained transformers. MetaTT enables flexible and parameter-efficient model adaptation by using a single shared TT to factorize transformer sub-modules. This factorization indexes key structural dimensions, including layer and matrix type, and can optionally incorporate heads and tasks. This design allows MetaTT's parameter count to scale with the sum, rather than the product, of the modes, resulting in a substantially more compact adapter. Our benchmarks compare MetaTT with LoRA along with recent state-of-the-art matrix and tensor decomposition based fine-tuning methods. We observe that when tested on single-task standard language modeling benchmarks, MetaTT achieves competitive parameter efficiency to accuracy tradeoff. We further demonstrate that MetaTT performs competitively when compared to state-of-the-art methods on multi-task learning. Finally, we leverage the TT decomposition to design a rank adaptive optimizer inspired by the DMRG method from many-body physics. Our results demonstrate that integrating this approach with AdamW enhances optimization performance for a specified target rank.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MetaTT，一种基于张量训练（Tensor Train, TT）的适配器框架，用于预训练Transformer的参数高效微调。MetaTT使用单个共享TT分解多个Transformer子模块，通过索引层、矩阵类型等结构维度，使得参数量随模式的和而非积增长，从而更加紧凑。在单任务语言建模基准上，MetaTT在参数效率与准确率权衡上达到与LoRA等最新方法竞争的水平；在多任务学习中也表现良好。此外，受多体物理DMRG方法启发，设计了秩自适应优化器，与AdamW结合可提升优化性能。
Motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法（如LoRA）的参数量与子模块数量乘积相关，导致模型较大。需要更紧凑的适配器结构，同时保持或提升性能。
Method: 提出MetaTT框架，使用单个共享张量训练（TT）分解Transformer中的多个子模块（如Q、K、V矩阵），通过引入层索引、矩阵类型等维度压缩参数量。并基于DMRG方法设计秩自适应优化器。
Result: 在单任务语言建模上，MetaTT取得与LoRA等最新方法竞争的参数效率-准确率权衡；在多任务学习中表现优于或持平于现有方法。秩自适应优化器与AdamW结合进一步提升了优化性能。
Conclusion: MetaTT通过全局TT分解实现了更紧凑的参数高效微调，并展示了秩自适应优化器的潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MAGIK: Mapping to Analogous Goals via Imagination-enabled Knowledge Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Humans excel at analogical reasoning - applying knowledge from one task to a related one with minimal relearning. In contrast, reinforcement learning (RL) agents typically require extensive retraining even when new tasks share structural similarities with previously learned ones. In this work, we propose MAGIK, a novel framework that enables RL agents to transfer knowledge to analogous tasks without interacting with the target environment. Our approach leverages an imagination mechanism to map entities in the target task to their analogues in the source domain, allowing the agent to reuse its original policy. Experiments on custom MiniGrid and MuJoCo tasks show that MAGIK achieves effective zero-shot transfer using only a small number of human-labelled examples. We compare our approach to related baselines and highlight how it offers a novel and effective mechanism for knowledge transfer via imagination-based analogy mapping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出MAGIK框架，利用想象力机制将目标任务中的实体映射到源域中的对应物，使强化学习代理无需与环境交互即可复用原有策略，实现零样本迁移。在MiniGrid和MuJoCo任务上，仅需少量人工标注示例即可有效迁移。
Motivation: 强化学习代理在面对结构相似的新任务时通常需要大量重新训练，而人类能通过类比推理快速迁移知识，因此需要让代理具备类似的零样本迁移能力。
Method: MAGIK框架通过想象力机制（imagination mechanism）建立目标任务与源域之间的实体映射，使代理能够直接重用源域的预训练策略，无需与目标环境交互。
Result: 在自定义MiniGrid和MuJoCo任务上，MAGIK使用少量人类标注示例实现了有效的零样本迁移，并优于相关基线方法。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种通过基于想象力的类比映射进行知识迁移的新颖且有效的机制，为强化学习中的零样本迁移提供了新思路。

papers.title: Composite Reward Design in PPO-Driven Adaptive Filtering
papers.abstract_en: Model-free and reinforcement learning-based adaptive filtering methods are gaining traction for denoising in dynamic, non-stationary environments such as wireless signal channels, biomedical monitoring, and sensor networks. Traditional filters such as LMS, RLS, Wiener, and Kalman are often limited by assumptions of stationarity, the need for exact noise statistics, or fragile parameter tuning. This paper proposes an adaptive filtering framework using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), guided by a composite reward that balances SNR improvement, MSE reduction, and residual smoothness. We frame adaptive filtering as a Markov decision process and train a PPO agent to adjust filter coefficients directly in response to changing noise. Experiments on synthetic nonstationary signals with diverse noise types show that the PPO agent generalizes beyond its training distribution. Moreover, real-world analysis is made and evaluated on ECG recordings from the MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test Database corrupted by baseline wander, electrode motion, and muscle artifacts. The learned PPO policy achieves real-time inference and slightly outperforms strong classical baselines on ECG denoising. These results demonstrate the viability of policy-gradient reinforcement learning as a computationally efficient and flexible tool for adaptive filtering in nonlinear, time-varying dynamical systems.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于近端策略优化（PPO）的自适应滤波框架，通过设计复合奖励函数（平衡信噪比提升、均方误差降低和残差平滑性）来优化滤波器系数。在合成非平稳信号和MIT-BIH噪声应激测试数据库的ECG去噪实验中，该PPO策略实现了实时推理，性能略优于经典基线（如LMS、卡尔曼滤波），证明了策略梯度强化学习在非线性时变系统中作为自适应滤波工具的可行性。
Motivation: 传统自适应滤波器（如LMS、RLS、维纳滤波、卡尔曼滤波）受限于平稳性假设、需精确噪声统计或参数调优脆弱，难以适应无线信道、生物医学监测等动态非平稳环境。
Method: 将自适应滤波建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），采用PPO算法直接调整滤波器系数；奖励函数由信噪比（SNR）提升、均方误差（MSE）降低和残差平滑性三项加权组成。
Result: 在合成非平稳信号（多种噪声类型）上，PPO代理能泛化到训练分布之外；在MIT-BIH噪声应激测试数据库的ECG去噪中，PPO策略实现实时推理且略优于经典基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调策略梯度强化学习可作为计算高效且灵活的工具，用于非线性时变系统中的自适应滤波。

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of Lightweight CNNs for Resource-Constrained Devices: Predictive Performance, Efficiency Trade-offs, and Initialization Effects
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight convolutional neural networks are often compared using results obtained with different training recipes, input settings, and pretrained checkpoints. Such differences make architecture rankings difficult to interpret. This study presents a controlled benchmark of seven established CNNs across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet under a shared fine tuning protocol. The evaluation reports top-1 accuracy, macro F1, top-5 accuracy, parameter count, FP32 parameter storage, and multiply accumulate operations. EfficientNetV2-S records the highest observed top-1 accuracy on all three datasets, reaching 97.57%, 86.98%, and 78.73%. EfficientNet-B0 remains within 0.85 percentage points of EfficientNetV2-S across the three datasets while requiring only about 21% of its parameters and 14% of its multiply accumulate operations on Tiny ImageNet. It therefore offers a favorable general balance between predictive performance and computational demand. MobileNetV3-Small is a strong candidate for ultra low resource settings. It uses about 40% of the parameters and 15% of the multiply accumulate operations of EfficientNet-B0 while retaining competitive accuracy. A matched comparison of ImageNet pretrained and randomly initialized EfficientNet-B0 and MobileNetV3-Small models shows that the pretrained advantage is substantially larger on CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet than on CIFAR-10 under the fixed protocol. The results provide a focused reference for selecting established lightweight CNNs when predictive quality, parameter storage, and theoretical computation must be considered together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文在统一微调协议下对七种轻量级CNN在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet数据集上进行了受控基准测试，报告了准确率、参数量、存储和计算量。EfficientNetV2-S取得了最高的top-1准确率，而EfficientNet-B0在性能和计算需求之间提供了良好的平衡。研究还比较了预训练和随机初始化模型的影响。
Motivation: 现有轻量级CNN比较常因训练设置不同而难以解释，该论文旨在通过受控实验提供可比的基准，帮助在资源受限设备上选择网络架构。
Method: 采用固定的微调协议，对七种CNN（包括EfficientNet系列、MobileNetV3等）在同一条件下进行训练和评估，并额外对比了ImageNet预训练与随机初始化的影响。
Result: EfficientNetV2-S在三个数据集上取得最高top-1准确率（97.57%、86.98%、78.73%）；EfficientNet-B0准确率仅低0.85个百分点以内，但参数量和计算量大幅减少；MobileNetV3-S在超低资源场景下表现突出。预训练初始化在更困难的数据集上优势更大。
Conclusion: 该基准为同时考虑预测质量、参数存储和理论计算时的轻量级CNN选择提供了参考依据。

papers.title: Learning 3D-Gaussian Simulators from RGB Videos
papers.abstract_en: Realistic simulation is critical for applications ranging from robotics to animation. Learned simulators have emerged as a possibility to capture real world physics directly from video data, but very often require privileged information such as depth information, particle tracks and hand-engineered features to maintain spatial and temporal consistency. These strong inductive biases or ground truth 3D information help in domains where data is sparse but limit scalability and generalization in data rich regimes. To overcome the key limitations, we propose 3DGSim, a learned 3D simulator that directly learns physical interactions from multi-view RGB videos. 3DGSim unifies 3D scene reconstruction, particle dynamics prediction and video synthesis into an end-to-end trained framework. It adopts MVSplat to learn a latent particle-based representation of 3D scenes, a Point Transformer for particle dynamics, a Temporal Merging module for consistent temporal aggregation and Gaussian Splatting to produce novel view renderings. By jointly training inverse rendering and dynamics forecasting, 3DGSim embeds the physical properties into point-wise latent features. This enables the model to capture diverse physical behaviors, from rigid to elastic, cloth-like dynamics, and boundary conditions (e.g. fixed cloth corner), along with realistic lighting effects that also generalize to unseen multibody interactions and novel scene edits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出3DGSim，一个从多视角RGB视频直接学习物理交互的3D模拟器。它融合MVSplat学习基于粒子的3D场景表示、Point Transformer进行粒子动力学预测、时序合并模块保持一致性，以及高斯泼溅 (Gaussian Splatting) 生成新视角渲染。端到端训练使模型将物理属性嵌入逐点潜特征，能够模拟刚体、弹性、布料等动力学并泛化到未见交互和场景编辑。
Motivation: 现有学习型模拟器依赖深度图、粒子轨迹等特权信息或手工特征，限制了数据丰富场景下的可扩展性与泛化性。
Method: 提出端到端框架3DGSim，统一3D场景重建、粒子动力学预测和视频合成。采用MVSplat学习潜粒子表示，Point Transformer预测动力学，时序合并模块确保时间一致性，最后通过高斯泼溅渲染新视角。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，但声称模型能捕捉刚体、弹性、布料等多样物理行为及边界条件，并泛化到未见过多体交互和新场景编辑，同时呈现真实光照效果。
Conclusion: 3DGSim证明了仅从RGB视频学习通用物理模拟器的可行性，避免了3D标注或手工特征，为机器人、动画等领域提供了更可扩展的仿真途径。

papers.title: A Survey of Circuit Foundation Model: Foundation AI Models for VLSI Circuit Design and EDA
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven electronic design automation (EDA) techniques have been extensively explored for VLSI circuit design applications. Most recently, foundation AI models for circuits have emerged as a new technology trend. Unlike traditional task-specific AI solutions, these new AI models are developed through two stages: 1) self-supervised pre-training on a large amount of unlabeled data to learn intrinsic circuit properties; and 2) efficient fine-tuning for specific downstream applications, such as early-stage design quality evaluation, circuit-related context generation, and functional verification. This new paradigm brings many advantages: model generalization, less reliance on labeled circuit data, efficient adaptation to new tasks, and unprecedented generative capability. In this paper, we propose referring to AI models developed with this new paradigm as circuit foundation models (CFMs). This paper provides a comprehensive survey of the latest progress in circuit foundation models, unprecedentedly covering over 130 relevant works. Over 90% of our introduced works were published in or after 2022, indicating that this emerging research trend has attracted wide attention in a short period. In this survey, we propose to categorize all existing circuit foundation models into two primary types: 1) encoder-based methods performing general circuit representation learning for predictive tasks; and 2) decoder-based methods leveraging large language models (LLMs) for generative tasks. For our introduced works, we cover their input modalities, model architecture, pre-training strategies, domain adaptation techniques, and downstream design applications. In addition, this paper discussed the unique properties of circuits from the data perspective. These circuit properties have motivated many works in this domain and differentiated them from general AI techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了电路基础模型（Circuit Foundation Models, CFMs）在VLSI电路设计和EDA中的最新进展，涵盖130多篇相关工作，其中90%以上发表于2022年及之后。将CFMs分为两类：基于编码器的通用电路表示学习方法（用于预测任务）和基于解码器的大语言模型方法（用于生成任务），并讨论了电路数据的独特性质。
Motivation: 传统AI解决方案是任务特定的，而电路基础模型通过自监督预训练和微调可实现模型通用化、减少对标注数据的依赖、高效适应新任务等优势，但缺乏系统性的综述。
Method: 将现有电路基础模型分为两类：1）基于编码器的方法，进行通用电路表示学习以支持预测任务；2）基于解码器的方法，利用大语言模型（LLMs）进行生成任务。覆盖输入模态、模型架构、预训练策略、域适应技术和下游设计应用。
Result: 总结了130多篇相关工作，超过90%发表于2022年及之后，表明该领域发展迅速。
Conclusion: 从数据视角讨论了电路的特殊性质，这些性质推动了许多相关工作，并使其区别于通用AI技术。

papers.title: Meta-Representational Predictive Coding: Neuroscience-Informed Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning has become an increasingly important paradigm in the domain of machine intelligence. Furthermore, evidence for self-supervised adaptation, such as contrastive formulations, has emerged in recent computational neuroscience and brain-inspired research. Nevertheless, current work on self-supervised learning relies on biologically implausible credit assignment -- in the form of backpropagation of errors -- and feedforward inference, typically a forward-locked pass. Predictive coding, in its mechanistic form, offers a biologically plausible means to sidestep these backprop-specific limitations. However, unsupervised predictive coding rests on learning a generative model of raw input (akin to "generative AI" approaches), which entails predicting a potentially high dimensional input; on the other hand, supervised predictive coding, which learns a mapping between inputs to target labels, requires human annotation, and thus incurs the drawbacks of supervised learning. In this work, we present a scheme for self-supervised learning, specifically for an emerging research sub-domain that we label as neuroscience-informed self-supervised learning (NeuroSSL), within a neurobiologically plausible framework that appeals to the free energy principle, constructing a new form of predictive coding that we call meta-representational predictive coding (MPC). MPC sidesteps the need for learning a generative model of sensory input (e.g., pixel-level features) by learning to predict representations of the input across parallel streams, resulting in an encoder-only learning and inference scheme. This formulation notably rests on active inference (in the form of sensory glimpsing) to drive the learning of representations, i.e., the representational dynamics are driven by sequences of decisions made by the model to sample informative portions of its sensorium.
papers.comment: Significant updates to modeling framework, saccade planning + LGN units detailed, natural image experiments, new analyses and zero-shot generalization results now included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经科学启发的自我监督学习框架——元表征预测编码（MPC），基于自由能原理和主动推理，通过并行流的表征预测替代了传统生成模型或监督学习，实现仅编码器的学习与推理。该方法避免了生物不可信的误差反向传播和前向锁定推理，在自然图像实验和零样本泛化中展示了有效性。
Motivation: 现有自我监督学习依赖生物不可信的误差反向传播和前向锁定推理，而预测编码要么需要学习高维输入生成模型，要么需要人工标注进行监督预测编码。本文旨在提出一种无监督且生物可行的自我监督学习方案。
Method: 提出元表征预测编码（MPC），基于自由能原理和主动推理，通过感官瞥视（sensory glimpsing）驱动表征学习，模型学习在并行流之间预测输入的表征，而非预测原始输入，从而仅使用编码器进行学习和推理。
Result: 摘要报告了在自然图像上的实验分析和零样本泛化结果，但未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 本文强调MPC为自我监督学习提供了一种生物可行的替代方案，通过主动推理和表征预测避免了生成模型或监督标签的需求。

papers.title: Split-n-Chain: Privacy-Preserving Multi-Node Split Learning with Blockchain-Based Auditability
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning, when integrated with a large amount of training data, has the potential to outperform machine learning in terms of high accuracy. Recently, privacy-preserving deep learning has drawn significant attention of the research community. Different privacy notions in deep learning include privacy of data provided by data-owners and privacy of parameters and/or hyperparameters of the underlying neural network. Federated learning is a popular privacy-preserving execution environment where data-owners participate in learning the parameters collectively without leaking their respective data to other participants. However, federated learning suffers from certain security/privacy issues. In this paper, we propose Split-n-Chain, a variant of split learning where the layers of the network are split among several distributed nodes. Split-n-Chain achieves several privacy properties: data-owners need not share their training data with other nodes, and no nodes have access to the parameters and hyperparameters of the neural network (except that of the respective layers they hold). Moreover, Split-n-Chain uses blockchain to audit the computation done by different nodes. Our experimental results show that: Split-n-Chain is efficient, in terms of time required to execute different phases, and the training loss trend is similar to that for the same neural network when implemented in a monolithic fashion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Split-n-Chain，一种多节点拆分学习（split learning）变体，将神经网络层分布到多个分布式节点，从而在不共享训练数据的前提下保护数据隐私和模型参数隐私，并利用区块链对节点计算进行审计。实验表明，该方法的执行时间高效，训练损失趋势与单机实现的神经网络相似。
Motivation: 联邦学习存在安全/隐私问题，现有拆分学习方法可能暴露完整模型参数。需要一种在多方协作训练中同时保护数据和模型参数的方案。
Method: 提出 Split-n-Chain，将神经网络层拆分到多个分布式节点，每个节点只持有部分层；使用区块链记录和审计各节点的计算，确保可追溯性。
Result: 实验显示不同阶段的执行时间高效，训练损失趋势与单机实现的神经网络相似。
Conclusion: Split-n-Chain 在保持隐私的同时实现了与单机网络相似的性能，区块链审计增强了可信度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Wearable Device Dataset for Mental Health Assessment Using Laser Doppler Flowmetry and Fluorescence Spectroscopy Sensors
papers.abstract_en: Mental health problems such as stress, anxiety, and depression affect millions of people worldwide. These conditions are usually assessed using questionnaires, which rely on how people describe their own feelings. In this study, we explore whether a wearable device can help measure mental health using physical signals from the body. The device records small changes in blood flow and tissue activity from the fingertip. We collected data from 132 adults across 19 countries and compared these signals with mental health questionnaire results. We found that patterns in blood flow and tissue activity are linked to stress-related symptoms. This approach may help develop new tools for simple, non-invasive mental health monitoring in everyday life. Code and datasets are publicly available: https://github.com/leduckhai/Wearable_LDF-FS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文收集了来自19个国家132名成年人的可穿戴设备数据，使用激光多普勒血流测量和荧光光谱传感器记录指尖血流和组织活动信号，并与心理健康问卷结果关联。发现这些生理信号模式与压力相关症状有关，为日常非侵入性心理健康监测提供了潜在工具。数据集和代码已公开。
Motivation: 传统心理健康评估依赖问卷，受主观感受影响。本文探索使用可穿戴设备通过身体信号客观评估心理健康，解决主观问卷的局限性。
Method: 使用可穿戴设备采集激光多普勒血流测量和荧光光谱传感器数据，记录指尖微循环变化，并与心理健康问卷结果进行关联分析。
Result: 发现血流和组织活动模式与压力相关症状存在关联，表明该方法可用于心理健康监测。
Conclusion: 该研究为开发简单、非侵入性的日常心理健康监测工具提供了基础，但需进一步验证其普适性和准确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Leveraging Metamemory Agent for Enhanced Data-Free Code Generation in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in automated code generation, with few-shot prompting widely used for its simplicity and effectiveness. However, few-shot methods depend on curated or manually crafted reference examples, limiting their applicability in data-free coding scenarios such as real-world data-free coding scenarios and benchmarks without training sets. Existing methods that generate reference examples via recitation or analogy cannot guarantee their authenticity or accuracy. Inspired by human metamemory, we propose a novel metamemory agent to enhance one-time code generation in data-free coding scenarios. The agent guides LLMs to recall relevant prior knowledge, evaluate confidence in recalled information, and selectively exploit reliable content for problem solving. This agent removes the need for external reference examples, improves the authenticity and accuracy of recalled knowledge, and adaptively tailors the recall\&evaluation process to each task. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed metamemory agent significantly improves one-time code generation quality across data-free coding scenarios. The AI contribution is the metamemory agent, which makes self-recalled examples reliable through confidence evaluation and selection; the engineering application is data-free automated code generation, validated on eight public benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种元记忆代理（metamemory agent），用于增强大语言模型在无数据代码生成场景中的一次性代码生成质量。该代理引导模型回忆相关先验知识、评估置信度并选择可靠内容，无需外部参考示例。实验在八个公开基准上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有少样本代码生成依赖人工构建的参考示例，在无数据编码场景（如无训练集的基准）中受限；通过背诵或类比生成的参考示例无法保证真实性和准确性。
Method: 提出元记忆代理，包含三个步骤：回忆相关先验知识、评估回忆内容的置信度、选择性地利用可靠内容进行问题求解。该代理自适应调整回忆与评估过程，无需外部示例。
Result: 在八个公开基准上，该方法显著提升了无数据代码生成场景下一次性代码生成的质量。
Conclusion: 元记忆代理通过置信度评估和选择使自回忆示例变得可靠，适用于无数据自动代码生成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Interactive Global Geolocation Assistant
papers.abstract_en: Global geolocation, which seeks to predict the geographical location of images captured anywhere in the world, is one of the most challenging tasks in the field of computer vision. In this paper, we introduce an innovative interactive global geolocation assistant named GaGA, built upon the flourishing large vision-language models (LVLMs). GaGA uncovers geographical clues within images and combines them with the extensive world knowledge embedded in LVLMs to determine the geolocations while also providing justifications and explanations for the prediction results. We further designed a novel interactive geolocation method that surpasses traditional static inference approaches. It allows users to intervene, correct, or provide clues for the predictions, making the model more flexible and practical. The development of GaGA relies on the newly proposed Multi-modal Global Geolocation (MG-Geo) dataset, a comprehensive collection of 5 million high-quality image-text pairs. GaGA achieves state-of-the-art performance on the GWS15k dataset, improving accuracy by 4.57% at the country level and 2.92% at the city level, setting a new benchmark. These advancements represent a significant leap forward in developing highly accurate, interactive geolocation systems with global applicability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个名为 GaGA 的交互式全球地理定位助手，基于大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）构建，通过挖掘图像中的地理线索并结合 LVLMs 的世界知识来预测地理位置，并提供解释。同时设计了交互式定位方法，允许用户干预和修正，提升了灵活性和实用性。模型在 GWS15k 数据集上取得了国家级别 4.57%、城市级别 2.92% 的准确率提升，刷新了基准。
Motivation: 全球地理定位是计算机视觉中的难题，现有方法大多静态推理，缺乏交互性和可解释性，且准确率有待提升。
Method: 提出交互式地理定位助手 GaGA，基于 LVLMs 挖掘图像地理线索，并结合世界知识进行定位；设计交互式方法允许用户干预预测；构建了包含 500 万高质量图像-文本对的 MG-Geo 数据集用于训练。
Result: 在 GWS15k 数据集上，国家级别准确率提升 4.57%，城市级别提升 2.92%，达到新最优。
Conclusion: 交互式方法结合 LVLMs 能显著提升全球地理定位的准确率和实用性，但领域为图像地理定位，与降水、天气预报无关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Causal Explanations for Image Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Existing algorithms for explaining the output of image classifiers use different definitions of explanations and a variety of techniques to find them. However, none of the existing tools use a principled approach based on formal definitions of cause and explanation. In this paper we present a novel black-box approach to computing explanations grounded in the theory of actual causality. We prove relevant theoretical results and present an algorithm for computing approximate explanations based on these definitions. We prove termination of our algorithm and discuss its complexity and the amount of approximation compared to the precise definition. We implemented the framework in a tool ReX and we present experimental results and a comparison with state-of-the-art tools. We demonstrate that ReX is the most efficient black-box tool and produces the smallest explanations, in addition to outperforming other black-box tools on standard quality measures.
papers.comment: Accepted to Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research (JAIR). A subset of the contribution was published in ICCV 2021
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research, vol 86, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于实际因果理论的黑盒方法，用于计算图像分类器的解释。他们开发了工具 ReX，证明了相关理论结果，并实验表明 ReX 是最有效的黑盒工具，产生最小的解释，并在标准质量指标上优于其他工具。
Motivation: 现有图像分类器解释算法缺乏基于因果关系的形式化定义。
Method: 基于实际因果理论的黑盒方法，计算近似解释，并证明算法终止性。
Result: ReX 在效率、解释大小和标准质量指标上优于现有黑盒工具。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了形式化的因果解释框架，但存在近似与精确解释之间的权衡。

papers.title: MiraGe: Editable 2D Images using Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) approximate discrete data through continuous functions and are commonly used for encoding 2D images. Traditional image-based INRs employ neural networks to map pixel coordinates to RGB values, capturing shapes, colors, and textures within the network's weights. Recently, GaussianImage has been proposed as an alternative, using Gaussian functions instead of neural networks to achieve comparable quality and compression. Such a solution obtains a quality and compression ratio similar to classical INR models but does not allow image modification. In contrast, our work introduces a novel method, MiraGe, which uses mirror reflections to perceive 2D images in 3D space and employs flat-controlled Gaussians for precise 2D image editing. Our approach improves the rendering quality and allows realistic image modifications, including human-inspired perception of photos in the 3D world. Thanks to modeling images in 3D space, we obtain the illusion of 3D-based modification in 2D images. We also show that our Gaussian representation can be easily combined with a physics engine to produce physics-based modification of 2D images. Consequently, MiraGe allows for better quality than the standard approach and natural modification of 2D images
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MiraGe 是一种利用高斯溅射 (Gaussian Splatting) 进行 2D 图像编辑的新方法，通过将 2D 图像映射到 3D 空间中的镜像反射，并使用扁平化高斯体实现精确编辑，同时提升渲染质量并支持基于物理的修改。
Motivation: 现有的基于高斯函数的图像表示方法（如 GaussianImage）虽能达到与隐式神经表示 (INR) 相当的压缩和质量，但无法进行图像修改。MiraGe 旨在解决这一限制，实现高质量的 2D 图像编辑。
Method: 提出 MiraGe 方法，利用镜像反射将 2D 图像视为 3D 空间中的对象，通过扁平化高斯体 (flat-controlled Gaussians) 进行表示，从而支持在 3D 空间中对 2D 图像进行编辑，并可与物理引擎结合。
Result: 该方法相比标准高斯表示方法提升了渲染质量，并实现了自然且基于物理的 2D 图像修改。
Conclusion: MiraGe 通过在 3D 空间中建模 2D 图像，实现了高保真的编辑能力，并展示了与物理引擎结合的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Event-based vision sensing and its application to pedestrian detection for intelligent transportation and surveillance
papers.abstract_en: Pedestrian detection in conventional frame-based imaging often suffers from limited temporal responsiveness and substantial data redundancy. Inspired by the biological retina, event-based vision sensing (EVS) offers ultra-low latency, high temporal resolution, wide dynamic range, and low power consumption, making it highly attractive for pedestrian perception in complex environments. This paper provides a comprehensive review of EVS and its application to pedestrian detection in intelligent transportation and surveillance scenarios. We first summarize the sensing principles, historical development, and key advantages of event-based vision in comparison with conventional frame-based imaging. We then review the major methodological components of event-based pedestrian detection, including sensing inputs, event representations, preprocessing strategies, feature extraction, detection models, datasets, and evaluation metrics. In addition, representative methods are comparatively analyzed in terms of temporal fidelity, detection accuracy, computational efficiency, and deployment complexity. Finally, we discuss the major open challenges in current EB-PD research, including benchmark standardization, event-native model design, multimodal fusion, and real-world deployment, and outline several promising directions for future development. This review aims to provide a structured and up-to-date reference for researchers working on event-based pedestrian perception and related intelligent vision systems.
papers.comment: Published in Advanced Engineering Informatics, Vol. 76, Part B, 104989 (2026). Received 31 December 2025; Revised 3 June 2026; Accepted 18 June 2026; Available online 23 June 2026. DOI: 10.1016/j.aei.2026.104989
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了事件视觉传感（EVS）在智能交通和监控中行人检测的应用。与传统的帧基成像相比，EVS具有超低延迟、高时间分辨率、宽动态范围和低功耗等优势。文章系统总结了EVS的感知原理、历史发展、关键优势，以及事件基行人检测（EB-PD）的方法论组件，包括传感输入、事件表示、预处理、特征提取、检测模型、数据集和评估指标。此外，对代表性方法进行了比较分析，讨论了当前的主要挑战和未来方向。
Motivation: 传统帧基成像在行人检测中存在时间响应不足和数据冗余问题，事件视觉传感作为生物启发的新型感知方式，有望克服这些局限，但目前缺乏系统性的综述来指导该领域的研究。
Method: 采用文献综述方法，系统梳理事件视觉传感的原理和优势，并详细分类和比较事件基行人检测的各个技术环节，包括输入表示、预处理、特征提取、检测模型等。
Result: 通过比较分析，指出事件基行人检测在时间保真度、检测精度、计算效率和部署复杂性方面的权衡，并识别出基准标准化、事件原生模型设计、多模态融合和实际部署等关键挑战。
Conclusion: 本文提供了事件视觉传感在行人检测领域的结构化参考，强调未来需要发展事件原生模型、标准化基准以及融合多模态信息，以推动实际应用。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 采用文献综述方法，系统梳理事件视觉传感的原理和优势，并详细分类和比较事件基行人检测的各个技术环节，包括输入表示、预处理、特征提取、检测模型等。
summary_sections.result: 通过比较分析，指出事件基行人检测在时间保真度、检测精度、计算效率和部署复杂性方面的权衡，并识别出基准标准化、事件原生模型设计、多模态融合和实际部署等关键挑战。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文提供了事件视觉传感在行人检测领域的结构化参考，强调未来需要发展事件原生模型、标准化基准以及融合多模态信息，以推动实际应用。

papers.title: A locally statistical active contour model for SAR image segmentation can be solved by denoising algorithms
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel locally statistical variational active contour model based on I-divergence-TV denoising model, which hybrides geodesic active contour (GAC) model with active contours without edges (ACWE) model, and can be used to segment images corrupted by multiplicative gamma noise. By adding a diffusion term into the level set evolution (LSE) equation of the proposed model, we construct a reaction-diffusion (RD) equation, which can gradually regularize the level set function (LSF) to be piecewise constant in each segment domain and gain the stable solution. We further transform the proposed model into a general ROF model by adding a proximity term ,and it can be solved by a fast denoising algorithm proposed by Jia-Zhao or soved by BM3D and NLM denoising algorithm, which also provide a unified solution framework for formally generalized-ROF-like subproblems arising in multivariate splitting algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于I-divergence-TV去噪模型的局部统计变分活动轮廓模型，融合测地线活动轮廓（GAC）与无边缘活动轮廓（ACWE）模型，用于分割被乘性伽马噪声污染的SAR图像。通过向水平集演化方程添加扩散项构造反应扩散方程，使水平集函数逐步分段常数并稳定求解。进一步通过添加邻近项将模型转化为广义ROF模型，可利用Jia-Zhao、BM3D、NLM等快速去噪算法求解，为多变量分裂算法中的广义ROF子问题提供统一求解框架。
Motivation: 现有活动轮廓模型在处理乘性伽马噪声污染的SAR图像时存在局限，且缺乏统一的去噪算法求解框架。
Method: 基于I-divergence-TV去噪模型，混合GAC与ACWE模型，引入扩散项构建反应扩散方程，并通过邻近项转化为广义ROF模型，利用现有去噪算法求解。
Result: 该方法可有效分割乘性伽马噪声污染的SAR图像，并借助快速去噪算法实现高效求解。
Conclusion: 提出的模型为SAR图像分割提供了一种统一且可扩展的求解框架，可利用多种去噪算法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Active contours driven by local and global intensity fitting energy with application to SAR image segmentation and its fast solvers
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel variational active contour model based on Aubert-Aujol (AA) denoising model, which hybrides geodesic active contour (GAC) model with active contours without edges (ACWE) model and can be used to segment images corrupted by multiplicative gamma noise. We transform the proposed model into classic ROF model by adding a proximity term.[26] was submitted on 29-Aug-2013, and our early edition was ever submitted to TGRS on 12-Jun-2012, Venkatakrishnan et al.[27] proposed their PnP algorithm on 29-May-2013, so Venkatakrishnan and we proposed the PnP algorithm almost simultaneously. Inspired by a fast denosing algorithm proposed by Jia-Zhao recently, we propose two fast fixed point algorithms to solve SAR image segmentation question.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Aubert-Aujol (AA) 去噪模型的变分主动轮廓模型，混合测地线主动轮廓 (GAC) 模型与无边缘主动轮廓 (ACWE) 模型，用于分割受乘性伽马噪声污染的图像。通过添加邻近项将模型转化为经典ROF模型，并受Jia-Zhao快速去噪算法启发，提出两种快速定点算法求解SAR图像分割问题。
Motivation: SAR图像常受乘性伽马噪声影响，现有主动轮廓模型在噪声抑制和边缘保持上存在局限，需要鲁棒的分割方法。
Method: 基于AA去噪模型构建变分主动轮廓模型，混合GAC与ACWE的保真项，并添加邻近项转换为ROF形式；借鉴Jia-Zhao快速去噪算法，提出两种快速定点算法。
Result: 能够有效分割受到乘性伽马噪声污染的SAR图像，且快速定点算法提高了求解效率。
Conclusion: 所提模型将分割问题转化为ROF形式，并利用快速算法求解，为SAR图像分割提供了新途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAR image segmentation algorithms based on I-divergence-TV model
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel variational active contour model based on I-divergence-TV model to segment Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images with multiplicative gamma noise, which hybrides edge-based model with region-based model. The proposed model can efficiently stop the contours at weak or blurred edges, and can automatically detect the exterior and interior boundaries of images. We further transform the proposed model into a general ROF model by adding a proximity term ,and it can be solved by a fast denoising algorithm proposed by Jia-Zhao or soved by BM3D and NLM denoising algorithm, which also provide a unified solution framework for formally generalized-ROF-like subproblems arising in multivariate splitting algorithms[25]. [25] was submitted on 29-Aug-2013, and our early edition was ever submitted to TGRS on 12-Jun-2012, Venkatakrishnan et al. [26] proposed their PnP algorithm on 29-May-2013, so Venkatakrishnan and we proposed the PnP algorithm almost simultaneously.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于I-divergence-TV模型的活动轮廓模型，用于分割含有乘性伽马噪声的SAR图像，该模型混合了基于边缘和基于区域的方法，能有效停在弱或模糊边缘，自动检测内外边界。通过添加邻近项将模型转化为通用ROF模型，并可用Jia-Zhao快速去噪算法或BM3D、NLM去噪算法求解，为多变量分裂算法中的广义ROF-like子问题提供统一求解框架。
Motivation: SAR图像分割中，乘性噪声和弱边缘导致传统模型难以准确定位边界，现有方法在边缘保持和区域一致性之间权衡不足。
Method: 提出混合边缘-区域的活动轮廓模型，利用I-divergence-TV保真项处理伽马噪声，并通过邻近项转化为ROF模型，采用快速去噪算法（如Jia-Zhao算法、BM3D、NLM）求解。
Result: 模型能够自动检测图像内外边界，有效处理弱或模糊边缘，并提供与PnP算法几乎同时提出的统一求解框架。
Conclusion: 该模型为SAR图像分割提供了一种有效且可快速求解的变分框架，但摘要未给出量化实验结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A global optimization SAR image segmentation model can be easily transformed to a general ROF denoising model
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel locally statistical active contour model (LACM) based on Aubert-Aujol (AA) denoising model and variational level set method, which can be used for SAR images segmentation with intensity inhomogeneity. Then we transform the proposed model into a global optimization model by using convex relaxation technique. Firstly, we apply the Split Bregman technique to transform the global optimization model into two alternating optimization processes of Shrink operator and Laplace operator, which is called SB_LACM model. Moreover, we propose two fast models to solve the global optimization model , which are more efficient than the SB_LACM model. The first model is: we add the proximal function to transform the global optimization model to a general ROF model[29], which can be solved by a fast denoising algorithm proposed by R.-Q.Jia, and H.Zhao; [29] was submitted on 29-Aug-2013, and our early edition was ever submitted to TGRS on 12-Jun-2012, Venkatakrishnan et al. [30] proposed their PnP algorithm on 29-May-2013, so Venkatakrishnan and we proposed the PnP algorithm almost simultaneously. Thus we obtain a fast segmentation algorithm with global optimization solver that does not involve partial differential equations or difference equation, and only need simple difference computation. The second model is: we use a different splitting approach than one model to transform the global optimization model into a differentiable term and a general ROF model term, which can be solved by the same technique as the first model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于AA去噪模型和变分水平集方法的局部统计活动轮廓模型(LACM)用于SAR图像分割，并通过凸松弛技术转化为全局优化模型。利用Split Bregman技术求解，并进一步提出两个快速模型，其中一个将全局优化模型转化为通用ROF去噪模型，从而避免偏微分方程求解，仅需简单差分计算。
Motivation: 现有SAR图像分割模型难以处理强度不均匀性，且求解过程复杂。作者希望提出一种能处理强度不均匀性且计算高效的全局优化分割模型。
Method: 基于AA去噪模型和变分水平集建立LACM，通过凸松弛转化为全局优化模型。使用Split Bregman分解为交替的Shrink算子和Laplace算子求解（SB_LACM）。进一步提出两个加速模型：第一个通过添加近端函数转化为通用ROF去噪模型，利用快速去噪算法求解；第二个采用不同的分裂方法，将优化模型分解为可微项和ROF项。
Result: 未在摘要中提供具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 所提方法可转化为通用ROF去噪模型，求解过程不涉及偏微分或差分方程，仅需简单差分计算，从而获得高效的全局优化分割算法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Introduction to Transformers: an NLP Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have dominated empirical machine learning models of natural language processing. In this paper, we introduce basic concepts of Transformers and present key techniques that form the recent advances of these models. This includes a description of the standard Transformer architecture, a series of model refinements, and common applications. Given that Transformers and related deep learning techniques might be evolving in ways we have never seen, we cannot dive into all the model details or cover all the technical areas. Instead, we focus on just those concepts that are helpful for gaining a good understanding of Transformers and their variants. We also summarize the key ideas that impact this field, thereby yielding some insights into the strengths and limitations of these models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是面向自然语言处理领域的Transformer入门综述，系统介绍了标准Transformer架构、模型改进技巧及其常见应用。作者聚焦于帮助读者建立对Transformer及其变体的基本理解，并总结了影响该领域的关键思想，讨论了模型的优势与局限性。
Motivation: Transformer在自然语言处理中占据主导地位，但相关技术快速演进，初学者或跨领域研究者需要一份聚焦核心概念的导引材料，避免淹没在过多细节中。
Method: 采用教程式叙述，从标准Transformer架构（自注意力、多头注意力、位置编码等）出发，逐步引入训练技巧（如学习率调度、正则化）和模型变体（如BERT、GPT等），并列举典型应用场景。
Result: 作为综述，不提供实验数值结果；但文章归纳了影响Transformer性能的关键设计选择（如注意力头数、层数）及其优缺点，为后续研究提供背景知识。
Conclusion: Transformer模型的优势在于并行计算和长距离依赖建模，但存在二次复杂度、位置编码局限等问题。未来演进方向包括更高效的注意力机制和针对特定任务的定制化架构。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Mean Field Approach to Empirical Bayes Estimation in High-dimensional Linear Regression
papers.abstract_en: We study empirical Bayes estimation in high-dimensional linear regression. To facilitate computationally efficient estimation of the underlying prior, we adopt a variational empirical Bayes approach, introduced originally in Carbonetto and Stephens (2012) and Kim et al. (2022). We establish asymptotic consistency of the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator (NPMLE) and its (computable) naive mean field variational surrogate under mild assumptions on the design and the prior. Assuming, in addition, that the naive mean field approximation has a dominant optimizer, we develop a computationally efficient approximation to the oracle posterior distribution, and establish its accuracy under the 1-Wasserstein metric. This enables computationally feasible Bayesian inference; e.g., construction of posterior credible intervals with an average coverage guarantee, Bayes optimal estimation for the regression coefficients, estimation of the proportion of non-nulls, etc. Our analysis covers both deterministic and random designs, and accommodates correlations among the features. To the best of our knowledge, this provides the first rigorous nonparametric empirical Bayes method in a high-dimensional regression setting without sparsity.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 1 figure; This version adds non-asymptotic rates of convergence for the NPMLE and the MF-NPMLE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究高维线性回归中的经验贝叶斯估计，采用均值场变分经验贝叶斯方法，证明了非参数最大似然估计（NPMLE）及其均值场变分代理（MF-NPMLE）的渐近一致性，并在主导优化器假设下，建立了计算高效的后验近似在1-Wasserstein度量下的准确性，支持后验置信区间、回归系数最优估计等贝叶斯推断。
Motivation: 高维线性回归中，经验贝叶斯方法通常计算复杂且缺乏严格的非参数理论保证，尤其在不假设稀疏性时。
Method: 采用均值场变分经验贝叶斯方法，通过非参数最大似然估计及其均值场近似，在温和条件下证明一致性，并利用1-Wasserstein度量评估近似精度。
Result: 建立了NPMLE和MF-NPMLE的渐近一致性及非渐近收敛速率；证明了均值场近似在1-Wasserstein度量下的准确性，支持后验置信区间、回归系数最优估计等任务。
Conclusion: 提供了高维回归中首个不依赖稀疏性的严格非参数经验贝叶斯方法，覆盖确定性和随机设计，并允许特征间相关性。

papers.title: Spintronics for image recognition: performance benchmarking via data-driven simulations
papers.abstract_en: We present a demonstration of image classification using an extreme learning machine (ELM) based on a unique simulated magnetic tunnel junction (MTJ) delayed in time. As the ground state of the MTJ is a magnetic vortex, we refer to it as a vortex-based spin-torque oscillator (STVO). The dynamics of the magnetic vortex is simulated with a model called the data-driven Thiele equation approach (DD-TEA). This allows to avoid the constraints associated with repeated experimental manipulation for hyperparameters search and benchmarking. We showcase the versatility of our implementation by using it successfully for classification tasks on the MNIST, EMNIST-letters and Fashion MNIST datasets. Through simulations, we show that within an ELM with a sufficient number of parameters, the performance reached using the STVO dynamics as a source of nonlinearity is equivalent to the ones obtained with classical software activation functions such as the reLU and the sigmoid. While achieving state-of-the-art accuracy levels on the MNIST dataset, our model's performance on EMNIST-letters and Fashion MNIST is lower due to the simplicity of the network architecture and the increased complexity of the data. We expect that the DD-TEA framework will enable the exploration of deeper and more complex STVO-based architectures, ultimately leading to improved classification accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用基于磁涡旋自旋扭矩振荡器（STVO）的极限学习机（ELM）进行图像分类，通过数据驱动的Thiele方程方法（DD-TEA）模拟磁隧道结动力学，在MNIST、EMNIST-letters和Fashion MNIST数据集上测试性能。结果显示，在足够参数下，STVO非线性与ReLU、sigmoid等经典激活函数效果相当，但在复杂数据集上表现较低。
Motivation: 传统实验方法进行超参数搜索和基准测试需要反复操作，本文旨在通过数据驱动模拟避免实验约束，并验证STVO作为非线性源的可行性。
Method: 采用数据驱动的Thiele方程方法（DD-TEA）模拟磁涡旋动力学，将其作为ELM的非线性激活函数，在图像分类任务上进行性能评估。
Result: 在MNIST数据集上达到与经典激活函数相当的准确率，但在EMNIST-letters和Fashion MNIST上因网络简单和数据复杂而性能较低。
Conclusion: DD-TEA框架有望推动更深的STVO架构探索，进一步提升分类精度。

papers.title: Playing 20 Question Game with Policy-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: The 20 Questions (Q20) game is a well known game which encourages deductive reasoning and creativity. In the game, the answerer first thinks of an object such as a famous person or a kind of animal. Then the questioner tries to guess the object by asking 20 questions. In a Q20 game system, the user is considered as the answerer while the system itself acts as the questioner which requires a good strategy of question selection to figure out the correct object and win the game. However, the optimal policy of question selection is hard to be derived due to the complexity and volatility of the game environment. In this paper, we propose a novel policy-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) method, which enables the questioner agent to learn the optimal policy of question selection through continuous interactions with users. To facilitate training, we also propose to use a reward network to estimate the more informative reward. Compared to previous methods, our RL method is robust to noisy answers and does not rely on the Knowledge Base of objects. Experimental results show that our RL method clearly outperforms an entropy-based engineering system and has competitive performance in a noisy-free simulation environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于策略的强化学习方法，使20问题游戏中的提问者学会最优提问策略，通过与用户连续交互提高猜中率。方法使用奖励网络估计信息量更大的奖励，对噪声答案鲁棒，且不依赖知识库。实验表明在无噪声模拟环境下优于基于熵的方法。
Motivation: 20问题游戏中提问者的最优策略难以推导，传统方法对环境噪声敏感且依赖知识库。
Method: 提出基于策略的强化学习（Policy-based RL）方法，令提问者智能体通过与用户交互学习提问策略；引入奖励网络（reward network）以提供更有效的奖励信号。
Result: 在无噪声模拟环境中，RL方法优于基于熵的工程系统，且对噪声答案具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: RL方法不依赖知识库，可适应复杂游戏环境，为交互式问答系统提供新思路。

papers.title: ESC: Emotional Self-Correction for Reliable Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse multimodal tasks, yet they remain vulnerable to unreliable reasoning. Existing self-correction methods mitigate these issues but typically rely on post-training or carefully engineered feedback, incurring high computational cost. In this work, we revisit this challenge through the lens of emotional cues, asking whether they can activate latent self-correction behaviors in VLMs without additional training. \textbf{We find that emotional signals serve as an effective trigger for self-correction, encouraging more cautious and reflective reasoning}. Motivated by this finding, we propose \escabstract (\textbf{\underline{E}}motional \textbf{\underline{S}}elf-\textbf{\underline{C}}orrection), a training-free self-correction framework. ESC introduces an external verifier that detects potentially incorrect initial responses and injects emotional feedback to encourage model to reflect, and produce a better revised response without additional training. Extensive experiments across safety, hallucination, vision-centric perception, and multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that ESC consistently improves reliability while preserving overall model utility. These results suggest that emotion can function not only as an ability to be recognized, but also as a practical control signal for scalable self-correction in VLMs. \textbf{We therefore believe that ESC provides a strong foundation for a new reliable human-like, emotion-integrated research direction.} Our project is publicly available at \textcolor{red}{https://genai4e.github.io/ESC/}.
papers.comment: ECCV Main Track 2026 (113 pages, 15 tables, 65 figures). Project Page: https://genai4e.github.io/ESC/?
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现情感信号可以触发视觉语言模型（VLM）的自我修正行为，提出无需训练的ESC框架，通过外部验证器检测错误初始响应并注入情感反馈，促使模型反思并生成更好的修订响应。在安全、幻觉、视觉感知和多模态推理基准上，ESC持续提升可靠性而不损害模型整体效用。
Motivation: 现有VLM易出现不可靠推理，现有自校正方法依赖后训练或精心设计的反馈，计算成本高。本文探索情感线索作为激活VLM潜在自校正行为的低成本触发器。
Method: 提出ESC（Emotional Self-Correction）框架，包含外部验证器检测初始响应中的潜在错误，然后注入情感反馈（如谨慎、反思的提示）激励模型自我修正，无需额外训练。
Result: 在安全、幻觉、视觉感知和多模态推理等多个基准上，ESC持续提升VLM的可靠性，同时保持模型原有效用。
Conclusion: 情感不仅可以作为被识别的能力，也可以作为VLM中可扩展自校正的实用控制信号。作者认为ESC为建立可靠的人性化、情感整合的研究方向提供了基础。

papers.title: Learning Effective Soliton Dynamics from Scattering Data
papers.abstract_en: The inverse scattering transform (IST) provides the standard theoretical framework for deriving soliton dynamics. Traditionally, such derivations have been of an analytical, rather than data-driven, nature. In this paper, we combine the conceptual framework of the IST with weak-form system identification methods to discover effective soliton dynamics directly from observed scattering data, without assuming prior knowledge of the scattering equations. Our method avoids parameterizing solitary waves via ad hoc curve-fitting by working in the scattering domain, yielding interpretable low-dimensional models that remain valid in perturbed and near-integrable regimes. We demonstrate the performance of the proposed approach on synthetic and experimental data governed by shallow-water equations of Korteweg--de Vries-type and recover models that are consistent with canonical IST theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文融合逆散射变换（IST）与弱形式系统辨识方法，直接从散射数据中学习有效的孤子动力学，无需已知散射方程。该方法在散射域中避免了孤波的经验曲线拟合，得到可解释的低维模型，在受扰及近可积条件下依然有效。在KdV型浅水方程的合成和实验数据上验证了性能，模型与经典IST理论一致。
Motivation: 传统的孤子动力学推导依赖解析分析而非数据驱动，且孤波参数化常采用特设的曲线拟合，缺乏鲁棒性。本文旨在发展一种从观测散射数据直接发现有效孤子动力学的数据驱动方法。
Method: 将逆散射变换的概念框架与弱形式系统辨识相结合，在散射域而非物理域进行建模，自动得到低维、可解释的动力学模型，无需预设散射方程。
Result: 在KdV型浅水方程的合成和实验数据上，该方法恢复的模型与经典IST理论一致，展示了在受扰和近可积系统中的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法为从数据中发现孤子动力学提供了一种可解释的替代方案，尤其适用于传统解析推导困难或参数化不可靠的场景。

papers.title: MMAO-Cls: Metabolic Multi-Agent Optimization for Joint Feature Selection and Classifier Tuning
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies whether the Metabolic Multi-Agent Optimizer (MMAO) can act as a credible outer-loop optimizer for classification model selection. We propose MMAO-Cls, a mixed-space realization in which each agent jointly encodes a binary feature mask and classifier hyperparameters, while private energy, communal budget, role drift, and lifecycle turnover are mapped to the accuracy-complexity tradeoff of wrapper learning. The implementation is strengthened by deriving feature-budget adaptation from feature-information priors and by regularizing validation reward with both subset compactness and train-validation overfitting gap. We evaluate MMAO-Cls on seven standard tabular benchmarks with three seeds each and compare it against RandomSearch, GA-lite, PSO-lite, and an endogenous no-sharing ablation. On the aggregate validation objective, MMAO-Cls ranks second ($0.9433$) behind GA-lite ($0.9446$). On held-out test performance, it reaches mean score $0.8882$, improving over RandomSearch ($0.8808$) and GA-lite ($0.8857$), remaining close to PSO-lite ($0.8874$) and the no-sharing ablation ($0.8900$), while using the most compact mean held-out feature subset among all compared methods (feature ratio $0.4881$). Pairwise tests show that these margins are not yet statistically significant. The resulting claim is therefore conservative: MMAO-Cls supports classification applicability and compact mixed-space search more clearly than it isolates communal sharing as a decisive standalone advantage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究代谢多智能体优化器 (MMAO) 能否作为分类模型选择的外循环优化器，提出 MMAO-Cls，将每个智能体编码为二进制特征掩码和分类器超参数，并映射准确率-复杂度权衡。在七个标准表格基准上，MMAO-Cls 在验证目标上排名第二，测试性能平均 0.8882，略优于 RandomSearch 和 GA-lite，特征子集最紧凑（特征比率 0.4881），但统计显著性不足。
Motivation: 现有 wrapper 方法在特征选择和分类器调参联合优化中面临搜索效率与模型复杂度平衡的挑战，MMAO 的元启发式框架尚未被系统地应用于此类混合空间优化。
Method: 提出 MMAO-Cls，基于 MMAO 框架，每个智能体联合编码二值特征掩码和分类器超参数，通过私有能量、公共预算、角色漂移和生命周期轮换映射 wrapper 学习中的准确率-复杂度权衡，并引入基于特征信息先验的预算调整和验证奖励正则化。
Result: 在七个标准表格基准上，MMAO-Cls 在聚合验证目标上排名第二（0.9433），低于 GA-lite（0.9446）；在保留测试集上平均 0.8882，优于 RandomSearch（0.8808）和 GA-lite（0.8857），但与 PSO-lite（0.8874）和无共享消融（0.8900）接近；平均特征子集最紧凑（0.4881）。成对检验显示这些差距不显著。
Conclusion: 摘要保守声称 MMAO-Cls 支持分类适用性和紧凑混合空间搜索，但尚未明确证明公共共享作为决定性优势。

papers.title: Certified World Models as Sensing Clocks: Drift-Aware Deadlines for Active Perception
papers.abstract_en: Certified world models estimate how long their predictions remain valid. We turn this validity horizon into an operational sensing clock: a rule for when an agent should stop coasting and re-sense. Starting from an audited equivariant world model, we derive a deadline for no-sensing intervals and show that deployable deadlines in learned world models must be drift-aware: on-manifold Lyapunov rates alone overestimate coasting validity, while calibrated native rollout-drift envelopes carry the deployed guarantee. On a frozen 3D VN-JEPA model, the resulting clock controls held-out interval-simultaneous certificate violation across seeds and data shards. In a cue-conditioned theorem-bed (a synthetic bench where all schedulers share the exact model, isolating the scheduling rule), the clock remains valid on the deployment distribution and substantially reduces eventful-tail violations relative to exact-mixture expected-belief scheduling at matched sensing budget. We also report limits: in the short-horizon frozen VN-JEPA regime, empirical conformal horizons match the deployed clock on validity and budget, and a partial-reset exploration finds no clean budget-matched advantage for the spectral term. Thus the contribution is a certified sensing-clock primitive and drift-aware deployment method, not a claim that spectral clocks empirically dominate all non-spectral schedulers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种认证世界模型，通过将预测有效性窗口转化为操作感知时钟，为主动感知任务定义无感知间隔截止时间。基于经审计的等变世界模型，推导出漂移感知的部署截止时间，并使用校准的本地展开漂移包络来保证部署时的有效性。在冻结的3D VN-JEPA模型上，该时钟在保持预算的同时减少了事件性违反。
Motivation: 现有世界模型在部署时缺乏对预测有效性的精确保证，导致主动感知任务中无感知间隔过长或过短，引发性能下降或资源浪费。
Method: 从经审计的等变世界模型出发，推导出无感知间隔的截止时间，并提出漂移感知部署方法：利用校准的本地展开漂移包络代替流形上的Lyapunov率，以提供更可靠的保证。
Result: 在冻结的3D VN-JEPA模型上，该时钟在跨种子的保持间隔同时证书违反方面表现一致；在基于线索的定理床实验中，与精确混合期望信念调度相比，在匹配感知预算下显著减少了事件性尾部违反。
Conclusion: 贡献在于提供了一个认证的感知时钟基元及漂移感知部署方法，而非主张光谱时钟在经验上优于所有非光谱调度器。在短时冻结VN-JEPA机制中，经验共形视界在有效性和预算上与部署时钟匹配，部分重置探索未发现光谱项的明显预算匹配优势。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hidden-Shot: Towards One-Shot Task Generalization for Low-Level Vision Generalist Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite the intense engagement surrounding low-level vision generalist models, their effectiveness in zero/few-shot scenarios beyond learned tasks remains unverified. The primary challenge of developing an ideal generalist lies in achieving the ability to generalize from new unseen tasks, which also can be assessed by matched quantitative criteria. Existing methods have made some progress in prompt engineering but have not systematically explored this gap across a wide range of low-level visual tasks. Stimulated by the problem, we propose Hidden-Shot, an implicit prompt mechanism aimed at exploring low-level task adaptation in a vision generalist model. Specifically, the method extracts implicit visual task-based information, utilizes a global task-aware textural prompt, and selectively merges implicit information with in-task processing information to enhance one-shot capabilities in new tasks. The overall design performs direct injection in a cost-effective manner, while minimally altering the architecture of the original generalist model. Additionally, we introduce a data-driven evaluation framework termed C/U assessment to cover two basic scenarios, 3C4U (3 conventional and 4 unconventional tasks) for retraining existing models and 3C7U (3 conventional and 7 unconventional tasks) for training from scratch, as a comprehensive assessment to systematically test the generalization ability of low-level generalist models. Experiments on seven and ten datasets outperform the state-of-the-art vision generalist model, respectively verified by 3C4U and 3C7U framework. Our presented Hidden-Shot approach demonstrates superior performance on one-shot new tasks while maintaining consistent performance on existing tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低层视觉通用模型在新任务上的泛化能力，提出隐式提示机制Hidden-Shot，通过提取隐式视觉任务信息、使用全局任务感知纹理提示、选择性融合隐式信息与任务内处理信息，增强一次学习能力。同时提出C/U评估框架（3C4U和3C7U）系统测试泛化能力。实验在7/10数据集上优于现有通用模型。
Motivation: 现有低层视觉通用模型在零样本/少样本场景下对未见任务的泛化能力未得到验证，缺乏系统性评估。
Method: 提出Hidden-Shot隐式提示机制，包含隐式视觉任务信息提取、全局任务感知纹理提示、以及隐式信息与任务内处理信息的融合，以最小改动架构的方式实现一次性任务泛化。同时设计了C/U评估框架（3C4U和3C7U）用于系统评估。
Result: 在3C4U和3C7U框架下的7个和10个数据集上，所提方法优于当前最先进的视觉通用模型，并在保持已有任务性能的同时在新任务上表现出色。
Conclusion: Hidden-Shot方法为低层视觉通用模型提供了一种有效的单样本泛化机制，且评估框架可系统衡量泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OPINE-World: Programmatic World Modeling with Ontology-error-Prioritized Interactive Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Learning how an environment behaves from interaction is central to building agents that adapt to unfamiliar tasks. World models learned with deep networks are flexible but data-hungry and transfer poorly beyond their training distribution. Program-synthesized world models, written as source code by LLMs and refined through counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS), are instead data-efficient and reusable, yet they have been demonstrated mainly on structured-state worlds with a given object vocabulary, and a single program search does not scale to pixel-rendered environments whose object structure must be hypothesized flexibly. We introduce OPINE-World, an LLM agent that learns an object-centric programmatic world model online from interaction. OPINE-World couples two cooperating agents in a loop of hypothesis and test, one acting in the environment and one synthesizing the model in code with replay verification and model-based planning, and it steers exploration with a Bayesian measure of object-type adequacy we call ontology error. We evaluate OPINE-World on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark for skill-acquisition efficiency in which the object vocabulary, the goal, and the action semantics are withheld. OPINE-World solves 20 of 25 games without per-game training and reaches an action-efficiency score of 78.4 against the human baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OPINE-World，一种基于 LLM 的智能体，通过交互在线学习面向对象的程序化世界模型。该系统结合两个协作智能体（一个在环境中行动，一个用代码合成模型），并利用贝叶斯本体论误差度量引导探索。在 ARC-AGI-3 基准上，OPINE-World 无需逐游戏训练即解决 20/25 个游戏，动作效率得分达到 78.4（人类基线为 100）。
Motivation: 现有世界模型存在数据效率低、分布外泛化差的问题；程序合成的世界模型虽数据高效且可复用，但此前主要适用于具有给定对象词汇的结构化状态世界，难以扩展到需要灵活假设对象结构的像素渲染环境。
Method: 提出 OPINE-World，包含两个协作智能体：一个在环境中行动，另一个用代码合成世界模型并通过回放验证和基于模型的规划进行迭代精炼；同时引入本体论误差（ontology error）的贝叶斯度量来引导探索。
Result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 基准上，OPINE-World 无需逐游戏训练即解决 20/25 个游戏，动作效率得分达到 78.4（人类基线为 100）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在需要灵活推断对象结构的环境中的高效世界学习能力，但未讨论在更复杂像素环境或实际任务中的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IntentTune: Using user demand and personalization to resolve "unknown" query intents for e-commerce search
papers.abstract_en: Understanding user intent is fundamental to delivering relevant search results in e-commerce. However, substantial fraction of real-world queries are under-specified (e.g., "watch" or "shirt"), lacking explicit attributes such as gender or age group. This ambiguity poses a significant challenge for query intent detection models in e-commerce search systems, which must accurately infer latent user intent (e.g., age, gender) to support effective downstream retrieval. We introduce IntentTune, a framework for resolving ambiguous or under-specified query intents by leveraging either (1) user-specific behavioral signals including search history, browsing activity, and profile attributes or (2) population-level demand patterns aggregated across all users. Through experiments on real-world e-commerce data, we first demonstrate that population-level demand patterns alone are insufficient to reliably infer intent in under-specified queries. We then demonstrate that user-specific behavioral signals -- particularly prior search queries -- outperform both population-level statistics and static profile information for inferring gender, age group, product category, and size intent from underspecified queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IntentTune 框架，用于解决电商搜索中不明确查询（如“watch”或“shirt”）的意图识别问题。该框架利用用户特定的行为信号（搜索历史、浏览活动、属性）或总体需求模式来推断潜在意图（如性别、年龄组）。实验表明，用户特定的搜索查询行为优于总体统计和静态属性信息。
Motivation: 电商搜索中大量查询表述不明确，缺乏显式属性，导致意图检测困难，影响下游检索效果。现有方法依赖总体需求模式不足以可靠推断意图。
Method: 提出 IntentTune 框架，基于用户特定行为信号（尤其是历史搜索查询）或总体需求模式，对不明确查询的意图进行消歧。
Result: 在真实电商数据上，用户特定的搜索查询行为在推断性别、年龄组、产品类别和尺寸意图上优于总体统计和静态属性信息。
Conclusion: 论文强调用户行为信号（特别是搜索历史）对于解决查询意图模糊性的重要性，但未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wind-Aware Reinforcement Learning Control of a Small Quadrotor Using Learned Onboard Wind Estimation in Simulated Atmospheric Turbulence
papers.abstract_en: Small multirotor aircraft are increasingly tasked with operations in the atmospheric boundary layer, where turbulent winds comparable to the vehicle's airspeed degrade trajectory tracking and can defeat conventional feedback control. This work illustrates a two-stage learning pipeline that first estimates the local wind from onboard kinematics and dynamics and then exploits that estimate inside a reinforcement learning (RL) flight controller. The wind estimator, an attention-augmented gated recurrent network trained on thousands of simulated flights through von Karman turbulence with power-law shear and veer, recovers the horizontal wind vector with a per-flight root-mean-square error of 0.40 m/s and a direction error of 3.2 degrees on unseen wind regimes, an accuracy near the floor imposed by unresolved turbulence, and generalizes to vertical ascent profiles with a skill score of 0.861 over a constant-wind reference. A proximal policy optimization controller receiving the frozen estimator's output reduces horizontal trajectory tracking error by 48% relative to a wind-blind proportional-derivative baseline across mean winds of 4 m/s to 12 m/s, winning on 100% of evaluation episodes. A three-way ablation decomposes this improvement into a kinematic component, available without wind information, and a wind-perception component; the perception share rises with wind speed, from small in light winds toward roughly half the total benefit in strong winds, consistent with the quadratic scaling of aerodynamic drag. The controller degrades gracefully on out-of-distribution winds of 13 m/s to 15 m/s, where the baseline fails catastrophically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两阶段学习流水线，首先利用注意力增强的门控循环网络从机载运动学与动力学数据估计局部风矢量，然后将该估计输入强化学习（RL）飞行控制器。在冯·卡门湍流模拟中，风估计器对水平风矢量的均方根误差为0.40 m/s，方向误差3.2度；结合近端策略优化（PPO）的控制器在4-12 m/s平均风速下将水平轨迹跟踪误差相比无风基线降低48%，且在13-15 m/s的分布外风速下失效时控制器仍能优雅退化。
Motivation: 小型多旋翼飞行器在大气边界层中常遭遇与自身空速相当的湍流风，传统反馈控制难以保持轨迹精度，且缺乏实时可靠的风场信息。
Method: 两阶段学习：第一阶段使用注意力增强的门控循环网络（基于数千次模拟飞行训练）从机载传感器数据估计水平风矢量；第二阶段将冻结的估计器输出作为状态输入到近端策略优化（PPO）控制器中，并设计三路消融实验分解改进来源。
Result: 风估计器对未见风速模式的均方根误差为0.40 m/s，方向误差3.2度；PPO控制器在4-12 m/s平均风速下将水平轨迹跟踪误差降低48%，在100%评估回合中胜出；消融实验显示风感知贡献随风速增大，从轻风时的微弱作用上升到强风时约占总收益的一半。
Conclusion: 基于学习的有载风估计与强化学习控制相结合能显著提升四旋翼在湍流环境下的轨迹跟踪能力，且对分布外风速具有优雅退化特性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantifying the Uncertainty of Blindly Estimated Room Embeddings Using a Dispersion-Calibrated Score
papers.abstract_en: Room embeddings derived from reverberant speech are often unreliable: speech content and recording degradation can alter the representation even when speaker, room, and source-receiver geometry remain unchanged, degrading downstream task performance. We propose a framework that learns room embeddings robust to speech-content variation and a representation-level uncertainty score from reverberant speech without downstream-task supervision. The embedding is anchored to a structured room impulse response (RIR) latent space and trained using a multi-view data structure with Kullback-Leibler (KL)-based alignment; a multi-positive contrastive term further refines robustness. A lightweight uncertainty head is calibrated using the dispersion of corruption-induced embeddings and optimized with a rank-based objective. Across waveform- and spectrogram-level corruptions, the score is consistent with representation dispersion and enables effective selective prediction while requiring only a single utterance at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种框架，从混响语音中学习对语音内容变化鲁棒的房间嵌入，并学习表示级的不确定性分数。嵌入通过多视图数据结构和 KL 散度对齐锚定到结构化的 RIR 潜在空间，不确定性头使用腐败诱导的嵌入分散度校准。实验表明该分数与表示分散度一致，可用于选择性预测，推理时仅需单个话语。
Motivation: 从混响语音中导出的房间嵌入常常不可靠，因为语音内容和录音退化会改变表示，降低下游任务性能。需要一种鲁棒的嵌入和不确定性量化方法。
Method: 提出多视图数据结构和 KL 散度对齐，将嵌入锚定到结构化 RIR 潜在空间，并加入多正对比项提高鲁棒性。轻量级不确定性头使用腐败诱导的嵌入分散度校准，采用基于排名的目标优化。
Result: 在波形和频谱级别的多种腐败下，不确定性分数与表示分散度一致，能有效实现选择性预测，且推理时只需单个话语。
Conclusion: 框架能提供鲁棒的嵌入和可靠的不确定性估计，有助于提升下游任务的可靠性。

papers.title: Mean Field Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: This monograph provides an introduction to mean field reinforcement learning through the lens of Markov decision processes arising from large-population stochastic control with mean field interactions and common noise. Starting from the connection between multi-agent reinforcement learning and mean field control, it develops the probabilistic, mathematical, and control-theoretic framework needed to formulate representative-agent learning problems, analyze their relationship with finite-population systems, and study both general and linear-quadratic models. The presentation includes dynamic programming principles, propagation-of-chaos limits, and theoretical analyses of tabular Q-learning and policy-gradient methods. It also discusses numerical implementations, including tabular schemes and deep reinforcement learning methods such as deep deterministic policy gradient. The goal is to give readers a coherent bridge between mean field control theory and reinforcement learning methodology, emphasizing the mathematical structure of the problems and the design of tractable learning approaches for large stochastic populations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该专著通过平均场交互和公共噪声下的大人口随机控制框架，系统介绍了平均场强化学习。从多智能体强化学习与平均场控制的联系出发，建立了概率、数学和控制理论基础，涵盖动态规划、混沌传播、表格Q学习和策略梯度方法，并讨论数值实现。
Motivation: 现有的多智能体强化学习在大人口系统中计算复杂，需要有效的降维方法。平均场理论提供了一个将有限智能体问题转化为代表性代理问题的框架，但需要系统的数学基础。
Method: 基于马尔可夫决策过程，建立平均场控制与强化学习的联系，包括动态规划原理、混沌传播极限、以及表格Q学习和策略梯度方法的理论分析。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但给出了理论框架和数值方法讨论，包括表格方案和深度确定性策略梯度等深度强化学习方法。
Conclusion: 该专著旨在为平均场控制理论与强化学习方法之间搭建桥梁，强调问题的数学结构和处理大人口随机系统的可解学习方法。

papers.title: Multi-Head Recurrent Memory Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent memory agents extend LLMs to arbitrarily long contexts by iteratively consolidating input into a fixed-size memory window. Despite their scalability, these agents exhibit a well-documented reliability problem: end-to-end performance degrades systematically as context length grows. We diagnose this failure by decomposing performance into two factors--memory capture and memory retention--and quantitatively confirm that retention is the dominant bottleneck. Retention collapses because existing designs maintain memory as a monolithic text block, forcing every update to risk overwriting previously retained content. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose Multi-Head Recurrent Memory (MHM), a general, training-free framework that partitions memory into independent heads governed by a stage-wise select-then-update strategy. At each step, exactly one head is selected for update while the remaining heads are structurally shielded from overwriting, shifting the burden of retention from model behavior to architectural design. As a lightweight instantiation, we introduce Least-Recently-Updated MHM (MHM-LRU), which guarantees uniform head utilization with zero additional token overhead. Extensive experiments on long-context benchmarks show that MHM-LRU substantially improves both retention and end-to-end accuracy across the 100K--1M token range, where baselines degrade sharply. On RULER-HQA at 896K tokens, MHM-LRU improves the memory retention rate from less than 30% to 73.96%. These gains generalize across model families, scales, and task types, positioning architectural optimization as a practical and cost-efficient path toward reliable long-context recurrent memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断了递归记忆代理（recurrent memory agents）在长上下文任务中性能退化的主要瓶颈是记忆保留（retention），并提出多头递归记忆（MHM）框架。MHM将记忆划分为独立头，采用阶段性的先选后更新策略，每一步只更新一个头，其余头被保护不被覆盖。轻量实例化MHM-LRU基于最近最少更新策略，保证均匀利用且无额外token开销。实验显示在100K-1M token范围内，MHM-LRU显著提升记忆保留率和端到端准确率，例如在RULER-HQA 896K token上将记忆保留率从低于30%提升至73.96%。
Motivation: 现有递归记忆代理在上下文增长时性能系统性地下降，之前缺乏对性能衰减因素的分解诊断。
Method: 提出Multi-Head Recurrent Memory (MHM)，一种无需训练的通用框架：将记忆分割为独立头，每一步只选择一个头更新，其余头被结构性地保护不被覆盖。并基于最近最少更新策略提出轻量实例化MHM-LRU。
Result: 在RULER-HQA 896K token上，MHM-LRU将记忆保留率从低于30%提升至73.96%。在100K-1M token范围内，MHM-LRU在多项长上下文基准上显著改进保留率和端到端准确率，且跨模型家族、规模和任务类型泛化。
Conclusion: 本文表明架构优化（而非模型训练）是实现可靠长上下文递归记忆的实用且经济高效的路径。

papers.title: Robust and Explainable 3D Mode Shape Recognition Using Region-Aware Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Mode shape recognition is a fundamental task in automotive NVH development, yet it remains dependent on manual visual inspection by experienced engineers. Existing approaches based on engineering heuristics, Modal Assurance Criterion (MAC), or geometry-dependent AI representations often exhibit limited robustness across different vehicle architectures, finite element (FE) meshes, and experimental measurement layouts, restricting their industrial applicability. This paper presents a Canonical Engineering Graph Representation and region-aware graph learning framework for robust and explainable 3D mode shape recognition. Rather than learning directly from vehicle-specific FE meshes, heterogeneous FE models and experimental measurements are transformed into a common graph whose nodes represent semantically meaningful structural regions connected through engineering-informed relationships. Geometry-independent regional descriptors are combined with graph attention learning and region-aware pooling to capture structural interactions while preserving engineering semantics and enabling physically interpretable predictions. The resulting representation decouples engineering knowledge from numerical discretization, allowing transfer across different vehicle programs without requiring identical mesh topology or sensor configurations. The proposed framework is validated using FE and experimental datasets from four vehicle programs under severe label scarcity. Results demonstrate high classification accuracy, cross-vehicle transferability, and physically meaningful explanations by directly relating predictions to engineering-defined structural regions used in NVH analysis. Beyond mode shape recognition, the proposed Canonical Engineering Graph Representation provides a reusable engineering abstraction for trustworthy and transferable AI across heterogeneous simulation and experimental workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对汽车NVH开发中3D模态形状识别依赖人工目视检查的问题，提出了一种基于区域感知图神经网络的鲁棒且可解释的识别框架。该方法将异构有限元模型和实验测量转换为规范工程图表示，节点代表语义化结构区域，通过图注意力学习和区域感知池化捕获结构交互，在四个车型程序的数据集上验证了高分类精度和跨车型可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有模态形状识别方法依赖人工经验或几何相关的AI表示，在不同车型架构、有限元网格和实验布局下鲁棒性不足，限制了工业应用。
Method: 提出规范工程图表示（Canonical Engineering Graph Representation），将异构FE模型和实验测量转化为公共图，节点对应语义化的工程结构区域，边基于工程先验连接；结合图注意力学习和区域感知池化实现可解释预测。
Result: 在四个车型程序的FE和实验数据集上，面对严重标签稀缺，该方法取得了高分类准确率，并展示了跨车型的迁移能力以及物理可解释性。
Conclusion: 该表示解耦了工程知识与数值离散化，可跨不同网格拓扑和传感器配置迁移，为异构仿真和实验工作流提供了可复用的工程抽象。

papers.title: The risk of KV cache compression
papers.abstract_en: Transformer inference on long sequences is expensive because softmax attention repeatedly reads from a large KV cache. The prevalent approach to this bottleneck is KV cache compression, which replaces the full cache with a compact summary. Despite its practical importance, the design of such summaries is largely driven by empirical experimentation. On the theoretical side, existing results show that KV cache compression can be impossible in the worst case, but offer little systematic guidance for designing algorithms in regimes where accurate compression is possible. We bridge this gap by characterizing the minimax risk of KV cache compression in terms of the intrinsic compressibility of a cache, revealing when and how accurate compression is possible. These results yield novel design principles for KV cache compression under causal masking that map efficiently to prefill and autoregressive decoding while achieving minimax-optimal risk. We instantiate these principles in a practical algorithm and report promising performance on LongBench in targeted experiments. Overall, our results provide a principled avenue for practical KV cache compression with theoretical guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer推理中KV缓存压缩的理论局限性，通过刻画最小化最大风险（minimax risk）与缓存内在可压缩性的关系，揭示了准确压缩可行的条件。提出了在因果掩码下的设计原则，可高效映射到预填充和自回归解码，并实现最小化最优风险。基于这些原则实现了实际算法，在LongBench上展示了有希望的性能。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩方法主要依赖经验，缺乏理论指导；最坏情况下压缩不可行，但实际中可准确压缩的区间缺乏系统设计原则。
Method: 通过刻画KV缓存压缩的最小化最大风险与缓存内在可压缩性的关系，提出在因果掩码下的设计原则，使压缩算法在预填充和自回归解码中高效且达到最小化最优风险。
Result: 在LongBench上的目标实验中，所提出算法展示了有希望的性能。
Conclusion: 为具有理论保证的实用KV缓存压缩提供了原则性途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revisiting Chain-of-Thought Reasoning under Limited Supervision: Semi-supervised Chain-of-Thought Learning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has emerged as an effective approach for activating latent reasoning capabilities in large language models. However, most existing CoT methods use reasoning chains mainly as inference-time prompts, while the generated reasoning traces are rarely reused as semi-supervised learning signals. In this report, we define \textbf{Semi-supervised Chain-of-Thought Learning} and propose \textbf{Semi-CoT}, a simple framework that uses unlabeled questions to construct pseudo reasoning supervision. Semi-CoT samples multiple pseudo-CoTs for each unlabeled question, estimates answer-level semantic entropy, and selects low-entropy reasoning chains as reliable pseudo-CoT demonstrations. This extends the self-training view of CoT from inference-time refinement to semi-supervised pseudo-supervision. Pilot experiments on AQuA, SVAMP, GSM8K, and MultiArith show that the entropy gate selects high-precision pseudo-CoTs, with pseudo-answer precision ranging from $91.36\%$ to $100\%$. Semi-CoT also gives small gains on SVAMP and GSM8K, while AQuA shows negative transfer and MultiArith reaches a ceiling. These results suggest that unlabeled questions can provide reliable pseudo reasoning signals, but their effective use still requires stronger demonstration selection or student training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出半监督链式思维学习（Semi-CoT），利用未标注问题构造伪推理监督。通过采样多个伪链式思维（pseudo-CoT）、估计答案级语义熵并选择低熵链作为可靠演示，将链式思维从推理时提示扩展为半监督伪监督。在AQuA、SVAMP、GSM8K和MultiArith上的初步实验显示，熵门控可选出高精度伪CoT，伪答案精度达91.36%-100%，但仅SVAMP和GSM8K有微小提升，AQuA出现负迁移，MultiArith达到上限。
Motivation: 现有链式思维方法主要将推理链用作推理时提示，很少将生成的推理迹复用为半监督学习信号，缺乏利用未标注数据的机制。
Method: 提出Semi-CoT框架：对每个未标注问题采样多个伪CoT，计算答案级语义熵，选择低熵推理链作为可靠的伪CoT演示，用于半监督训练。
Result: 在四个数学推理数据集上，伪答案精度达91.36%-100%；SVAMP和GSM8K获得微小提升，AQuA出现负迁移，MultiArith达到性能上限。
Conclusion: 未标注问题可提供可靠的伪推理信号，但有效利用仍需更强的演示选择或学生训练策略。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在四个数学推理数据集上，伪答案精度达91.36%-100%；SVAMP和GSM8K获得微小提升，AQuA出现负迁移，MultiArith达到性能上限。
summary_sections.conclusion: 未标注问题可提供可靠的伪推理信号，但有效利用仍需更强的演示选择或学生训练策略。

papers.title: Janus: a Playground for User-Involved Agentic Permission Management
papers.abstract_en: AI agents that autonomously execute tool calls on a user's behalf raise pressing questions about permission management: what role could users play, and what role should they play? Despite many proposed approaches, the user's role in agentic permission management remains under explored. We introduce Janus, a playground system for implementing and evaluating user-involved agentic permission management designs. Janus consists of two components: Janus-Core, a modular agentic system supporting a diverse spectrum of permission management designs, and Janus-Harness, an automated evaluation framework. Grounded in a conceptual model that identifies key design axes for user involvement, we implement six permission assistants spanning the design space and evaluate them across three scenarios and three synthetic responders. We demonstrate that user input is critical and can significantly strengthen privacy and security, that AI augmentation of user decisions can help reduce cognitive load, and that realistic user behavior including permission fatigue must be accounted for in system design. No single design performs optimally across all contexts, motivating a more principled and context-sensitive approach to deploying permission assistants in agentic systems. Janus is publicly available to support future investigation into this dimension of agentic system design.
papers.comment: Code and data released on GitHub: https://github.com/GraceBrigham/Janus
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Janus，一个用于实现和评估用户参与式代理权限管理（agentic permission management）的游乐场系统。Janus包含Janus-Core（模块化代理系统）和Janus-Harness（自动评估框架）。基于概念模型，实现了六个权限助手并在三个场景和三个合成响应者上评估。实验表明用户输入对隐私和安全至关重要，AI辅助可减轻认知负荷，且系统设计需考虑现实用户行为如权限疲劳。没有单一设计在所有上下文中最优。
Motivation: AI代理自主执行工具调用引发权限管理问题，但用户角色尚未充分探索。
Method: 提出Janus系统，包括Janus-Core（支持多种权限管理设计的模块化代理系统）和Janus-Harness（自动评估框架），基于概念模型设计六个权限助手。
Result: 摘要报告用户输入显著增强隐私安全；AI辅助降低认知负荷；需考虑权限疲劳等现实用户行为；无单一设计在所有场景下最优。
Conclusion: 强调需要更原理性和上下文敏感的方法来部署代理系统中的权限助手，Janus公开可用以支持未来研究。

papers.title: The Agentic Garden of Forking Paths
papers.abstract_en: Empirical research rarely admits a unique analysis. Different analytical choices can lead to different conclusions from the same data, yet these hidden forking paths are difficult to observe. We show that AI agents capture much of the analytical variation among human researchers while making these paths explicit. Across four high-stakes domains, assigning different personas is sufficient for AI agents to report divergent, often opposing, conclusions from the same data and question, with findings systematically aligned with those beliefs. In a study in which 42 human research teams analyzed the same immigration dataset, AI agents reproduced 72% of the human ideological gap in reported effect estimates. Despite reaching opposing conclusions, it is difficult to identify clear issues in each analysis based on the final AI reports: 86% passed independent AI review and 78% passed majority human expert review. These findings suggest that the central challenge is often not flawed analyses, but selective exploration and reporting from a large space of methodologically defensible analyses. AI agents may amplify this longstanding problem by making such exploration inexpensive and scalable. To address this, we introduce the m-value (multiverse value), the probability that an analysis path would produce a claim at least as extreme as the reported one. We further introduce Agentic Bootstrap, which estimates the m-value by using AI agents to sample plausible analysis paths. Applied to the human immigration study, 13.5% of reported human analyses fell in the most extreme 5% of the analysis space (m<0.05). Scientific evidence should therefore be evaluated not only by a single reported analysis but also by its position within the distribution of analyses that could reasonably have been reported. Agentic Bootstrap makes this distribution observable and turns it into a criterion for scientific credibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文展示AI智能体能够捕捉人类研究者在同一数据上的不同分析选择，导致结论分歧。在四个高风险领域，不同角色设定的AI智能体从相同数据得出对立结论。在一项42个人类团队分析同一移民数据集的研究中，AI智能体复现了72%的人类意识形态差距。尽管结论对立，最终报告难以发现明显问题：86%通过独立AI审查，78%通过多数人类专家审查。为此提出m值（多重宇宙值）和引导式智能体方法（Agentic Bootstrap）来量化分析路径的极端性。
Motivation: 实证研究中单一分析可能掩盖分析路径的多样性，导致不同结论难以观察。需要方法显式捕捉和量化分析选择的空间。
Method: 使用AI智能体并赋予不同角色（persona）来模拟人类研究者的分析变化；引入m值（多重宇宙值）即分析路径产生报告极端结果概率；提出Agentic Bootstrap通过AI智能体采样可行分析路径估算m值。
Result: 在移民数据集研究中，AI复现人类意识形态差距的72%；13.5%的人类分析落在最极端5%的分析空间中（m<0.05）。AI报告通过审查率较高。
Conclusion: 科学证据应基于其在合理分析分布中的位置评估，而非单一报告。Agentic Bootstrap使该分布可观察，并转化为科学可信度标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Disentangling Pictorial Cue Understanding from Language Bias in VLMs via Depth Ordering Task
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study depth perception of vision-language models (VLMs) to isolate the effects of pictorial depth cues and disentangle vision and language influences on model performance. To this end, we combine depth-ordering and odd-one-out psychophysical tasks: the VLMs are presented with images where one object is at different depth relative to other, otherwise identical, objects, and must determine whether the odd-one-out target is closer or farther to the observer. To create stimuli, we generate 2D views from simulated and real 3D scenes while controlling the presence of individual pictorial depth cues, enabling a fine-grained analysis of cue-level contributions. Language effects are examined by varying referring expression clarity. We also introduce a novel metric to quantify vision-vs-language sensitivities. Applying this methodology, we create the Odd-One-Out Depth (O3-D) dataset with 37K real and synthetic images and 147K image-question pairs. Evaluation of 12 open-source and commercial models on O3-D shows under-utilization of depth cues and depth-ordering accuracies between 47% and 56%, with no model above chance level. At the same time, our metric reveals strong linguistic bias in the answers. Neither chain-of-thought (CoT) nor in-context learning (ICL) significantly improves performance, suggesting that static image data alone may be insufficient for depth understanding. All code, the image generation pipeline, and the O3-D dataset are publicly released at https://github.com/lyiqian/o3-d.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, accepted to ECCV 2026 (30 pages, 13 figures, supplementary materials included)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过深度排序与odd-one-out心理物理学任务，系统研究了视觉语言模型（VLM）的深度感知能力，并分离了图形深度线索与语言偏差的影响。作者构建了包含37K真实与合成图像的O3-D数据集，评估了12个开源和商业模型，发现模型深度排序准确率仅47%-56%，低于随机水平，且答案存在强语言偏差。链式思维（CoT）和上下文学习（ICL）未能显著提升性能，表明静态图像数据可能不足以支持深度理解。
Motivation: 现有VLM在深度感知任务中常受语言偏差干扰，难以区分视觉线索和语言影响，缺乏细粒度分析深度线索贡献的方法。
Method: 结合深度排序和odd-one-out任务，通过控制单个图形深度线索生成2D视图，并引入量化视觉vs语言敏感性的新度量来分离影响因素。
Result: 12个模型在O3-D数据集上的深度排序准确率为47%-56%，均未超过随机水平，且结果显示语言偏差强烈；CoT和ICL未带来显著改善。
Conclusion: 静态图像数据可能不足以使VLM真正理解深度关系；作者公开了代码、图像生成流程和数据集以供进一步研究。
Relevance: 0
