papers.title: Anti-Prompt: Image Protection against Text-Guided Image-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Image-to-Video generation allow a single image to be animated into a convincing video under text guidance, raising serious copyright and privacy risks. We propose Anti-Prompt, an image protection approach that injects imperceptible perturbations into an image, inducing visible inconsistencies and structural failures in text-guided I2V generation. Our method is motivated by a simple empirical observation. When text guidance is removed from modern I2V models, generation quality degrades markedly, not only in motion realism but also in subject preservation, structural coherence, and temporal consistency. Building on this insight, Anti-Prompt exploits the model reliance on textual guidance by attenuating text-conditioned interactions during denoising while strengthening visual-only pathways. To further systematically evaluate protection effectiveness, we introduce a Video-LLM-assisted evaluation protocol that provides interpretable, frame-grounded analyses of generation artifacts and inconsistencies. Experiments on two representative I2V architectures demonstrate that our method achieves strong protection performance while improving efficiency and cross-model transferability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Anti-Prompt，一种针对文本引导的图像到视频（I2V）生成模型的图像保护方法。通过向图像注入不可察觉的扰动，诱导生成视频出现明显的结构失败和时间不一致。该方法基于观察：移除文本引导会导致 I2V 生成质量显著下降，因此通过削弱去噪过程中的文本条件交互、强化视觉路径来保护图像。
Motivation: 文本引导的 I2V 生成技术带来版权和隐私风险，现有保护方法不足。论文旨在开发一种能有效阻止未经授权的 I2V 生成的图像保护技术。
Method: 利用 I2V 模型对文本引导的依赖，在图像中添加对抗性扰动，在去噪过程中减弱文本条件交互，同时强化仅视觉通路，导致生成的视频出现明显伪影和不一致性。同时提出基于 Video-LLM 的评估协议，用于可解释地量化保护效果。
Result: 在两个代表性 I2V 架构上，Anti-Prompt 实现了强保护性能，同时提升了效率和跨模型迁移性（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。
Conclusion: Anti-Prompt 通过对抗性扰动有效抑制文本引导对 I2V 生成的影响，提供了一种实用的图像保护手段，但可能存在对特定模型或攻击的局限性（摘要未详细讨论）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Learning Representations of Policies in Two-Player Zero-Sum Imperfect-Information Games
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the problem of learning useful policy representations (embeddings) in two-player zero-sum imperfect-information games. We make three contributions: First, we introduce methods of creating datasets of policies for a given game. Second, we propose methods to learn policy representations. Third, we introduce downstream tasks to evaluate the effectiveness of such representations. We evaluate each dataset method, embedding method, and downstream task on Kuhn and Leduc Poker. Although our methods are very basic, we demonstrate that useful behavioral representations are present in the learned embeddings. To our knowledge, this work is among the first to systematically compare self-supervised learning techniques for learning policy representations in games. Our code is available at https://github.com/VitamintK/ssl-project for others to extend.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在两人零和不完美信息博弈中学习有用的策略表示（嵌入）。作者提出了三种贡献：创建策略数据集的方法、学习策略表示的方法以及评估表示有效性的下游任务。在Kuhn和Leduc扑克上评估了每种数据集方法、嵌入方法和下游任务。尽管方法基础，但实验表明学习到的嵌入中包含有用的行为表示。据作者所知，这是首次系统比较自监督学习技术在博弈中学习策略表示的工作。代码开源。
Motivation: 在博弈中，策略表示学习有助于策略分析和迁移，但目前缺乏对自监督学习方法在博弈策略表示上的系统比较和评估框架。
Method: 首先为给定游戏生成策略数据集（如纳什均衡策略、最佳响应等），然后采用自监督学习（如对比学习）训练策略编码器，最后通过下游任务（如策略身份识别、策略聚类）评估表示质量。
Result: 在Kuhn和Leduc扑克上，所提方法能学习到有意义的策略表示，区分不同策略行为。具体数值未在摘要中明确给出。
Conclusion: 尽管方法基础，但自监督学习可以提取出博弈策略的有用表示，为后续策略比较和迁移学习提供基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Unveiling the Non-Monotonic Effect of Privacy on Generalization under Byzantine Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has established a fundamental trilemma between Byzantine robustness, local differential privacy (LDP), and optimization error in distributed learning. We show that this trilemma does not universally extend to generalization error, but instead depends critically on the privacy regime. Specifically, in the high-noise regime (strong privacy), we prove that increasing privacy reduces the generalization error, i.e., there is no tension between robustness and privacy. In the low-noise regime (weaker privacy), however, the tension between robustness and privacy reappears and increasing privacy indeed degrades generalization. Our theory explains this surprising non-monotonic behavior of the generalization error via matching lower and upper bounds on the algorithmic stability of Byzantine-robust distributed learning under LDP constraints. We corroborate and further analyze these theoretical findings with empirical evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究拜占庭鲁棒分布式学习中隐私对泛化误差的影响，发现隐私的增强并非单调地影响泛化，而是取决于隐私噪声水平：强隐私下增加隐私反而降低泛化误差，弱隐私下则相反。作者通过理论上下界和实验验证了这种非单调效应。
Motivation: 现有研究指出拜占庭鲁棒性、LDP和优化误差之间存在三元冲突，但泛化误差的角色不明确，本文旨在揭示隐私对泛化误差的非单调影响。
Method: 理论分析，导出拜占庭鲁棒分布式学习在LDP约束下的算法稳定性的匹配上下界，从而解释泛化误差的非单调性；并结合实验验证。
Result: 在高噪声（强隐私）下，增加隐私降低泛化误差；在低噪声（弱隐私）下，增加隐私增加泛化误差。理论上下界匹配。
Conclusion: 隐私对泛化误差的影响并非单调，取决于隐私机制，这扩展了对分布式学习中隐私-鲁棒性-泛化权衡的理解。

papers.title: Don't Let Gains FADE: Breaking Down Policy Gradient Weights in RL
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning post-training dramatically improves LLM reasoning, but suffers from training instability and diversity collapse. Advantage functions offer an appealing fix: they reshape the training objective, reweight which rollouts drive learning, and are trivial to implement. Yet a proliferation of methods makes it unclear which advantage to use and when. We cut through the confusion with a unifying framework that decomposes any advantage into its positive and negative gradient mass along two orthogonal axes. On the sign axis, imbalanced updates collapse either entropy or weight geometry. On the difficulty axis, hard-problem focus sharpens signal but costs sample size. Both trade-offs shift during training: exploration favors balance and hard focus; exploitation favors suppression and medium focus. This motivates FADE (Focal Advantage with Dynamic Entropy), a self-adapting advantage that reads training dynamics to schedule the gradient weight automatically. FADE reaches peak pass@1 20k steps earlier than the best static baseline at the 7B scale and 2k steps earlier at the 32B , while achieving the best accuracy-diversity trade-off across all pass@k on LiveCodeBench and AIME.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，将强化学习中优势函数（advantage function）按符号轴和难度轴分解为正负梯度质量，并分析了训练动态中的权衡。基于此，提出FADE（Focal Advantage with Dynamic Entropy），一种自适应调整梯度权重的优势函数，在7B和32B规模下相比静态基线更快达到峰值pass@1，并在LiveCodeBench和AIME上取得最佳精度-多样性权衡。
Motivation: 强化学习后训练虽大幅提升LLM推理能力，但存在训练不稳定和多样性崩溃问题。优势函数虽可缓解这些问题，但方法众多且效果不明确，需要统一框架来理解不同优势函数的适用场景和权衡。
Method: 提出一个分解框架，将任何优势函数沿符号轴（正负梯度）和难度轴（困难/简单样本）分解为正负梯度质量。基于训练动态中探索与利用阶段的不同偏好，设计FADE优势函数，自动根据训练动态调整梯度权重。
Result: 在7B和32B规模下，FADE分别比最佳静态基线提前20k和2k步达到峰值pass@1，并在LiveCodeBench和AIME的所有pass@k指标上取得最佳精度-多样性权衡。
Conclusion: FADE通过自适应的优势函数调度，能有效平衡训练稳定性与多样性，加速推理性能提升。

papers.title: How to Allocate Your Tokens? Scaling Laws with Training Steps and Batch Size
papers.abstract_en: We propose a scaling law that takes into account model size and training data while explicitly splitting the latter into training steps and batch size (called three-term law). Fitting the proposed law on a large set of training runs, we find that it correctly recovers the scaling of the optimal batch size. Moreover, because it makes use of training runs with suboptimal batch size, our proposed law can be robustly fit with a significantly smaller amount of training runs. We further show that the three-term law can be used to derive scaling laws for suboptimal batch sizes, and that it matches previous empirical findings related to the critical batch size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个包含模型大小、训练步数和批大小的三因素缩放定律（three-term law）。在大规模训练运行上拟合该定律，发现它能正确恢复最优批大小的缩放，并且能用更少的训练运行稳健拟合。该定律还可用于推导次优批大小的缩放定律，并匹配了之前关于临界批大小的实证发现。
Motivation: 现有缩放定律通常只考虑模型大小和数据量，但忽略了训练步数和批大小对训练效率的影响，导致无法准确预测最优批大小或在不同配置下进行资源分配。
Method: 提出一个三因素缩放定律，将训练数据量显式拆分为训练步数和批大小。在大规模训练运行集合上拟合该定律，利用含次优批大小的训练运行来提高拟合鲁棒性。
Result: 拟合结果显示，该定律正确恢复了最优批大小的缩放关系，并且相比传统两因素定律，能以更少的训练运行实现稳健拟合。此外，它还能推导出次优批大小下的缩放行为。
Conclusion: 该三因素缩放定律为资源分配（如训练步数与批大小的权衡）提供了理论指导，并验证了与之前临界批大小实证发现的一致性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Fully Unsupervised Detection of Physical Contacts on Subsea Cables via State-of-Polarization Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: We present a fully unsupervised Fast-Slow DSVDD detector for continuous State-of-Polarization monitoring on a deployed subsea cable. Trained without event labels, it ranks all five confirmed trawler contacts within the top 13 of 122,174 recordings and surfaces additional corroborated cable-contact events.
papers.comment: This paper is a preprint of a paper accepted in ECOC 2026 and is subject to Institution of Engineering and Technology Copyright. A copy of record will be available at IET Digital Library
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种完全无监督的Fast-Slow DSVDD检测器，用于连续监测海底电缆的偏振态。该方法无需事件标签，在122,174条记录中成功将全部5个已知拖网接触事件排在前13位，并发现了额外的经确认的电缆接触事件。
Motivation: 海底电缆的物理接触检测通常依赖有标签数据，但实际部署中标签难以获取。本文旨在开发无需事件标签的全无监督检测方法，以提升对电缆接触事件的监测能力。
Method: 提出Fast-Slow DSVDD（深度支持向量数据描述）检测器，利用慢速和快速偏振态变化进行无监督异常检测，训练过程不依赖事件标签。
Result: 在122,174条记录中，所有5个已知拖网接触事件均被排在前13位，且检测到额外的经确认的电缆接触事件。
Conclusion: 该方法在无监督条件下有效检测海底电缆物理接触，具有实际部署潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Procedural Memory Distillation: Online Reflection for Self-Improving Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), along with recent selfdistillation variants such as SDPO, evaluates each rollout against a verifier and updates the policy from that episode-level signal. However, the richer procedural information in the rollout is rarely retained or reused. Across episodes and epochs, the model repeatedly encounters related problems under a changing policy, producing cross-episode signals that episode-local updates cannot capture: which strategies consistently pass verification, which failure modes persist, which patterns recur. We propose Procedural Memory Distillation (PMD), which converts these crossepisode signals into reusable procedural memory and distills it into the policy's weights during training. This memory functions as a training scaffold, absorbed into the policy itself, yielding a memory-free model at inference. PMD organizes the memory at three levels of abstraction: raw trajectories, self-reflected strategies and lessons, and higher-level behavioral patterns that recur across problems, all extracted online from the model's own trajectories. A memory-conditioned self-teacher draws on the accumulated experience to supervise the student on its own rollouts, enabling student to progressively internalize procedural knowledge within its parameters. The central design principle is co-evolution: the policy generates rollouts that update the memory, and memory shapes the supervision that updates the policy. Empirically, across Qwen3-8B and OLMo3-Instruct-7B, PMD improves over SDPO by 3.8-5.5% on SCIKNOWEVAL and 7.9-13.6% on LIVECODEBENCH. Co-evolution powers these gains: freezing either the memory or the policy trails PMD by more than 10% across SCIKNOWEVAL domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出程序性记忆蒸馏（Procedural Memory Distillation, PMD），将语言模型在自我改进训练中跨回合出现的信号转化为可重用的程序性记忆，并蒸馏到策略权重中。记忆分为原始轨迹、自反思策略和教训、跨问题行为模式三个抽象层次，通过记忆条件自教师监督学生逐步内化程序性知识。核心设计是共同演化：策略生成轨迹更新记忆，记忆塑造监督更新策略。在Qwen3-8B和OLMo3-Instruct-7B上，PMD相比SDPO在SCIKNOWEVAL提升3.8-5.5%，在LIVECODEBENCH提升7.9-13.6%。
Motivation: 现有RLVR和自蒸馏方法（如SDPO）仅利用回合级验证信号更新策略，忽视了回合中丰富的程序性信息以及跨回合的信号（如哪些策略持续通过验证、哪些失败模式持续存在）。
Method: 提出PMD，在线从模型自身轨迹中提取三层次程序性记忆（原始轨迹、自反思策略和教训、跨问题行为模式），并用记忆条件自教师基于累积经验监督学生模型在自身 rollout 上的学习，实现记忆与策略的共同演化。
Result: 在Qwen3-8B和OLMo3-Instruct-7B上，PMD相比SDPO在SCIKNOWEVAL提升3.8-5.5%，在LIVECODEBENCH提升7.9-13.6%。消融实验表明，冻结记忆或策略均导致在SCIKNOWEVAL上性能下降超过10%。
Conclusion: PMD通过将跨回合程序性记忆蒸馏到策略中，有效提升了语言模型的自我改进能力，且推理时无需额外记忆存储。共同演化是核心增益来源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Boundary-Aware Quantization: Finite-Scale Decision Geometry of Neural Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: We measured quantization-induced decision-boundary changes using local logit-margin radii, first-order boundary displacement, normal variation, slice-boundary Jaccard distance, grid prediction changes, multiclass junction counts, and low-margin boundary-band flips. On the digits benchmark, 8-bit weight quantization preserved all test labels while producing boundary-mask Jaccard \(0.428\) on the PCA slice; at 4 bits, accuracy remained \(0.9733\), while boundary Jaccard rose to \(0.970\) and median local boundary shift reached \(0.0290\). Interpolation between adjacent quantization levels localized the visible reconfigurations at multiclass junctions, with 12, 34, and 17 triple-junction cells in the selected transitions. Calibration-to-test stopping reduced the digits held-out flip rate from \(0.0094\) to \(0.0022\) and boundary Jaccard from \(0.825\) to \(0.524\); the same stopping rule also reduced flips on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST. On official CIFAR-10 subsets, PTQ-W selected by accuracy gave 6-bit flip \(0.0367\) and boundary Jaccard \(0.184\), whereas boundary-aware stopping selected 8-bit flip \(0.0083\) and boundary Jaccard \(0.048\). On full CIFAR-10 with three seeds, 6-bit PTQ-W lost \(0.0029\) accuracy relative to float, changed \(5.3\%\) of held-out decisions, and changed \(24.5\%\) of low-margin boundary-band decisions. A fixed-bit boundary-gap rounding term changed the trade-off at 4 bits by reducing boundary Jaccard from \(0.457\) to \(0.435\) and boundary-band pair-order flip from \(0.3600\) to \(0.3558\), with an accuracy trade-off; the 3-bit stress test exposed the tuning limit of this surrogate. Calibration boundary Jaccard predicted held-out boundary Jaccard across PTQ-W and optimized rounding variants with \(r=0.947\)--\(0.994\).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对神经网络分类器在权重量化后的决策边界变化进行了细粒度几何测量，引入了局部logit-margin半径、边界位移、切片边界Jaccard距离等多种度量。在MNIST、CIFAR-10等基准上实验表明，边界感知的校准停止准则和边界间隔舍入项能有效减少量化导致的决策翻转，且校准边界Jaccard与留出边界Jaccard高度相关（r=0.947-0.994）。
Motivation: 量化引起的决策边界重构可能导致分类器预测不稳定，现有工作缺乏对边界几何变化的精确量化与分析。
Method: 提出一组边界几何度量（如局部logit-margin半径、一阶边界位移、切片边界Jaccard距离等），并基于这些度量设计了边界感知的校准停止准则和固定比特边界间隔舍入项。
Result: 在数字基准上，8-bit权重量化保留所有测试标签但边界Jaccard为0.428；4-bit精度0.9733，边界Jaccard升至0.970，中位边界位移0.0290。校准测试停止将留出翻转率从0.0094降至0.0022。在完整CIFAR-10上，6-bit PTQ-W精度损失0.0029，改变5.3%留出决策和24.5%低边界带决策。边界间隔舍入在4-bit将边界Jaccard从0.457降至0.435。
Conclusion: 边界Jaccard可作为量化后边界变化的有效预测指标，边界感知的停止准则和舍入项能在不严重牺牲精度的情况下显著降低决策边界不稳定性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文对神经网络分类器在权重量化后的决策边界变化进行了细粒度几何测量，引入了局部logit-margin半径、边界位移、切片边界Jaccard距离等多种度量。在MNIST、CIFAR-10等基准上实验表明，边界感知的校准停止准则和边界间隔舍入项能有效减少量化导致的决策翻转，且校准边界Jaccard与留出边界Jaccard高度相关（r=0.947-0.994）。
summary_sections.motivation: 量化引起的决策边界重构可能导致分类器预测不稳定，现有工作缺乏对边界几何变化的精确量化与分析。
summary_sections.method: 提出一组边界几何度量（如局部logit-margin半径、一阶边界位移、切片边界Jaccard距离等），并基于这些度量设计了边界感知的校准停止准则和固定比特边界间隔舍入项。

papers.title: Class-Grouped Normalized Momentum and Faster Hyperparameter Exploration to Tackle Class Imbalance in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Class imbalance poses a critical challenge in federated learning (FL), where underrepresented classes suffer from poor predictive performance yet cannot be addressed by standard centralized techniques due to privacy and heterogeneity constraints. We propose FedCGNM (Federated Class-Grouped Normalized Momentum), a client-side optimizer in FL that partitions classes into a small number of groups based on minimum within-group variance, maintains a momentum per group, normalizes each group momentum to unit length, and uses the summation of the normalized group momentums as an update direction. This design both equalizes gradient magnitude across majority and minority groups and mitigates the noise inherent in rare-class gradients. We further provide a theoretical convergence analysis explicitly accounting for time-varying resampling-rates. Additionally, to efficiently optimize these rates in small-client regimes, we introduce FedHOO, an X-armed-bandit (XAB) based algorithm that exploits federated parallelism that evaluates many combinations of two candidate rates per client at linear cost. Empirical evaluation on four public long-tailed benchmarks and a proprietary chip-defect dataset demonstrates that FedCGNM consistently outperforms baselines, with FedHOO yielding further gains in small-scale federations.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43 rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedCGNM (Federated Class-Grouped Normalized Momentum)，一种联邦学习客户端优化器，通过将类别按最小组内方差分组、为每组维护动量并归一化后求和作为更新方向，以缓解类别不平衡问题。还提出 FedHOO 算法，基于X-臂老虎机(XAB)高效优化小客户群下的重采样率。实验表明 FedCGNM 在长尾基准和芯片缺陷数据集上优于基线，FedHOO 在小规模联邦中进一步提升性能。
Motivation: 联邦学习中类别不平衡导致少数类预测性能差，而隐私和异构性限制使得标准集中式方法不可用。
Method: 提出 FedCGNM：将类别按最小方差分组，每组维护动量，归一化后求和作为更新方向；并给出考虑时变重采样率的收敛分析。另提出 FedHOO：基于 X-臂老虎机算法，利用联邦并行性以线性成本评估每个客户端两个候选重采样率的组合。
Result: 在四个公开长尾基准和一个专有芯片缺陷数据集上，FedCGNM 持续优于基线，FedHOO 在小规模联邦中带来进一步增益。
Conclusion: 提出的分组归一化动量和基于老虎机的超参数探索能有效应对联邦学习中的类别不平衡，尤其在小客户端场景下。

papers.title: World Feedback for Clinical Agents: Diagnosing RL in FHIR Environments
papers.abstract_en: Clinical protocol-execution tasks -- checking a lab value, applying a threshold, placing a correctly structured FHIR order -- are natural candidates for RL from world feedback: once clinical SMEs encode decision logic into a verifier, that verifier grades unlimited rollouts without per-episode annotation. But applying RL requires a sound feedback channel and sufficient base capability. We audit MedAgentBench v1/v2, find a 41.7\% silent-finish ceiling that makes inaction the RL dominant strategy, and construct \textbf{MedAgentBench-v3 (MAB-v3)} (508 tasks, 8.9\% ceiling). Training Qwen3-8B exposes two structural barriers: a \emph{capability ceiling} (10/20 task types have 0\% base performance, zero gradient) and a \emph{format-knowledge barrier} (3/20 types require exact clinical codes undiscoverable by exploration). Pure RL reaches 18.2\% pass@1 vs.\ 34.1\% for rule-based SFT; the 15.9~pp gap is attributable entirely to these barriers. A decision/format-knowledge/lookup taxonomy predicts RL learnability and prescribes the fix: SFT to inject codes, RL to learn conditionals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计临床诊疗任务中的强化学习（RL）反馈通道，发现现有MedAgentBench v1/v2存在41.7%的静默完成上限，导致RL最优策略为不作为。作者构建新基准MAB-v3（508任务，上限8.9%），训练Qwen3-8B时发现能力上限（10/20任务类型零基础性能）和格式知识障碍（3/20类型需精确临床代码）两个结构性问题，使纯RL仅达18.2% pass@1，而基于规则的SFT达34.1%，15.9百分点的差距完全由此解释。提出决策/格式知识/查找三分类法预测RL可学性，并建议用SFT注入代码、RL学习条件逻辑。
Motivation: 临床协议执行任务（如核实实验室值、应用阈值、下结构化的FHIR订单）适合用世界反馈做RL，但需要可靠的反馈通道和足够的基础能力。现有基准存在静默完成上限，掩盖了RL的实际效用，需要构建更严格的基准并诊断RL应用的障碍。
Method: 审计MedAgentBench v1/v2并构建MAB-v3（508任务，8.9%上限）。使用Qwen3-8B进行纯RL训练，同时与基于规则的SFT对比。分析失败案例，归纳出能力上限（10/20类型零基础性能）和格式知识障碍（3/20类型需临床代码）两类障碍，并提出决策/格式知识/查找分类法。
Result: 纯RL在MAB-v3上达到18.2% pass@1，基于规则的SFT达到34.1%，差距15.9个百分点完全由能力上限和格式知识障碍解释。10/20任务类型零基础性能（无梯度），3/20类型需要精确临床代码（不可通过探索发现）。
Conclusion: 临床RL应用受制于两个结构性障碍，纯RL无法独立克服。SFT注入格式知识（如临床代码）是必要前提，RL用于学习条件逻辑。决策/格式知识/查找分类法可预测任务对RL的可学性，指导混合训练策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Cost-Aware, Paired Protocol for Auditing Dynamic Tool Synthesis in Agentic Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Agentic Video Question Answering (VideoQA) systems invoke tools during inference, but their tool libraries are fixed, so recurring procedures are rebuilt from primitives on every question. Synthesizing composite tools could remove this overhead, but whether such expansion helps is hard to assess: final-answer accuracy, the standard metric, ignores inference effort, so it cannot reveal how a system shifts cost. We propose a cost-aware, paired protocol for auditing tool-augmented video agents. The protocol pairs two complete systems on the same input for each question and reports their net difference across accuracy and cost jointly. For each question, it sorts the paired outcome into one of six groups defined by joint correctness and by the change in visible tool calls, separating accuracy-preserving efficiency gains from harmful regressions. Significance is reported with McNemar's test and paired bootstrap confidence intervals. We instantiate the protocol on Dynamic-SAGE, an agentic VideoQA framework that synthesizes, validates, and persistently registers executable composite tools for reuse on unseen questions, and evaluate it against the SAGE baseline on SAGE-Bench. The audit reveals a multi-axis profile that a scalar accuracy comparison would miss: Dynamic-SAGE improves accuracy by 7.5 points (p < 0.001) and reduces reasoning turns and visible tool calls by roughly 28%, while shifting rather than reducing inference cost, as token usage rises 34% and cost 26%. Gains are largest on visual and open-ended questions and neutral on verbal and multimodal ones, and residual failures concentrate on hard, open-ended questions where the pipeline does the most work. By measuring accuracy and cost jointly, the protocol shows where the pipeline-level difference is reliable and where it is not. The code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/Dynamic-SAGE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个成本感知的配对审计协议，用于评估动态工具合成在智能体视频问答中的效果。该协议配对两个完整系统在同一输入上，联合报告准确性和成本的净差异，并将配对结果分为六组。在Dynamic-SAGE框架上实例化后，审计显示相比基线，准确率提升7.5个点（p<0.001），推理轮次和可见工具调用减少约28%，但token使用量增加34%，成本增加26%。代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有智能体VideoQA系统的工具库固定，重复过程需从头构建，合成复合工具可减少开销，但标准准确率指标忽略推理成本，无法揭示系统如何转移成本。
Method: 提出成本感知的配对审计协议：对每个问题配对两个完整系统，联合报告准确性和成本的净差异；将配对结果按正确性和工具调用变化分为六组；使用McNemar检验和配对bootstrap置信区间报告显著性。在Dynamic-SAGE上实例化，该框架合成、验证并注册可重用复合工具，与SAGE基线在SAGE-Bench上对比。
Result: 动态工具合成（Dynamic-SAGE）相比基线准确率提升7.5个点（p<0.001），推理轮次和可见工具调用减少约28%，但token使用量增加34%，成本增加26%。增益在视觉和开放式问题上最大，在语言和多模态问题上中性，失败集中在困难开放式问题。
Conclusion: 联合测量准确性和成本的协议揭示了标量准确率比较会错过的多轴特征，显示了管线级差异在哪些方面可靠、哪些不可靠。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Next-Token Prediction: An RLVR Proof of Concept for Tool-Use Agents on Atlassian Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are trained to predict the next token, not to act inside a specific API. In niche enterprise SaaS workflows -- where success means hitting the right endpoint with the right nested arguments in the right order -- this objective mismatch shows up as silent failures: dropped required fields, hallucinated tools, or early stops after a single read. We ask whether Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), applied directly in the target environment, closes the gap. As a proof of concept we build a suite of five synthetic environments emulating the Jira REST v3 and Confluence v2 APIs at schema fidelity; rewards are computed entirely from the tool-call trace, with no live API, no learned judge, and no human label in the loop. Scoring prompted Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3.5-4B on the same checkers that drive GRPO training, we find that on the four scenarios whose rewards are non-degenerate the RL-trained policy lifts average reward from a 4B-baseline range of 0.35--0.92 to 0.95--1.00, with the largest single gain on Confluence page creation ($0.35 \rightarrow 1.00$). We position this as a preliminary step toward outcome-optimised small models for niche enterprise APIs, and foreground two limitations a workshop reader should weigh: hand-crafting verifiable rewards does not scale beyond the handful of endpoints reported here, and one of our five scenarios (ticket-transition) has a saturating reward shape that the prompted 4B already maxes out.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在特定企业SaaS API（如Jira和Confluence）中工具使用失败的问题，提出使用可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）直接在实际环境中训练模型。作为概念验证，作者构建了五个模拟Jira和Confluence API的合成环境，训练Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3.5-4B模型，在四个非退化场景中将平均奖励从0.35-0.92提升到0.95-1.00，最大提升出现在Confluence页面创建任务（0.35→1.00）。作者指出手工构建可验证奖励难以扩展，且一个场景（ticket-transition）的奖励已经饱和。
Motivation: 大语言模型训练目标是预测下一个token，而非在特定API中执行行动，导致在企业SaaS工作流中出现静默失败（如遗漏必填字段、幻觉工具、过早停止）。
Method: 提出RLVR（强化学习结合可验证奖励）方法，在目标环境中直接训练；构建五个高保真合成环境模拟Jira REST v3和Confluence v2 API，奖励仅基于工具调用轨迹计算，无需实时API、学习型评判者或人工标注。
Result: 在四个非退化场景上，RL训练的策略将平均奖励从4B基线模型的0.35-0.92提升到0.95-1.00；最大增益在Confluence页面创建上（0.35→1.00）。
Conclusion: 本文是面向小众企业API的结果优化小模型的初步步骤，但手工构建可验证奖励难以扩展到更多端点，且一个场景的奖励已饱和。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Grounded Optimization: A Layered Engineering Framework for Reducing LLM Hallucination in Automated Personal Document Rewriting
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to resume optimization for applicant tracking systems, introducing hallucination failures distinct from general text generation: anachronistic technology injection, cross-domain terminology contamination, structural mutation, and content fabrication. We present Grounded Optimization, a five-layer framework combining temporal context validation, deterministic contamination detection, structural invariant enforcement, prompt-level grounding, and an evaluator agent. In ablation experiments across three LLMs, four temperature settings, and six layer configurations on 25 synthetic resumes spanning 14 industries, undefended baselines produce 2.48-5.36 detected hallucinations per resume. Among detectors independent of the active defenses, temporal hallucinations are reduced by 50-95% across all conditions; overall detected hallucination rate falls to 0.04-0.24. Prompt-level grounding alone achieves zero detected hallucinations at low temperature with a capable instruction-following model; higher temperatures and weaker models reveal the need for the deterministic layers as a complement. We release the contamination taxonomy, evaluation code, and raw data.

TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型在简历优化中产生的特定幻觉（如时间错位技术注入、跨领域术语污染、结构突变和内容捏造），提出一个名为Grounded Optimization的五层工程框架。框架包括时间上下文验证、确定性污染检测、结构不变性强制、提示级接地和评估器代理。在三个LLM、四种温度设置和六种层配置下，对25个跨14个行业的合成简历进行消融实验，未防御基线每份简历产生2.48-5.36个检测到的幻觉，而完整框架将总体检测率降至0.04-0.24，其中时间幻觉减少50-95%。

papers.title: Token Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Language models learn continuous programs over discrete symbols, with the embedding table and LM-head acting as the read/write interface between them. We show that this interface has gradient geometry distinct from dense hidden weights which can be exploited to improve the Pareto frontier across supervised finetuning, RL, and pretraining, while only utilizing kilobytes of optimizer state. We introduce Ember, a lightweight optimizer for embedding and LM-head matrices that utilizes O(V + D) VRAM, instead of Adam's O(2VD), and forgoes the need to shard both token table optimizer states. We provide empirical evidence that Ember scales effectively across batch size and parameter count. We show that the optimization trajectory of tokens can be well described by a simple 1D ray, counter to the popular belief that neural net parameters navigate a heavily nonconvex landscape. We provide a principled view on the surprisingly narrow space of optimizers that suffice for Transformer training. Finally, we open-source our distributed Ember implementation that merges cleanly with existing ZeRO/FSDP setups to support further research at https://github.com/katop1234/ember
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现语言模型的嵌入表和LM头具有与密集隐藏权重不同的梯度几何结构，利用此结构可以改善监督微调、强化学习和预训练的帕累托前沿。作者提出Ember优化器，仅需O(V+D)显存（Adam需O(2VD)），并证明其可跨批大小和参数量扩展。此外，论文指出token的优化轨迹可用一维射线描述，对Transformer训练的优化器选择提供了新视角。
Motivation: 现有优化器（如Adam）在嵌入表和LM头上占用过多显存（O(2VD)），且未充分利用这些层独特的梯度几何结构，导致效率不高。
Method: 提出Ember轻量优化器，专用于嵌入表和LM头，利用梯度几何的稳定性，仅需O(V+D)显存，无需分片存储token表优化器状态。通过理论分析和实验验证其可扩展性。
Result: Ember在监督微调、强化学习和预训练任务上改善了帕累托前沿，显存占用大幅减少，且可跨批大小和参数量有效扩展。
Conclusion: 论文挑战了神经网络参数非凸性假设，展示了token优化的简单几何特性，并开源了与ZeRO/FSDP兼容的分布式实现。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware R-Structured Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel hybrid neural architecture, the Geometry-aware R-Structured Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (GRS-KAN), which integrates V.L.Rvachev's R-functions into the Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) framework. The proposed approach combines two complementary modeling mechanisms: smooth nonlinear structure is learned by KAN branches, while known geometric or logical constraints are encoded analytically using differentiable R-functions. This enables explicit representation of discontinuities, feasible regions, and implicit geometric boundaries within a trainable neural architecture. The framework implements differentiable logical operations through R-conjunctions and R-disjunctions, allowing complex geometric supports to be represented analytically and incorporated directly into regression models. Several GRS-KAN variants are introduced, including additive, multiplicative, and agnostic branch-weighted architectures. The method is demonstrated on regression problems involving discontinuities with circular and rectangular supports. Numerical experiments show that explicit geometric encoding substantially improves predictive accuracy and boundary localization compared with standard KANs. In the considered benchmarks, geometry-aware GRS-KAN models reduce test RMSE by up to 67% while simultaneously improving interpretability through explicit analytical representation of the learned geometric structure. The agnostic variant further demonstrates the ability to automatically determine whether geometric priors are beneficial for a given learning task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新型混合神经网络架构GRS-KAN，将V.L.Rvachev的R函数集成到Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）框架中。该架构通过KAN分支学习平滑非线性结构，同时利用可微R函数显式编码已知几何或逻辑约束，从而能够表达间断、可行区域和几何边界。在含圆形和矩形支撑的间断回归问题上，GRS-KAN相比标准KAN将测试RMSE降低高达67%，并提升了可解释性。
Motivation: 标准KAN缺乏显式表示几何约束和间断的能力，而许多回归问题需要融入先验几何知识以提高精度和边界定位。
Method: 提出GRS-KAN，通过R-合取和R-析取实现可微逻辑操作，从而将复杂几何支撑解析地融入回归模型。引入了加性、乘性和不可知分支加权三种变体架构。
Result: 在含间断的回归基准上，几何感知的GRS-KAN变体将测试RMSE降低最多67%，同时改善了边界定位。不可知变体能自动判断几何先验是否对给定任务有益。
Conclusion: 显式几何编码能显著提升预测精度和可解释性，且所提框架可推广至其他含几何约束的回归问题。

papers.title: Hamm-Grams: An Algorithm for Mining Regular Expressions of Bytes
papers.abstract_en: Malware poses a critical and ever-evolving threat, and robust and effective systems for detecting and classifying malware are of essential importance. $n$-grams features are among the common static features used in effective machine learning systems for malware, but these features are inherently brittle. We propose an algorithm for constructing more robust features, hamm-grams, which are a special class of regular expressions having a fixed length and single-character wildcards. We devise an efficient algorithm for finding common hamm-grams using a new locality-sensitive hash designed to produce collisions among pairs of small Hamming distance and a clustering within hash buckets to place wildcards. We then demonstrate the advantages of these features in malware classification and detection tasks.
papers.comment: To appear in Machine Learning for Malware Detection
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为hamm-grams的算法，用于挖掘字节序列中的正则表达式特征，这些特征具有固定长度和单字符通配符，旨在比传统的n-gram特征更鲁棒。算法利用一种新的局部敏感哈希，使小汉明距离的字节对易碰撞，并通过桶内聚类放置通配符。实验在恶意软件分类和检测任务上显示了优势。
Motivation: 恶意软件检测中常用的n-gram特征具有固有的脆弱性，需要更鲁棒的特征表示。
Method: 提出hamm-grams算法，通过设计一种新的局部敏感哈希来高效发现共同hamm-grams，该哈希使汉明距离小的字节对易碰撞，并在哈希桶内聚类以确定通配符位置。
Result: 在恶意软件分类和检测任务上，hamm-grams特征相比传统n-gram表现出优势。
Conclusion: hamm-grams是一种有效的静态特征，可提升恶意软件检测系统的鲁棒性。

papers.title: On the Utility and Factual Reliability of Pruned Mixture-of-Experts Models in the Biomedical Domain
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer inference speedups via selective activation but impose substantial memory requirements because the whole network must remain loaded. Structured expert pruning is a practical approach for reducing deployment costs in resource-constrained settings. However, prior studies primarily evaluate benchmark utility, leaving the effect of pruning on factual reliability underexplored, particularly in high-stakes domains such as biomedicine. In this paper, we investigate how domain-specific expert pruning affects both utility and reliability. We assess four MoE models, six pruning methods, and multiple pruning ratios across generation and classification tasks under in-domain (biomedical) and cross-domain settings. Results reveal that moderate pruning preserves in-domain utility without immediate reliability decline, although hallucination risks increase at extreme pruning ratios. When shifting to the general domain, both utility and reliability degrade rapidly. These findings indicate that safe compression depends heavily on the task and domain. Evaluating pruned MoE models solely on utility is inadequate for high-stakes deployment without reliability assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究结构化专家修剪对混合专家模型（MoE）在生物医学领域的实用性和事实可靠性的影响。评估了四个MoE模型、六种修剪方法和多种修剪比例，发现适度修剪可保持领域内实用性且可靠性不立即下降，但极端修剪增加幻觉风险；跨领域时实用性和可靠性迅速退化。结论强调仅评估修剪后MoE的实用性不足以用于高风险部署。
Motivation: 现有研究主要评估修剪对基准实用性的影响，忽略了对事实可靠性的影响，特别是在生物医学等高风险领域。
Method: 系统评估四个MoE模型、六种修剪方法和多种修剪比例，在领域内（生物医学）和跨领域设置下进行生成和分类任务实验。
Result: 适度修剪保持领域内实用性且可靠性不立即下降，但极端修剪增加幻觉风险；跨领域时实用性和可靠性迅速退化。
Conclusion: 安全压缩高度依赖于任务和领域，仅评估实用性不足以评估高风险部署中的修剪模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Forgeries to Foundation Models: A Systematic Survey of Identity Document Attack and Detection
papers.abstract_en: Identity document forgery has undergone a fundamental capability shift: generative AI tools now enable high-fidelity document synthesis and field-level manipulation with minimal technical expertise, while detection methods remain constrained by benchmarks that do not reflect this threat. The resulting attack surface spans physical presentation, digital injection, and fully generative synthesis, introducing distinct forensic failure modes that require a unified threat model and evaluation framework. This survey provides, to our knowledge, the first unified treatment of Presentation Attacks, Digital Injection Attacks, and GenAI-driven synthesis within a single identity verification threat model. We trace detection methodologies from rule-based heuristics through forensic localisation, injection-aware pipelines, foundation models, and few-shot frameworks. A systematic audit of public datasets from 2019--2025 exposes a persistent Reality Gap between benchmark conditions and operational deployment. We further analyse large multimodal models for identity document manipulation, identifying Script-Dependent Generative Instability (SDGI) as a recurring typographic failure mode in non-Latin script inpainting. Finally, zero-shot benchmarking on unseen synthesised ID cards shows that even the strongest publicly available models achieve APCER values above 25% under security-oriented operating conditions, highlighting substantial limits in cross-domain generalisation. We conclude by outlining future directions toward forensically grounded, privacy-preserving, and legally accountable identity verification systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统综述了身份证件伪造与检测的最新进展，涵盖物理呈现攻击、数字注入攻击和生成式AI驱动的全合成攻击。论文对2019-2025年间的公开数据集进行审计，指出现有基准与真实部署之间存在显著差距；分析了大型多模态模型在身份证件篡改中的缺陷，揭示了非拉丁文字修复中的脚本依赖生成不稳定性（SDGI）。零样本测试表明，即使在最强公开模型下，安全导向操作条件下的APCER仍超过25%。
Motivation: 现有身份证件伪造检测方法受限于不反映真实威胁的基准，而生成式AI工具使得高保真证件合成和字段级篡改变得容易，攻击面涵盖物理、数字和全生成合成，需要统一威胁模型和评估框架。
Method: 采用统一威胁模型对呈现攻击、数字注入攻击和GenAI驱动合成进行分类；对检测方法从规则启发式到基础模型、小样本框架进行系统梳理；对公开数据集进行系统审计；对大型多模态模型进行对抗性分析；在未见过的合成ID卡上进行零样本基准测试。
Result: 发现基准条件与真实部署之间存在持续的现实差距；识别出脚本依赖生成不稳定性（SDGI）作为非拉丁文字修复中的常见缺陷；零样本测试下最强公开模型在安全导向条件下APCER仍超过25%。
Conclusion: 需要走向法医学上可靠、保护隐私且法律上可问责的身份验证系统。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文系统综述了身份证件伪造与检测的最新进展，涵盖物理呈现攻击、数字注入攻击和生成式AI驱动的全合成攻击。论文对2019-2025年间的公开数据集进行审计，指出现有基准与真实部署之间存在显著差距；分析了大型多模态模型在身份证件篡改中的缺陷，揭示了非拉丁文字修复中的脚本依赖生成不稳定性（SDGI）。零样本测试表明，即使在最强公开模型下，安全导向操作条件下的APCER仍超过25%。

papers.title: How Much Future Helps? A Controlled Study of Future-Privileged Supervision for Causal Egocentric Gaze Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric gaze estimation is commonly studied using models that process the full video with access to future frames, while real-world applications require strictly causal, online prediction. This discrepancy raises key questions: Does future context inherently provide valuable signals for gaze estimation? If so, how much future look-ahead optimally supervises a causal model during training? To investigate, we propose a controlled framework featuring a future-aware branch that accesses a tunable look-ahead horizon during training but is discarded at inference. This design isolates the impact of future context while keeping the inference architecture fixed and strictly causal. Across EGTEA Gaze+ and Ego4D, we find that future-privileged supervision consistently improves causal gaze prediction, confirming its utility. However, performance gains do not increase monotonically with longer look-ahead, but rather peak within a bounded temporal regime. Specifically, optimal performance corresponds to roughly 1.7--3.3 seconds of future context ($H{\in}[5, 10]$) on EGTEA Gaze+ and 2.7 seconds ($H{=}10$) on Ego4D. Our results demonstrate that lightweight causal models can effectively absorb future-aware signals, providing practical guidance for real-time egocentric gaze modeling.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 7th International Workshop on Eye and Gaze in Computer Vision (GAZE 2026), CVPR 2026. Best Paper Award
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一个受控框架研究未来上下文对因果性自我中心注视估计的影响。该框架在训练时使用一个未来感知分支访问可调节的视野，推理时丢弃该分支以保持严格因果性。在EGTEA Gaze+和Ego4D数据集上的实验表明，未来特权监督一致提升了因果注视预测性能，但性能增益并非随视野长度单调递增，而是在有限时间窗口内达到峰值（约1.7-3.3秒）。
Motivation: 现有自我中心注视估计模型常利用未来帧进行训练，但实际应用需要严格的因果在线预测。这种差异引出一个关键问题：未来上下文是否提供有价值信号，以及如何最优地利用它来训练因果模型。
Method: 提出一个受控框架，包含一个未来感知分支，该分支在训练时访问可调节的视野（look-ahead horizon），但在推理时被丢弃，从而隔离未来上下文的影响，同时保持推理架构固定且严格因果。
Result: 在EGTEA Gaze+和Ego4D上，未来特权监督一致改善因果注视预测；最优性能对应的未来上下文长度在EGTEA Gaze+上约为1.7-3.3秒（H∈[5,10]），在Ego4D上约为2.7秒（H=10）。性能增益不随视野长度单调递增。
Conclusion: 表明轻量级因果模型可以有效吸收未来感知信号，为实时自我中心注视建模提供实用指导。

papers.title: Discrete Diffusion Language Models for Interactive Radiology Report Drafting
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models, which generate text by denoising a token canvas bidirectionally instead of emitting tokens left to right, have become competitive with autoregressive (AR) generation. Medical foundation models, however, remain almost entirely autoregressive. We adapt a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model, DiffusionGemma-26B, and benchmark it against its same-size AR sibling Gemma-4-26B under an identical LoRA recipe on medical visual question answering datasets, scored by a verbosity-robust LLM judge. Diffusion matches or exceeds AR on all of them, and the finetuned model (3.8B active) is competitive with frontier vision-language models; its decoding is also 3.5-4.4x faster. Beyond this parity, the diffusion model offers a drafting capability AR lacks: any-order infill. Because the canvas is denoised bidirectionally, a radiologist can fix report fragments and have the model fill the text between them, an operation inherent to diffusion but not to autoregression, which is subpar at it. This suits real reports, which are often terse or inconsistent across clinicians and institutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文调整了混合专家扩散语言模型DiffusionGemma-26B，并与其自回归版本Gemma-4-26B在医学视觉问答数据集上对比，在相同LoRA设置下，扩散模型匹配或超过自回归性能，解码速度快3.5-4.4倍，并提供了自回归模型缺乏的任意顺序填充能力，适用于放射学报告起草中的交互式片段填充。
Motivation: 现有的医学基础模型几乎全为自回归模型，缺乏交互式报告起草所需的灵活填充能力。
Method: 采用混合专家扩散语言模型DiffusionGemma-26B，通过LoRA微调，在医学视觉问答数据集上训练，利用双向去噪生成文本。
Result: 扩散模型在所有医学VQA数据集上匹配或超过自回归模型，解码速度提升3.5-4.4倍，且3.8B活跃参数模型与前沿视觉语言模型竞争力相当。
Conclusion: 扩散语言模型在医学报告起草中具有优势，特别是其固有的任意顺序填充能力，适合处理临床报告中长短不一的片段。

papers.title: Sign in the Air to Unlock: An Interface for authentication in Virtual and Augmented Reality Powered by Point-Voxel Cross-Attention Network
papers.abstract_en: Significant advancement of immersive technologies such as Virtual and Augmented Reality (VR/AR) and their integration into diverse aspects of modern life need authentication interfaces that are secure, intuitive, and compatible with embodied interaction. Traditional methods such as passwords, PINs, and device-based logins, break immersion and rely on external hardware. Recent 3D-specific behavioral approaches, such as hand-gesture, eye-tracking, and electroencephalography (EEG)-based methods, offer promising alternatives but often require specialized sensors or constrain natural movement, limiting usability in dynamic environments. We present Sign in the Air to Unlock, an in-air signature interface that enables users to authenticate by signing naturally in 3D space which is a familiar, personal, and reproducible gesture. To realize this interface, we design a point-voxel Cross-Attention Network (PV-Net) that jointly models local motion dynamics and global spatial structure from 3D trajectories. The model is evaluated on two datasets: the public DeepAirSig dataset (1,800 signatures from 40 users) and ImmAirsig, a new dataset collected using Meta Quest 2 in immersive VR (880 samples from 22 users). PV-Net achieves an Equal Error Rate of 2.5% on DeepAirSig and 76% classification accuracy on ImmAirSig. These findings highlight the potential of 3D behavioral interfaces for seamless, user-centric authentication that merges security with natural interaction in immersive environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于空中签名的VR/AR认证接口，用户通过在3D空间中自然签名进行身份验证。设计了点-体素交叉注意力网络（PV-Net）联合建模局部运动动态和全局空间结构。在DeepAirSig数据集上等错误率为2.5%，在自采ImmAirSig数据集上分类准确率为76%。
Motivation: 现有VR/AR认证方法（如密码、设备登录）破坏沉浸感，而手势、眼动等行为方法需要专用传感器或约束自然动作，缺乏实用性与自然交互的融合。
Method: 提出点-体素交叉注意力网络（PV-Net），同时处理3D轨迹的局部运动细节和整体空间结构，用于空中签名认证。
Result: 在公开DeepAirSig数据集（1800签名/40用户）上等错误率2.5%；在自采ImmAirSig数据集（880样本/22用户）上分类准确率76%。
Conclusion: 3D行为接口（如空中签名）可在沉浸式环境中实现安全且自然的用户认证，具有应用潜力。

papers.title: CreativityNeuro: Steering Language Model Weights to Improve Divergent Thinking and Reduce Mode Collapse
papers.abstract_en: Divergent thinking is a crucial aspect of creativity, yet large language models (LLMs) tend to consistently generate similar responses to open-ended questions, in what has been termed the artificial hivemind effect. Here, we introduce CreativityNeuro, a data-free method for enhancing divergent thinking in LLMs via contrastive weight steering. We evaluate our method across multiple creativity assessments and report several main findings. On the Divergent Association Task (DAT), a vocabulary-space creativity test, CreativityNeuro improves performance by up to 14 human percentile points. Next, in a large-scale human evaluation (N=720) on the Alternative Uses Test (AUT) and the Task Task, CreativityNeuro achieves significant improvements in originality, surprise, and creativity, transferring to longer-form and more open-ended tasks. Importantly, we find that across all three tasks, CreativityNeuro demonstrably reduces measures of mode collapse. Moreover, activation steering achieves comparable performance to CreativityNeuro on the DAT, but it does not transfer to the AUT and Task Task, demonstrating the effectiveness of weight-space steering in generalizing to unseen tasks. In conclusion, CreativityNeuro improves divergent thinking and reduces mode collapse without requiring behavioral data, re-training, or gradient-based fine-tuning, providing a straightforward way to enhance LLM performance in creative domains.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Creativity & Generative AI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CreativityNeuro，一种无需数据的对比权重导向方法，用于增强大语言模型（LLM）的发散思维并减少模式崩溃。在发散联想任务（DAT）上，该方法将人类百分位提升最多 14 个点；在包含 720 人的人类评估中，替代用途测试（AUT）和 Task Task 任务上的原创性、惊喜度和创造力均有显著提升，并且减轻了模式崩溃。与激活导向相比，权重导向方法能更好地泛化到未见任务。
Motivation: 大语言模型在开放式问题上倾向于生成雷同回答（人工蜂巢效应），缺乏发散思维，需要一种无需重新训练或梯度微调的方法来提升创造力。
Method: CreativityNeuro 采用对比权重导向（contrastive weight steering），通过调整模型权重来促进发散思维，无需额外数据、重训练或梯度微调。
Result: 在 DAT 上提升性能达 14 个人类百分位；在 AUT 和 Task Task 的大规模人类评估（N=720）中，原创性、惊喜度和创造力显著提升，且模式崩溃指标下降。激活导向在 DAT 上表现类似但无法迁移到其他任务，而权重导向泛化更好。
Conclusion: CreativityNeuro 在不依赖行为数据、重训练或梯度微调的情况下，有效提升发散思维并减少模式崩溃，为增强 LLM 创造力提供了一种简洁方法。

papers.title: IsoSci: A Benchmark of Isomorphic Cross-Domain Science Problems for Evaluating Reasoning versus Knowledge Retrieval in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ISOSCI, a benchmark of isomorphic cross-domain science problem pairs that separates reasoning ability from domain knowledge retrieval in LLM evaluation. Each pair shares identical logical structure but requires different domain-specific knowledge, enabling controlled attribution of reasoning-mode gains. Across five model pairs spanning four model families, we find that 91.3% of reasoning-mode gains are knowledge-dependent rather than structure-invariant (63/69 gains; Wilson 95% CI [82.3%, 96.0%]), directly challenging the assumption that chain-of-thought reasoning improves short-horizon procedural scientific problem-solving. Reasoning toggles on highly capable models provide less than 5 percentage points accuracy gain across all domains, and a reasoning-specialized model (o3-mini) that outperforms its standard counterpart on GPQA Diamond (+19.2 percentage points) underperforms on ISOSCI (-24.7 percentage points), showing that benchmark choice determines conclusions about reasoning utility. We release ISOSCI at https://huggingface.co/datasets/isosci/isosci
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ISOSCI 基准，由同构跨领域科学问题对组成，用于在 LLM 评估中分离推理能力与领域知识检索。通过对5个模型对（跨4个模型系列）的测试，发现91.3%的推理模式增益依赖于领域知识而非结构不变性，直接质疑了思维链推理能改善短程程序性科学问题解决的假设。推理切换在高能力模型上仅带来不到5个百分点的准确率提升，且推理专用模型 o3-mini 在 GPQA Diamond 上优于标准模型（+19.2百分点）但在 ISOSCI 上表现更差（-24.7百分点），说明基准选择决定了关于推理实用性的结论。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 评估难以区分推理能力与领域知识，导致对推理提升的误判，因此需要一种能独立测量推理贡献的基准。
Method: 构建同构跨领域科学问题对，每对共享相同的逻辑结构但需要不同的领域特定知识，从而控制变量地归因推理模式增益。
Result: 91.3%的推理模式增益依赖于领域知识（63/69增益；Wilson 95% CI [82.3%, 96.0%]）；推理切换在高能力模型上准确率提升不到5个百分点；o3-mini 在 GPQA Diamond 上提升19.2百分点但在 ISOSCI 上下降24.7百分点。
Conclusion: 基准选择（如 ISOSCI vs GPQA Diamond）会显著改变关于推理实用性的结论，短程程序性科学问题解决中推理的增益主要来自领域知识而非结构不变的推理能力。

papers.title: When Should Service Agents Reconsider? Difficulty-Routed Control in Customer-Service Operations
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous customer-service agents are shifting from conversational interfaces toward operational execution roles: they retrieve firm records, apply service policies, and execute backend writes such as refunds, cancellations, exchanges, order modifications, and reservation changes. This shift creates a service-control problem: firms must keep routine service fast and low-friction while preventing operational errors on requests where customer instructions, policy constraints, firm records, and backend writes interact. We propose a difficulty-routed service-control architecture that asks when service agents should reconsider before acting. A lightweight router keeps routine sessions on a low-cost baseline path and routes operationally coupled sessions to an escalated workflow. The escalated path uses conflict-aware communication and write-triggered reconsideration to concentrate deliberation and safeguards before consequential backend writes, rather than applying additional control uniformly across all service sessions. We evaluate the architecture on human-verified retail and airline tasks from $τ^{2}$-bench. In retail, the method improves reliability consistently on service requests with operational conflict. Routing evidence shows that stronger control is directed toward conflicted requests rather than broadly applied to routine ones. Dialogue and tool-use profiles suggest that gains do not come from indiscriminate interaction expansion or broader tool chains; instead, added turns and tool calls support evidence gathering, write separation, and pre-write reconsideration. Case-level evidence shows that the escalated workflow preserves fallback plans, binds retrieved records to the correct action, sequences writes, and decomposes multi-entity requests. Airline results extend the same service-control logic to reservation operations.

TL;DR: 本文针对客户服务代理从对话界面转向操作执行角色（如退款、取消、修改订单等）带来的服务控制问题，提出了一种基于难度路由的服务控制架构。该架构通过轻量级路由器将常规会话保持在低成本基线路径上，将操作耦合的会话路由到升级流程，升级流程使用冲突感知通信和写入触发重新考虑来集中保障。在τ²-bench的零售和航空任务上评估，该方法在具有操作冲突的服务请求上持续提高可靠性，且改进来自额外的对话轮次和工具调用以支持证据收集、写入分离和写入前重新考虑。
Motivation: 自主客服代理向操作执行角色转变，导致需要在保持常规服务快速低摩擦的同时，防止因客户指令、政策约束、公司记录和后端写入交互而产生的操作错误，现有方法难以平衡这一需求。
Method: 提出难度路由的服务控制架构：一个轻量级路由器将常规会话路由到低成本基线路径，将操作耦合的会话路由到升级流程；升级流程采用冲突感知通信和写入触发重新考虑，在关键的后端写入前集中进行推理和安全检查。
Result: 在τ²-bench（零售和航空任务）上，该方法在具有操作冲突的服务请求上持续提高可靠性。证据显示更强的控制仅针对冲突请求，而非均匀应用于所有会话；增加的对话轮次和工具调用主要用于证据收集、写入分离和预写入重新考虑。
Conclusion: 升级流程能够保留后备计划、正确绑定记录与操作、序列化写入并分解多实体请求。航空任务的结果验证了相同的服务控制逻辑在预订操作中的可迁移性。

papers.title: Agent4cs: A Multi-agent System for Code Summarization in Large Hierarchical Codebases
papers.abstract_en: Understanding large, complex codebases, especially those with obfuscated structures and incomplete documentation, remains a significant challenge. Existing code summarization solutions often rely on a single language model or coding assistant like Claude Code, and treat source code as flat text, underutilizing the rich interdependencies and hierarchical information within a repository. To address these shortcomings, we propose Agent4cs - a multi-agent framework that summarizes large codebases in a bottom-up fashion, where a summarization agent focuses on producing robust summaries; a keyword-extraction agent proactively identifies critical information from subfolders; and a quality-assurance agent iteratively refines the outputs for readability, coherence, and completeness. Evaluated on 7 frontier models, Agent4cs improves semantic consistency across all folder levels by average 8% compared to two structured prompting baselines with code segments. Furthermore, extensive evaluation on real-world datasets demonstrates up to 38% gains in normalized keyword coverage rate over the same baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted to the main track of the 23rd European Conference on Multi-Agent Systems (EUMAS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Agent4cs，一个多智能体系统，用于大型层级代码库的代码摘要。系统通过自底向上的方式，由摘要智能体、关键词提取智能体和质量保证智能体协同工作。在7个前沿模型上评估，与两个结构化提示基线相比，语义一致性平均提升8%，归一化关键词覆盖率提升最高达38%。
Motivation: 现有代码摘要方法通常依赖单一语言模型，将代码视为平面文本，未充分利用代码库中的层级结构和依赖关系，导致对复杂代码库的理解不足。
Method: 提出多智能体框架Agent4cs，包含三个智能体：摘要智能体生成鲁棒摘要，关键词提取智能体从子文件夹主动识别关键信息，质量保证智能体迭代优化输出的可读性、连贯性和完整性。采用自底向上的摘要方式。
Result: 在7个前沿模型上，与两个结构化提示基线相比，所有文件夹级别的语义一致性平均提升8%；在真实世界数据集上，归一化关键词覆盖率提升最高达38%。
Conclusion: 多智能体协作和层级化处理能显著提升大型复杂代码库的代码摘要质量，尤其在高混淆结构和缺乏文档的场景下有效。

papers.title: Risk Architecture for AI-Native Engineering Teams: An Organizational Framework for Agentic System Governance
papers.abstract_en: Engineering management research has produced mature frameworks for software risk: ownership by feature, escalation by severity, and assurance by test coverage. These frameworks implicitly assume deterministic behavior, discrete and auditable change events, and clear component-to-owner mappings. Teams that build and operate agentic AI systems violate all three assumptions at once: outputs are probabilistic, systems take autonomous multi-step actions, and the risk surface mutates silently between deployments. Existing AI risk literature addresses this from above (policy frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001) or below (threat taxonomies such as OWASP's agentic AI guidance), but not at the layer where an engineering manager (EM) operates: roles, decision rights, and escalation structures. This paper contributes (i) a seven-dimension profile distinguishing pure software-engineering, hybrid, and AI-native teams; (ii) a six-cluster failure-mode taxonomy including a previously unarticulated cluster, dependency-boundary determinism mismatch; and (iii) a synthetic framework-adequacy methodology scoring how well each profile's risk architecture detects, contains, and escalates a defined scenario set. Because the object of study is framework adequacy rather than human behavior, the evaluation yields derived rather than observed coverage claims. Coverage degrades as teams move from pure software engineering to AI-native operation, monotonically in the median and abruptly in the count of uncovered, high-consequence failures appearing only at the AI-native step. The degradation concentrates in specific failure-mode categories, and the most severe, least-covered failures arise not inside AI-native teams but at the organizational boundary where their probabilistic outputs are consumed by determinism-assuming dependencies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对构建和运营智能体AI系统的工程团队，提出了一种风险架构组织框架。论文贡献包括：一个七维团队画像（区分纯软件工程、混合和AI原生团队）、一个六类故障模式分类（包含新提出的依赖边界确定性失配），以及一个框架充分性评估方法。评估显示，从纯软件工程到AI原生操作，风险覆盖能力中位数单调下降，且AI原生步骤中出现了大量未覆盖的高后果故障模式。
Motivation: 现有软件风险管理框架隐含假设确定性行为、离散可审计变更事件和清晰组件所有者映射，而智能体AI系统同时违背这三项假设。AI风险文献从顶层政策或底层威胁分类出发，但缺乏工程管理层（角色、决策权、升级结构）的视角。
Method: 提出一套分析框架：定义七维画像区分团队类型；归纳六类故障模式（包括新发现的依赖边界确定性失配）；设计框架充分性评估方法，对每种团队画像，评分其风险架构对既定场景集的检测、遏制和升级能力。
Result: 随着团队从纯软件工程过渡到AI原生操作，风险覆盖能力中位数单调下降，且在AI原生步骤中突然出现大量未覆盖的高后果故障。最严重、覆盖最差的故障并非发生在AI原生团队内部，而是出现在其概率输出被假设确定性的依赖方消费的组织边界处。
Conclusion: 论文强调现有风险管理框架在AI原生团队中的不足，并指出边界失配是关键风险源。框架充分性评估提供了可操作的改进方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MultAttnAttrib: Training-Free Multimodal Attribution in Long Document Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: As grounded QA systems are increasingly deployed in AI assistants, accurately attributing generated answers to evidence is critical for user trust and model safety. While unimodal attributions have been explored in depth, the multimodal setting remains relatively under-researched. As a result, we introduce MultAttnAttrib, a training-free attribution-generation method that leverages a model's prefill pass, selected attention heads, and calibrated thresholds to locate source evidence within a document. To establish baseline results for the method, we introduce MultAttrEval, a complementary benchmark dataset annotated with fine-grained, ground-truth attributions for answer components grounded in multimodal source documents. To our knowledge, this is the first evaluation dataset designed specifically for multimodal attribution in long-form documents. Experimental results show that MultAttnAttrib consistently outperforms a variety of attribution-generation methods, including several strong prompting-based approaches and matches the latest frontier models such as GPT 5.4. Our method not only substantially improves attribution accuracy for both unimodal and multimodal attribution types, but also produces attributions at up to one-seventh of the direct inference latency compared to prompting on the same base model.
papers.comment: 25 pages (8 main, 17 references + appendix), 15 figures, Submitted to EMNLP 2026 Conference (Long Paper)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态长文档问答中的归因问题，提出了一种无需训练的多模态归因方法 MultAttnAttrib，利用模型预填充阶段、选定的注意力头和校准阈值来定位证据。同时引入新基准数据集 MultAttrEval，该数据集包含细粒度的多模态归因标注。实验表明，MultAttnAttrib 在归因准确率上优于多种基于提示的方法，匹配前沿模型 GPT 5.4，且推理延迟低至直接提示的七分之一。
Motivation: 现有问答系统大多关注单模态归因，而多模态场景下的归因研究较少，缺乏标准评估数据集和方法。
Method: 提出无需训练的 MultAttnAttrib 方法，利用模型预填充阶段的特定注意力头和校准阈值来定位文档中的源证据，无需额外训练。
Result: 在引入的 MultAttrEval 基准上，MultAttnAttrib 在归因准确率上持续优于多种基于提示的方法，并匹配 GPT 5.4 的性能，同时推理延迟降低至七分之一。
Conclusion: 该方法在无需训练的情况下实现了高效准确的多模态归因，填补了多模态归因评估数据集的空白，但方法依赖模型内部注意力机制，可能受模型架构影响。

papers.title: Adoption and Impact of Command-Line AI Coding Agents: A Study of Microsoft's Early 2026 Rollout of Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI
papers.abstract_en: Organizations rolling out agentic command line tools like Anthropic's Claude Code and GitHub's Copilot CLI need to know who will try them, who will keep using them, and whether the tools produce enough output to justify their cost. At organizational scale, token spend can run into millions of dollars annually, so misreading adoption, retention, or impact can make a rollout expensive without changing engineering velocity. Studying tens of thousands of engineers at Microsoft over its early-2026 rollout, we find that first use spread primarily through social networks, retention was associated more with engineers' coding activity than with demographics, and adopters merged roughly 24% more pull requests than they would have otherwise. We use merged pull requests as our proxy for output -- acknowledging that a merged PR is not the same as the value it delivers -- and the lift persists across our four-month window. These results suggest that CLI coding agents are neither uniformly adopted nor mere novelty effects and that organizations should treat visible peer use as central to rollout strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究微软2026年初推广的Claude Code和GitHub Copilot CLI等命令行AI编码代理的采用与影响。通过对数万名工程师的观察，发现首次使用主要通过社交网络传播，保留率与编码活动相关而非人口统计特征，采用者合并的PR数量比预期多约24%，且提升持续四个月。结果表明此类工具并非均匀采用或仅为新鲜感效应，组织应重视可见的同行使用以优化推广策略。
Motivation: 组织在推广命令行AI工具时需了解谁将试用、谁会持续使用以及产出是否足以抵消成本，因token消费可达数百万美元/年，错误判断采用或影响可能导致高投入但未提升工程速度。
Method: 采用观察性研究，分析微软2026年初推广期间数万名工程师的实际使用数据，考察首次使用的传播模式、用户保留率的影响因素，并以合并PR数量作为产出代理指标评估工具影响。
Result: 首次使用主要通过社交网络传播；保留率与工程师的编码活动量相关而非人口统计特征；采用者合并的PR数量比预期多约24%，该提升在四个月窗口内持续存在。
Conclusion: 命令行AI编码代理既非均匀被采用也非短暂的新奇效应，组织应将可见的同行使用作为推广策略的核心组成部分。

summary_sections.motivation: 组织在推广命令行AI工具时需了解谁将试用、谁会持续使用以及产出是否足以抵消成本，因token消费可达数百万美元/年，错误判断采用或影响可能导致高投入但未提升工程速度。
summary_sections.method: 采用观察性研究，分析微软2026年初推广期间数万名工程师的实际使用数据，考察首次使用的传播模式、用户保留率的影响因素，并以合并PR数量作为产出代理指标评估工具影响。
summary_sections.result: 首次使用主要通过社交网络传播；保留率与工程师的编码活动量相关而非人口统计特征；采用者合并的PR数量比预期多约24%，该提升在四个月窗口内持续存在。
summary_sections.conclusion: 命令行AI编码代理既非均匀被采用也非短暂的新奇效应，组织应将可见的同行使用作为推广策略的核心组成部分。

papers.title: Conditional Inference Trees and Forests for Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: Conditional inference trees (CIT) and conditional inference forests (CIF) reduce split-selection bias by testing features before choosing split thresholds, but repeated permutation tests and threshold searches can make these methods computationally expensive. We study CIT and CIF as top-$k$ feature-ranking methods for downstream prediction using real-data benchmarks, runtime ablations, and synthetic feature-recovery experiments. At a fixed node, if the features and permutation budget do not depend on the node responses, Bonferroni-corrected $+1$ Monte Carlo permutation $p$-values control nodewise rejection under the complete permutation null. CIF ranks 4th among 17 classification methods on 22 datasets and 3rd among 18 regression methods on 8 datasets. With Bonferroni correction held fixed, the CIF runtime ablations indicate that adaptive stopping and the number of thresholds searched have the largest measured effect on runtime: turning off adaptive stopping and using exact threshold search increase fitting time by 4.0--8.4$\times$ and 1.9--10.8$\times$, respectively, while downstream score changes are at most 0.011. Sparse high-$p$ simulations indicate that forest feature sampling can leave informative features out of many split decisions. Overall, the results support CIF as a top-$k$ feature-ranking method in the evaluated downstream prediction benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了条件推理树（CIT）和条件推理森林（CIF）作为top-k特征排序方法，用于下游预测。通过实际数据基准、运行时间分析和合成特征恢复实验，评估了其性能。结果表明CIF在分类和回归任务中表现良好，并分析了不同参数对运行时间的影响。
Motivation: 条件推理树和森林通过测试特征再选择分割阈值来减少分裂偏差，但重复的置换检验和阈值搜索导致计算开销大，本文旨在系统评估其作为特征排序方法的效率与效果。
Method: 使用Bonferroni校正的+1蒙特卡洛置换p值控制节点拒绝错误率；通过实际数据基准、运行时间消融实验和合成特征恢复实验进行分析。
Result: CIF在22个数据集上的17种分类方法中排名第4，在8个数据集上的18种回归方法中排名第3；关闭自适应停止和精确阈值搜索分别使拟合时间增加4.0-8.4倍和1.9-10.8倍，而下游评分变化最多0.011；高维稀疏模拟表明森林特征采样可能使信息特征被遗漏。
Conclusion: 结果支持CIF作为下游预测基准中的top-k特征排序方法。

papers.title: Beyond Heatmaps: Unsupervised Concept-Graph Reasoning for Interpretable Visual Explanation
authors: Daniel Sonntag (1 and 3) ((1) German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI)
papers.abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) provide an intrinsically interpretable alternative to post-hoc explanations. However, existing CBMs often rely on predefined concept vocabularies or supervised annotations, lack explicit concept grounding, and summarize each concept with a single image-level score -- discarding spatial recurrence and inter-concept dependencies. We propose a Graph-based Concept Bottleneck Model (G-CBM), an intrinsically interpretable framework that performs unsupervised concept discovery via Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) and represents the discovered concepts as nodes in a per-image concept-graph representation. G-CBM matches region-level features to these concept nodes -- providing concept grounding and capturing concept recurrence across the image -- and applies a \emph{tunable concept filtering threshold} $τ$ to suppress weak region-level features. A Graph Attention Network (GAT) then performs concept-level reasoning by modeling nonlinear dependencies across nodes. Across ImageNet, HAM10000, PH2, and Derm7pt, G-CBM achieves an average relative AUC improvement of 3.7\% over a ResNet-50 baseline. Concept filtering frequently improves predictive performance while inducing selective concept use, achieving peak AUC of $0.96$ on PH2 with only 2 of 10 concepts and 0.92 on HAM10000 with 3.8 of 9 concepts. On dermoscopy benchmarks, G-CBM is competitive with supervised approaches requiring external annotations. Deletion/insertion analyses with random ablation controls show that the learned concept ranking faithfully reflects model predictions.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Workshop on Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI), Bremen, Germany. 7 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图的概念瓶颈模型（G-CBM），通过非负矩阵分解（NMF）进行无监督概念发现，并将概念表示为图像级别的概念图节点。利用图注意力网络（GAT）对节点间的非线性依赖进行推理，并在多个图像基准上（ImageNet、HAM10000、PH2、Derm7pt）平均相对AUC提升3.7%，同时实现稀疏概念使用。
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBM）依赖预定义概念词汇或监督标注，缺乏显式概念基础，且用单图像级分数概括每个概念，忽略了空间重复性和概念间依赖关系。
Method: 提出G-CBM框架：使用NMF进行无监督概念发现，将发现的概念作为节点构建每张图像的概念图；通过可调概念过滤阈值抑制弱区域特征；利用图注意力网络（GAT）建模节点间的非线性依赖进行推理。
Result: 在ImageNet、HAM10000、PH2、Derm7pt上，G-CBM平均相对AUC比ResNet-50基线提升3.7%；概念过滤常能提升性能，例如在PH2上仅用2/10个概念达到AUC 0.96，在HAM10000上用3.8/9个概念达到0.92；在皮肤镜基准上与需要外部标注的监督方法竞争。
Conclusion: G-CBM通过无监督概念发现和概念图推理提供可解释性，且概念排名忠实反映模型预测。

papers.title: The Rollout Infrastructure Tax in Coding-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Coding-agent reinforcement learning treats execution infrastructure as a background implementation detail, despite relying on large numbers of interactive software rollouts. This is a missed opportunity: measuring infrastructure overhead can reveal practical efficiency gains for RL post-training, where small per-rollout savings compound at scale. We present a comparative study of four execution substrates: single containers, hosted sandboxes, Kubernetes-orchestrated containers, and cloud virtual machines. We find up to $110\times$ variation in cold-start latency and a $1.8\times$ spread in projected worker-hours for one million 150-step trajectories. Our results suggest that future coding-agent RL systems should optimize execution substrates as part of the training system itself, not merely as deployment plumbing.
papers.comment: Preprint. 6 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ACM SoCC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究编码智能体强化学习中执行基础设施的开销，发现不同执行子层间冷启动延迟差异高达110倍，在百万级轨迹任务中工人小时数差异达1.8倍。作者认为未来应把执行子层优化纳入训练系统设计，而非仅视为部署细节。
Motivation: 现有编码智能体强化学习将执行基础设施视为背景实现细节，忽略了基础设施开销的量化分析。随着训练规模扩大，单次回合并行开销的累积效应可能显著影响整体效率。
Method: 对比四种执行子层（单容器、托管沙箱、Kubernetes编排容器、云虚拟机），测量冷启动延迟和模拟大规模训练轨迹的工人小时数。
Result: 冷启动延迟最大差异达110倍；在100万次150步轨迹模拟中，预计工人小时数差异为1.8倍。
Conclusion: 编码智能体强化学习系统应在训练阶段优化执行子层，而非仅将其视为部署基础设施。

papers.title: BIFROST: Bridging Invariant Feature Representation for Observation-space Sim2Real Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Sim2real transfer for robot policy learning suffers due to mismatch between simulation and reality. Existing methods typically address each gap in isolation through separate adaptation modules, which are composed or layered when both gaps coexist. Yet the basis for attempting sim2real in the first place is that there is shared structure between a task in simulation and reality, where equivalent actions from equivalent configurations produce equivalent long term outcomes regardless of domain specific differences in rendering or physics. In this paper, we study whether we can identify and exploit this shared structure from raw observations to train a policy that enables zero shot transfer. We introduce BIFROST, which learns a shared history encoder on paired cross-domain data via cross-domain bisimulation objective: observation-action sequences leading to equivalent long-term behavior are mapped to nearby latent states, regardless of domain. Policies trained on these latent states in simulation transfer zero-shot to reality. We provide empirical evidence on sim2sim visual navigation and sim2real contact rich manipulation task and visual servoing task that BIFROST achieves effective transfer where domain adaptation and co-training baselines fail under both visual and dynamics domain gaps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BIFROST方法，通过跨域双模拟（cross-domain bisimulation）目标从配对交叉域数据中学习共享历史编码器，使得在不同域中产生等价长期行为的观测-动作序列映射到相近的隐状态，从而在仿真中训练的策略可以零样本迁移到真实世界。在模拟到模拟的视觉导航和模拟到真实的接触丰富操作及视觉伺服任务中，BIFROST在视觉和动态域差异下实现了有效迁移，而领域自适应和协同训练基线失败。
Motivation: 现有sim2real方法通常分别处理渲染和物理差异，通过独立适应模块组合或堆叠，但未能充分利用模拟与现实任务间的共享结构，导致迁移效果有限。
Method: BIFROST学习一个共享历史编码器，通过跨域双模拟目标对配对跨域数据（观测-动作序列）进行训练，使得导致等价长期行为的序列在隐空间中靠近，忽略域差异。策略在仿真隐状态上训练后零样本迁移到真实域。
Result: 在模拟到模拟视觉导航和模拟到真实接触丰富操作及视觉伺服任务中，BIFROST实现了有效的零样本迁移，而领域自适应和协同训练基线在视觉和动态域差异同时存在时失败。
Conclusion: BIFROST表明，通过识别和利用模拟与真实任务间的共享结构，可以从原始观测学习到跨域不变的策略，实现零样本sim2real迁移。

papers.title: GPUAlert: A Zero-Instrumentation Process-Boundary Monitor for Diagnosing GPU Training-Job Failures
papers.abstract_en: GPU training jobs fail often, roughly two in five on large production clusters, yet the operator typically learns of a failure only by reconnecting hours later. Experiment trackers require editing the training script and maintaining a cloud connection; the scheduler's mail hook delivers a single status line with no cause and no logs. GPUAlert is a command-line wrapper that monitors any training command at the process boundary, and with no change to that command, emails a structured notification on completion carrying a classified failure cause, durable logs, and output artifacts. The tool is organized around three reliability primitives: a pre-launch log guarantee that establishes the durable destination before the child process can crash, notifier isolation that makes the wrapper's exit code a pure function of the child's status regardless of whether the email succeeds, and a non-silent artifact budget that bounds attachment size without ever dropping output silently. We release a labelled corpus of 474 GPU training logs across 15 failure classes and a reproducible evaluation harness. On the twelve hardware-reproduced classes, the ordered-rule classifier reaches 0.997 macro-F1, against 0.830 for unordered keyword matching and 0.133 for exit-code inspection. Wrapper overhead is a constant approximately 3ms per job; the pre-launch guarantee preserves a log where a shell redirect yields nothing; and across all 15 failure modes the wrapper returns the child's exit code unchanged even when the SMTP relay is unreachable.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables,3 Listings. Submitted as an arXiv preprint. Source, corpus and evaluation harness available at https://github.com/Parv-01/gpualert and https://github.com/Parv-01/gpualert-eval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GPUAlert，一个无需修改训练脚本的命令行包装器，在进程边界监控GPU训练命令，并在任务完成时发送结构化邮件通知，包含分类的失败原因、持久化日志和输出工件。工具基于三个可靠性原语：预启动日志保证、通知隔离和非静默工件预算。作者释放了包含15个失败类别的474个GPU训练日志语料库和可复现评估框架。在12个硬件复现的失败类别上，顺序规则分类器达到0.997 macro-F1。
Motivation: GPU训练任务在大规模生产集群中经常失败（约五分之二），但运维人员通常数小时后才通过重连得知失败，实验追踪器需要修改脚本并保持云连接，调度器的邮件钩子只提供单行状态而无原因和日志。缺乏零侵入的失败诊断工具。
Method: 提出GPUAlert，一个命令行包装器，在进程边界监控任意训练命令，无需修改命令即可发送结构化通知。包含三个可靠性原语：预启动日志保证（在子进程启动前建立持久化日志目的地）、通知隔离（包装器退出码仅取决于子进程状态，与邮件是否成功无关）、非静默工件预算（限制附件大小但不静默丢弃输出）。基于标注的474个日志语料库构建顺序规则分类器。
Result: 在12个硬件可复现的失败类别上，顺序规则分类器达到0.997 macro-F1，对比无序关键字匹配的0.830和退出码检查的0.133。包装器开销恒定为每次任务约3ms；预启动保证在shell重定向无法产生日志时仍能保留日志；在所有15种失败模式下，即使SMTP中继不可达，包装器也返回与子进程相同的退出码。
Conclusion: GPUAlert以零侵入方式实现了GPU训练任务失败的结构化诊断和通知，且保持子进程退出码不变，具有极低的开销和鲁棒的日志保证。

summary_sections.motivation: GPU训练任务在大规模生产集群中经常失败（约五分之二），但运维人员通常数小时后才通过重连得知失败，实验追踪器需要修改脚本并保持云连接，调度器的邮件钩子只提供单行状态而无原因和日志。缺乏零侵入的失败诊断工具。
summary_sections.method: 提出GPUAlert，一个命令行包装器，在进程边界监控任意训练命令，无需修改命令即可发送结构化通知。包含三个可靠性原语：预启动日志保证（在子进程启动前建立持久化日志目的地）、通知隔离（包装器退出码仅取决于子进程状态，与邮件是否成功无关）、非静默工件预算（限制附件大小但不静默丢弃输出）。基于标注的474个日志语料库构建顺序规则分类器。
summary_sections.result: 在12个硬件可复现的失败类别上，顺序规则分类器达到0.997 macro-F1，对比无序关键字匹配的0.830和退出码检查的0.133。包装器开销恒定为每次任务约3ms；预启动保证在shell重定向无法产生日志时仍能保留日志；在所有15种失败模式下，即使SMTP中继不可达，包装器也返回与子进程相同的退出码。
summary_sections.conclusion: GPUAlert以零侵入方式实现了GPU训练任务失败的结构化诊断和通知，且保持子进程退出码不变，具有极低的开销和鲁棒的日志保证。

papers.title: Spin-Weighted Spherical Harmonics Enable Complete and Scalable $\mathrm{E}(3)$-Equivariant Networks
papers.abstract_en: $\mathrm{E}(3)$-equivariant networks are promising for 3D atomistic system modeling, yet their scalability is limited by the $O(L^6)$ complexity of the Clebsch-Gordan Tensor Product (CGTP). The recently proposed Gaunt Tensor Product (GTP) reduces the complexity but is unable to capture the antisymmetric paths, resulting in incomplete expressivity. In this work, we present SpinGTP, an approach to overcome the GTP incompleteness by generalizing from scalar functions to Spin-Weighted Spherical Harmonics (SWSH). By relying on the algebraic properties of SWSH, SpinGTP recovers the missing antisymmetric interactions while maintaining the asymptotic efficiency of GTP. It also allows for a more expressive equivariant basis that naturally accounts for the parity-odd components of tensor products. We evaluate SpinGTP across diverse benchmarks, including Tetris, 3BPA, SPICE-MACE-OFF, and OC20. Our results show that SpinGTP achieves accuracies comparable to full CGTP. Notably, by explicitly capturing antisymmetric paths, SpinGTP exhibits superior performance in tasks involving chiral materials and non-centrosymmetric geometries. This work provides a complete, scalable, and mathematically rigorous path toward high-order equivariance in large-scale 3D atomistic system simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpinGTP，通过自旋加权球谐函数(SWSH)扩展Gaunt Tensor Product，以恢复反对称相互作用路径，实现完整的E(3)-等变网络。该方法将CGTP的O(L^6)复杂度降为O(L^3)量级，同时保持完整表达能力。实验表明，SpinGTP在多个3D原子系统基准上达到与全CGTP相当的精度，在手性和非中心对称几何体任务中表现更优。
Motivation: 现有E(3)-等变网络受限于CGTP的O(L^6)复杂度，而近期GTP虽然降低复杂度但丢失反对称路径，表达能力不完整。需要一种同时具有高效性和完整表达能力的方案。
Method: 将标量球谐函数推广为自旋加权球谐函数(SWSH)，利用其代数性质设计SpinGTP，在不增加渐近复杂度的前提下恢复反对称相互作用，并自然地包含张量积的奇偶奇分量。
Result: 在Tetris、3BPA、SPICE-MACE-OFF、OC20等基准上，SpinGTP取得与全CGTP相当的精度。在手性材料和非中心对称几何体任务中，由于显式捕获反对称路径，性能优于现有方法。
Conclusion: SpinGTP提供了实现高阶等变性的完整、可扩展且数学严谨的路径，适用于大规模3D原子系统模拟。

papers.title: NeuroBridge: Bridging Multi-Task MRI Knowledge for Neurodegenerative Disease Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Accurate MRI-based identification of Alzheimer's disease (AD), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and related dementias remains challenging because disease-related structural changes are often subtle and heterogeneous. We developed NeuroBridge, a clinically guided multi-task MRI framework for neurodegenerative disease diagnosis. METHODS: NeuroBridge integrates large-scale self-supervised MRI pretraining with hippocampal segmentation, hippocampal atrophy classification, and reconstruction objectives, followed by gated fusion fine-tuning. Performance was evaluated across ADNI and OASIS cohorts, including cross-cohort transfer, probability-based analysis, and opportunistic screening. RESULTS: NeuroBridge achieved the highest performance across evaluated classification tasks, reaching 88.17% accuracy for AD versus cognitively normal controls in ADNI and 82.78% in OASIS. The largest gains occurred in MCI-related and mixed-diagnosis settings. The framework demonstrated strong cross-cohort generalization, systematic associations between predicted-class probability and accuracy, and the feasibility of probability-based opportunistic screening. DISCUSSION: Clinically guided multi-task representation learning improves neurodegenerative MRI diagnosis beyond conventional single-task approaches. NeuroBridge provides a robust and scalable framework for dementia assessment and MRI-based opportunistic screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuroBridge 是一个基于多任务 MRI 的神经退行性疾病诊断框架，结合大规模自监督预训练、海马体分割、萎缩分类和重建目标，再通过门控融合微调。在 ADNI 和 OASIS 数据集上，对阿尔茨海默病与正常对照的分类准确率分别达到 88.17% 和 82.78%，在轻度认知障碍和混合诊断场景中提升最大，并展示了良好的跨队列泛化能力和概率驱动的机会性筛查潜力。
Motivation: 基于 MRI 的阿尔茨海默病、轻度认知障碍及相关痴呆症诊断因疾病相关结构变化细微且异质而具有挑战性，现有单任务方法性能有限。
Method: 集成大规模自监督 MRI 预训练与海马体分割、海马体萎缩分类和重建三个任务，然后使用门控融合微调。
Result: 在 ADNI 和 OASIS 队列中，AD 与正常对照分类准确率分别为 88.17% 和 82.78%；在 MCI 相关和混合诊断场景中增益最大；具有强跨队列泛化能力和基于概率的机会性筛查可行性。
Conclusion: 临床引导的多任务表示学习优于传统单任务方法，NeuroBridge 为痴呆评估和 MRI 机会性筛查提供了鲁棒且可扩展的框架。

papers.title: A global predicted-fMRI drive signal from TRIBE does not predict YouTube replay heatmaps
papers.abstract_en: Deep multimodal brain-encoding models now predict fMRI responses to naturalistic video with high accuracy. Whether their predicted neural signals also forecast behavioral engagement is unknown. We run TRIBE, the winning model of the 2025 Algonauts brain-encoding challenge (Llama-3.2 + V-JEPA2 + Wav2Vec-BERT), on 48 YouTube videos and reduce its predicted cortical response to a per-second engagement curve, the global field power. Correlated against each video's "most replayed" heatmap, a passively-collected proxy for which moments viewers return to, the curve shows no evidence of predicting re-watch behavior. The pooled position-controlled partial correlation is +0.058 (95% CI [-0.04, 0.15]; one-sample t(47)=1.21, p=0.23), indistinguishable from zero and not significantly above simple loudness and motion baselines (loudness +0.04, paired p=0.74). The raw correlation is also near zero; the moderate values reported for music videos reflect a genre-specific intro/onset-replay artifact rather than content prediction, and do not generalize. The null holds across six cortical-network readouts and under an autocorrelation-preserving permutation test. We release the code, the video-ID manifest, and an acquisition method that works despite YouTube's SABR-only streaming.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 1 figure. Code, video-ID manifest, and per-video results: https://github.com/mercurialsolo/tribe-replay-heatmaps
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文测试了2025年Algonauts脑编码挑战赛冠军模型TRIBE预测fMRI信号与YouTube视频回放行为之间的关联。结果表明，TRIBE预测的全局场功率与视频的“最重播”热图几乎没有相关性，且并不优于简单的音量和运动基线，该结论在多个皮层网络读取和自相关保持置换检验下依然成立。
Motivation: 深度多模态脑编码模型已能高精度预测自然视频的fMRI响应，但这些预测神经信号是否能预测行为参与度（如视频回放行为）尚不明确。
Method: 使用TRIBE模型（Llama-3.2 + V-JEPA2 + Wav2Vec-BERT）处理48个YouTube视频，将预测的皮层响应降维为每秒的全局场功率曲线，并与视频的“最重播”热图进行相关性分析，包括部分相关和置换检验。
Result: 全局场功率与回放行为无显著相关：合并位置控制的部分相关系数为+0.058（95% CI [-0.04, 0.15]; t(47)=1.21, p=0.23），与零无差异，且未显著优于简单响度基线（+0.04, paired p=0.74）。原始相关也接近零，音乐视频中的中等值归因于体裁特定的开头/重播伪影，不可推广。
Conclusion: 预测的fMRI信号无法预测YouTube视频的观众重播行为，提示当前脑编码模型在行为预测上存在局限。

papers.title: Computer Vision for Wildlife Monitoring: Detecting Brown Howler Monkeys using YOLO
papers.abstract_en: Urban expansion threatens global biodiversity, especially affecting arboreal species due to the fragmentation of forest habitats. The movement of arboreal species across disjointed forest patches increases mortality risk and, thus, compromises their conservation. In this context, the installation of canopy bridges can be a viable strategy; yet continuous monitoring of their use by arboreal species is essential for ensuring their effectiveness, typically carried out with the aid of camera traps. However, this method often produces false-positive images that demand time from conservationists for review. In this context, computer vision algorithms can optimize the task of detecting target species using the canopy bridges. In this study, we explored the automatic detection of brown howler monkeys (Alouatta guariba) in videos obtained by camera traps. Given the need for a large number of annotated images of the target animals to train the algorithms, we tested the incorporation of auxiliary data to improve detection models, fine-tuning the YOLOv10 framework using varying proportions of them. The improvement of these automatic detection techniques contributes to conservation efforts, by providing automatic tools to monitor solutions that minimize the impact of human interference in animals habitats.
papers.comment: Accepted on International Conference on Computer Animation, Social Agents, and Extended Reality '26 (CASAXR 26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨利用YOLOv10框架自动检测摄像机陷阱视频中的褐吼猴（Alouatta guariba），通过加入辅助数据微调模型以提高检测准确性，旨在减少野生动物监测中的假阳性图像，为保护工作提供自动化工具。
Motivation: 城市化导致森林碎片化，树栖物种穿越断片森林时风险增加，树冠桥是有效缓解措施，但需要持续监测。传统摄像机陷阱产生大量假阳性图像，耗费人力审查，亟需自动检测技术。
Method: 使用YOLOv10框架，通过微调并测试不同比例的辅助数据（标注图像）来提升褐吼猴的自动检测性能。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但表明加入辅助数据可改善检测模型，有助于减少人工审查负担。
Conclusion: 该研究为树冠桥使用情况的自动监测提供可行方案，支持保护工作，减少人为干扰对动物栖息地的影响。

papers.title: Rethinking Generic Object Tracking Toward Human-Level Perceptual Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: At the heart of human visual perception lies the ability to maintain a continuous and coherent understanding of the external world. By integrating observations with accumulated experience, the human visual system can continuously adapt to variations in both the target and its surrounding environment, while preserving robust visual continuity as scene dynamics evolve. Human vision can therefore integrate prior knowledge, spatial geometry, and semantic context to understand complex scenes and their changes. As a core problem in computer vision, visual object tracking aims to bring machine perception closer to human visual perception. These capabilities are central to the task of Generic Object Tracking (GOT). In this task, a visual tracker is initialized only with the bounding box of an arbitrarily specified target in the first frame, and must continuously localize the target in subsequent dynamic visual streams. However, future events, observations, and real-world variations are inherently unpredictable; therefore, the model's generalization and online adaptation capabilities remain bottlenecks. Tracking reliability can deteriorate when the target undergoes severe deformation, is affected by complex distractors, encounters significant environmental changes, or belongs to a category unseen during training. This dissertation aims to narrow the gap between machine visual tracking systems and human visual perception by proposing a series of methods that systematically enhance the target discrimination, robust adaptation, and geometric reasoning capabilities of tracking models.
papers.comment: Ph.D. dissertation, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, 2026. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2602.14771
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇博士论文，旨在通过提出一系列方法系统性地增强目标判别、鲁棒适应和几何推理能力，从而缩小机器视觉跟踪系统与人类视觉感知之间的差距。论文聚焦于通用目标跟踪（GOT），该任务要求仅根据第一帧的边界框初始化，在后续动态视觉流中持续定位目标。
Motivation: 通用目标跟踪中，模型泛化性和在线自适应能力是瓶颈，当目标发生严重变形、受复杂干扰影响、遭遇显著环境变化或属于训练未见的类别时，跟踪可靠性会下降。
Method: 提出一系列方法系统性地增强跟踪模型的目标判别、鲁棒适应和几何推理能力。
Result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，仅指出旨在通过所提方法缩小机器视觉与人类视觉感知的差距。
Conclusion: 本论文目标是通过增强目标判别、鲁棒适应和几何推理能力来缩小机器视觉跟踪系统与人类视觉感知之间的差距。
